### [3120-continuator](/dream/3120-continuator) · adult / duet · musical-stakes · **a two-way vocal duet partner that learns YOUR idiom live — you sing a phrase, it goes quiet and folds what you sang into a running model of your style, then sings back a NEW phrase that is recognisably *you* but never a literal repeat; the model accumulates so the duet at minute 8 differs from second 0 because of what you sang** / the lab's **first generative turn-taking instrument** (every prior voice piece either *follows a known score* — `2920-follow` — or tracks pitch into a shader; this one *generates a novel answer* to your live stream) and its **first online statistical model of the player**. **The concept:** the jury (2026-07-27) asked to get off the fragment shader, raise the bar from *dial* to *decision*, and extend `2920-follow` "toward a real song and a real duet." This is that extension — a partner with **memory** that answers *in your voice*, audio-primary, rendered entirely in **SVG** (no WebGL/shader). **The response engine (`model.ts`) — an online idiom model:** a **variable-order Markov / prefix tree** built live over your sung material. Each sung note becomes a `(interval, duration)` pair — the interval is the pitch change from the previous note **in cents, kept continuous, never snapped to equal temperament** (contexts are bucketed at ~40-cent bins for *keying only*, while the stored continuations are the exact continuous values). For every position and order *k*=0…3, the model records the length-*k* context → the continuation that followed; repeats accumulate weight. `ingestPhrase()` folds each turn in; `generatePhrase()` walks a new phrase trying the **highest available context order** and **backing off** to a lower order when the recent context is unseen (Pachet's core mechanism), samples a stored continuation, emits its continuous interval+duration (±6-cent humanising jitter), anchors it in your register, and reflects back in if a run would drift off-voice — so the answer is genuinely new yet built from *your own* material. **The growth is legible (jury #5 long-form memory):** `modelStats()` surfaces idiom-contexts learned / notes heard / phrases ingested, and each answer reports the max context order it actually reached (deepens 0→2+ as repeats accrue) — so a short review *sees* the model getting richer. **Named reference:** **François Pachet, *The Continuator* (2002/2003)** — the canonical system that continues a musician's playing in their own style via a variable-order Markov model with back-off; this is a small vocal homage. **Input = voice/mic** (jury-sanctioned exception: the raw last-10 count has voice ≈4×, but the jury *explicitly asked to extend the voice piece 2920-follow*, which overrides the audit count — and this is generative turn-taking, distinct from 2920's score-following, 2928's harmony, 3048's voice-into-shader). **Output = SVG** (deliberately — SVG had cratered to 1× in the window; steers hard off the 8×-in-15 WebGL2 fragment-shader monoculture the jury banned). **Subsystems (≥4):** autocorrelation pitch (parabolic-interp, continuous Hz, voice-gated) + streaming `NoteSegmenter` (>75-cent jump / RMS gate, drops <90ms blips) + the variable-order Markov idiom model + two Fant source–filter **formant** voices (partner + a brighter baked-human, glided via `setTargetAtTime`, shared reverb tail) + the SVG two-lane transcript with playhead & growth readout. **Turn machine:** `LISTENING → THINKING (ingest) → ANSWERING (sing) → LISTENING`, your turn ending on a >450ms silence gap after ≥2 notes. **Degrades fully:** AudioContext opens only on a Start/Play gesture; no mic → a seeded **`mulberry32(0x3096)`** autopilot feeds six baked human contours through the *exact same* ingest→generate→sing pipeline (repeated presses visibly enrich the model) + an on-brand `text-destructive` notice; **Forget everything** re-seeds; no strobe; full teardown (rAF, timers, oscillators, mic tracks, context) on stop/unmount. **Ambition — 4/5:** #1 (first generative turn-taking + first online player-model in the lab) · #2 (≥3 subsystems, ~4–5 above) · #3 (Pachet's Continuator) · #5 (RESEARCH §923 same-date — StreamMUSE / real-time LM jamming, June 2026; the visible today's-research→today's-build chain). **diversity:** last-10 ≈ [2952,2960,2992,3008,3048,3080,3056,3040]; `banned` (JURY-2026-07-27) = [a **fresh drug-free altered-states** piece (over-pumped 8×) · **WebGL2 fragment-shader as default output** (8× — forced a non-shader register) · the shared **visionary kit driven by one scalar** · re-adding the **JI/pentatonic net**]; `picked` = [**voice** input (jury-sanctioned "extend 2920") · **SVG / audio-primary** output (off the shader; SVG was 1×) · **online-Markov generative call-and-response** technique (0× in the lab) · **duet / musical-conversation** vibe (NOT altered-states — a decision with stakes, the human owns the melody)] — clears every live ban; continuous pitch protected. **mode:** DEEP (ledger 916 D · 917 W · 918 D · 919 W · 920 D · 921 W · 922 D → **923 D**; the jury named an exceptional piece to *extend* — 2920-follow — which AGENT.md maps to DEEP-on-X, overriding the W/D alternation). ONE north star — *a duet partner that learns you and answers in your voice* — raced across three response engines. **candidates:** 3120-continuator(win — freshest technique, canonical Pachet ref, cashes jury #5 memory, truest extension of 2920 toward a *learning* duet, deterministic self-demo with legible growth) · 3112-antiphon(banked ⭐⭐ HIGH, IDEAS §923 — strict canon-by-transformation, Fux; the cleanest/most-visually-legible but the more *inevitable* concept) · 3128-jugalbandi(banked ⭐, IDEAS §923 — shadow-and-lead real-time harmonizer, sawal-jawab; held on TWO strikes: its lead snaps to a **JI scale grid** — the jury-protected net — and its live-shadow latency is unverifiable headless). Both losers `rm -rf`'d after banking full IDEAS §923 briefs, before the authoritative build (never committed). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + SVG + getUserMedia; zero new npm deps, no server route, no network, no secrets). **Validation:** normalizer = **0 rewrites** (on-brand: semantic-token chrome, raw color confined to the SVG art layer in violet, `min-h-[44px]`/`rounded-md` buttons, no `text-white`/`font-serif`/off-brand-hue chrome; helpers named `make*`/`draw*`/`render*` — no non-hook `use*`); folder `next lint --max-warnings 0` = clean; both losers banked then removed before the authoritative winner-only `next build --experimental-build-mode compile` (the 4096-fd container gate per every recent cycle; Vercel runs the full pipeline on deploy). **NOT eye/ear-verified** (headless — no display/speakers/mic): whether the two formant voices read as distinct warm companions, whether autocorrelation+segmenter handle a real breathy voice cleanly, and whether the answers *feel* "more like you" at minute 8 all want Karel's device; the seeded 6-contour autopilot + live contexts/notes/order readout are the silent-review stand-ins. `theme: a duet partner that learns your idiom and answers in your voice (Pachet's Continuator, sung) · state: n/a (deliberately NOT altered-states — the jury's cooling-week) · pole: n/a · vibe: musical-conversation, real stakes`. status: **demoable**

### [3040-tunnel](/dream/3040-tunnel) · adult / cosmic-ambient · **pilot your own passage down the near-death "tunnel toward the light" — hold to bloom the being-of-light closer, let go to drift back into the void, and go completely still and time itself dilates, slowing image AND sound as one** / the lab's **first raymarching piece** and **first piloted 3-D camera-flight**, and the **first spatial use of the shared visionary kit** (`shepard` + `droneBank` + `convolutionVoid`). **The concept:** a drug-free evocation of the near-death / dissociative *tunnel* phenomenology, built as a **piloted instrument, not a self-playing simulation** — you fly it moment to moment (directly answers JURY-2026-07-26 #2, "put a hand back on the instrument"). **The technique (`raymarch.ts`):** a single full-screen **WebGL2 fragment shader** sphere-traces (raymarches, 96 steps) a camera flying down an **infinite tube SDF** on a slow **Lissajous** centreline — an endless wormhole with a **being-of-light core** far down the bore, exponential **depth fog** thinning toward the light, **fake gravitational light-bending** (each march step nudges the ray toward the core — the browser black-hole-lensing lineage), an animated **tunnel-vision vignette** constricting the periphery, and procedural **value-noise wall striations/caustics** on the shared brand-violet ramp (`_shared/palette` `PALETTE_GLSL`); filmic tone-map bounds the swells. **One gesture, felt three ways:** **hold** (pointer / Space / persistent button) → `approach` eases up: core nearer + brighter bloom, ray-bend harder, vignette closes, fog thins, drone lowpass opens, Shepard **descent** glissando brightens; **release** → drift back into the darker, wetter, foggier void; **go still** → a global `timeScale` decays toward near-stillness (`TIME_MIN 0.12`) that scales the shader clock, the camera travel, AND the audio glide's `dt` **together** — image and sound dilate as one (the signature); any input blooms it back. **Input = pointer-drag + device-tilt (iOS-gated `requestPermission()`) + WASD/arrows**, all summed into one heading — deliberately **NOT mic** (≈4× over-used in last-10). **Output = WebGL2 raymarch** (the under-used GPU lane; steers off the recent Canvas2D streak). **Audio (`audio.ts`):** shared `shepard` (`dir:-1` plunge carrier, `drive=approach`, `step(dilatedDt)`) + `droneBank` (JI sub-floor, lowpass opens toward light) + `convolutionVoid` (wetter in the void) → master **≤0.14** → dilation lowpass → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter. **Degrades fully:** AudioContext opens only on the Begin gesture; `webgl2` null / shader-compile fail → a **Canvas2D concentric-tunnel** (`makeTunnelFallback`) answering the same controls + audio; seeded **`mulberry32(0x3040)`** autopilot flies a slow S-curve so it self-demos headless (flying within ~1s; hands back to autopilot after 3s idle); `prefers-reduced-motion` slows the flight, disables the clarity/bloom snap, softens the vignette, narrows dilation; full teardown (rAF, `WEBGL_lose_context`, audio engines, AudioContext, all listeners). **Named refs:** Raymond Moody *Life After Life* (1975) · Pim van Lommel et al., *Lancet* NDE study (2001) · Borjigin et al. gamma-surge in the dying brain (PNAS 2013/2023 — **evocation only**) · Shepard–Risset endless glissando · the browser gravitational-lensing / black-hole raymarch lineage (2026 *Singularity* Three.js/TSL showcase). **Ambition — 4/5:** #1 (first raymarching + first piloted 3-D flight + first spatial use of the void/shepard kit) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: pointer/tilt/keys pilot + WebGL2 raymarch renderer + time-dilation engine + shepard/drone/void audio = 4) · #3 (Moody/van Lommel/Shepard-Risset/Singularity) · #5 (RESEARCH §922 same-date — browser lensing + half-res god-rays; the visible today's-research→today's-build chain). **diversity:** last-10 = [2920,2928,2952,2960,2992,3008,3048,3080,3056]; `banned` = JURY-2026-07-26 [science/data-system sonification (whole *kind*) · input-free self-play default · clinical diagram-as-score vibe · re-adding the JI/pentatonic net] + audit [**mic ≈4×** (2920/2928/3048/3056-breath) — avoided]; ### [3056-clearlight](/dream/3056-clearlight) · adult / cosmic-ambient · **breathe a boundless clear light into being — slow, steady breathing brightens an edge-free Ganzfeld field until faint hallucinatory form-constants surface from it; your breath is the only instrument** / the lab's **first Ganzfeld piece** and the **first real use of the shared `_shared/visionary` kit** (`safeFlicker` + `shepard` + `droneBank` + `convolutionVoid`, unused since 2026-07-23). **The concept:** a Ganzfeld is an unstructured, edge-free field the eye can't fix on, so internally-generated imagery surfaces and the field's perceived brightness tracks the viewer's relaxed, alpha-rich state. **Breath → light + sound:** the mic is read as a *slow amplitude envelope* (~5.5 breaths/min) by a self-scaling follower (`breath.ts` — fast attack / slow release, never pitch or FFT tone); that ONE scalar (a) expands + warms a center-out clear-light bloom on the inhale, (b) swells a just-intonation drone (`droneBank`) through a long convolution-void tail (`convolutionVoid`) + lifts a low Shepard–Risset shimmer (`shepard`) for boundlessness, (c) gates faint **form-constants** — concentric rings (shared `formConstant`) + a soft log spiral, the shapes a uniform field amplifies — that a **calm accumulator** (~34 s rise / ~4.5 s fall) fades up near-subliminally as steady breathing persists; agitation scatters them back to noise. A 5.5-bpm **pacer ring** to breathe with. **Output = Canvas2D** (`field.ts` — soft radial luminance wash, imperceptibly slow violet-arc hue drift; raw color confined to the art layer). **Input = mic-breath** (RMS envelope — a new input for the lab; distinct from voice-pitch). **Degrades fully:** AudioContext opens only on the Begin gesture; mic denied/absent/headless → a seeded **`mulberry32(0x3056)`** synthetic ~5.5-bpm breath self-demos the piece + an on-brand `text-destructive` notice; never throws; full teardown (tracks stopped, AudioContext closed, rAF cancelled, resize listener removed). **Safety:** the field is slow luminance *drift* by default; an OPT-IN photic pulse sits behind a **two-step photosensitivity warning**, hard-capped **≤3 flashes/sec** by the shared `SafeFlicker` (never a high-contrast strobe), instant kill, forced sub-perceptual under prefers-reduced-motion. **Named refs:** Brion Gysin's *Dreamachine* (1959) · Collective Act's *Dreamachine* (2022) · the Ganzflicker alpha-brightening literature (dual-alpha: entrainment + eye-closure rebound) · *"From dots to faces"*, Neuroscience of Consciousness **2026**(1) niag016 (imagery capacity predicts flicker-hallucination content). **Ambition — 4/5:** #1 (first Ganzfeld + first real use of the shared visionary/safeFlicker kit) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: breath analysis + safe photic engine + Ganzfeld/form-constant renderer + shepard/drone/void audio = 4) · #3 (Gysin/Collective Act) · #5 (RESEARCH §921 same-date — Ganzflicker alpha-brightening + niag016 2026; AGENT Decide option (c)). **diversity:** last-10 = [2912,2920,2928,2952,2960,2992,3008,3048,3080]; `banned` = JURY-2026-07-26 [science/data-system sonification (whole *kind*) · input-free self-play as default · clinical diagram-as-score vibe · re-adding the JI/pentatonic net] + audit soft-watch [mic 3× · Canvas2D 3× · WebGL2 3×]; `picked` = [**mic-breath** input (breath-RMS envelope — a hand/lung on it moment-to-moment, clears input-free; a new input distinct from the recent voice-pitch mic use) · **Canvas2D** output · **Ganzfeld + safe-flicker** technique (0×, NOT science-sonification — a *played* meditative instrument) · **soft-white-boundless meditative cosmic-ambient** vibe (Karel's requested pole, balances 3048-intense + 3080-organic)] — clears every live ban; continuous pitch protected (drone is JI-flavoured but never scale-*snaps* the breath input). **mode:** WIDE (ledger 916 D · 917 W · 918 D · 919 W · 920 D → **921 WIDE**; three altered states of the CALM pole — meditation / near-death / dissociation — each entered by a human hand). **candidates:** 3056-clearlight(win — most product-relevant to Resonance's breath/meditation core, cleanest research→build chain, first use of the visionary kit, lowest 06:30-phone risk on Canvas2D, highest ambition 4/5) · 3040-tunnel(banked ⭐⭐ HIGH, IDEAS §921 — NDE-wormhole WebGL2 raymarch you pilot; ### [3008-daylight](/dream/3008-daylight) · adult / cosmic-ambient · **what if the light in your ROOM were the instrument — the camera reads the environment (brightness, warm↔cool colour, motion), NOT your body, and turns it into one slow living continuous-pitch chord you shape by cupping the lens, waving a hand, or walking to a window?** / the **inverse colour-organ** — Scriabin's *tastiera per luce* in *Prometheus: Poem of Fire* (1910) and Castel's *clavecin oculaire* (1730s) both turned sound→light; Daylight runs the arrow the other way, light→sound. Deliberately breaks a now-**5-cycle solo-hand-instrument groove** (913 sing-follow · 914 sing-harmony · 915 tabla · 916 murmuration · 917 around) with an **environment-as-instrument** register while still keeping a human responsible moment-to-moment (cup/wave/move → instant audible response — dodges JURY-2026-07-26's input-free ban), covers the **cosmic-ambient pole** Karel asked for, and leans into the **loved camera cluster** (101/104/138/217/1482). **The concept:** the whole camera frame is downscaled to 64×48 and reduced each frame (`vision.ts` `LightSensor`) to three smoothed scalars — **L** mean perceptual luminance (heavily one-pole-smoothed so the chord *breathes*), **H** warm↔cool balance (R vs B), **M** mean absolute frame-diff motion (smoothed less so gestures register). Audio (`audio.ts` `LightAudio`): a **7-partial additive bank** forming ONE continuous-pitch chord — **L →** master gain (`L^1.4`, so a cupped lens ≈ silence) + partial gating + a master lowpass (spectral brightness); **H →** base frequency (110↔156 Hz) and **continuously-lerped** warm/cool interval ratios (**never** snapped to a scale/JI grid — the honest kill of the safety net the jury protects); **M →** tremolo/shimmer depth + a soft `accent()` on motion spikes; all changes glide via `setTargetAtTime` (a drone that breathes, no clicks), through a limiter with a slow detune-drift LFO. **Output = Canvas2D** (`viz.ts` `AuroraRenderer`, DPR-aware): an additive violet-arc **aurora** — brightness/hue/motion drive breathing core + ribbons + motion sparkles, driven by the *identical* smoothed L/H/M so the sound and the image are one gesture (raw hsla confined to the art layer). **Input = camera-of-environment** (`facingMode:"environment"` — reads the room, not a selfie). **Degrades fully:** audio opens first on the Start gesture (guaranteed), camera is optional; no camera / denied / headless → a seeded **`mulberry32(0x3008)`** autopilot drifts L/H/M like *a room easing into dusk with passing clouds* (runs the visuals from mount, before any gesture), with an on-brand `text-destructive`/muted notice; never throws; full teardown (tracks stopped, AudioContext closed, rAF cancelled, listeners removed). **All processing on-device — no pixel data leaves the browser, no network calls** (stated in-UI + README). **Named refs:** **Scriabin, *Prometheus: Poem of Fire*** (1910, colour-organ) · **Louis-Bertrand Castel, *clavecin oculaire*** (1730s). **Ambition — 3/5:** #1 (novel technique: environment/light-as-primary-instrument-input, inverse colour-organ — 0× in the lab; camera pieces read the *body*, none read the room's *light* as the instrument) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: camera capture + L/H/M analysis + 7-partial continuous-pitch synth + Canvas2D aurora renderer = 4) · #3 (Scriabin/Castel) · #5 (RESEARCH §918 same-date — NIME-2026 embodiment/haptics turn validates resurrecting the §917 Scriabin light-seed; `picked` = [**camera-of-environment** input (light not body — a human shapes it moment-to-moment; clears input-free) · **Canvas2D** output (steered off the over-used WebGL2) · **inverse colour-organ / light-as-instrument** technique (0×, NOT science-sonification — it's a *played* instrument) · **cosmic-ambient meditative** vibe (Karel's requested pole, NOT clinical)] — clears every live ban; ### [2992-around](/dream/2992-around) · adult / spatial · **what if you could reach into the space around your head and SCULPT a living choir — place sustained continuous-pitch voices at real 3-D positions and hear them orbit you in true binaural space, and turn (drag or device-tilt) to rotate the whole field around you?** / the lab's **first dedicated 3-D binaural instrument** and a deliberate break from a **4-cycle solo-hand-instrument groove** (913 sing-follow · 914 sing-harmony · 915 tabla · 916 murmuration — all one hand directly playing one instrument): a wholly fresh *interaction kind* (spatial arrangement, not strike/bow/sing/drag) that still keeps a human changing the outcome moment-to-moment (dodges JURY-2026-07-26's input-free ban) and cleanly clears every jury absolute (human-driven · continuous pitch · not science-sonification · not clinical · **no JI net**). **The concept:** the listener sits at the origin; each **voice-orb** is a small **additive drone** (fundamental + natural overtones + a detuned twin for slow beating) at a **continuous pitch derived from its 3-D position** (`freqFromPosition` = `90·6.1^t` Hz, ~90–549 Hz, *never* quantised to any scale/lattice), spatialised through **its own Web Audio `PannerNode{panningModel:"HRTF"}`** positioned via `positionX/Y/Z` and mixed through a `DynamicsCompressor` limiter into a master gain capped at **0.15**. Each voice **orbits** the head on its own seeded arc (with a slow elevation bob) so the field is alive and the binaural motion is audible — a voice sweeps ear-to-ear. Turning your **head / device** rotates the `AudioListener` (`forwardX/Y/Z`,`upX/Y/Z`, with a legacy `setOrientation` fallback) so the whole field turns around you. **Input = pointer (place/drag on a top-down radar: angle→azimuth, radius→distance, slider→elevation) + device-orientation** (iOS `requestPermission()` on tap, desktop pointer "look around"). **Output = Canvas2D** dual view — a top-down radar (rings, spokes, orbit paths, a facing cone, elevation stalks, a ring on the loudest voice) + a facing-relative elevation horizon band (on-palette violet art hex only). **Degrades fully:** no HRTF params → legacy panner API; no orientation sensor → pointer look; a seeded **`mulberry32(0x2992)`** demo orbits a few voices *visually on load* before any gesture (audio needs one Start tap, per browser policy); **`prefers-reduced-motion`** slows the orbit. **Named refs:** Web Audio **HRTF `PannerNode`/`AudioListener`** · **Jens Blauert, *Spatial Hearing*** (HRTF localization cues) · **AudioMiXR: 6DoF Spatial Audio Object Manipulation** (arXiv:2502.02929, 2026). **Ambition — 3/5:** #2 (≥3 subsystems: pointer/orientation 3-D placement + HRTF spatial graph w/ movable listener + additive continuous-pitch voice bank + Canvas2D radar/horizon renderer = 4) · #3 (HRTF/Blauert/AudioMiXR) · #5 (RESEARCH §917 same-date — the "spatial audio + head-tracking is a first-class 2026 interaction, and the browser ships the primitive but the lab never built a dedicated 3-D binaural instrument" dive). *Honest grade: "first HRTF instrument" is NOT claimed as #1 — `PannerNode` is in ~207 files as incidental panning; the novelty is the dedicated 3-D sound-sculpture instrument with a movable listener, graded at 3/5 not 4.* **diversity:** last-10 = [2808,2816,2848,2864,2888,2912,2920,2928,2952,2960]; `banned` = JURY [science-sonification · input-free self-play · clinical diagram-as-score · JI/pentatonic net] + self-observed [solo-hand-instrument *kind* forming 913–916]; `picked` = [**pointer + device-orientation** input · **HRTF binaural spatialization** technique (dedicated 3-D spatial instrument, 0× in lab) · **Canvas2D spatial-field** output · **cosmic-spatial immersive** vibe] — clears every live ban; continuous pitch protected. **mode:** WIDE (ledger 914 W · 915 W · 916 D → **917 W**; three unrelated registers — SPACE / PEOPLE / ENVIRONMENT — raced to break the solo-hand-instrument groove). **candidates:** 2992-around(win) · 3008-daylight(banked ⭐⭐ **HIGH**, IDEAS §917 — camera-as-light-sensor → a slow living chord, Scriabin's *clavier à lumières* inverted; the cosmic-ambient pole + freshest concept) · 3000-commons(banked ⭐, IDEAS §917 — collective BroadcastChannel drone-choir extending the multi-user peak `2912-ensemble`; resurrect with roughness-minimization coupling, not JI-attraction). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D; Vercel runs the full pipeline on deploy), emitted `/dream/2992-around/{page.js,…}` (losers 3000/3008 absent). **NOT ear-verified** (headless — no headphones): HRTF localization strength + whether turning audibly rotates the field want Karel's device; ### [2960-murmuration](/dream/2960-murmuration) · **what if an instrument's MEMORY were a living swarm — you play continuous-pitch gestures with your hand, and a flock of autonomous voices grows around the phrases you keep returning to, and forgets the ones you abandon?** / the direct cash of **JURY-2026-07-26**'s two live orders *at once* — #2 "**put a hand back on the instrument** (a human responsible moment-to-moment)" AND provocation #5 "**extend the long-form-MEMORY peak**" (`2672-somnus`/`2656-loom`) — by inverting the fresh research into a **played** instrument: not a self-playing memory you watch, but a memory you *drive*. **The concept — stigmergic memory:** a 128×72 **scent field** where the Y axis is log-pitch (~2.5 octaves) and X is pan/phase; dragging your pointer sounds a sustained continuous-pitch **hand voice** AND deposits a fading Gaussian **scent** trail along your path (all cells multiply by ~0.99 each frame → evaporation). A **swarm of 48 boid-like voice-agents** (`swarm.ts`) each senses the local scent **gradient** (central differences), steers up-gradient with seeded wander + inertia + bounded speed (reflecting at edges), and — where it crosses a bright cell — fires a **short plucked grain** at that cell's pitch AND deposits a little scent of its own (`field.splat`, the **stigmergic reinforcement**). So paths you **revisit consolidate** into bright self-sustaining attractors a shimmering choir clusters around, and paths you **abandon evaporate** and the flock disperses to your newer gestures — the piece is audibly different at minute 6 than at second 0, and *you* caused it. **Input = pointer/touch** (mouse + touch); **Output = Canvas2D** — the scent field drawn as a violet-ramp heat-field (dim violet → white-hot peaks, additive `lighter` blend), agents as bright motes with motion-smear trails, your cursor a glowing radial head — you **see the memory you're feeding**. **Audio** (`audio.ts`): sustained gliding hand voice + a pool of short agent grains → bus → gentle lowpass → `tanh` soft-limiter → master **0.14** (≤0.15), per-frame grain budget so a dense choir stays cheap. **Degrades fully:** no AudioContext/Canvas → on-brand notice; **`prefers-reduced-motion`** slows the field drift (no rapid luminance flash, peaks pulse gently — motion-safe); no input → a seeded **`mulberry32(0x2960)`** ghost hand traces a **revisit-biased** phrase schedule on load, so attractors consolidate and the piece is alive at a silent 06:30 review; **drag to take over ⇄ Return to autopilot**. **Named refs:** **M.J. Buehler, *MusicSwarm* (Advanced Intelligent Systems, 2026)** — swarms of frozen agents self-organise music via **stigmergic** peer signals + shared memory, where "local novelties consolidate into global form" (this piece is that inverted into a hand-played instrument) · **Tim Blackwell, *Swarm Granulator*** · **O. Bown & A. Eldridge, ecosystem-based generative music**. **Ambition — 4/5:** #1 (novel technique: agent-swarm / stigmergic scent-field memory, 0× in the lab) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: pointer-instrument input + continuous-pitch poly synth + stigmergic scent-field + swarm engine + Canvas2D heat-render = 4) · #3 (MusicSwarm 2026 / Blackwell / Bown & Eldridge) · #5 (RESEARCH §916 same-date — the "invert MusicSwarm's stigmergy into a played memory instrument" dive). **diversity:** last-10 = [2808,2816,2848,2864,2888,2912,2920,2928,2952]; `banned` = JURY-2026-07-26 [**science-sonification** (whole *kind*) · **input-free self-play** (posture) · **clinical diagram-as-score** vibe · re-adding the JI/pentatonic net] + audit [**mic** (2×, near cap)]; `picked` = [**pointer/touch** input (played, a literal hand on the instrument — dodges input-free; only `2952` recent) · **agent-swarm / stigmergic memory** technique (0× ever, NOT physics-sonification: you *play* it, a human is responsible) · **Canvas2D heat-field** output (the output the piece needs — a per-pixel field + 48 motes; jury: "prefer the output the piece needs, not a ban") · **organic living-choir** vibe (not clinical readout)] — clears every live ban; continuous pitch protected (grains are the exact field pitch, never scale-snapped). **mode:** DEEP (mode ledger 913 D · 914 W · 915 W → **916 DEEP**; ONE north star — a hand-played swarm-memory instrument — raced via three memory substrates: boid-swarm scent field / GPU reaction-diffusion field / desire-path graph). **candidates:** 2960-murmuration(win) · 2968-thicket(banked ⭐⭐ **HIGH**, IDEAS §916 — the lab's **first GPU reaction-diffusion** (Gray-Scott, WebGL2 ping-pong): plant sound into a living RD field, readback drives an additive partial bank; the freshest missing technical substrate) · 2976-desirepath(banked ⭐, IDEAS §916 — an **ant-colony desire-path graph** of your melodic habits, walkers improvise in your idiom à la George Lewis's *Voyager*, SVG living diagram). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D; zero new npm deps, no server route, no network, no secrets; pointer is a passive read). **Validation:** normalizer = **0 rewrites** (already on-brand: violet-ramp/white hex confined to the Canvas art layer, semantic-token chrome, `text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight` hero, `min-h-[44px]`/`rounded-md` buttons, no `text-white`/`font-serif`/off-brand-hue chrome, helpers `draw*`/`spawn*`/`step*` — no non-hook `use*`); 0 real `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date` (all matches are comments); builder ran real `tsc --noEmit` = clean + folder `eslint --max-warnings 0` = clean; both losers banked to IDEAS §916 then `rm -rf`'d before the authoritative build (never committed); authoritative winner-only `rm -rf .next && npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0** (the container's `ulimit -n` is hard-capped at 4096 — a full `next build` EMFILEs at page-data collection across ~870 routes — so compile-mode is the standing gate, per every cycle 903–915; Vercel runs the full pipeline on deploy), emitted `/dream/2960-murmuration/{page.js, page.js.nft.json, page_client-reference-manifest.js}` (losers 2968/2976 absent from `.next` and `src`). **NOT ear-verified** (headless — no speakers): whether the consolidation reads as musical (a choir gathering on a revisited phrase vs. mush), whether the grain/evaporation balance lets several attractors coexist rather than crowding the single brightest one, and the exact tuning (grain envelope, evaporation ~0.99, splat width — all hand-estimated) want Karel's device; ### [2952-tabla](/dream/2952-tabla) · **what if you could strike a REAL vibrating drumhead with your fingers — and PRESS into it with your palm to bend the pitch up mid-ring, the way a tabla player slides the heel of their hand across the head (the *ga*/*ghe* pitch-glide)? — because the sound is a genuine 2-D digital waveguide MESH membrane, not a sample.** / the lab's **FIRST 2-D physical model** (0× — everything before was 1-D Karplus–Strong / waveguide strings) and its **most literal cash of JURY-2026-07-26 #2** ("put a hand back on the instrument, responsible moment-to-moment") — a deliberate pivot OFF the two prior cycles' **mic-voice-follower** groove (913 `2920-follow` + 914 `2928-freeharmony`, both voice→accompanist — a *forming* monoculture) toward a hand physically ON a vibrating body: no voice, no reference score, no listening agent, no sonified system. **The concept:** a **2-D digital waveguide mesh** (Van Duyne & Smith, *"The 2-D Digital Waveguide Mesh,"* 1993 — a grid of 4-port scattering junctions joined by bidirectional unit delays, provably equivalent on the homogeneous square mesh to the explicit FDTD form of the 2-D wave equation `u(n+1)=2u(n)−u(n−1)+c²(uN+uS+uE+uW−4u)`, run here in `mesh.ts` + inlined in `worklet.ts`) solved at audio rate: a **circular Dirichlet boundary** clamps the square grid into a round head so the rim reflects waves into the membrane's modal spectrum; a **raised-Gaussian displacement impulse** scaled by strike velocity excites it, its width shrinking toward the rim so **edge strikes = bright high-partial *na*/*ta*** and **centre strikes = deep fundamental *ge***; output read at a fixed off-centre listening junction → DC-blocker → one-pole lowpass → soft `tanh` limiter, master ≤**0.12**. **Press-bend — the whole trick:** a per-junction `c²` (local squared wave-speed = tension) field; pressing eases `c²` up in a Gaussian region under the pointer (kept ≤0.49 for stability), raising local wave speed → raising the ringing modes' pitch, so a **struck note audibly bends UP while it still sounds** (the tabla *ga*), gliding back down on release. **Input = multi-touch / pointer:** tap = strike (velocity from pointer speed), radius = timbre, press-and-hold(+drag) = pitch-bend. **Output = Canvas2D** height-map of the membrane's REAL displacement field (goatskin tones, gold crests, dark troughs, violet press-glow, the dark syahi tuning-paste centre + violet rim) — you **see the wave you hear**. **Where it runs:** the audio mesh (**42×42**) runs a full block every render quantum inside an **AudioWorklet loaded from a Blob-URL string** (`worklet.ts`, so Next bundles nothing special) + a **ScriptProcessorNode fallback** running the same `MembraneMesh` on the main thread; a separate coarser eye-tuned membrane (52×52) draws the visible ripples, driven by the same strike/press events so vision tracks sound. **Degrades fully:** no AudioWorklet → ScriptProcessor; no pointer → a seeded **`mulberry32(0x2952)`** virtual player runs a looping 16-step *theka* (dha·dhin·tin·ta with occasional *ga* press-glides) on load, so the page is alive at a silent 06:30 review before anyone touches it; **Start the drum** resumes the AudioContext, **Take over** flips to hands-on. **Named refs:** **Van Duyne & Smith (1993)** the 2-D DWM · **C.V. Raman, "The Indian Musical Drums" (1934)** — the loaded (syahi) tabla head's harmonic overtones are why it carries pitch. **Ambition — 4/5:** #1 (novel technique: first 2-D digital waveguide mesh / 2-D physical model in the lab; 1-D only before) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: audio-rate 2-D mesh worklet + press-bend `c²` tension field + Canvas2D real-displacement renderer + seeded theka autopilot = 4) · #3 (Van Duyne & Smith · C.V. Raman) · #5 (RESEARCH §915 same-date — the "2-D DWM is small-mesh-only-in-real-time, so a browser tabla with a press-to-bend stroke is unbuilt and feasible" dive). **diversity:** last-10 = [2744,2768,2808,2816,2848,2864,2888,2912,2920,2928]; `banned` = [**input-free self-play** (4× + JURY) · **mic** (3×, approaching cap) · **science-sonification** (JURY, whole *kind*) · JI/pentatonic net (JURY)]; `picked` = [**touch/pointer/drag** input (0× recent — a literal hand on the instrument) · **2-D digital waveguide mesh** technique (0× ever, NOT physics-sonification: you *play* it, it doesn't play itself) · **Canvas2D real-displacement** output · **tactile / earthy / non-Western hand-drum** vibe] — clears every live ban; the *ga* bend is a continuous glide, never scale-snapped. **mode:** WIDE (mode ledger 912 W · 913 D · 914 W → **915 W**; three unrelated direct-manipulation tactile instruments in one fire — the anti-monoculture move applied pre-emptively to the voice-follower groove that 913+914 were forming). **candidates:** 2952-tabla(win) · 2944-bowfield(banked ⭐⭐ **HIGH**, IDEAS §915 — a genuine bowed-string stick-slip friction physical model you bow with your hand (MSW 1983), Canvas2D vibrating strings; first bowed model in the lab, the string counterpart to this membrane) · 2936-seaboard(banked ⭐, IDEAS §915 — a ROLI-Seaboard/Osmose multi-touch MPE surface, per-note bend/pressure/timbre independent, three.js petal field; first MPE instrument). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D; zero new npm deps, no server route, no network, no secrets; touch is a passive read). **Validation:** normalizer = **0 rewrites** (already on-brand: warm/gold/violet hex confined to the Canvas art layer, semantic-token chrome, `text-xl`+ `font-semibold tracking-tight` hero, `min-h-[44px]`/`rounded-md` buttons, no `text-white`/`font-serif`/off-brand-hue chrome, helpers `make*`/`draw*`/`step*` — no non-hook `use*`); builder ran real `tsc --noEmit` = 0 errors project-wide + folder `eslint --max-warnings 0` = clean; all three candidates passed the all-three diagnostic `next build` (compile) = EXIT 0 before curation; both losers banked to IDEAS §915 then `rm -rf`'d before the authoritative build (never committed); authoritative winner-only `rm -rf .next && npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0** (the container's `ulimit -n` is hard-capped at 4096 — a full `next build` EMFILEs at page-data collection across ~870 routes — so compile-mode is the standing gate, per every cycle 903–914; Vercel runs the full pipeline on deploy), emitted `/dream/2952-tabla/{page.js, page.js.nft.json, page_client-reference-manifest.js}` (losers 2944/2936 absent from `.next` and `src`). **NOT ear-verified** (headless — no speakers): whether the mesh audibly *sounds like a drum*, whether the strike rings and the press bends the pitch UP, and the exact tuning (fundamental ~410 Hz, ring time, tanh drive 16, press-glide feel — all hand-estimated) all want Karel's device; the model is statically verified (real 2-D DWM/FDTD, circular boundary, per-junction tension field) and the seeded theka is the silent-review stand-in. Honest caveats: the ScriptProcessor fallback runs the 42×42 mesh on the main thread (could strain low-end mobile — the worklet path is fine), and the visible ripple is a deliberately separate coarser eye-tuned mesh driven by the same events (as the brief permits), so on-screen pitch is illustrative, not sample-accurate to the sound. `theme: tactile physical instrument (strike a real membrane, press to bend the pitch) · vibe: earthy non-Western hand-drum, first 2-D physical model`. status: **demoable**

### [2928-freeharmony](/dream/2928-freeharmony) · **what if you could sing (or hum, or play) ANYTHING with no reference score — and in real time it found your key and laid the right chord under your voice, re-harmonizing a beat or two after you modulate?** / the **scoreless free-harmony companion** to yesterday's score-anchored `2920-follow`: together they span "accompany a piece I know" ⟷ "jam with me on anything." The direct cash of **JURY-2026-07-26** #2 ("put a hand back on the instrument — a human responsible moment-to-moment") + the jury's "**danger — an agent who can be wrong**": with no score, the singer owns the melody with real stakes, and the harmonizer can genuinely mis-read the key. **The concept:** a **YIN** pitch detector (`pitch.ts` — cumulative-mean-normalized difference + parabolic interpolation + RMS/clarity voicing gate → continuous float MIDI, never scale-snapped) feeds a **decaying 12-bin pitch-class histogram** (~2.4 s exponential half-life, weighted by confident-pitch duration); every ~200 ms `harmony.ts` runs **Krumhansl–Schmuckler key-finding** (Pearson-correlate the histogram against all **24 rotated Krumhansl–Kessler major/minor profiles** → best-fit tonic+mode) and chooses a **diatonic triad by functional preference** (I/IV/V/vi favoured, harmonic-minor dominant so V resolves) with **voice-leading** (octave placement minimizes motion from the last chord) and **hysteresis** (chords hold ≥1.5 s unless a change is strongly favoured). The histogram's deliberate lag means the key **trails** the singer — so it re-harmonizes *a beat or two after* you modulate, like a real player catching up, not a quantizer snapping. `audio.ts` = bass root + 3-voice sustained pad + gentle arp (+ soft lead in Auto mode), all `setTargetAtTime` glides between chords, master ≤**0.15**. **Visual = WebGL2** (off the over-used Canvas2D): a single-triangle fbm **domain-warp "harmony aurora"** fragment shader — **hue** tracks the tonic's position on the circle of fifths biased into the Resonance violet arc (indigo→violet→magenta, no garish full spectrum), **bloom** pulses on chord changes, **turbulence** tracks sung pitch height + key stability; Canvas2D fallback if WebGL2 is unavailable. **Degrades fully:** no mic / denied → `text-destructive` notice + a seeded **VirtualImproviser** (`mulberry32(0x2928)`) sings a slowly wandering, occasionally-modulating line through the *same* pitch→harmony→audio→viz path, so with zero mic the piece is alive and you watch the key-finder lock and drift (the silent-review stand-in). Toggle **Sing (mic)** ⇄ **Auto**. AudioContext resumes on the Start gesture; clean teardown of RAF / AudioContext / mic. **Named refs:** **ReaLchords (arXiv:2506.14723, 2025)** — the RL agent that *learns* this same live chord-under-a-melody reflex; free-harmony is its deterministic music-theory cousin · **Krumhansl & Schmuckler / Krumhansl & Kessler** key-finding (Krumhansl, *Cognitive Foundations of Musical Pitch*, 1990) · framed against **"A Design Space for Live Music Agents" (arXiv:2602.05064, 2026)** — this is the *scoreless harmonic-follower* corner of that space. **Ambition — 4/5:** #1 (novel technique: Krumhansl–Schmuckler live key-finding, 0× in the lab) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: YIN pitch + KK key-finding harmony engine + poly synth + WebGL2 aurora shader = 4) · #3 (ReaLchords / Krumhansl / Design-Space) · #5 (RESEARCH §914 same-date — the "map the whole live-music-agent space, build its empty corners" dive). **diversity:** `banned` = JURY-2026-07-26 [sonify-a-named-system technique · input-free self-play posture · clinical diagram-as-score vibe · re-adding the JI/pentatonic net]; ### [2920-follow](/dream/2920-follow) · **what if Resonance had an accompanist that follows YOU — you sing a melody live, at your own tempo, with rubato and pauses, and it plays the accompaniment locked to YOUR position, not a click track?** / the lab's **first score-following / reactive-accompanist piece** (0× — "live-performance fitness," Karel's care #3), and the direct cash of **JURY-2026-07-26** #1 (moratorium on science-sonification — *killed*; nothing here sonifies a system) + #2 ("put a hand back on the instrument — a human performing, not a simulation observed") + the jury's explicit "the banked `2920-follow` is the single most product-relevant thing waiting — **ship it**." **The concept:** you sing a built-in original tune ("Little Lantern," 16 notes, F major); a **YIN** pitch detector (`pitch.ts`, difference-function + parabolic interpolation → continuous float MIDI, never scale-snapped) feeds an **online forward-path DTW score follower** (`follower.ts` — banded monotone recursion `D'[j] = localCost(j) + min(D[j], D[j-1], D[j-2])`, octave-folded cost, per-frame band-normalized) whose **head IS the position** — so silence literally doesn't advance it (the accompaniment **waits** through your rubato pause) and a forward leap snaps the head ahead (it **catches up**); no wall clock anywhere on the position path. Pads/bass/arp fire **event-driven on beat-crossings of the DTW head** (`audio.ts`, warm layered voices → delay room → master ≤0.15), so the accompaniment breathes with your timing. **Visual = SVG** (rotated off the over-used Canvas2D per the jury/IDEAS note): a warm "lantern path" — the reference melody as a glowing ribbon, a tempo-stretching violet playhead sitting where the DTW head is, your live pitch trace, and chord blooms when accompaniment fires (bounded element pools mutated by ref). **Degrades fully:** no mic / denied → `text-destructive` notice + a seeded **VirtualSinger** (`mulberry32(0x2920)`) performs the tune with elastic tempo, breath pauses, entry scoop, vibrato and intonation drift through the *same* follower, so with zero mic you watch the tracking work and hear position-locked accompaniment (the silent-review stand-in). ### [2912-ensemble](/dream/2912-ensemble) · **what if two people on two different devices could reach into ONE shared resonant instrument in the browser — no server — and hear each other play it in real time?** / the lab's **first multi-user / WebRTC piece** (jury #4's biggest-untouched category, named 5+ juries running — and **network input is 0× in the entire lab**). A shared rack of 22 Karplus–Strong plucked strings rendered in **SVG-DOM** (bounded pools of `<path>`/`<circle>`/`<g>` created once, mutated by ref each frame — a deliberately under-used substrate); drag across the rack to excite the field, and a partner sees the ripple bloom in your violet-ramp color. **The load-bearing idea (this cycle's fresh research, §912): control events, not audio.** Nothing streams audio — only compact `{pluck, stringIndex, x, velocity, t}` / `{cursor, x, y}` events cross the wire, and **each browser re-synthesizes the sound LOCALLY** from them (the "synchronized local engine" model → no TURN, no relay, low latency). Every pluck — yours or off the wire — funnels through one `excite()`, so local and remote are indistinguishable to synth and visuals. **Three connection tiers, one protocol:** (1) **seeded ghost partner** (`mulberry32(0x2912)`, default, always works — a virtual second player duets immediately, the headless-review stand-in), (2) **BroadcastChannel loopback** across two tabs on one machine (self-demo without a second device), (3) **manual-SDP WebRTC** `RTCDataChannel` for real cross-device pairing (copy invite / paste answer, no server). Pitch is a **continuous log map** across the rack — free ratios, never scale-snapped (keeps the danger). Named ref: **Chris Chafe & SoundWIRE** telematic music / the **Cornelljam** control-events-not-audio model. `theme: networked shared instrument (telematic duet) · pole: social/collaborative (cosmic-calm violet field)`. status: **demoable**

### [2864-stillpoint](/dream/2864-stillpoint) · **what if a visionary hallucination opened not by dragging a slider but by HOLDING YOUR BODY STILL — the way meditation, not a knob, dissolves the boundary of perception?** / the reducing valve made *embodied*. As the valve opens, sensory precision drops and the brain's geometric priors bleed through: the live camera texture is progressively warped through the shared **log-polar (retina→V1) map** (`LOGPOLAR_GLSL`) and overwritten by breathing **Klüver form constants** (tunnel/spiral/spoke/honeycomb), until at full stillness the room is gone and you are inside slowly-turning geometry. ### [2848-overturning](/dream/2848-overturning) · **what if you could HEAR the ocean's great conveyor belt approach a tipping point — the deep overturning drone wobbling wider and recovering slower as freshwater builds up (critical slowing down), then a sudden shutdown, and a recovery that does NOT retrace (hysteresis)?** / a long-form (~10 min) self-playing **tipping-point sonification** (Canvas2D + Web Audio) built on a REAL fast-slow stochastic system with a **fold catastrophe**: **Stommel's (1961) two-box thermohaline circulation** in Marotzke non-dimensional form (`engine.ts`, Euler–Maruyama + seeded Box–Muller noise, `mulberry32(0x2848)`). Temperature contrast ΔT and salinity contrast ΔS relax toward forcing; their density difference drives the overturning `q = ΔT − ΔS`; the system is genuinely **bistable** — a strong thermally-driven "on" state and a collapsed salinity-dominated "off" state separated by a saddle-node — with folds (numerically verified) at F≈1.0 (off→on) and F≈1.245 (on→off). **The long-form arc:** a slow freshwater forcing F drifts up past the upper fold (the circulation **shuts down**), then back down; because the "off" state is stable over a range of F, the overturning does NOT restart at the same F it collapsed at — it stays off until a lower fold, tracing a real **hysteresis loop** (a genuinely different piece at minute 10 than second 0 — the jury-2026-07-25 **#5 long-form-stateful seam**, cashed via a wholly new mechanism, not the 2388/2656/2672 memory members). **The early-warning signals are REAL and drive the sound:** a rolling window of q computes live **variance** and **lag-1 autocorrelation (AC1)**; as the fold nears, recovery slows → variance ↑ and AC1 → 1 (**critical slowing down**), and a well-curvature **resilience** meter falls toward 0. Those signals steer `audio.ts` (real Web Audio, no stubs): a layered ocean — a **deep abyssal overturning drone** (twin detuning sawtooths ← q; the detune grows with instability into audible **beating** and bends off-integer), a **mid thermocline** voice ← ΔT, a **surface salinity** voice ← ΔS that **rises and takes over on collapse**, a band-passed **turbulence bed** that swells as resilience drops, and a **feedback delay whose tail lengthens** near the fold — so the drone audibly "loses its footing" before it tips, the shutdown is a decisive **phase transition** (the deep drone collapses/drops an octave, not a fade), and near the edge **flickering** stutters the deep gain between basins. **Pitch is mapped continuously** (`freq = f0·2^(k·norm)`) and **NEVER snapped to a scale/JI/pentatonic** (the honest kill of the safety net the jury protects — pointedly unlike arXiv:2602.14560, which sonified a tipping system but snapped it to a gamelan scale). **Visual (Canvas2D):** the iconic **Scheffer "ball in a potential well"** stability landscape (`viz.ts`) — the "on" well flattens as F drifts (visible loss of resilience), the ball rattles wider as variance rises, and at the fold the well vanishes and the ball rolls to the collapsed basin — plus a **q(t) time-series with a widening variance envelope**, a shutdown marker, and a **hysteresis-loop inset** (F on x, q on y: outward collapse vs. return restart) + a live EWS readout (variance / AC1 / resilience / q / F / state). Reads as a story with sound muted; visuals animate on mount, audio on the Begin gesture; Pause/Resume + deterministic **Jump-ahead**; graceful `text-destructive` degrade; clean rAF+AudioContext teardown; no strobe (all luminance drift ≤3 Hz, `prefers-reduced-motion` honored). **Headless-verified** (shipped `engine.ts`, seed `0x2848`, full 600 s arc): collapse at F=1.219 (matches the upper fold ≈1.245); **variance rises ×2.95** (0.00216→0.00638, peak 0.082) and **AC1 rises 0.835→0.936** (peak 0.994) before the tip while **resilience falls 0.985→0.046** — critical slowing down confirmed; **hysteresis** at F=1.1 q_out=0.632 (ON) vs q_return=−0.076 (OFF), Δ=0.708 (Δ=0.848 at F=1.15) — the return path clearly differs. Cycle 909 **DEEP** winner — ONE north star (*hear a system tip*), raced via three tipping substrates: **`2840-threshold`** (ecosystem/vegetation-grazing fold — a staggered extinction cascade of voices; variance ×1.58, AC1 0.79→0.90, hysteresis Δc≈0.61; ⭐⭐ IDEAS §909) + **`2856-cascade`** (Kuramoto explosive-synchronization tip — an incoherent wash snaps into lockstep, hysteresis ΔK≈0.64; ⭐⭐ IDEAS §909), both banked. **Named refs:** Scheffer et al., "Early-warning signals for critical transitions," *Nature* 461 (2009) · Stommel, "Thermohaline convection with two stable regimes of flow," *Tellus* 13 (1961) · Rahmstorf (thermohaline hysteresis) · the 2026 frontier arXiv:2603.14944 / 2605.12308 / 2509.04683. **Ambition 4/5** (`#1` novel technique — critical-slowing-down / fold-tipping sonification is **0×** in the lab, verified distinct from `1810-bourse`'s *random* regime jumps and `2728-bifurcation`'s period-doubling route-to-chaos; `#2` ≥3 subsystems — fast-slow stochastic ODE + live rolling variance/AC1 EWS estimator + resilience-driven continuous-pitch layered synth + flicker/shutdown event engine + stability-landscape/hysteresis viz; `#3` Scheffer/Stommel/Rahmstorf; `#5` same-day RESEARCH §909 drove it). **diversity:** `banned` = jury-2026-07-25 [**QWERTY-keyboard-as-primary-input** (8/15) · **the "AI plays music with/against you" concept** · **voice-as-subject** · **JI/pentatonic net**]; recent input ruts also dodged = mic (905/906), camera (896/907), input-free-deterministic-MATH (901/903/904), live-external-data (908); `picked` = [**input-free / self-playing** (jury-endorsed genuinely-input-free generative — and NOT the closed-form-math rut: a *stochastic fast-slow dynamical system with noise*) · **Canvas2D output** · **critical-slowing-down / fold-bifurcation tipping** technique (0×) · **ecological-dread / loss-of-resilience** vibe (a new emotional register; visionary cosmic-ambient pole on the drift, intense at the tip)] — clears every live ban and every recent rut. **mode:** DEEP (ledger …906 W · 907 D · 908 W → alternate to DEEP; and JURY #5 "point the next DEEP cycle at the long-form-stateful seam" — satisfied via a new mechanism). **NOT ear-verified** (headless — no speakers): whether the shutdown reads as *the conveyor stopping* vs a smeary drop, and whether critical slowing down is audible as the drone "wobbling wider and recovering slower," want Karel's ears; ### [2816-heliograph](/dream/2816-heliograph) · **what if you could hear the actual weather on the Sun right now — the live solar wind blowing past Earth as an evolving cosmic drone whose dissonance rises and falls with the real interplanetary magnetic field?** / a **live real-world-data sonification** (WebGL2 aurora shader + Web Audio) that fetches NOAA SWPC's real-time space-weather telemetry **directly from the browser** (no API route, no key, CORS-open): `summary/solar-wind-speed.json` (proton speed km/s), `summary/solar-wind-mag-field.json` (Bt total field + Bz north–south IMF), and `noaa-planetary-k-index.json` (Kp), re-polled every 45 s and parsed defensively. **Four channels of the physics each drive one voice** (`noaa.ts` → `deriveParams`): solar-wind **speed → base drone pitch** on a continuous log glide (250 km/s→70 Hz, 800→140 Hz, never scale-snapped — the honest kill of the JI net); **Bt → harmonic richness/brightness** of the upper partials; **Kp → slow shimmer swells + sparse "substorm" bells**; and — the emotional core — **Bz → consonance↔roughness**: when the field turns *southward* (negative Bz, the real physical condition that couples solar wind into Earth's magnetosphere and lights auroras) the twin oscillators of each partial split into beating, the ratios bend off-integer, and a band-passed noise bed rises, so **the drone audibly turns stormy exactly when the real sky does**. Audio (`audio.ts`) is real Web Audio: 7 twin-oscillator partials + noise bed + shimmer LFO + substorm bells → `DynamicsCompressor` → master 0.15. Visual (`aurora.ts`) is a WebGL2 fbm auroral-curtain fragment shader (Canvas2D curtain fallback) — height/brightness track speed & Kp, color/turbulence track Bz (calm green-violet drift northward → roiling reddened turbulence southward), all luminance oscillation ≤3 Hz (**no strobe**; respects `prefers-reduced-motion` via `_shared/visionary/safeFlicker`). **Self-demos with zero network:** if any fetch fails/CORS-blocks, a fully deterministic seeded (`mulberry32(0x2816)`) "geomagnetic storm day" simulator runs a physical storm arc (sudden southward commencement → recovery) from mount — the aurora breathes and the drone plays even offline; live NOAA data swaps in cleanly on the first successful poll (status line flips `SIMULATED (offline)` → `LIVE · solar wind N km/s · Kp N`). The lab's **first live external-data-API input** — the long-overdue real-world-data lane (multiple juries flagged it 0×) — and the freshest break of every recent input rut (mic 905/906, camera 896/907, input-free-math 901/903/904). Refs: NOAA SWPC real-time products · NASA HARP (Heliophysics Audified Resonances in Plasmas, listen.spacescience.org) · heliophysics sonification of Parker/Wind/MMS via CDAWeb. **Not ear-verified** (headless): whether the Bz storm-turn reads as *the sky going stormy* vs a smeary detune wants Karel's ears; the mappings + the seeded self-demo are statically verified. `state: solar wind / geomagnetic storm · pole: cosmic-ambient` · `status: demoable` · cycle 908 · WIDE (won over `2824-murmuration` boids-emergence + `2832-thumbstick` gamepad-instrument, both banked IDEAS §908).

### [2768-faraday](/dream/2768-faraday) · **what if you could pour sound into a dish of water and the water answered back — a real Faraday-wave fluid whose emergent standing-wave pattern re-voices the sound that shook it?** / a **cross-modal fluid instrument** (Canvas2D + Web Audio, mic-primary) built on real **Faraday-wave** physics: a fluid surface under *vertical parametric vibration* answers **subharmonically** (at half the drive frequency) and self-organises into standing-wave cells past a real **Mathieu threshold** — Faraday (1831), not a noise texture. The engine (`field.ts`, seeded `mulberry32(0x2768)`) integrates a genuine damped, parametrically-forced surface PDE `∂²h/∂t² = c²∇²h − β∇⁴h − γ∂h/∂t + F·a(t)·h` on a 160×160 circular dish (5-point Laplacian + biharmonic ∇⁴ capillary stiffness that *sets the cell size*, cubic Landau `−h³` saturation for a finite clean amplitude, semi-implicit damping, meniscus rim loss). The drive `a(t)` is the **mic's loudness** (or a seeded self-demoing carrier that breathes across threshold), so louder sound swells the dish above the Faraday threshold. **The see≈hear weld (bidirectional):** each frame a Hann-windowed **radial slice-DFT** reads the dish's dominant spatial wavenumber and re-voices a **7-partial inharmonic bank** whose frequencies are the fluid's own dispersion relation `ω₀(k)=√(c²k²+βk⁴)` mapped log to ~62–1480 Hz — so **pitch is a continuous consequence of the water's physics, never scale-snapped** (the honest kill of the JI net the jury protects), and the drive↔field↔voice loop closes both ways (the exact "scalar→pitch compositional model hasn't moved" gap the jury keeps flagging). Constants tuned by a headless sweep to the real Faraday phases (flat below amp≈0.5 → clean pattern at k*=ω₀⁻¹(Ω/2) around 0.55–0.95 → whole-dish slosh over-driven). **Visual (Canvas2D, deliberately — not the over-served SVG/WebGL2):** a shaded **caustic dish** (`viz.ts`) whose luminance is built from phase-insensitive |height|/gradient terms so the subharmonic pulsing **never strobes**; violet ramp art, near-black ground; a live readout of drive amplitude, voiced Hz, dominant wavelength, and above/below-threshold state. ### [2744-musaic-room](/dream/2744-musaic-room) · **if a room could only ever play back what it has already heard, what music would it compose out of its own past?** / real-time **concatenative musaicing** in the browser (mic input · Canvas2D · Web Audio, **no ML**) — the room rebuilds each present moment out of its own memory. A `ScriptProcessorNode` captures the live mic in ~93 ms grains (`audio.ts` `MusaicEngine`); each grain gets **three real features** computed from the signal (`dsp.ts`: RMS loudness, spectral centroid via a hand-rolled Hann-windowed radix-2 **FFT**, zero-crossing rate), normalized into a 0–1 vector. Grains + PCM accrete into a **growing corpus** (cap 600, oldest evicted → long-form-stateful). For every new query grain the engine finds its **nearest neighbour** by weighted feature distance — **excluding anything heard in the last ~1 s** so the room can't just echo itself — and plays that *past* grain (buffer source, cosine edge-fades) **instead of** the live sound: sparse and literal at first, dense and uncanny as memory fills. **No scale-snapping / no JI net** — grains are the raw recorded material, free to sound rough (the danger the jury protects). Viz: a live 2D feature map (x = brightness, y = loudness), each corpus grain a violet dot fading with age, the current query + its matched neighbour highlighted and linked by a line, the match pulsing at ~0.7 Hz (no strobe). Mic on a Begin gesture; graceful deterministic demo fallback (mulberry32 `0x2744`) through the *same* pipeline if mic denied. Refs: Diemo Schwarz **CataRT** · Zils & Pachet *Musical Mosaicing* (2001) · *The Concatenator* (arXiv:2411.04366) · *Latent Granular Resynthesis* (arXiv:2507.19202, Jul 2026). `status: demoable` — cycle 905, DEEP winner (of 3: banked `2752-spore-garden`, `2760-tide-pool`).

### [2664-quantum](/dream/2664-quantum) · **what if you jammed with musicians whose replies live in SUPERPOSITION — a shimmering cloud of possible answers that only COLLAPSES into one actual note on each downbeat, and TELEPORTS to the other agents imperfectly, so the ensemble drifts between echoing you and diverging into its own strange music?** / a played keyboard instrument answered by **three cooperative "quantum" agents**, the direct cash of a 4-day-old paper (arXiv:2607.19212, "Teleportation Game," 21 Jul 2026) as a genuinely new *interaction model*. `engine.ts` (deterministic, quantum-**inspired** — no quantum lib/ML/network): each agent holds a probability distribution `prob[]` (amplitudes) over a 25-bin **free 12-TET** pitch grid; every frame it evolves toward `(1−divergence)·yourRecentNotes + divergence·seededAttractor`; on each downbeat it **collapses** (seeded-samples one bin and actually plays it, with a continuous `±divergence·55¢` microtonal detune so pitch space stays free — **no just-intonation / pentatonic snapping**, the direct kill of the 2026-07-24 jury's still-open #1 "let a piece sound bad") then **teleports** a *noisy* copy of its distribution to its round-robin neighbour (`noise = 0.12 + divergence·0.55`) — embracing that transfer noise as the expressive "quantum whisper," drawn as a ~260 ms bright thread while the neighbour's cloud reshapes toward it. A single **DIVERGENCE** slider is the whole continuum: near 0 the agents echo you (imitation), near 1 they wander into their own attractors and genuinely clash (divergence) — a controllable-dissonance knob, not a safety net. The agents **cooperate/echo — they never trap or fight you** (explicitly NOT an adversarial-AI piece, breaking the recent duel/trap/goad 3× rut). Audio (`audio.ts`, Web-Audio only): polyphonic triangle **lead** voices for your keys + one **FM** timbre per agent triggered on collapse (staggered ~85 ms), master gain 0.18 → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter, created inside the Begin gesture. Visual (`viz.ts`, **WebGL2** — breaks the recent SVG streak): each agent is a ring of additively-blended glowing points on the violet→magenta art ramp that **contracts to a bright core on collapse** then re-blooms, with teleport threads between agent centres; no strobe (≤~1.6 Hz collapse, reduced-motion damps the flash); WebGL2 absent → on-brand `text-destructive` notice, audio still runs. **Input = computer keyboard PLAYED** (home + top row → MIDI 60–79, always-on polyphony) — a played instrument that **needs a human** (a recurring jury ask); a seeded (`mulberry32(0x2664)`) ghost jams a short motif after ~4 s idle so it self-demos silently and yields on first keypress. Cycle 900 **WIDE** winner (raced vs ⭐⭐ `2672-follow` online-DTW reactive accompanist + ⭐⭐ `2680-metronome-mutiny`, the lab's first joke — both banked IDEAS §900). Named ref: **arXiv:2607.19212** "Teleportation Game: Quantum Teleportation in Multi-Agent Systems for Interactive Music" (2026). **Ambition 3/5** (`#1` first probabilistic-superposition/collapse cooperative-agent improv engine in the lab — the words "superposition/teleport" appear only incidentally in prior wave-physics/scene-jump pieces, never as this technique; `#2` ≥3 subsystems — keyboard input + probability-distribution agent engine + collapse/teleport controller + WebGL2 cloud + FM/lead synth; `#3` arXiv:2607.19212; `#5` same-day RESEARCH §900). **diversity:** `banned` = jury-2026-07-24 [Canvas2D-primary · pointer/slider-only input · JI/pentatonic safety-net audio · physics-particle-sim content · clinical "measure-a-system" framing] + my audit of last 10 [voice-as-subject ~4× · adversarial-AI-planning 3×]; `picked` = [**keyboard-played** input · **WebGL2** output (breaks the SVG streak) · **superposition→collapse→noisy-teleport cooperative agents** technique (0× in lab) · **uncanny-cooperative-improv** vibe (not voice, not adversarial, not clinical)] — clears every live ban + both emerging ruts. **mode:** WIDE (ledger …897 D · 898 W · 899 D → alternate to WIDE). **Validation:** normalizer 0 rewrites; full-tree `npx tsc --noEmit` 0; `npx next lint --dir src/app/dream/2664-quantum --max-warnings 0` clean; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` **EXIT 0**, emitted `/dream/2664-quantum/{page.js, page.js.nft.json, page_client-reference-manifest.js}`; losers 2672/2680 banked IDEAS §900 then `rm -rf`'d before the authoritative build (never committed). **NOT eye/ear-verified** (headless — no display/GPU/speakers): actual WebGL2 glow, timbre balance, and whether the DIVERGENCE knob's dissonance onset reads as intended want Karel's browser; the seeded ghost + WebGL2→notice fallback are the silent-review stand-ins.
