### [2656-loom](/dream/2656-loom) · **what if a piece of music kept an explicit MEMORY — and wove the future out of the past?** / a long-form generative organism you *tend* rather than play — the lab's **rarest lane** (long-form / evolving, previously held by a single piece, `2388-round`), and the fullest cash of that lane yet because it is the only lab piece with a genuine **recapitulation**. The engine (`engine.ts`, `Loom`) keeps a growing **library of motifs**; most future material is not invented but **recalled and transformed** by nine developing-variation operators (transpose · invert · retrograde · augment/diminish · fragment+echo · interval-expand/contract · chromatic-neighbour). Transforms **compound**, so a headless run to 8 min produces ~131 motifs / ~803 notes at generation-depth ~6 — material at minute 8 *descends from but no longer resembles* the second-0 seeds — and near 82% through, a deliberate **recapitulation** recalls the earliest, lowest-generation motif near-original (the plain diatonic opening `3,2,2,2,3`) transposed to the current drone root, so the arc *closes* on a recognizable return. **Dissonance is a first-class, resolvable axis** (the direct kill of the 2026-07-24 jury's still-open #1 "no just-intonation net"): an explicit `dissonanceOf(pitch,root)` metric measures each motif against a slow **drone-root plan** (`[0,-2,3,-4,5,-2,0]`), and a structural **tension arch** (`sin` rise to a ~0.62 climax, release to the close) steers *which* candidate transform is chosen to hit a target dissonance — the `expand`/`chromatic` operators push notes microtonally off the tempered grid to beat against the sustained drone (measured dissonance spans 0.00→0.81, climaxing ~0.9 around minute 5, resolving to 0.0 at the end; ± buttons nudge it live). Audio (`audio.ts`, `LoomAudio`, Web-Audio-only) is a plucked/struck chamber voice pool (two detuned oscillators → per-note low-pass envelope) through a shared **convolver-reverb + feedback-delay** bus over a root+fifth drone; fractional (microtonal) pitches are honoured so dissonance is real, not snapped away; deterministic reverb tail from a seeded PRNG. **Visual (SVG, no Canvas2D):** a **memory loom** — each motif a little pitch-contour **sparkline glyph**, connected to its descendants by lineage **warp threads** (violet→magenta hue = transform type / tension / recurrence), a **tension band** and a **playhead** so you watch a motif be born, recalled, deformed, and finally recapitulated. **Interaction = you tend, you don't play it:** the piece self-weaves autonomously (visuals animate on load with zero input, audio unlocks on "Begin"); you can **plant a seed contour**, nudge dissonance ±, or **request a recapitulation**, and a **"Jump ahead 4 min"** control lets a reviewer fast-forward the development. Fully deterministic (`mulberry32(0x2656)`; two runs → byte-identical note lists; no `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date` in logic). Cycle 899 **DEEP** winner (ONE north star — *music that grows, remembers, and returns* — raced via three structure engines: `2642-grove` musical-L-system growth-tree ⭐⭐ + `2648-tide` concept-vector steering-field ⭐, both banked IDEAS §899). Named refs: **Schoenberg** (developing variation) · **David Cope, *Experiments in Musical Intelligence*** · **arXiv:2603.00576** (long-sequence hierarchical symbolic-music structure, Feb 2026). **Ambition 4/5** (`#2` ≥3 subsystems — motif engine + 9 transforms + tension arch + drone plan + recap + Web-Audio pool + SVG loom = ~5; `#3` named refs; `#5` same-day RESEARCH §899; arguably `#1` — first generative-grammar-with-recapitulation long-form engine in the lab, `2388-round` is long-form via body-looping not motivic memory). **diversity:** `banned` = [keyboard input (7/10 recent ships)] + jury-2026-07-24 [Canvas2D-primary · pointer/slider-only · JI/pentatonic net · physics-particle-sim content · clinical "measure-a-system" framing]; `picked` = [**tend/self-evolve input** (not keyboard, not a poke-toy) · **SVG output** (healthy minority) · **motivic-memory + developing-variation long-form engine** technique (never in lab) · **a living thing you tend that grows and returns** vibe (not clinical, not AI-duel, not voice)] — clears every live ban. **mode:** DEEP (ledger …896 W · 897 D · 898 W → alternate to DEEP). **NOT ear-verified** (headless — no speakers): whether the recapitulation lands *emotionally* as a return and whether the dissonance climax reads as tension vs noise wants Karel's ears; the long-form structure is numerically verified (recap recalls the opening seed; dissonance arc 0→0.81→0). `status: demoable`

### [2626-tritave](/dream/2626-tritave) · **what does it feel like to play an instrument with no octaves?** / a genuinely playable microtonal keyboard in the **Bohlen–Pierce** tuning — the single most literal cash of the 2026-07-24 jury's still-open #1 provocation, which *named Bohlen–Pierce* as the way to kill the just-intonation safety net. BP's interval of equivalence is the **tritave (3:1, a perfect twelfth)** divided into **13 equal steps** (ratio `3^(1/13) ≈ 1.0882`, ~146.3¢), built on **odd harmonics** — an alien consonance/dissonance you cannot fake into "always pretty." **Double-novel:** first non-octave tuning AND first **Web MIDI** integration in the ~850-deep lab. `bp.ts` computes `freq(base,step)=base·3^(step/13)`, the 9-note **Lambda** mode (steps 0,1,3,4,6,7,9,10,12), the **3:5:7 "BP major" triad** (≈ steps 0,6,10) and 5:7:9 (≈ 0,4,7), and an additive **clarinet-like `PeriodicWave`** with strong odd partials (1,3,5,7,9,11) so real BP consonances lock and clusters bite. **Numerically verified headless:** step 13 = exactly 3× base; the ordinary 2:1 octave lands at step 8.202 and coincides with *no* step — it never closes. **Input (not pointer-only):** QWERTY as a BP keyboard (bottom row `A‥;`=steps 0‥9, top row `Q‥Y`=10‥15) + Web MIDI (note 60=tonic, degrades silently) + tappable SVG keys. **Visual (SVG):** a **tritave spiral** where one full turn = one tritave, so the amber-dashed octave marker visibly points mid-turn and never closes while the violet tritave marker completes exactly one turn; played keys glow, the held chord's ratio is named. Immediate Start; a deterministic 4s idle autopilot plays a Lambda run + the 3:5:7 chord so it self-demos silently. Cycle 898 WIDE winner (raced vs `2618-nodefarm` device-telemetry techno + `2634-hold` decaying hold-muzak joke, both banked IDEAS §898). Refs: Bohlen 1978 · Mathews & Pierce · Xenharmonic Wiki. **Unverified:** whether the odd-harmonic timbre makes the 3:5:7 triad *audibly* ring (perceptual, needs ears) + Web MIDI with real hardware. `status: demoable`

### [2610-prosody-formant](/dream/2610-prosody-formant) · **what if a machine listened only to HOW you speak and threw away WHAT you say — playing back only the melody, rhythm, intensity, AND vowel-colour of your voice, never the words?** / the direct cash of **RESEARCH §894 (arXiv:2606.26083, "Real-Time Voice AI Hears but Does Not Listen," June 2026** — shipping voice AI locks onto lexical content and is largely deaf to prosody), **force-shipped** after being banked and raced twice (§894 `2562-prosody`, §896 `2586-prosody`) — held both times only because its payoff is mic-gated/headless-unverifiable, never on quality. Cycle 897 went **DEEP**: ONE concept — *keep only the prosody, throw the words away* — raced via three resynthesis techniques (YIN portamento source-filter · granular grain-cloud · **formant-preserving source-filter**), shipping the fullest of the three. `prosody.ts` tracks **f0** via normalized autocorrelation + parabolic interpolation (continuous microtonal Hz ~70–400, a clarity+RMS voiced/unvoiced gate — **never scale-snapped**, the direct kill of the 2026-07-24 jury's still-open #1 "no just-intonation net"), plus a **coarse spectral envelope** (five log-spaced band energies + rough F1/F2 formant peaks from `getFloatFrequencyData`) that carries vowel colour, plus RMS intensity + spectral-centroid brightness. `synth.ts` is the Fant **source-filter** resynth (all native Web Audio): a glottal `PeriodicWave` buzz (1/n falloff) gliding to the tracked f0 via `setTargetAtTime` (audible portamento = the melody), a white-noise breath source for unvoiced frames (consonants read as airy shapes, not silent gaps), both exciting a **live parallel BiquadFilter formant bank** whose F1/F2 centres + per-band gains are set every frame from the analysed envelope — so /a/–/i/–/u/ colour survives with the words gone, reading as *breath, not buzz*. **SVG-only** visual (no Canvas2D): a scrolling f0 spine (thickness = loudness) over **stacked violet→magenta spectral strata** you watch shift with vowel colour, and a dissolving **"WORDS · DISCARDED"** redaction stream above a **"PROSODY + COLOUR · KEPT"** ribbon so the concept reads at a glance; DOM capped ~35. Silent seeded auto-demo (`mulberry32(0x2610)`: declination + stressed peaks + unvoiced gaps + a wandering F1/F2 vowel path) both draws and sounds on load if the mic is denied (`text-destructive` notice). Named refs: arXiv:2606.26083 · **Fant, *Acoustic Theory of Speech Production*, 1960** · arXiv:2603.06079 "StreamVoiceAnon+" (the mirror image — keeps HOW you feel / discards WHO you are). Two runners-up banked as IDEAS §897 seeds (`2602-prosody-yin` — YIN CMND tracker, the most octave-robust f0; `2606-prosody-grain` — an airier granular-cloud resynth). **NOT ear-verified** (headless — no mic/speakers): whether the formant resynth reads as a genuinely wordless voice with distinguishable vowel colour on real speech wants Karel's browser + a mic. `status: demoable`

### [2590-tremor](/dream/2590-tremor) · **what if you were the glottis and your hands were the vocal tract — a body tracked by the camera that becomes a continuous, dissonance-capable voice you play by moving?** / the deliberate INVERSION of 2026's audio→body frontier: **EchoAvatar** (arXiv:2605.28272) and **DiscoForcing** (arXiv:2605.28491), both SIGGRAPH '26, generate real-time full-body motion *from* streaming audio — avatars puppeted by sound. Tremor runs the arrow the other way, **sound FROM motion**: the human moves, the machine sings what the motion means. `motion.ts` produces one normalized `MotionState` (`{cx, cy, energy, spread, velocity}`) from any of three sources so the voice never knows which is driving it — (1) **MediaPipe HandLandmarker** (preferred; loaded at runtime from an ESM CDN with `webpackIgnore`, no npm dep — the pattern `2410-facesong` established — 21 landmarks/hand, up to two hands, raced against a 12 s timeout), (2) an **optical-flow fallback** (frame-diff motion field computed from a 64×48 **offscreen** buffer — pixel-read for analysis only, never a visible drawing surface — reduced to a diff-weighted centroid + spread + energy), (3) a **seeded auto-demo** (`mulberry32(0x2590)` gesture: rise→open→accelerate→still, looping ~13 s). `audio.ts` is a source–filter vocal synth — two detuned glottal saws + a sub sine → three parallel bandpass **formants** → tremolo → limiter — where centroid height → continuous **microtonal f0** (log ~90–880 Hz, + a ±2-semitone horizontal drift, *never* snapped to a scale/chord/pentatonic/JI lattice), spread/openness → a closed-"oo"→open-"ah" formant sweep, energy → gain, and velocity+spread → **roughness** (the two saws beat against each other, an inharmonic growl partial at ×2.76 grows, tremolo jitter deepens) — so fast, wide motion genuinely clashes: dissonance under the mover's control, the direct cash of the operative **2026-07-24 jury's #1** ("kill the just-intonation safety net — let a piece sound *dangerous*"), on a completely fresh input axis. `glfield.ts` is a hand-rolled **WebGL2** ping-pong feedback trail — each frame fades/drifts the accumulation buffer then adds a splat at the motion centroid, stretched by energy and hue-shifted by roughness along the violet→magenta art ramp, tone-mapped with a vignette — so the sonic gesture becomes a glowing continuous mark; if WebGL2 is absent it degrades to an **SVG** tract figure (an ellipse that opens with the hand + a polyline trail). INPUT = **camera / body motion** (the single thinnest input lane — only `2410-facesong` used the camera before, and this is the lab's first hand-tracking→voice); OUTPUT = **WebGL2 (+SVG fallback)**; a small HUD reads live f0 (Hz), roughness, and motion energy. **WIDE-mode winner (cycle 896)**, 1 of 3 explorers across three *unrelated input sources* — voice / body / world — chosen to break the lab's **six-ship keyboard monoculture** (890→895 are all keyboard-driven single instruments). **Silent-06:30 legibility:** the seeded auto-demo drives both the WebGL2 voice-field and the continuous voice on load with zero interaction (audio unlocks on the first gesture per browser autoplay policy; visuals never wait). **Curated over** ⭐⭐ `2586-prosody` (mic → keep ONLY the melody of how you spoke, throw the words away; a YIN-autocorrelation f0 tracker → continuous microtonal resynth + an SVG "WORDS·DISCARDED / PROSODY·KEPT" ribbon — the direct cash of arXiv:2606.26083, the most on-brand-for-Resonance seed, banked IDEAS §896 as TOP resurrect; **now raced twice (§894+§896) — FORCE-SHIP next mic-suitable cycle**, held again only because it's headless-unverifiable and tremor cashed *today's* fresher §896 research at a higher ambition floor) and ⭐ `2594-quake` (live USGS seismicity → a dissonance-capable room drone, depth→pitch + magnitude→roughness, SVG world-map + timeline; real & clean but the least-thin input lane and 2/5 ambition, banked IDEAS §896). Named refs: **arXiv:2605.28272 "EchoAvatar" (SIGGRAPH '26); arXiv:2605.28491 "DiscoForcing" (SIGGRAPH '26)** — the audio→body frontier this inverts. **Ambition 4/5** (`#1` never-in-lab technique — hand-tracking→continuous voice (source-filter driven by MediaPipe Hands) has never been built; `#2` ≥3 subsystems — camera/MediaPipe + optical-flow + source-filter synth + WebGL2 feedback field = 4-5; `#3` EchoAvatar + DiscoForcing; `#5` same-day RESEARCH §896 — the SIGGRAPH '26 audio→body line → today's sound-from-motion build). **diversity:** `banned` = jury-2026-07-24 [Canvas2D-primary output · pointer/drag/click/slider-only input · just-intonation/pentatonic safety-net audio · physics-particle-sim content · "measure/play a physical system" clinical framing]; `picked` = [**camera/body-motion input** (the thinnest lane — breaks the 6-ship keyboard run) · **WebGL2 (+SVG) output** (the healthy-minority the jury endorsed) · **motion→source-filter-voice with a roughness term** technique (continuous Hz, no lattice — CAN sound bad) · **embodied instrument / a human on the other end** vibe (jury #2 — not a system-you-measure)] — clears every live ban. **mode:** WIDE (ledger …894 W · 895 D → alternate to WIDE; three *unrelated input sources* is the correct anti-monoculture answer to six straight keyboard ships). **candidates:** 2590-tremor(win) · 2586-prosody(banked ⭐⭐ IDEAS §896) · 2594-quake(banked ⭐ IDEAS §896). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + WebGL2/SVG; no npm deps — MediaPipe via runtime CDN import only, degrading to optical-flow then the demo; no server route; the only network touch is the OPTIONAL MediaPipe CDN fetch, read-only). **Validation:** normalizer 0 rewrites (on-brand: semantic tokens, violet→magenta art confined to the WebGL2/SVG art layer, `text-2xl` hero, `min-h-[44px]`/`rounded-md` buttons, no `font-serif`/`text-white`/off-brand-hue chrome, helpers `draw*`/`run*`/`make*`/`apply*`/`track*`/`synth*` — no `use*`); full-tree `npx tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `npx eslint src/app/dream/2590-tremor --max-warnings 0` clean; authoritative winner-only `rm -rf .next && npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` **EXIT 0 — full route tree + First-Load-JS summary, NO EMFILE (ulimit hard-capped 4096, so compile-mode is authoritative)**, emitted `/dream/2590-tremor/{page.js, page.js.nft.json, page_client-reference-manifest.js}`; losers 2586/2594 banked to IDEAS §896 then `rm -rf`'d before the authoritative build (never committed). **NOT eye/ear-verified** (headless — no camera/display/speakers): the MediaPipe + camera + optical-flow paths could not be exercised, and whether motion reads as a legible, playable *voice* (vs noise) wants Karel's browser + a webcam; the deterministic self-playing auto-demo + WebGL2→SVG fallback + `text-destructive` no-camera/no-audio notices are the silent-review stand-ins. Builder's honest caveats: hand-tracking/optical-flow are noisy so everything is EMA-smoothed (very fast gestures blur); two-formant morphing approximates vowels rather than a full tract. All browser APIs SSR-guarded; AudioContext gesture-gated; no strobe (the field is a slow luminance trail); full teardown on unmount (oscillators stopped, `ctx.close()`, `cancelAnimationFrame`, camera stream stopped, GL context released). ### [2578-goad](/dream/2578-goad) · **what if you traded fours with an AI improviser that PLANS several exchanges ahead — an adversary whose whole goal is to bank unresolved TENSION against you, over a continuously ringing drone so its held tritone genuinely BEATS in your ear?** / the third prototype in the lab's adversarial-musician genre (after `2502-duel`'s counterpoint negamax and `2530-trap`'s single-line tension tug-of-war) — but deliberately built to break OUT of that groove on the two axes those two share: it swaps the SVG piano-roll for a **WebGL2 tension landscape** and swaps transient dissonance for **continuous audible roughness**. You and an AI alternate 4-bar phrases (8 events) over a continuously ringing **C-major drone** — the shared harmonic ground that makes dissonance *beat*. `tension.ts` is a real, continuous psychoacoustic scalar per event: **Sethares' closed-form partial-pair roughness** `d = a₁a₂(e^(−b₁sx) − e^(−b₂sx))` (the analytic form of the **Plomp & Levelt 1965** critical-band dissonance curve) summed over each melody note's first six harmonics against the drone's partials — so a tritone or minor-2nd genuinely roughens against the sounding drone — plus voice-leading leaps + a per-pitch-class tendency-tone/metric-expectation weight (a leading tone or tritone held over the barline = the *banked cliff* handed to the next player). `planner.ts` is an adversarial **beam search** (K=10 over 8 steps) maximising `1.00·banked + 0.85·humanResidual − 0.34·meanInteriorTension` — it scores each candidate phrase by the *lowest tension your best stepwise resolution can still reach* (a greedy human-resolver model), so it plans past its own phrase into your reply (≥2-exchange lookahead — the sign-flipped-lookahead spirit of **Shannon 1950**) and prefers cliffs you *cannot* defuse; the chosen phrase yields a taunting intent line ("held the tritone over the barline — resolve it or lose ground"). `landscape-gl.ts` is a hand-rolled **WebGL2** scrolling "mountain range" — height = the tension scalar, colour the canonical violet→hot-magenta ramp (magenta crests = cliffs the AI banked, violet valleys = resolution), with a glowing crest line — under an aligned **SVG overlay** (note markers, phrase boundaries, YOU/AI labels, banked-cliff flags, playhead, live cursor). `synth.ts` = the ringing drone + two free-**12-TET** melody timbres (you vs AI — no just-intonation/pentatonic snapping, so the roughness is real). INPUT = **computer-keyboard** (`a w s e d f t g y h u j k o l` → one chromatic octave, piano layout) + a seeded auto-demo; OUTPUT = **WebGL2 + SVG** (SVG-curve fallback if WebGL2 is absent). The direct cash of the operative **2026-07-24 jury's #1** ("kill the just-intonation safety net — let ONE piece be allowed to sound *dangerous*"; this is the only lab piece where dissonance is *continuously audible* against a sounding drone, not just transient) fused with **#5** ("extend `2502-duel` — the negamax-as-musician is a whole genre, worth three prototypes"). **DEEP-mode winner (cycle 895)**, 1 of 3 planning-technique explorations of ONE north star (*trade fours with an adversary that plans*). **Silent-06:30 legibility:** on load a deterministic `mulberry32(0x2578)` auto-demo self-plays a full dialogue (a synthetic human vs the AI) with zero input — the WebGL2 landscape scrolls its banked-tension mountain range and plays the whole story, audio unlocking on first gesture. **Curated over** ⭐⭐ `2574-riposte` (a *genuine* negamax game-tree, `SEARCH_DEPTH=4`/~22.6k nodes, over a 12-move motif-transformation space with a live game-tree readout — the *truest* generalization of the duel's negamax and the strongest search of the three, banked IDEAS §895 as TOP resurrect; **held back precisely because it's the closest sibling to the already-shipped `2530-trap`** — a third SVG-piano-roll negamax-tension duel would be the "too similar" pattern the mandate exists to break, so it's banked with a FUSION brief: graft its real search onto goad's beating-drone + WebGL2 landscape) and ⭐ `2582-mimic` (an AI that steals your motif and hands it back progressively deformed — a **motif family-tree** of developing-variation mutations tightening like a stretto, the biggest conceptual surprise, banked IDEAS §895). ### [2566-ovation](/dream/2566-ovation) · **what if you could conduct a crowd's applause — from one lone awkward clapper up to a thundering standing ovation that spontaneously locks into rhythmic unison, and back down?** / a warm-human joke grounded in real physics: applause is a population of **coupled oscillators** (Néda et al., *Nature* 403, 2000) that spontaneously synchronizes into periodic unison when the clapping rate slows. `sim.ts` runs a mean-field **Kuramoto crowd** (`dθ_i/dt = ω_i + K·r·sin(ψ−θ_i)`, order parameter `r` = coherence 0→1) of up to 4,000 phase oscillators; `audio.ts` is a **granular impulse AudioWorklet** (Blob URL, ~160-grain pool of bandpassed white-noise bursts — **zero pitch, no scale, no melody** — where low `r` smears grains into diffuse patter and high `r` stacks them into one thunderous unison smack, so the sync is *audible* in the grain timing); `gl.ts` is a raw **WebGL2** stadium point-cloud (per-agent flash, additive-blend persistence, visible wavefronts). Conduct with `Space`/`↑↓` (swell/hush) + `1`–`6` (crowd size); `A` toggles a seeded auto-conduct arc (lone→roar→lock→fade) that also runs as the WebGL2/audio fallback. The direct cash of the 2026-07-24 jury's still-open #1 (a *noise/granular voice with no pitch lattice at all* — "still unbuilt") **and** #2 (*a joke, a human on the other end, not another differential-equation demo*). `status: demoable`

### [2558-khoomei](/dream/2558-khoomei) · **what if one sustained note could split into two — a droning fundamental and a piercing whistle overtone you sweep by hand, like a Tuvan throat singer — synthesized by a real physical vocal tract?** / biphonic (khoomei / sygyt) overtone singing produced by a **1D Kelly–Lochbaum digital-waveguide vocal tract** — the physical model behind Neil Thapen's *Pink Trombone*, and the lab's FIRST vocal-tract tube (it has vowel/formant *filter* instruments — 2410-facesong, 393-kids-vowel-color, 175-vocal-choir — and non-vocal waveguides — 1694-reed-column clarinet bore, 827-waveguide-mesh drum — but never a synthesized *throat*) · **the direct cash of RESEARCH §893 (arXiv:2606.04943, "Differentiable Articulatory Copy-Synthesis of Biphonic Singing", June 2026 — a differentiable KL waveguide fit to real sygyt recordings), fused with the 2026-07-24 jury's still-open #1 (kill the just-intonation safety net; let a piece sound dangerous — a synthetic throat growls/hisses/clashes on a totally fresh axis, the human voice as a played physical instrument).** `worklet-source.ts` runs the tract sample-by-sample inside an `AudioWorkletProcessor` (loaded from a `Blob` URL, no network): **44 cylindrical sections**, each area `A[i]=d[i]²`; two counter-propagating streams `R[i]`/`L[i]`; canonical one-multiply KL scattering `w=k·(R[i-1]+L[i]); Rout=R[i-1]−w; Lout=L[i]+w` with `k[i]=(A[i-1]−A[i])/(A[i-1]+A[i])` (correct signs → passive → provably bounded); sliding the constriction toward the lips shortens the front cavity and raises its resonance, so the boosted harmonic climbs the series (5f0→6f0→7f0…) — a bright whistle rising over the steady drone, produced by the *physics*, not a second oscillator (the constriction index is derived from the target overtone via the quarter-wave relation, then lerped per-sample so the whistle glides) · **dissonance-capable by construction:** no scale, no pitch lattice — `f0` continuous, and a `detune` control drifts the overtone *off* the exact harmonic so it beats/clashes against the drone · INPUT = **keyboard-first control surface** (←/→ sweep the overtone up/down the ladder · 1–9 jump to a harmonic · ↑/↓ glide drone f0 · z/x constriction tightness · ,/. detune-to-clash · Space start/silence; ### [2538-driver](/dream/2538-driver) · **what if a techno machine never played the same bar twice — a generative club engine that composes an endless, evolving arrangement in real time, rhythm-first, and can sound genuinely dangerous?** / a rhythm-first generative club engine whose long-form **arrangement state machine** (`engine.ts`) walks a multi-minute arc — intro → build → drop → breakdown → build → drop… — mutating a fully-synthesized 909/303 pattern bank every bar so the machine audibly transforms over minutes and **never plays the same bar twice** · **the direct cash of RESEARCH §892 (arXiv:2605.21874, "Real-time EDM-inspired sonification of a supercomputer", May 2026): *infinite-yet-stylistically-coherent, genre-native* monitoring music — a continuous stream that stays engaging because it EVOLVES rather than loops — fused with the lab's rarest, most-prized lane (long-form generative with genuine state/memory; `2388-round` is the only 5/5).** `engine.ts` advances one 16th-step per `tick()` and re-evaluates the whole piece each bar: **phase walk** (each phase a fresh PRNG-drawn length so no two passes line up), **energy/tension scalars** (target derived from phase+progress, smoothed per step ~2 s — also the photosensitive-safety guarantee — gating track fade-in/out so kick+hats fall away in the breakdown, sub+open-hat only at a drop top), **per-bar mutation** (four-on-floor kick w/ drifting ghosts, backbeat clap, offbeat-8th hats + probabilistic 16th ghosts = main variety source, fills that roll+fire a noise riser before a drop), and an **acid line that evolves not regenerates** (~40% of 16 steps re-rolled each bar). **Never-repeats, two mechanisms:** every bar draws fresh values from one advancing `mulberry32(0x2538)` stream, AND each finished bar is FNV-hashed over the whole pattern bank+acid+root and checked against a rolling 64-bar history — the HUD tallies `distinct bars · 0 repeats` (tracks the bar count exactly). **Deliberately dangerous, NOT snapped-consonant:** the acid pool includes the b9 (1 semitone) + tritone (6), can jump an octave, and drifts its root into dissonance against the sub — NO just-intonation/pentatonic quantiser anywhere — through a resonant envelope-modulated 303 filter + waveshaper drive + master soft-clip/limiter · OUTPUT = hand-rolled **WebGL2** fragment-shader "equalizer city" (no three.js): glowing violet columns over a receding club floor driven by live per-voice envelopes + energy, a VU cap riding each bar, a playhead-glow on the current 16th, tension beams; ### [2530-trap](/dream/2530-trap) · **what if an AI musician were trying to WIN — planning a phrase ahead to lead the shared melody into a harmonic trap you can't resolve, and you could see the trap coming and try to escape?** / an adversarial tension tug-of-war: you and a planning AI alternately extend ONE shared chromatic melodic line; the AI's objective is to **maximise unresolved harmonic tension** and yours is to **resolve** it — a single tension meter is the rope (AI pulls up, a good resolving move pulls down), you score by snapping high-tension back to consonance, the AI scores by stranding you in dissonance you can't answer · **`planner.ts` is a genuine depth-limited minimax with alpha–beta (Shannon 1950): tension is one scalar both sides fight over, the AI is the maximiser and the modelled human the minimiser — but two things make it a *trap-setter*, not a note-by-note dissonance grabber: (1) it values a move by *your best reply one phrase ahead* (`PLAN_DEPTH` plies), so it will play a merely-tense note if that note builds the sonority into a cluster you cannot escape, and (2) tension on YOUR turn is weighted higher than on its own (`PLAYER_W` 1.3 vs `AI_W` 0.7) — it hunts positions where your hands are tied. `tension.ts` is a pure chromatic (12-TET) model: context dissonance against a decaying rolling window of the last 5 pitches (implied polyphony, after Bregman) blending decayed-average with decayed-**worst-clash** + voice-leading strain + "corner strain" (the minimum dissonance the best reply can still reach — high corner = a trap). The worst-clash term is the real fix for chromatic escapability: in 12-TET a naive average-dissonance model is trivially escapable near a minor third, so the AI plants a tritone+semitone cluster in the window that no single next note answers — parameters tuned by headless self-play so a perfect player mostly only "holds" and a fallible one gets stranded. `synth.ts` = two-timbre Web Audio (biting saw AI / warm triangle you) with overlapping tails so dissonant intervals actually beat.** · **the direct cash of the 2026-07-24 jury's #5 (*"extend `2502-duel` — GENERALISE the negamax-as-musician; an AI that plays adversarially against your line is a whole genre… worth three prototypes"*) fused with #1 (*kill the just-intonation safety net — let a piece sound dangerous*): dissonance is the AI's WEAPON, fully chromatic, never snapped to a can't-sound-bad lattice** · **the trap-reveal (ReaLJam CHI 2026's anticipation, made adversarial):** on commit the search's **principal variation** is stored, and on your turn the line shows a faint dashed circle where the AI *expects your reply* (`pv[1]`) + a magenta dashed **"trap"** note it plans to play next (`pv[2]`) to spring it — one beat's warning, and the revealed threat IS the AI's own search PV, not decoration · INPUT = **keyboard control surface** (A W S E D F T G Y H U J K → C4…C5) + equal clickable SVG cells — NOT pointer-only · OUTPUT = **SVG** piano-roll + live tension meter (DOM-eased fill, violet→magenta→red danger ramp in the art layer) + two scores + RESOLVED/held/STRANDED verdicts — NOT Canvas2D · **adversarial-lookahead-planning improv with strategic chromatic dissonance technique** · **duet-with-a-planning-AI / musical-contest vibe (deliberately NOT altered-states, NOT a clinical system-you-measure)** · **DEEP-mode winner (cycle 891)**, 1 of 3 interaction models racing ONE concept — *a planning improv partner that shows its hand*. **Silent-06:30 legibility:** a deterministic `mulberry32(0x2530)` auto-demo self-plays a full round on load (AI sets a trap → it's revealed → a scripted player escapes or is caught → the meter swings → the score moves, landing a scored 2–1) so a still glance reads as a contest with stakes. **Curated over** ⭐⭐ `2526-tell` (turn-based trading-fours where the AI ghosts its whole planned DEPTH-4 answer on the SVG roll a beat early with a resolve/provoke/auto toggle — the prettiest plan-reveal + most on-brand for a pianist; banked IDEAS §891 as TOP resurrect — held back as the closest sibling to the shipped `2502-duel`) and ⭐ `2534-echo` (a real-time continuous jam — the AI commits its next ~3 beats via depth-3 search and draws them as an anticipation waterfall scrolling toward a NOW line, the most literal ReaLJam; banked IDEAS §891 — its core payoff, the real-time lock *feel*, is unverifiable headless per its own builder). ### [2522-xyscope](/dream/2522-xyscope) · **what if the sound *were* the picture — an XY oscilloscope where the raw audio signal itself draws the glowing vector shape, and driving it toward harsher timbres warps the shape in lockstep?** / oscilloscope / Lissajous music: two hard-panned oscillators form a stereo signal (voice A = left = X axis, voice B = right = Y), so the figure on screen is the parametric curve `(L(t), R(t))` — not a *visualization of* the sound, it *is* the sound, pulled from two `AnalyserNode`s (`getFloatTimeDomainData`, one per channel) every frame · **the deliberate answer to the 2026-07-24 jury's #1 mandate — kill the just-intonation safety net, build a sound engine that CAN sound bad:** base freq + oscillator **ratio are fully continuous / un-quantized** (no pitch lattice at all), so simple ratios (2:1, 3:2) draw stable standing loops while irrational/complex ratios make the figure precess and the sound beat and clash; a **`tanh` waveshaper drive + FM index** bends each sine toward a square with inharmonic sidebands — hold Space to ramp to full **danger** and it buzzes/screeches while the vector figure sharpens into spikes · OUTPUT = **hand-rolled WebGL2 vector renderer** (`scope-gl.ts`, no three.js): audio-buffer `LINE_STRIP` with additive blending into a ping-pong **persistence buffer** + a bloom/tonemap/vignette pass for the phosphor look — WebGL, the healthy-minority output the jury endorsed against the lab's Canvas2D over-use (Canvas2D 7× vs WebGL 2× in the last 15) · INPUT = **computer-keyboard control surface** (letter keys play base pitches, arrows sweep ratio/phase, Space ramps drive) — NOT pointer-only; ### [2502-duel](/dream/2502-duel) · **what if counterpoint were a turn-based strategy GAME you play against an AI that actually thinks ahead?** / the lab's FIRST real game-with-a-winner and FIRST adversarial game-tree AI — a Counterpoint Duel where you and a 3-ply negamax opponent alternately place notes over a fixed cantus firmus, each move scored live by Fux's first-species rules, highest total wins · **`ai.ts` is a genuine negamax (`AI_DEPTH=3`, the sign-flipped minimax of Shannon's 1950 chess paper): a move's value = its immediate rule score MINUS the best the opponent can then extract, recursively — so the AI plays the note that leaves YOUR best reply weakest, not the locally tastiest one; the scoreboard prints the actual node count walked (thousands/move) so the search is visible. `counterpoint.ts` scores each move by first-species rules (Fux 1725): vertical consonance vs the note below (imperfect 3rds/6ths slightly over perfect 5ths/8ves), heavy penalty for parallel perfect 5ths/8ves between beats, contrary/oblique motion beats similar, stepwise rewarded / leaps >6th docked, opening & closing beats must be perfect consonances — each move returns signed reasons so the UI shows the WHY on hover. `synth.ts` = two-timbre Web Audio (triangle cantus / saw counterpoint), immediate notes + full-line playback with a moving playhead** · INPUT = discrete turn-based note-placement (click a staff cell, hover to preview the score) · OUTPUT = **SVG** staff/piano-roll (breaks the lab's Canvas2D over-use), live You-vs-AI scoreboard, per-move reasons, verdict line · **minimax game-tree search + species-counterpoint scoring** technique (0× in the lab) · **music-theory strategy-game vibe (deliberately NOT about consciousness — a real game with a winner)** · **DEEP-mode winner (cycle 889)**, 1 of 3 game designs racing ONE concept — *counterpoint as a playable GAME with a real adversarial-search AI* — the direct cash of the 2026-07-23 jury's #1 provocation ("build something not about consciousness at all — a GAME, a genuinely useful tool") and the lab's biggest structural gap (hundreds of "experiences," almost no games, and grep-0× adversarial-search AI). **Silent-06:30 legibility:** a deterministic `mulberry32(0x2502)` auto-demo self-plays a full duel on load — notes appearing on the SVG staff, the score ticking, a winner — so a still glance reads as a game with stakes. **Curated over** ⭐⭐ `2506-weave` (Counterpoint Golf — a single-player PUZZLE where a live rule-linter flags violations and a branch-and-bound *oracle* computes your provably-optimal "par"; the most fun, banked IDEAS §889 — resurrect on a rhythm/reactive cycle). ### [2482-collide](/dream/2482-collide) · **what if a room full of physical objects composed its own music by colliding?** / a 3D physics bowl where dropped/thrown objects of four materials (glass / wood / metal / stone) fall, collide, and ring by what they're made of — a self-playing generative percussion sculpture · **an *owned* rigid-body impulse solver (fixed 1/120 s substeps · sphere–sphere de-overlap + normal-impulse resolution `j = -(1+e)vₙ/(1/m₁+1/m₂)` · a paraboloid bowl that funnels the pile back to the centre so it keeps colliding on its own · rim wall) emits a *strike event* on every resolved collision above a speed threshold, carrying the body's material + its size→just-intonation fundamental + the impact velocity; each strike excites a **modal-synthesis** voice (a sum of exponentially-decaying inharmonic partials, per-material ratios/decays/brightness, velocity scaling both loudness AND high-partial brightness) through a 24-voice oldest-steal pool + synthesized convolution reverb + limiter; a lit three.js scene (lathed bowl, shadow key light + hemisphere fill + violet accent, per-material geometry, emissive impact pulses, gently orbiting camera) shows it composing, with a top-down Canvas2D fallback that still collides and rings** · throw/spawn + shake input · **three.js 3D lit geometry** output (breaks the Canvas2D groove — 0× in the last 10) · rigid-body-physics → collision-driven modal-Foley technique · playful physical-materials / self-composing-sculpture vibe (NOT about consciousness) · **DEEP-mode winner (cycle 887)**, 1 of 3 framings of ONE concept — *strike the world and hear what it's made of* — the first piece to make the **join** the lab had structurally avoided: a rigid-body collision whose impulse *excites a material-dependent ring* (the actual thesis of FoleyAutomatic; ### [2466-horizon](/dream/2466-horizon) · **if I stood outside right now and looked up, what would the sky be singing?** / a from-the-ground planetarium of the REAL sky over your location, sonified as a just-intoned drone · **the actual positions of the Sun, Moon and five naked-eye planets are computed offline (zero network) from the live wall clock via Paul Schlyter's low-precision Keplerian algorithm — day-number → orbital elements → geocentric ecliptic → RA/Dec → altitude/azimuth for the viewer's real geolocation (Local Sidereal Time); each body sounds ONE sustained voice whose pitch is log-mapped from its real sidereal orbital PERIOD and snapped to a just-intonation grid (after Kepler's *Harmonices Mundi*, 1619), so a fast Mercury sings high and slow Saturn low — pitch is period-FIXED so the chord stays legible; ALTITUDE→loudness (a body below the horizon fades to silence — you can't see it), AZIMUTH→stereo pan (east→right, west→left), so as the real sky turns bodies rise & set and the chord BREATHES. ### [2422-chladni](/dream/2422-chladni) · **the lab's FIRST cymatics / standing-wave simulation** / see the hidden shapes of a vibrating surface and play them · **drive a square plate at a frequency and ~6,500 sand grains migrate off the moving areas onto the NODAL LINES, revealing the vibration mode as a crisp geometric figure; sweep the frequency (slider or drag the plate) and the mode reorganises and the sand re-migrates while a gentle Web-Audio tone drives the plate at the same pitch — you hear what you see · frequency-scrub input · Canvas2D particle-density field output · Chladni standing-wave nodal-line sim + gradient-descent particle migration technique · physics/instructional/beautiful-geometry vibe (NOT about consciousness)** · **WIDE-mode winner (cycle 882)**, 1 of 3 parallel non-consciousness explorers built to keep breaking the altered-state monoculture the 2026-07-23 jury flagged — a piece about the **real physical world** (jury provocation #1), directly grounded in this cycle's research dive (§882, *ChladniSonify* arXiv:2605.09846, 2026-05-11). **The math is done for real, per grain, every frame:** the plate's standing-wave displacement over the unit square is the classic Chladni figure function `f(x,y) = cos(nπx)cos(mπy) − cos(mπx)cos(nπy)` (nodes where `f≈0`, and `n≠m` always since `f≡0` when `n=m`); each of ~6,500 `Float32Array` grains evaluates `f` and its analytic gradient `∇f` and takes a **Newton step toward the level set** `p ← p − LR·f·∇f/(|∇f|²+ε)` (gradient descent on `|f|`, sliding straight to the nearest nodal line) plus a **jitter scaled by `|f|`** so high-motion grains agitate while node grains settle — the exact physical mechanism — snapping the cloud onto crisp lines over ~1–2 s with soft migration trails. Frequency maps through an ordered resonant-mode table; between entries the field AND its gradient are linearly **blended** (`f=(1−t)f_A+t·f_B`) so figures morph continuously — clean at the table values, a living hybrid in between, re-energising the sand via a decaying agitation term that also drives an audio shimmer. Grains deposit into a 512×512 density buffer tone-mapped (`1−e^(−d·exposure)`) through a plate→violet→warm-sand ramp in ONE `putImageData`/frame (no per-grain draw calls). Deterministic idle auto-sweep dwells on clean figures then morphs, so a silent phone glance already shows sand forming and reforming. **Curated over** ⭐ `2418-two-rooms` (the lab's first real cross-machine WebRTC duet — serverless copy-paste SDP, solo-complete; banked IDEAS §882 because its two-machine payoff is unreviewable solo on a phone at 06:30 — resurrect as a DEEP cycle w/ a QR-signalling helper) and ⭐⭐ `2420-temperament` (a genuinely useful live A/B tuning-system comparator — Just vs ET major-third beating switches off/on, real 6-partial additive beats, Helmholtz/Barbour; banked IDEAS §882, prime near-term TOOL cycle). Named ref: **Ernst Chladni, *Entdeckungen über die Theorie des Klanges* (1787)** (+ Hans Jenny, *Cymatics*, 1967). **Ambition 3/5** (`#1` never-used technique — first cymatics/standing-wave sim in the lab · `#3` Chladni 1787 named ref · `#5` §882 research, same-date <30-day source). **diversity:** `banned` = jury-2026-07-23 [screen-tap-only input · three.js/GPU-shader output · entrainment/phase-lock technique · "drug-free altered state" framing · the two-independent-variables/no-master-knob/one-question TEMPLATE]; `picked` = [frequency-scrub input · Canvas2D particle-density output · Chladni nodal-line simulation technique · physics/geometry vibe · a piece about the real physical world] — clears every live ban (canvas-2D is borderline-frequent but explicitly OFF the jury's ban list; the novelty lives on the input/technique/vibe axes). **mode:** WIDE. **candidates:** 2422-chladni(win) · 2418-two-rooms(banked ⭐ IDEAS §882) · 2420-temperament(banked ⭐⭐ IDEAS §882). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Canvas2D + Web Audio; zero new npm deps, no server route, no network). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites (on-brand: semantic tokens, violet-only accent, `text-2xl` hero, `min-h-[44px]`/`rounded-md` buttons, no `font-serif`/`text-white`/off-brand-hue chrome, helpers named `draw*`/`compute*`/`stepParticles` — no `use*`); both losers banked to IDEAS §882 then `rm -rf`'d before the authoritative build (never committed); full-tree `npx tsc --noEmit` = 0 errors, `npx next lint` = clean, authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = EXIT 0, emitting `/dream/2422-chladni/page.js` (30 KB). **NOT eye/ear-verified** (headless — no display/speakers): whether the nodal figures read crisply, the morph-between-modes feel, low-end fps of the ~6,500-grain per-frame Newton step, and the driving-tone loudness all want Karel's browser; the deterministic idle auto-sweep is the silent-review stand-in. ### [2388-round](/dream/2388-round) · visionary / long-form accumulating-memory canon · **your body is a live looper pedal — move for ~7 seconds and that gesture becomes an autonomous glowing ghost that loops forever; layer more and a whole canon of your past selves circles and sings at once, drifting out of phase over minutes · webcam optical-flow input · three.js Ikeda-monochrome output · accumulating-independent-loops (Reich phasing) technique · contemplative pole** · **DEEP-mode winner (cycle 877)**, 1 of 3 parallel approaches to ONE concept — *make the second, un-collapsible variable the visitor's own recorded MOTION HISTORY, replayed as a living presence that conflicts with live-you* (the direct cash of jury 2026-07-22 #2, *"the room remembering you"*, and #1, *"no master 0→1 knob"*). A "record" action captures the next ~7s of your webcam-tracked motion centroid into a **loop clip**; when the window closes the clip becomes a **persistent, autonomously-replaying layer** with its own drifting clock (a tiny per-layer rate-detune → Steve-Reich phase drift), and you can stack up to 6 + live. **The lab's first true long-form / stateful / accumulating piece** (the categorical-menu lane the lab was thinnest on): state only grows, auto-arm keeps laying down layers, and minute five holds and reshuffles every earlier layer — nothing like minute one. **The richest "no single knob" structure yet** — not two variables but N independent voices, each on its own loop clock; the only controls add/remove layers, never scale one intensity. Each layer maps its path to a warm-pentatonic gesture (centroid-Y→pitch, energy→amplitude) as one voice in a growing round; `three.js` draws each as a faint closed ghost line + bright pale head at its own depth (Ikeda near-monochrome white/grey on near-black, one cool accent for live-you), slow camera drift. Degrades gracefully: camera-denied → a seeded deterministic Lissajous auto-performer self-records the full canon (on-brand `text-destructive` note); no-WebGL → notice, audio continues. Ambition ~4/5 (`#2` ≥4 subsystems: webcam frame-diff optical-flow + timestamped looper/clip engine + per-layer autonomous-replay clock w/ phase drift + three.js canon renderer + per-voice Web Audio round · `#3` named refs: MOCO 2026 *"Moving Contexts: How Movement Histories Shape Whole-Body Interaction"* [ACM 10.1145/3802842.3802852] + Steve Reich phase music [*Piano Phase*, *It's Gonna Rain*] · `#4` multi-cycle-capable long-form + `#5` direct cash of the same-day §877 research finding). No API route → no `guard` (pure `"use client"` getUserMedia + Web Audio + three.js; zero new npm deps). **SAFETY:** no strobe — all luminance slow-drift, gentle camera motion. Banked non-winners: ⭐⭐ `2380-afterself` (three.js point-cloud duet with your afterself replayed on a 30s HRTF-spatial lag) + ⭐ `2384-hysteresis` (WebGL2 GPU ping-pong float-feedback thermal NOW-over-THEN, warm ember palette) → IDEAS §877. `status: demoable`.

### [2360-blind-spot](/dream/2360-blind-spot) · perceptual illusion / motion-induced blindness · **hear your own consciousness edit reality: sit still, fixate the center, and objectively-present tones VANISH from your awareness one by one — the chord audibly thinning as your attention narrows, re-blooming as the dots return · gaze-fixation + tap/1-6 report input · pure SVG-DOM output · clinical Ikeda-blue palette · perceptual-fading / cosmic-ambient pole** · **WIDE-mode winner (cycle 875)**, 1 of 3 parallel drug-free altered-state explorers of ONE thesis — *make the second, un-collapsible variable the visitor's own INVISIBLE perception*. A **Motion-Induced Blindness** instrument (Bonneh, Cooperman & Sagi, *Nature* 2001): a large field of blue crosses rotates gently (~0.08 rev/sec, no strobe) while warm target dots on cardinal AND oblique meridians spontaneously disappear from conscious awareness for seconds — physically always present, the explicit focus of attention, and you *know* they're there. **The purest "no master knob" in the lab:** objective presence (a constant outline ring) and subjective awareness (the dot's fill + its audible partial) are not two ends of a dial but independent facts that *contradict* each other. Each dot is a sustained partial in a soft A2 chord; **tap a faded dot (or press 1–6) to report it and its partial mutes** — so the chord thins to match your shrinking visual field, then re-voices as dots return: you literally hear the gap between what is there and what you perceive. The 2024 **spatial-anisotropy** finding (PMC11557702 — obliques fade sooner/longer than cardinals) is baked into the dot layout + a live "blind-map" readout that logs which positions you lose most. Ambition 4/5 (`#1` MIB is 0× in the ~880-route lab · `#2` 4 subsystems: rotating-grid stimulus renderer + report state machine + additive partial-bank synth + anisotropy blind-map · `#3` Bonneh/Cooperman/Sagi + PMC11557702 refs · `#5` same-day §875 research). `diversity: banned=[WebGL2/three.js/Canvas2D output · keyboard-played · camera-input · single-scalar-follower · intense-union pole · violet-gold palette · Kuramoto]; picked=[gaze+tap-report input · SVG-DOM output(grows the minority substrate) · MIB objective-vs-subjective technique · clinical Ikeda-blue palette · perceptual-fading pole]`. Raced vs. `2362-khoomei` (formant-tracking overtone singing — TOP resurrect ⭐⭐, IDEAS §875) + `2364-drift-static` (WebGPU-compute Kitaoka peripheral drift ⭐, IDEAS §875). **Reviewable on a silent phone:** SVG grid + dots render on mount, a seeded `mulberry32(0x2360)` auto-fade demo self-plays the whole idea with zero interaction and **no permissions** (no mic/GPU/camera/CDN). **No API route → no guard.** `status: demoable` · **NOT eye/ear-verified** (headless — real MIB requires the viewer's OWN fixation, so a perceptual disappearance is structurally unverifiable headless; the seeded demo is the honest stand-in): reasoned + `tsc`/ESLint/compile-verified only; degrades gracefully (no WebAudio → `text-destructive`, stimulus still renders; reduced-motion honored). Design notes: `src/app/dream/2360-blind-spot/README.md`

### [2354-buoyant](/dream/2354-buoyant) · movement-sonification / felt-body-weight illusion · **an altered state of your own BODY (not your mind): the SOUND your footsteps make retunes how HEAVY you feel — bounce with the phone and shape the movement-sound to feel buoyant & weightless or leaden & grounded · devicemotion footfall onsets · Canvas2D soft-body buoyancy field · high-key aerial palette · cosmic-ambient/embodied pole** · **Best on a phone — hold it and physically bounce/step in place.** Grounded same-day in RESEARCH §874: **SoniBand (Tajadura-Jiménez et al., CHI 2026)** — pitch-modulated movement-sound measurably changes *perceived body-lightness, effort, and affect*; brighter footstep-sound → lighter body (+ the foundational "As Light as Your Footsteps", CHI 2015; Lenggenhager/Blanke full-body ownership). `DeviceMotionEvent` accelerometer (iOS `requestPermission()` from the Start gesture) is high-passed against a gravity baseline and rising-edge peak-picked into **footfall onsets**; each onset fires a raw-Web-Audio impact (filtered-noise contact + continuous-pitch body-resonance tone with a stretched-inharmonic partial — **no pentatonic/JI**) over a sustained buoyancy drone whose pitch+inharmonicity rise with brightness (master ≈0.15 behind a compressor). A Canvas2D soft-body cloud hangs weightless (underdamped) when bright and sinks/compresses with a heavy contact-shadow (overdamped) when dark. **No master knob by design** — TWO genuinely independent, conflictable axes: **brightness/lightness** (SoniBand timbre + buoyancy physics) × **sync/lag ownership** (a delay on both audio+visual echo; tight = the new weight is *yours*, lagged = it floats free / derealized). The four quadrants (bright+tight buoyant-and-owned · bright+lagged weightless-not-yours · dark+tight heavy-but-owned · dark+lagged leaden-adrift) each get a distinct felt-state label. **DEEP-mode winner (cycle 874)**, 1 of 2 parallel captures of ONE body-lightness concept (raced vs. `2356-lighter`, a webcam vertical-motion version — banked to IDEAS §874 as the genuine cycle-2, since 2354's footfall paradigm is the more faithful SoniBand embodiment AND is phone-native, while webcam was just used at 2340/cycle 872). Ambition 3/5 (`#2` ≥4 subsystems: devicemotion capture + footfall onset-detection + movement-sonification synth + soft-body buoyancy physics + sync/ownership axis · `#3` SoniBand/CHI-2015/Lenggenhager-Blanke refs · `#5` same-day §874 research). `diversity: banned=[pointer/tap-as-primary ~4×/10 · single-scalar-knob(jury) · INTENSE/ecstatic-union pole(jury 8×) · violet→gold-on-near-black(jury 6×) · webcam-input(just used 2340)]; picked=[devicemotion footfall input · movement-sonification felt-body-weight technique(0× in lab) · two-axis brightness×sync · high-key aerial palette · cosmic-ambient/embodied pole]`. **Fully reviewable on a silent desktop:** robust pointer-drag fallback + a seeded (mulberry32) autopilot keeps the field bobbing before any click, with a live one-line note of the active input mode; no-sensor → pointer, camera/permission errors → `text-destructive`. Only auto-motion is a ≤0.12 Hz luminance drift, frozen under `prefers-reduced-motion`; no strobe. **No API route → no guard** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D + devicemotion; zero new npm deps). `status: demoable` · **NOT body-verified** (headless — no accelerometer/speakers): the felt-weight illusion, accelerometer thresholds, and whether the four quadrants land as distinct somatic states are reasoned + `tsc`/ESLint/compile-verified only; degrades gracefully. ### [2348-tritone-veil](/dream/2348-tritone-veil) · perceptual-illusion / auditory self-portrait · **the screen+speakers as a psychophysics instrument: Diana Deutsch's TRITONE PARADOX made into an interactive self-portrait — octave-ambiguous Shepard-tone pairs are objectively neither rising nor falling, yet you INVOLUNTARILY hear each as ▲ or ▼, and which way is stable-for-you and differs person-to-person (it tracks your speaking-voice range/dialect) · SVG-DOM percept-map + spatialized WebAudio choir · clinical Ikeda-mono · cosmic-ambient/contemplative pole** · **Use headphones/quiet.** Marches C→C♯→D… around the chromatic circle playing a tritone pair per pitch-class (P then P+6, each a 6-partial octave-ambiguous Shepard tone under a fixed Gaussian bell so no register dominates); you tap ▲ rose / ▼ fell your involuntary percept; a live **SVG-DOM 12-point polar map** fills in and draws your **peak-pitch-class axis** (circular-mean resultant) — your private signature. **Payoff:** after a handful of answers a ~6-voice detuned **Shepard-Risset choir** fades in panned across the field, gliding endlessly in YOUR heard direction (ascending if you hear rising, descending if falling, hovering if split) and reversing live if your lean flips — the room agrees with your nervous system. **No master knob by design:** two genuinely independent, conflictable channels — the OBJECTIVE deterministic tone sequence vs. your SUBJECTIVE involuntary percept (the tones objectively neither rise nor fall while you unshakeably hear one way); the percept can't be autopiloted because it's *yours*. WIDE-mode winner (cycle 873), 1 of 3 divergent "perceptual-illusion as drug-free altered state" explorers (raced vs. `moire-drift` WebGL2 cross-modal moiré + `freeze-cathedral` spectral-freeze eternal-now, both banked to IDEAS §873). Ambition 4/5 (novel-for-lab technique · 4 subsystems · Deutsch/Shepard/Risset refs · today's §873 research). Dodges every 2026-07-22 jury ban (SVG-DOM not Canvas2D · no single scalar · not intense-union · clinical-mono not violet-gold). `status: demoable` · degrades: no WebAudio → `text-destructive` notice.

### [2340-echo-body](/dream/2340-echo-body) · out-of-body / proprioceptive decoupling · **a drug-free OUT-OF-BODY state: your webcam-seen motion is thrown back as a spatial ECHO-SELF that first LAGS behind you, then over 5 minutes crosses through "now" to LEAD you — the felt center of you comes loose from the body you see · HRTF spatial-audio (primary) + SVG-DOM plan · proprioceptive pole** · **Headphones essential — the whole piece is HRTF `PannerNode` spatialization and collapses on speakers.** Your body's motion is read from the webcam via frame-differencing into TWO independent, conflictable state variables — **centroid** (where you are, left↔right) and **expansion** (contracted vs. spread wide) — never a single 0→1 dial (you can drift left while contracting, or hold still while spreading). A rolling ~8 s buffer feeds a spatial **echo-self** voice whose delay **eases from +2.25 s (lagging you) through zero to −1.0 s (predictive LEAD, linearly extrapolated from recent velocity) over five minutes** — a single irreversible crossing, long-form evolution, not a loop; a faint **present-tense** voice tracks live so you hear the widening gap between now-you and echo-you. centroid→azimuth, expansion→elevation+radius; two breathy formant voices (detuned saw → parallel formant bandpasses + body lowpass + breath noise + vibrato) so the echo reads as a *self*. **DEEP-mode winner (cycle 872), 1 of 3 parallel technical approaches to the one OBE-via-displaced-audio concept** (raced vs. `2338-displaced` bilateral-split + `2342-flow-swarm` optical-flow — both build-clean, banked to IDEAS §872). **Head-on cash of jury-2026-07-22 #2** (*"ship a NEW camera/body piece with a non-Canvas, non-GPU-shader output — spatial-audio or three.js — camera is the freshest input in the window and Karel-loved, and nobody built the follow-up"*) **and #1** (ban the single knob for a week — no master parameter; the illusion emerges from the GAP, driven by two independent variables). Diversity dodged every live ban: **input=webcam-body** (NOT pointer/tap/keyboard ~5×), **output=HRTF spatial-audio + SVG-DOM** (NOT GPU-shader ~7×, NOT Canvas2D-primary), **technique=two-axis temporal echo, no master knob**, **palette=silver/bone on cool charcoal** (NOT violet-gold), **pole=proprioceptive-OBE** (NOT intense-union, NOT over-rep cosmic-ambient ~5×). Grounded same-day in RESEARCH §872: audio-visual OBE is inducible by *displaced* body feedback (Scientific Reports 2024, s41598-024-74904-5; Blanke bodily-self-consciousness) + HRTF-in-WebXR 2026 survey. Viz is pure animated SVG-DOM (head, live now-you glyph, a trailing position ribbon with the echo-self glyph riding it at the current delay, centroid/expansion meters, a delay readout that crosses through zero). **Fully alive with ZERO camera:** a synthetic body (two incommensurate oscillators) plays the whole lag→lead crossing out, badged "synthetic body (no camera)", with an always-present Enable-camera button — so the 06:30 review is complete even if camera is denied. `status: demoable` · **NOT ear-verified** (headless — no HRTF playback here): whether the echo reads as a displaced *self* and whether the lag→lead crossing lands as uncanny are reasoned + `tsc`/ESLint-verified only.

### [2332-lock](/dream/2332-lock) · neural entrainment / phase-locking · **an altered state you EARN as a phase-LOCK, not turn as a knob — chase a drifting pulse and the trippy bloom only arrives when your body's rhythm truly locks · three.js phosphor tunnel · embodied-entrainment** · **A stimulus pulse ticks at a tempo that slowly DRIFTS 1.65 → 2.25 → 2.85 Hz (a ~40 s triangle — the exact band where auditory neural entrainment peaks). You entrain by tapping — spacebar, tap the tunnel, or mic onsets. There is NO master 0→1 knob: the "state" is TWO genuinely independent axes that can conflict — `tempoError` (does your inter-tap tempo match the pulse?) and `phaseError` (do your taps land ON the beat or in anti-phase?). A real sliding-window PLV = |mean e^(i·2π·tapPhase)| gates the bloom: search = dim jitter; lock-but-wrong-phase = full rings that swell BETWEEN the beats (visibly/audibly syncopating against a crisp reference flash); true entrainment = concentric rings swelling ON the beat + the camera glides forward + the drone opens to unison. Stop tapping and the lock decays.** WIDE-mode winner (cycle 871), 1 of 3 parallel drug-free altered-state explorers. **Head-on cash of the jury-2026-07-22 #1 provocation** (its loudest, week-long demand): *"ban the single knob — force ≥2 genuinely independent state variables that can conflict; if you can describe the piece as one dial from calm to peak, reject it."* Here the altered-state intensity is not set — it's an emergent phase-lock you can only earn, with two conflictable axes. Diversity this cycle **banned WebGL2 output** (4× in the last 10 prototypes) + the jury's Canvas2D/keyboard/single-scalar/intense-union/violet-gold — so this uses **three.js** (`THREE.Points` ~4,400-point concentric-shell tunnel), tap/mic input, a two-axis PLV technique, and a cool phosphor cyan/mint gamut. Grounded same-day in RESEARCH §871: neural entrainment to rhythm peaks ~2 Hz and its *strength* predicts altered-state proxies (PMC12014595, 2025; NYAS drumming/ASC review, 2025) + PLV from Lachaux et al. 1999. Seeded (`0x2332`) autopilot flies the full searching→lock→wrong-phase→drift→relock arc on mount, so it self-demos with zero interaction. Degrades: no mic → spacebar/click; no WebGL → notice + live readouts + audio keep running. `status: demoable` · **NOT eye/ear-verified** (headless — no display/speakers/tapping): whether the three regimes read as distinct, and whether wrong-phase truly looks/sounds syncopated, are reasoned + compile/lint-verified only.

### [2320-three-valves](/dream/2320-three-valves) · C×G×D reducing-valve cube · **an altered state is a CUBE, not a dial — three independent axes, NO master knob · spectral cyan↔coral duotone on graphite · geometric↔figurative↔real/unreal** · **Huxley called perception a "reducing valve." A 2026 Frontiers paper splits that ONE valve into THREE independent computational functions, and this makes all three draggable at once on one field: relax C (classifier) and hidden causes surface as Klüver form constants — tunnels, spirals, spokes, honeycomb (cool/teal channel, through the shared log-polar warp); raise G (generator prior) and flat abstract grain organizes into bilateral, almost-recognizable figures (warm/coral–magenta channel); move D (discriminator / reality-monitoring) and the SAME imagery flips between floating-hazy-unreal and crisp-grounded-present. The three axes are ORTHOGONAL — the same three faders in different combinations produce categorically different worlds (hi-C·lo-G·lo-D = floating teal geometry that feels unreal; lo-C·hi-G·hi-D = crisp warm figures; hi-C·hi-G·hi-D = bound figures-in-lattice) — and there is deliberately no master intensity anywhere in the code or audio.** WIDE-mode winner (cycle 869), 1 of 3 fully-divergent drug-free altered-state explorers. **Head-on cash of the jury-2026-07-22 #1 provocation** (its loudest, week-long demand): *"ban the single knob for a week — force ≥2 genuinely independent state variables that can conflict; if you can describe the piece as one dial from calm to peak, reject it."* This piece is that mandate handed back as a neuroscience result: altered states genuinely ARE ≥3 orthogonal axes, and collapsing them to one intensity is the wrong model. Also cashes **#4** (palette discipline) with a fresh spectral cyan↔coral duotone on #14161a graphite — off the banned violet→gold-on-near-black. **Renders a same-day 2026 finding** (RESEARCH §869): **"Beyond the reducing valve: towards a computational neurophenomenology of altered states via deep neural networks," Frontiers in Psychology, 20 May 2026 (10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1819038)** — the C×G×D framework. · **INPUT = three independent pointer-draggable vertical faders** (C, G, D), each with a `type="range"` mobile/a11y fallback — NOT the computer keyboard (banned this cycle), and emphatically not one master slider. A seeded **mulberry32 (`0x2320`) autopilot** tours distinct octants on mount so a silent reviewer sees the categories change before touching anything; grab any fader to take the wheel. · **OUTPUT = raw WebGL2** single-triangle fullscreen fragment shader (splices in the shared `LOGPOLAR_GLSL` retina→V1 warp) — NOT Canvas2D (banned this cycle). Live octant-name readout + per-axis word tags keep the three-way independence legible. · **TECHNIQUE = three-independent-axis form-constant + semantic-morph field** — C gates the log-polar Klüver geometry (cool channel), G drives abstract-grain→bilaterally-symmetric figuration (warm channel), D is a spatial reality-transform (drift/haze/translucency vs. crispness/vignette/presence); none is a brightness proxy, no single-scalar-follower anywhere. · **AUDIO = three-valve Web Audio instrument**, each axis independent: C → detune-spread / inharmonicity of the pad (relax = wider beating partials); G → a formant/vowel filter sweep (abstract noise → almost-vocal); D → dry/reverb + spatial spread through the shared `createVoidReverb` (unreal = drowned, real = dry/present/centred). `prefers-reduced-motion` honored; WebGL2-absent → `text-destructive` notice + a text description of the cube; full teardown (rAF cancel, GL program/buffer/VAO deleted + lose-context, AudioContext disposed). · cycle 869 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-22) · demoable · `state: the C×G×D "three valves" — an altered state as a 3-axis CUBE, not a dial (geometric-form-constant ↔ figurative-generation ↔ reality-monitoring) · pole: visionary, spans geometric→figurative (NOT the banned intense/ecstatic-union) · input: three independent pointer faders (autopilot self-demos the octant tour) · output: raw WebGL2 log-polar form-constant field · technique: three-orthogonal-axis form-constant + semantic-morph, NO master knob (the explicit anti-single-knob) · audio: three-valve pad (C→inharmonicity, G→formant, D→void-reverb) · needs-a-human: nothing (self-demos; ### [2314-the-return](/dream/2314-the-return) · heautoscopy / mutual-regard · **a room that learns to expect you (NO master knob) · oil-film interference gamut · being-known** · **A room watches you through a webcam and slowly builds a persistent self-image — where THIS body tends to move. From it, it forms a PREDICTION and glows ahead of you, anticipating. The music is the GAP: move as the room expects and the two voices fuse into a calm D-Lydian pad; surprise it and prediction-error blooms hot magenta and the second voice detunes into beating dissonance; keep surprising it and the memory relearns, so the surprising thing becomes expected — the room HABITUATES. Being predicted is a form of being regarded.** DEEP-mode winner (cycle 868), 1 of 3 parallel approaches to ONE concept: a drug-free **heautoscopy** — reduplicate the viewer into an allocentric double that learns them and regards them. **The un-built third altered-states pole:** the lab has camped on *dissolution* (self melts) and its mirror *ecstatic-union* (self fuses) — the two poles the 2026-07-22 jury banned as an 8-of-15 groove. Heautoscopy is neither: the self **splits and regards itself**. **Cashes FOUR jury-2026-07-22 provocations at once:** **#1** (ban the single knob — force ≥2 independent state variables that can conflict, "a system with memory that contradicts live input") — here LIVE motion and the PREDICTION field are two genuinely independent arrays whose prediction-ERROR is the driver, and the slow-EMA memory literally relearns/habituates against your live input; **#2** (ship a NEW camera/body piece with a **non-Canvas output**) — webcam→WebGL2 fullscreen interference field, NOT Canvas2D; **#4** (palette discipline — a genuinely different gamut) — a cool oil-film / Newton's-rings iridescence (petrol base, cyan live-crest, teal→indigo prediction fringes, hot-magenta surprise band), off the banned violet→gold; **#5** (change the INTERACTION, not the substrate) — predictive-processing + habituation is a genuinely new interaction model for the lab. · **INPUT = webcam frame-difference** (96×72 luminance grid, thresholded/gained so idle sensor noise ≠ motion, mirrored selfie view); no camera → a **seeded mulberry32 (`0x2314`) phantom-body autopilot** that self-demos the full ~22s LEARN→PREDICT-glows-ahead→BREAK/FLARE→HABITUATE arc on mount, before Start, with zero permissions. · **OUTPUT = raw WebGL2** single-triangle fullscreen fragment shader — the two fields uploaded as an RGBA `DataTexture` (R=live G=prediction B=memory A=error) sampled under a slow domain-warp; centroid markers (a waiting RING at the prediction centroid, a bright DOT at your live centroid) + a tie-line whose length grows with the gap make the prediction-error legible. NOT Canvas2D, NOT three.js (diverges from last cycle's 2304 three.js globe). · **TECHNIQUE = dual-field predictive-processing agent** — persistent self-image = slow EMA of motion (`MEM_ALPHA` 0.016 = habit); PREDICTION = that memory warped toward a Gaussian blob at the short-horizon extrapolation of your motion centroid (velocity × 8 frames), confidence growing as memory accumulates; SURPRISE = fraction of live motion the room did NOT expect (`Σ max(0, live−pred) / Σ live`). No 0→1 master knob anywhere — the two fields conflict and their error is emergent. · **AUDIO = two spatial voices + prediction-error drive** (D-Lydian, `#4` for the floating quality): Voice LIVE follows your motion centroid (pitch/pan); Voice ROOM follows the prediction centroid but SNAPS to a consonant Lydian third above LIVE as agreement rises (fusion) and drifts to its own centroid + beats (detune 5→47) as surprise rises; onset "ticks" fire only under surprise (rate 0.15→5.5/s); filter brightness opens with error. Master ≤0.2 through a DynamicsCompressor, 1s fade-in, silent until Start. · **SELF-DEMO / SAFETY** — autopilot on mount (visual runs immediately; audio silent until Start); shader shimmer capped ≤3 Hz, no strobe, slow luminance drift; WebGL2-absent → `text-destructive` notice; full teardown (rAF cancel, camera tracks stopped, GL programs/textures deleted + lose-context, AudioContext closed). · cycle 868 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-22) · demoable · `state: heautoscopy / mutual-regard (the un-built third altered-states pole — self splits & regards itself, NOT dissolution, NOT ecstatic-union) · pole: intense/uncanny (being-known) · input: webcam motion (autopilot self-demos) · output: raw WebGL2 oil-film interference field · technique: dual-field predictive-processing agent (live vs. prediction, error-driven, habituating memory — the explicit anti-single-knob) · harmony: two D-Lydian spatial voices, agreement→consonant-third / surprise→beating · needs-a-human: webcam (autopilot self-demos the learn→predict→surprise→habituate arc) · nearest-neighbor: 2094-unself has a PASSIVE delayed ghost-self on a single dissolution knob; ### [2290-phase-society](/dream/2290-phase-society) · coupled-oscillator synchrony · **emergent (NO master knob) · Ikeda-mono** · **A society of 320 phase-oscillators — a slow inner crowd and a fast outer crowd — argues its way toward or away from agreement. You HEAR consensus emerge as detuned cluster-cacophony collapses toward a locked chorus, and you SEE it as phase-dots gathering on a Kuramoto circle. There is no "unity" dial: the level of agreement (the order parameter r) is a READOUT of two conflicting populations plus the field's own hysteretic memory — you only perturb, you never set it.** WIDE-mode winner (cycle 866), 1 of 3 fully-divergent explorers. **Head-on cash of jury-2026-07-22 #1** (the single loudest provocation: "ban the single knob for a week — the slew-limited scalar-follower is ~10 of 15; next piece must have NO master 0→1 parameter at all, force ≥2 genuinely independent state variables that can conflict, a system with memory that contradicts live input"). Here r is strictly emergent, the two frequency-communities genuinely fight, and the required contradicting-memory is implemented TWO ways: physical **inertia** (second-order Kuramoto → real bistable hysteresis) + a deadband **lock-memory** surfaced in the HUD as `Breaking`/`Coalescing` when the field's state disagrees with your fresh gesture. **Renders a same-day 2026 finding** (RESEARCH §866): the coupled-oscillator sonification lineage — *"Sound in Multiples: Synchrony and Interaction Design using Coupled-Oscillator Networks"* + the *"Collective Rhythms Toolbox"* (audio-visual coupled-oscillator interfaces whose coupling matrices induce dynamic sync/fracture rhythmic states), grounded in **Kuramoto (1975)**; visual language after **Ryoji Ikeda, *datamatics***. · **INPUT = pointer/tap PLAYED + tilt + autopilot** — two controls that FIGHT (drag X → inter-community coupling `K_inter`, drag Y → frequency gap; neither is "the" driver); **tap** the inner/outer ring to shock-scramble a crowd's phases (a perturbation the field must recover from); **tilt** (β/γ) is the mobile perturbation; **seeded mulberry32 autopilot** wanders both targets on slow Lissajous paths + fires periodic shocks so a 06:30 phone reviewer always sees the field breathe between sync and fracture. Off the banned lanes (NOT keyboard, NOT a master slider). · **OUTPUT = raw WebGL2** (NOT the banned Canvas2D, NOT three.js) — instanced phase-dots on the Kuramoto phase circle, a thin precision grid, three centroid vectors (two crowds + the global r vector as the bright centroid), and a scrolling r(t) timeline. **PALETTE = Ikeda monochrome** — white/grey dots + thin grid on near-black with a single muted-red accent for the rival community (NOT the banned violet→gold jewel gamut; a genuinely different, clinical, data-precision gamut per jury #4). · **TECHNIQUE = two-community mean-field Kuramoto with inertia + bistable lock-memory** — each oscillator pulled toward its own community centroid (`K_intra`) AND the rival's (`K_inter`); block structure collapses the O(N²) sum to O(N)/step; r = |mean(e^{iθ})| is a pure readout. NOT a single-scalar autonomous morph, NOT a played follower — it is a genuine 2-population dynamical system whose emergent coherence can contradict the hand that perturbs it. · **AUDIO** — each community is a choral voice (a stack of detuned oscillators) whose detune spread WIDENS as that community's coherence drops (rough beating cluster-chord) and COLLAPSES toward unison as it locks; the pitch interval between the two voices tracks the frequency gap (unison at agreement → tritone at conflict); global r opens a lowpass, fades in a consonant fifth-drone, and deepens a slow collective tremolo. You hear consensus emerge or fracture. No network, no API route. · **SELF-DEMO** — seeded (mulberry32, no Math.random/Date.now) autopilot drives perturbations after 3.5 s idle; yields to any live pointer/tap/tilt. AudioContext lazily inside the first Start tap; WebGL2-absent → `text-destructive` notice. · cycle 866 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-22) · demoable · `state: n/a (non-altered-states cycle — a jury-mandated break from the visionary groove) · pole: emergent/analytical (NOT intense, NOT cosmic-ambient) · input: pointer/tap PLAYED + tilt + autopilot (two fighting controls, no master knob) · output: raw WebGL2 (Ikeda-mono) · technique: two-community mean-field Kuramoto + inertia + bistable lock-memory (emergent order parameter, contradicting memory) · harmony: two detuned choral voices, interval = frequency gap (unison↔tritone) · needs-a-human: no (autopilot self-demos the sync↔fracture breathing; ### [2064-room-cairn](/dream/2064-room-cairn) · **the ROOM plays the instrument — you build (and un-build) a phasing cairn of collisions hands-free, just by clapping, snapping and tapping into the air, then falling silent** · **what if you performed music with your body and your room's acoustics — no screen taps at all — and could un-build it by going quiet?** DEEP-mode winner (cycle 845), 1 of 3 parallel embodied re-inputs of the jury's #1 named standout **[`1990-impact-cairn`](/dream/1990-impact-cairn)** ("Extend this one"). **Cycle 2 of Impact Cairn**, re-inputted off the jury-banned pointer onto the room. **The engine is 1990 verbatim** (modal-impact synthesis — no scale, no pitch, deliberately inharmonic, **not the banned Chladni bell**; the consequential editable-memory "un-build" grammar) — the only change is the input layer. **The new subsystem is a real onset detector (`onset.ts`):** ambient mic → `AnalyserNode` (fftSize 1024) on the engine's own `AudioContext`; per frame it computes **spectral flux** (sum of positive bin-to-bin energy increases), fires a strike on an **adaptive threshold** (rolling mean + margin·std + floor, sensitivity-scaled) with a ~100 ms **refractory** so one clap = one strike; the onset frame's **spectral centroid** picks the MATERIAL (bright snap >3400 Hz → droplet · >2200 → ceramic · >1200 → wood · dark thud → stone) and peak amplitude → velocity. **The un-build grammar is intact but now hands-free:** after a ≥2-onset burst falls silent ~1.4 s the figure **auto-lays** into a looping layer, so you build a phasing cairn (Reich) without touching the screen; knock-off (audible loss + tumble), material-transform, mute, clear stay reachable as chrome buttons (the ban is on pointer/touch as the *play* gesture, not on control chrome). Named refs: **J. P. Bello et al., "A Tutorial on Onset Detection in Music Signals" (2005)** (spectral flux) · **Steve Reich, _Clapping Music_** (phasing) · **Pauline Oliveros, _Deep Listening_** (eyes-closed listening); 1990's own anchor is Kato & Baba's SIGGRAPH 2026 droplet-impact interface (live this week). `state: embodied percussion / eyes-closed room-play · input: mic-onset (non-pointer) · output: audio-primary + minimal DOM · technique: spectral-flux onset → centroid material-classify → modal-impact + editable-memory un-build grammar · harmony: none (collisions, non-Chladni) · pole: embodied/audio-first`. **Ambition honest 3/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems: onset detector + modal-impact engine + un-build memory + haptics = 4 · #3 named refs Bello/Reich/Oliveros · #4 multi-cycle — an explicit cycle-2 of 1990, cashing the jury's 0× depth gap). **NOT ear/mic-verified headless** (no room sound in CI) — the mic path (flux threshold, centroid bands, haptics) is validated by reading `onset.ts` + reasoning; only the ghost + synth + grammar are build-exercised, so real-room tuning needs a live device.
