### [2036-eternal-groove](/dream/2036-eternal-groove) · **a Shepard tone for TEMPO — a percussion groove that accelerates (or decelerates) forever without ever actually getting faster, while the underlying pattern is static and loops seamlessly** · **what if a groove could accelerate forever without ever actually getting faster — the rhythmic transposition of the Shepard/Risset endless-pitch illusion, which the lab has never built?** WIDE-mode winner (cycle 841), 1 of 3 divergent explorers. Five percussive layers are stacked one **octave apart in tempo**; in log-tempo space layer *k* sits at `o_k = (phase + k) mod N` and fires at `tempo_k = baseBPM · 2^(o_k − N/2)`. A **fixed raised-cosine (Hann) window** over the log-tempo axis, `w(o)=0.5−0.5·cos(2π·o/N)`, sets each layer's loudness — the window doesn't move, the **layers glide through it**; advancing `phase` slides every layer up (accelerando) or down (ritardando) the octave ladder at once. A layer that reaches the top **wraps to the bottom where the weight is ~0**, so the reset is inaudible and the loop is seamless; because the layers are spaced exactly one octave apart over exactly *N* octaves, the **Hann sum is constant (= N/2) for all phase**, so overall loudness never pulses as layers cross the band. Strike timing comes from `AudioContext.currentTime` via a **~25 ms-poll / ~100 ms-horizon look-ahead scheduler** (the "Tale of Two Clocks"); the `phase` control is integrated in rAF (60 fps) and read by the scheduler (timing off the audio clock, control off rAF). Each strike is a purely **percussive** voice — a pitch-swept sine "tom" + a bandpassed-noise transient, higher layers brighter/shorter, lower woodier/longer — **NO scale, melody, chord, or pitched drone** (the cleanest possible dodge of the jury-banned JI partial-stack). Opens a **grep-0× Risset-rhythm / tempo-illusion lane the lab lacked.** Anchored by the fresh **§841 dive** (three foundational-but-grep-0×-in-lab, no-model-budget techniques — Risset rhythm, diffusion curves, recurrence plots). · **INPUT = tap-tempo** (space / tap anywhere / button sets base BPM) + sweep drag/slider for direction — NOT mic (jury 7×), NOT tilt, NOT camera. · **SUBSTRATE = CSS-compositor** (one DOM ring per tempo layer; rAF writes `transform`/`opacity`/`filter` only — **zero canvas / WebGL / WebGPU / SVG-drawn animation**; the coldest, still-flagged substrate lane, off the jury-banned WebGPU/Canvas2D). Full teardown on stop/unmount (cancel rAF, clear scheduler interval, fade + `ctx.close`, remove listeners). · **HARMONIC MODEL = pure percussion, NO pitch lattice** (NOT the banned `[1,9/8,…,2]` JI stack — there is no scale at all). · **AUDIO** — a plain (non-hook) `RissetRhythmEngine` class owns the graph; AudioContext resumed inside "Begin"; master-gain ramps. · **SELF-DEMO / readout** — ~2 s scripted auto-demo sweeps accelerando→ritardando→hold on a loop the instant you press Begin, before any input; any manual change hands control to the user. · **SAFETY / a11y** — no strobe (ring flashes are per-strike brightness bumps decayed in rAF, gated by tempo not a flicker engine); chrome on semantic tokens (warm ink-brass palette confined to the art layer). · cycle 841 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-20) · demoable · `theme: a Shepard tone for tempo — a groove that accelerates forever without ever getting faster · palette: warm ink-on-paper / aged-brass on dark (NOT violet-cosmic) · input: tap-tempo + sweep drag (self-demos with a 2s auto-drive) · output: CSS-compositor (concentric DOM rings, transform/opacity only; off the jury-banned WebGPU/Canvas2D) · harmony: pure percussion, NO pitch lattice (the cleanest anti-JI-stack dodge) · technique: Risset RHYTHM / rhythmic Shepard illusion (grep-0× in the tempo domain) · pole: perceptual-illusion / rhythmic-instrument (an auditory "altered perception without the drug") · needs-a-human: tap the pulse + drag the sweep (auto-demos otherwise)` · notes: `README.md` · refs **Jean-Claude Risset — the "endless accelerando" / rhythmic Shepard-tone illusion** · Roger Shepard (endless-pitch original) / Kenneth Knowlton lineage. **Ambition — honest 3/5:** #1 (novel technique — Risset RHYTHM is grep-0× in the tempo domain across ~800 protos; No mic/camera/tilt. · **OUTPUT = SVG-DOM only** (jury #1 — off the GPU render family): the looper is drawn as magnetic **tape** — note events as SVG elements on a 6 s strip, a moving playhead (`requestAnimationFrame` reading the audio clock), splice marks where the tape was cut; **NO `<canvas>`, NO WebGL/WebGPU, NO three.js.** · **TECHNIQUE = destructive/editable live-looper** (jury #3 — memory made CONSEQUENTIAL, not additive): all edit ops are **pure functions over immutable event arrays** (`looper.ts`) — **record**, **destructive overwrite** (arm Overwrite + play over a region → existing events are *replaced*, not layered; live user-overwrite uses a punch that deletes neighbours as you play; audibly the same loop positions play different pitches next lap), **cut** (delete a slice, the loop loses it), **shift** (re-time a slice, wrapping), **fracture** (chop into N chunks and re-order — a phrase you know comes back tumbled). A **look-ahead scheduler** (~100 ms horizon polled every 25 ms off `AudioContext.currentTime`, NOT rAF) plays it sample-accurately. · **HARMONIC MODEL = a MODAL SCALE THAT DRIFTS (jury #2 — NOT the banned `[1,9/8,5/4,4/3,3/2,5/3,15/8,2]` JI stack, NOT pentatonic):** notes are stored as scale **DEGREES (0–6)+octave, not frozen frequencies**; a modal scale rotates continuously (Dorian→Phrygian→Lydian→Mixolydian→Aeolian→Locrian→Ionian, one lap ≈119 s, ~new mode every 17 s); `degree→frequency` is resolved *at schedule time* against the live mode, so a phrase recorded a minute ago **re-voices itself** — same fingering, different colour — and the SVG shows it (each note's y-position AND hue recomputed through the current mode, notes slide & re-colour as the mode steps). Deliberately **equal-tempered diatonic modes** — the point is the mapping *changes over time*. · **AUDIO** — warm FM pluck (sine carrier + decaying sine modulator, a hair of glide) → master **0.14** → tape-"wow" chorus → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination; AudioContext created inside the Begin gesture; full teardown on unmount (stop oscillators, disconnect, cancel rAF, clear timers, `ctx.close()`). · **SELF-DEMO** — deterministic seeded **ghost performer** (mulberry32 const seed; all timing off the AudioContext clock — no `Math.random`/`Date.now`) records a phrase, loops it, **overwrites** part (~8.6 s: replaces the `[1.2,3.0)` slice), **cuts** a slice, **fractures**, then lets the mode drift so the phrase re-voices — the whole editable-memory grammar self-demonstrates headless; real MIDI/key input takes over instantly, re-arms ~15 s idle. ### [1990-impact-cairn](/dream/1990-impact-cairn) · **music from timed IMPACTS you play eyes-closed, felt in your hand — and can UN-build by knocking a stone off** · **what if you built music by stacking timed physical impacts you can play eyes-closed, feel every hit in your hand, and un-make by knocking a stone off?** DEEP-mode winner (cycle 832), 1 of 3 realizations of ONE concept — *composing IS editing: every past gesture is editable/overwritable/un-makeable, and un-making is a musical event* (jury 2026-07-19 provocation #3, the under-served one). The others a destructive/editable SVG-DOM live-looper whose past re-voices itself under a drifting scale (`1986-splice-cassette`, banked ⭐⭐) and a Bohlen–Pierce SVG-DOM melody you weave and **un-weave** (`1988-tritave-loom`, banked ⭐), both IDEAS §832. Realizes the §831 ⭐⭐ `1982-droplet-cairn` bank AND Karel's own §831 MORNING ask ("Ship droplet-cairn next?"). Deliberately expands the lab's **thinnest, most-starving category — non-screen / audio-first / HAPTIC (0× recent)** — dodging the most jury axes at once. · **INPUT = tap / click / spacebar in RHYTHM** (timing, not pitch); each tap drops a stone that falls and **collides → the collision IS the sound**; `PointerEvent.pressure` supplies real strike velocity where available (fixed fallback). **The Vibration API (`navigator.vibrate`) is a load-bearing second feedback channel** — a velocity/material-scaled haptic pulse on every strike + tactile confirmations on knock-off / material-change (feature-detected, silent no-op where absent). No mic/camera/tilt. · **OUTPUT = audio-first, MINIMAL DOM/CSS** — a dark field of plain `<div>` stones (CSS-transform fall/settle); each laid layer is one settled stone that **pulses on every hit it sounds**; knocking one off scatters falling debris. **NO `<canvas>`, NO WebGL/WebGPU, NO three.js, NO SVG art scene** — deliberately spare (the piece is meant for eyes closed; the screen is a quiet index, testing the lab's screen-first bias). Near-monochrome graphite/bone (art hex in the DOM only; chrome on semantic tokens). · **HARMONIC MODEL = NONE, on purpose** — no scale, no tuning, no pitch lattice anywhere. Every sound is a struck object via **modal impact synthesis**: a broadband noise excitation low-passed to the material's colour → a bank of 3–6 **inharmonic** band-pass modes with exponential decay + **±4% per-hit freq jitter so no stable pitch can ever crystallise**; four **materials** (droplet/ceramic/wood/stone) differ only in modal ratios, decay, excitation colour, resonator-Q cap. **Timbre + rhythm are the ENTIRE compositional material** — the literal cash of jury provocation #2 ("pure rhythm/timbre with no pitch lattice at all"), the furthest possible departure from the banned JI-partial-stack groove. · **TECHNIQUE = editable/consequential rhythmic memory** (NOT sim→scalar→pitch, NOT a CA, NOT additive-deposit): (1) **lay** a tapped figure as a looping layer (look-ahead scheduler ~120 ms off the AudioContext clock, never rAF); (2) layers loop at slightly independent rates and **phase** against each other (Reich); (3) **knock a stone off** — delete a layer and the loop *audibly loses* it (+ a "tumble" so un-making is a sound, not a gap); (4) **change a laid stone's material** — a *transform* of existing memory (timbre swaps on the layer's next pass), not a new layer; (5) mute / clear. Layer count bound to 5 so the cairn stays legible. · **AUDIO** — modal-synth per hit → master **0.16** (≤0.18) → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination; per-material Q cap so a hard strike can't blow up; AudioContext created inside the Begin/first-tap gesture; full teardown on unmount (nodes disconnected, timers cleared, `ctx.close()`). · **SELF-DEMO** — deterministic seeded **ghost drummer** (mulberry32 from a constant seed; all timing from the audio clock — no `Math.random`/`Date.now`): taps a figure, loops it, adds a phasing layer, **knocks a stone off**, changes a material, cycling so the whole un-making grammar self-demonstrates headless with zero input; real tap takes over instantly, re-arms ~15 s. Pre-Begin hero (never blank). · **SAFETY / a11y** — no strobe/flicker; `prefers-reduced-motion` honoured; audio-blocked shows an on-brand `text-destructive` note and the visual keeps running; haptics degrade to a no-op. · cycle 832 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-19 jury) · demoable · `theme: build music from timed impacts you play eyes-closed and un-build by knocking a stone off · palette: near-monochrome graphite/bone (art) · input: tap/click/spacebar rhythm + PointerEvent.pressure + Vibration-API haptics (NON-touch-tap-as-pitch, NON-mic/camera/tilt) · output: audio-first + minimal DOM/CSS (coldest substrate, 0×; tests screen bias) · harmony: NONE — modal impact synth, inharmonic, no pitch lattice (jury #2's most radical answer) · technique: editable/consequential rhythmic memory — lay/phase/knock-off/material-transform (NOT sim→scalar, NOT additive-deposit) · pole: conceptual/tactile instrument (non-visionary) · needs-a-human: total (ghost only self-demos; haptics are the player's channel)` · notes: `README.md` · ref Kato & Baba (Tokyo Metropolitan U.) *A MIDI-Controlled Water-Droplet Interface for Generating Droplet Impact Sounds* — **SIGGRAPH 2026 Emerging Technologies, live July 19–23 2026** · Steve Reich *Clapping Music* (phasing) · Pauline Oliveros *Deep Listening*. **Ambition — honest 3/5:** #2 (≥3 subsystems: modal-impact synth + 4 materials + look-ahead phasing scheduler + Vibration-API haptics + minimal reactive DOM + ghost) · #3 (named refs above) · #5 (SIGGRAPH ET, live *today*, <7 days). NON-touch, NON-pointer — gamepad-as-adult-instrument is grep-fresh (used only in 3 paused kids toys), rotating hard off the pointer-on-glass groove (jury 6×). · **OUTPUT = Canvas2D** — the least-used renderer (the sharpest answer to the WebGL2 monoculture, 7×), a river-delta of branches spreading across the canvas, each sounding leaf glowing in time with its loop, the active channel bright. · **TECHNIQUE = a navigable/forkable version-TREE of musical decisions** (grep-0× in the lab — every prior "branch/tree" is a botanical/physics sim, never a git-for-melody): each node holds a short phrase; commit extends the current branch; navigate back to any ancestor and commit → a FORK (new sibling future); **nothing is ever deleted**, so your whole decision-history is durable AND re-enterable. · **PLAYBACK (the surprise) = ALL LEAVES sound simultaneously** — every leaf's root→leaf path is a looping voice, so the whole garden of alternate histories rings together (Borges: all outcomes happen at once); the root→**cursor** path is foregrounded (louder/brighter/wider filter) while the others sit quiet in a shared bed over a soft D drone. Bounded to the nearest ~7 leaves + the foreground path (≤8 melodic voices + 1 drone) so it stays consonant and never turns to mud. · **HARMONY = D Dorian** (7-note modal, D E F G A B C — deliberately NON-pentatonic; all voices share the mode + a common D root to stay consonant when sounding together). · **AUDIO** — per-leaf triangle+sine → envelope → per-voice lowpass → per-voice gain → master ≤ **0.18** (gesture-ramped, `ctx.resume()` on gesture), phase-preserving voice reconciliation, Dynamicses bounded; `AudioContext.close()` + all listeners removed + `cancelAnimationFrame` on unmount. · **SELF-DEMO** — no gamepad + ~5 s idle → a seeded deterministic **ghost gardener** builds phrases, extends branches, and ~42% of the time hops back and FORKS a new branch, so the delta visibly widens and the all-futures texture audibly thickens with zero input; Mic-denied → an Ode-to-Joy line drives the SAME engine so it self-demos headless. ### [1922-chladni-plate](/dream/1922-chladni-plate) · physical-model instrument / 2D modal synthesis · **what if you could STRIKE and BOW a real metal plate — and the exact same physical model you HEAR is the Chladni sand-figure you SEE? Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer fire (three physical-model instruments, each breaking a different one of the 2026-07-17 jury's three invisible monocultures — one scale/pentatonic, one color/violet, one habit/self-playing). The deepest answer to the pentatonic ban: you don't pick a scale, physics does — a plate's modes are INHARMONIC by construction (freq ∝ the SQUARE of the mode-index sum), so a pentatonic is literally impossible. Banked ⭐⭐ `bowed-maqam` (pointer-bowed waveguide gliding real maqam quarter-tones) + ⭐ `tide-scrub` (pointer granular-scrub grain cloud).** · **INPUT = STRUCK/BOWED BY A HAND — silent and dark until a pointer strikes (NOT self-playing, jury ~11×; no autoplay, energies start at 0): tap = strike, press-and-drag = bow. A strike at (x,y) excites every mode weighted by its mode-shape `sin(mπx)·sin(nπy)` at that point — hit an antinode and that mode rings loud, hit a node and it stays silent — so WHERE you strike sets both the figure and the timbre. NOT mic (jury 7×), NOT camera, NOT autonomous** / **OUTPUT = WebGL2 fragment shader (off the jury-banned Canvas2D 4×): a full-screen quad sums the active modes into the standing-wave field `u = Σ Aₖ·sin(mπx)·sin(nπy)`, rendering sand accumulating on the nodal lines (|u|→0 = bright brass/sand, antinodes dark) + a strike ripple; graceful on-brand `text-destructive` notice if WebGL2 absent. **What if a piece of music were a living thing you tend rather than a track you play — evolving because its population, not a script, is changing?** Winner of a **DEEP** 3-approach fire (ONE concept — *an evolving sonic ecology, sound & image as two views of one long-form emergent simulation* — attacked via mass-conservative Flow-Lenia / evolvable agents / drifting Gray-Scott biomes), chosen because DEEP was overdue (…802 W · 803 W) and to cash Karel's *"massively bigger concepts"* mandate on the menu's thinnest lane: **long-form generative with real state/memory/evolution** (not a loop, not a scripted arc). **The research, built:** it implements **Flow-Lenia — "Emergent evolutionary dynamics in mass conservative continuous cellular automata"** (Plantec/Hamon/Etcheverry/Chan/Oudeyer/Moulin-Frier, arXiv:2506.08569, *Artificial Life* 2025), the mass-conservative extension of Bert Wang-Chak Chan's **Lenia** — whose load-bearing insight is that CONSERVATION OF A FINITE MASS (organisms advect existing matter instead of spawning it) plus rule-parameters embedded IN the moving matter turns a pretty pattern generator into an **ecology with scarcity, competition, and open-ended evolution/speciation**. Here that's literal: the genome is embedded in the conserved matter (`G = mass·species`), mass is conserved exactly by **reintegration tracking**, so the three species genuinely compete for a finite resource and the population balance drifts over minutes — and the multi-voice pentatonic sonification tracks that turnover (a species blooming, taking over, or going near-extinct rings a bell), so the composition itself evolves. Also nods to the **Simulacra Naturae** generative-ecosystem installation (arXiv:2509.02924, 2025). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (mass-conserving CA solver + embedded-genome channel + emergent-stats→sonification + WebGL2 render = 4) + **#3** named refs (Chan Lenia · Plantec Flow-Lenia · Simulacra Naturae) + **#5** this cycle's §804 research. **#1 NOT claimed** — Lenia (1086), particle-life (16/236), physarum (327), reaction-diffusion (many) all pre-exist (grepped per jury #5); **What if a pure chord could only be completed by many people at once?** Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three unrelated non-altered, non-arc-engine, non-mic directions — this multi-tab choir / a webcam-color→drone `1830-roomtone` / a Houdini-Paint texture `1834-livingwall`), taking the standing **2026-07-16 jury's #1** provocation ("leave altered-states; build about something OTHER than the inside of a head" — which named **multi-user/WebRTC** the glaring 0×-built lane) and **#2** (break the mic monoculture) head-on. **The research, built:** it implements the mechanic from **"Real-Time Collaborative Music Creation on the Web: exploiting Web Audio Modules" (IEEE, 2026)** + **Sequencer.party**'s CRDT model — browser-collaborative music in 2026 does NOT stream audio; it transmits **only control/timing events (which voice, the shared tonic, an LFO phase) and each client synthesizes locally**. ### [1812-sideman](/dream/1812-sideman) · jazz / **a live-performance reactive jazz TRIO that reads you a beat ahead — you play a melody at the QWERTY keys (or a Web-MIDI keyboard) and a walking bass + rootless-comping piano + brush drums follow your inferred tempo & key, and — the headline — the canvas SHOWS you the chord it's about to play a beat before it lands (`Dm7 → G7 in 1.0 beats`), so you play INTO the change instead of chasing it (live-performance / jazz-responsive — the alternate-journey-arc Karel asked for; explicitly NOT altered-states, NOT mic, NOT a GPU shader)** · **KEYBOARD-PLAYED (QWERTY 2-octave, key-quantized) + optional Web MIDI — NO mic (breaks the jury's 7× mic monoculture)** / **CANVAS2D warm amber-on-black club palette + Web Audio: synthesized walking bass (chord-tones→chromatic approach into the *next* root), rootless 3rd/7th+9/13 comping on swung off-beats, swing-ride/brush-swish/feathered-kick drums; 25 ms/120 ms look-ahead scheduler ("Two Clocks"); tempo = median inter-onset interval (70–160 BPM, glided), key = decaying pitch-class histogram vs scale templates; bus→DynamicsCompressor limiter→master ≤~0.2** · cycle 800 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-16) · demoable · `state: live-performance reactive accompaniment · vibe: jazz`
**What if your rhythm section could read your playing a beat ahead?** Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three unrelated directions to break the 2026-07-16 jury's flagged **15/15 altered-states monoculture** — this jazz trio / a multi-user *In C* room / a text→music sound-poem), taking the jury's provocation **#1** ("build about something other than the inside of a head") and **#2** ("break the mic monoculture — force MIDI/keyboard/external input") head-on, and cashing **two explicit Karel directives**: care **#3** live-performance fitness (mic-free, low-latency, playable) + care **#4** a **jazz-responsive** alternate journey arc. **The research, built:** it implements the anticipation mechanic from **ReaLJam — "Real-Time Human-AI Music Jamming with RL-Tuned Transformers", arXiv:2502.21267 (Feb 2025)** (+ the Feb-2026 survey *A Design Space for Live Music Agents*, arXiv:2602.05064): the agent commits to and **displays its upcoming chords ahead of the beat** so the human plays *into* the change and the human↔machine latency mismatch disappears — here made visible as a scrolling chord-lane drifting toward a NOW line + a `current → next` header with a "next change in N.N beats" progress bar. **How it works:** two QWERTY rows are a ~2-octave melody instrument quantized to the current inferred key (every note fits); Web MIDI is used if present, else silent QWERTY fallback. A look-ahead scheduler (`AudioContext.currentTime`, the "Tale of Two Clocks" pattern) runs an 8-bar ii–V–I turnaround family transposed into the inferred key; **tempo** is inferred from the median inter-onset interval (clamped, glided) and **key** from a decaying pitch-class histogram scored against major/minor templates (both **lockable** if inference feels jumpy). The trio is fully synthesized (no samples): walking bass steps chord-tones→chromatic approach into the *next* chord's root; rootless (Bill Evans / Bud Powell) left-hand voicings comp on swung off-beats; brush drums swing the ride with a noise-swish and feathered kick. **Self-demo:** on Start it grooves immediately in C @116 BPM and, if you stay idle, plays short melodic phrases over the changes — so a reviewer who just clicks Start hears *and* sees a jazz trio. **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (input detect + tempo/key inference + 3-voice generative trio + anticipation viz) + **#3** named refs (ReaLJam anticipation · Evans/Powell rootless voicings) + **#5** this cycle's §800 research chain. **diversity:** `banned=[altered-states THEME(15/15) · cosmic-ambient VIBE(5×) · mic INPUT(7×) · WebGPU-compute + three.js/WebGL2-fragment OUTPUT(4× ea) · form-constant TECHNIQUE(4×)]`; `picked=[jazz-live-performance THEME(0× in 15) · keyboard-played+MIDI INPUT(non-mic) · Canvas2D OUTPUT(off the banned GPU family) · anticipatory-accompaniment TECHNIQUE(non-form-constant) · warm-jazz-club VIBE(non-cosmic/altered)]` — clears every hard ban on all five axes. **Honest note:** ReaLJam is RL-tuned transformers; this engine is **rule-based, not ML** — hand-written theory for progression/bass/voicings/groove + statistical tempo/key inference. What's faithfully borrowed is the *anticipation display*. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D; zero new npm deps). **Safety:** no strobe (chord-lane drifts, note marks bloom/decay). **Validation:** project-wide `npx tsc --noEmit` = **0 errors** + `npx eslint src/app/dream/1812-sideman --max-warnings 0` = **exit 0**; authoritative `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **exit 0**, route emitted, no `1814`/`1816` leaked. **NOT ear-verified** (headless, no audio device): musical feel + inference tuning want Karel's ears; the idle self-demo exercises the full scheduler→synth→viz path. Two more explored — banked **⭐⭐ `1814-in-c`** (multi-user Terry-Riley *In C* over BroadcastChannel — every tab a musician; boldest jury-untouched lane, resurrect as a networked/WebRTC room) + **⭐ `1816-ursonate`** (typed text → Schwitters-*Ursonate* sound-poetry with kinetic type) — to IDEAS §800 (both built demoable this session, backed up to scratchpad `banked-800/`, then `rm -rf`'d per the non-winner rule). ### [1810-bourse](/dream/1810-bourse) · real-world-data / **the live crypto market as a Ryoji Ikeda *datamatics* COLD-DATA tape — every trade a precise sine/click on a scrolling monochrome Canvas2D data-matrix, the whole flow at once a legible monitor and a hypnotic minimal-techno piece (finance sonification, 0× EVER in the lab; explicitly NOT altered-states, NOT cosmic-ambient, NOT warm — cold signal, gridded, precise)** · **LIVE MARKET WebSocket (best-effort Binance combined trade stream, folds in + swaps seamlessly) / deterministic seeded-GBM synthetic market (mulberry32 `0x1810`, regime shifts + Poisson arrivals, self-demos with ZERO network) — NO mic** / **CANVAS2D data-matrix + Web Audio: price→sparse-scale pure tone (sine/triangle per asset), buy/sell→timbre+pan, size→click+sub, volatility→minimal-techno kick grid (~108→~142 bpm) + high "tape tone"; bus → DynamicsCompressor → master 0.16** · cycle 799 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-16) · demoable · `theme: real-world-data sonification (finance/market) · NOT altered-states`
**What if the live market were a piece of music you could monitor by ear?** Winner of a **DEEP** 3-language race (ONE concept — the live market as an instrument — attacked via Ikeda cold-tape / warm chamber-ensemble / order-book resonator), the lab's **first finance sonification** (0× ever — the 2026-07-16 jury's boldest named-empty lane) and a deliberate **2nd consecutive outer/world-facing cycle** to break that jury's flagged **15/15 altered-states monoculture** (one outer cycle barely dents it). **The research, built:** it cashes **arXiv 2605.21874 (May 2026), "Real-time, EDM-inspired sonification of the activity of a supercomputer"** — whose thesis is that continuous real-time data becomes a good *monitor + long-listen* only when the musical language's temporal structure fits the data process; the bursty trade firehose gets Ikeda's pure-sine/click grammar over a minimal-techno pulse, the closest analog of the three legs. **How it works:** a fully deterministic **seeded-GBM market** (`mulberry32 0x1810` — geometric Brownian motion price paths for BTC/ETH/SOL/XRP + a weighted INDEX, a mean-reverting calm↔turbulent regime scalar for volatility clustering, Poisson-ish exponential trade arrivals, heavy-tailed sizes) advances off a fixed 1/60 per-frame step (no wall clock, no `Math.random`/`Date.now` on the loop), so the 06:30 box shows a living tape with a real regime-arc and zero permissions. A best-effort **Binance combined trade WebSocket** folds real prices in and replaces synthetic trades seamlessly (try/catch throughout, closes on unmount, SIM/LIVE badge); events are rate-limited to ≤~10/s (prioritising large prints) so audio never machine-guns. **Sound:** each trade's price is log-mapped into the asset's rolling [lo,hi] and snapped to a sparse 2-octave scale → a pure tone (sine BTC/ETH/INDEX, triangle SOL/XRP, distinct registers); buy pans right+bright, sell left+dark; size adds a 1 ms click "print" + a sub thud on large prints; volatility drives a quiet high "tape tone" and the tempo of a minimal-techno kick grid; bus → `DynamicsCompressor` → master 0.16, fade-in on the Start gesture, clean `ctx.close()` teardown. **Visual:** a Canvas2D data-matrix — scrolling trade tape (asset·price·size·side, mono numerals, buys violet / sells grey), per-asset price ladders with live markers + σ readouts, a hairline registration grid + crosshairs, a volatility-regime meter, decaying trade flashes; **What if sound alone could carry you bodily through space?** Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three unrelated directions — this audio-forward HRTF vection bath / a three.js Indra&apos;s-Net jewel lattice / a WebGL2 chromesthesia field), taking jury-2026-07-15 provocation **#3** on its emptiest reading: *"go the opposite way and finally test the screen-bias — an **audio-only / embedded** experiment; the menu has named it empty for months."* Audio-forward is the single most-empty substrate in the lab — off the banned Canvas2D (7×), off the rested WebGPU-compute, off the whole GPU-shader pile, off the just-used SVG. **The mechanism:** several warm pad partials plus a soft filtered-noise wind each ride their own slow 3-D orbit around your head via an HRTF `PannerNode`; the brain reads the coherent spatial sweep of the *whole* field as **self**-motion — auditory **vection** — with no beat frequency doing the work. **The research lever, built literally:** a real 6 Hz and 40 Hz oscillator is patched into two sources&apos; `positionY`, so the source POSITION oscillates at those rates (audio-rate, additive with the base height) — **not** its amplitude, so there is no strobe. ### [1792-replay-svg](/dream/1792-replay-svg) · visionary / **press Begin and a sharp "day" of seven warm luminous glyphs (plus a short melody) holds for ~14 s — then, with NO further input, the sensory gate closes over ~52 s: the veridical scene fades and a top-down pathway replays those EXACT forms, fragmented, drifting and condensing two-into-one, until the dream is made entirely out of its own memory, then gently wakes and loops (DREAM/hypnagogic pole; NOT an instrument, NOT touch, NOT mic, NOT Canvas2D, NOT WebGL)** · **NO INPUT — a deterministic self-running α 0→1 Wake→Sleep auto-arc (optional soft modulators omitted; zero permissions, self-demos headless)** / **100% SVG-DOM VECTOR ART — the jury-endorsed empty substrate as the PRIMARY render (grep-near-0×): the 7 source glyphs are real `<g>/<path>/<polygon>/<circle>` elements; the dream is those SAME elements via `<use href="#gN">` duplication + transforms, recombined through an SVG filter graph (`feTurbulence→feDisplacementMap` melt whose `scale` rides α, `feColorMatrix` hue drift ~0.06 Hz, `feGaussianBlur` top-down softening); a SINGLE rAF loop MUTATES attributes/filter params off an integer frame counter, DOM built once — NO `<canvas>`, NO WebGL, NO three.js anywhere** · cycle 796 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-16) · demoable · `state: Wake-Sleep sleep-phase memory replay · pole: dream`

**A dream isn&rsquo;t noise turned into geometry — it&rsquo;s your cortex closing the sensory gate and replaying the day&rsquo;s own forms, recombined.** Winner of a **DEEP** 3-substrate race (ONE concept — the α Wake→Sleep replay dial — attacked via SVG-native vs three.js-feedback vs WebGL2-ring-buffer), executing jury-2026-07-15 provocation **#2** (return to the PRIMARY DIRECTION at scale on the OTHER pole — this is the lab&rsquo;s cleanest **DREAM/hypnagogic** anchor: sleep-phase replay *is* dreaming, the thinnest pole) + **#3** (off the banned Canvas2D, onto the one substrate the jury explicitly named empty — **SVG**) + **#1** (leave the instrument/theory workshop — no played instrument, no self-writing score). **The model:** a single α∈[0,1] is the control parameter of **Bredenberg et al., "Modeling the hallucinatory effects of classical visionary states in terms of replay-dependent plasticity mechanisms," eLife 2026;14:RP105968** — it maps the **Wake-Sleep algorithm** (Hinton, Dayan, Frey & Neal, 1995) onto cortex: α=0 is WAKE (basal dendrites, bottom-up sensory inference), α=1 is SLEEP (apical dendrites, top-down generative **replay**); as the gate closes what you perceive is internally generated to match *learned memory*, not pure noise. Contrasted in the notes with **REBUS** (Carhart-Harris & Friston) — a prior-relaxation account rather than an active-replay one. **How it works:** `scene.ts` (fixed-seed mulberry32 `0x1792`) lays out 7 distinct warm glyphs (the veridical "day"), and builds `DREAM_INSTANCES` = 4 recombination fragments per glyph, each a slow drift + wrong rotation/scale + convergence toward a shared attractor (so two glyphs melt into one at the peak), fading in progressively as α passes per-fragment thresholds (recombination DENSITY rises, never a flash). The dream layer is literally `<use href="#gN">` of the day&rsquo;s glyph ids, so it is **provably made of the day scene** — the clearest of the three race entries. `audio.ts` mirrors it cross-modally: a warm JI pad + a faithful 8-step WAKE motif that fades as α rises while the SAME motif returns recombined (wrong-order, transposed ±octave/fifth, time-stretched, overlapping loops) through the shared `_shared/visionary/convolutionVoid` reverb, whose wet opens with α. Always-on **WAKE↔SLEEP α meter** + phase caption (basal→drifting→apical) makes cause→effect explicit. **Ambition — honest 2–3/5:** **#1** never-used technique via **SVG-DOM as the PRIMARY render substrate** (grep-near-0×; ### [1786-dissolve-boundless](/dream/1786-dissolve-boundless) · visionary / **slow your breath and a tight luminous sphere of ~524,000 GPU particles — "the ego" — unravels into a boundless, all-filling violet glow (drug-free ego-dissolution / meditative boundlessness); movement or loud sound snaps the boundary back and it re-coheres (COSMIC-AMBIENT pole; NOT an instrument, NOT a JI drone, NOT Canvas2D, NOT raw-WebGL2, NOT a raymarched SDF)** · **MIC-BREATH / STILLNESS (RMS low-band → cohesion driver 1→0 on held stillness, snaps back fast on movement; analyser ONLY, never to output) + deterministic ~46 s ghost-breath fallback when no mic** / **WebGPU COMPUTE — a WGSL `@compute` step over a ping-ponged pair of 524,288-particle f32 storage buffers (position+velocity vec4 each): a `cohesion`-scaled spring toward a shared sphere shell r0 vs a `(1−cohesion)`-scaled curl-flow diffusion + outward drift with a toroidal box-wrap, drawn as instanced additive soft-disc billboards; shared Shepard drift + JI drone bank widen/detune as cohesion falls** · cycle 795 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-16) · demoable · `state: ego-dissolution / meditative boundlessness · pole: cosmic-ambient`
**The boundary of "you" is a slider, and your breath moves it.** Winner of a **WIDE** 3-substrate fire (three unrelated off-Canvas2D directions on the thin cosmic-ambient pole — WebGPU-compute ego-dissolution / SVG-filter aurora / audio-forward HRTF sound-bath), executing jury-2026-07-15 provocation **#3** (force a **WebGPU-compute** piece, off the banned Canvas2D 7× monoculture — the substrate is still near-0× as the *primary* renderer) + **#2** (return to the visionary PRIMARY DIRECTION at scale on the OTHER pole — cosmic-ambient / meditative is thin, and the lab has visualized dissolution states only via raymarched SDF/void [1762-nde-void, 1041-nde-tunnel], **never as a live particle field**). **How it works — substrate:** a WGSL compute shader steps ~524k particles each frame, reading one pos/vel storage-buffer pair and writing the other (real ping-pong, not a texture animation). The one field each particle feels is a **cohesion↔diffusion blend**: `cohesion` (0..1) scales an elastic spring toward a shared sphere-shell radius r0 (at cohesion=1 the swarm is a tight, additive-bloomed, white-hot sphere — "the ego"), while `(1−cohesion)` scales a cheap divergence-free **curl flow** plus a gentle outward drift (at cohesion=0 a toroidal box-wrap distributes the swarm into a vast, even, dim violet luminescence filling the frame — "boundless awareness"). Integration is in real per-second units with frame-rate-independent `v *= exp(−drag·dt)` damping and a clamped dt, so it's stable across framerates. **Input:** a smoothed low-band mic RMS drives a single `cohesion` scalar — held stillness/quiet slowly lowers it (you dissolve), any movement/loud sound snaps it back fast (you re-form); the mic feeds an `AnalyserNode` **only** (never `.connect()`-ed onward → feedback impossible by construction). **Render:** each particle is a 6-vert instanced billboard with a soft `smoothstep` disc; **additive** blending does the aesthetic work for free — dense overlap in the coherent sphere whitens toward the core, the dispersed field reads as even glow — points grow softer/larger as cohesion drops for a smoother boundless wash. Cool violet→warm-white emission (palette lives inside the WGSL fragment string). **Audio:** the shared **Shepard** endless-drift + **just-intonation drone bank** summed to a master bus; `update(cohesion, dt)` couples sound to state — as cohesion falls the drone's drive rises (filter opens, detune widens) and the Shepard drift brightens (the felt "widening" of the boundary), pulling back on re-coherence. **Auto-demo:** no mic → a deterministic ~46 s **ghost breath** (`0.5+0.5·cos`) drives the same cohesion cycle so the headless 06:30 box dissolves + sounds on its own, never blank/silent; a `text-destructive` note surfaces the mic denial but never stops the piece. **Degrade:** no-WebGPU (`navigator.gpu` absent / no adapter / device lost) throws a typed `WebGPUUnsupportedError` the page catches → an on-brand notice + a lightweight CSS/DOM glow-bloom fallback breathing on the same cohesion signal, audio still running. **Safety:** meditative by slow luminance drift only — **no alpha-band flicker**; `prefers-reduced-motion` honored; brightness/emission kept sub-white by the additive falloff. **Named refs (README):** **Nour, Evans, Nutt & Carhart-Harris, "Ego-Dissolution Inventory (EDI)"** (*Frontiers in Human Neuroscience*, 2016) — the dissolution of the felt self↔world boundary this literally stages · **Millière / Letheby** on drug-free ego-dissolution phenomenology. **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (mic-breath/stillness detector + WebGPU-compute cohesion↔diffusion sim + instanced additive render + Shepard/drone audio bed coupled to state = 4) + **#3** the named refs + rare-technique (WebGPU-compute as the *primary* substrate, the jury's forced lane) + **#5-amended** research-cited to the §795 dive (the mature WebGPU-compute-agent-sim substrate aimed *inward* at ego-dissolution → today's research → tonight's build). **#1 NOT claimed** — WebGPU compute + particle fields are individually owned; ### [1758-boundless-wave](/dream/1758-boundless-wave) · visionary / **breathe toward your mic and a real GPU 2D wave-equation solver — the one every WebGPU water/cloth demo uses for REALISM — is pointed at its opposite: a boundless, edge-dissolving Chladni standing-wave field with no object, no center, no scale (formless-jhāna ākāsānañcāyatana, drug-free) (COSMIC-AMBIENT/meditative pole; NOT an instrument, NOT a harmony engine, NOT a JI drone, NOT Canvas2D, NOT raw-WebGL2)** · **MIC-BREATH (RMS low-band → smoothed drive amplitude; analyser ONLY, never to output) + deterministic ~0.08 Hz ghost-breath fallback** / **WebGPU COMPUTE — a WGSL finite-difference PDE solver `u_next = 2u − u_prev + c²∇²u` over a 512² ping-ponged f32 storage-buffer grid (reflective Neumann edges, damping 0.9985, c²=0.24), rendered `|u|`→dim-violet ramp clamped ≤0.7; inharmonic breath-swelled pad → void reverb** · cycle 789 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-15) · demoable · `state: formless-boundless / ākāsānañcāyatana · pole: cosmic-ambient/meditative`
**The GPU wave-solver, made anti-realist: not water, but boundless space.** Winner of a **DEEP** 3-substrate fire (ONE concept — *ĀKĀSA / boundless space: every edge, center and scale dissolved into one continuous standing-wave medium* — attacked via WebGPU-compute wave-equation PDE / three.js volumetric raymarch / three.js analytic Chladni plate), cashing the ⭐⭐ top-banked `1756-boundless` (§788) on the **cosmic-ambient/meditative pole the jury named thin**, and executing jury-2026-07-15 provocation **#2** (return to visionary at scale on the OTHER pole, cash a banked altered-states piece) + **#3** (force a WebGPU-compute piece, off the banned Canvas2D). **How it works — substrate:** a WGSL **compute** shader integrates the discretized 2D wave equation over a 512×512 grid of f32 amplitudes, ping-ponging three GPU storage buffers (u_prev, u_curr → u_next); the Laplacian is a 5-point stencil, light damping (×0.9985) bleeds energy so the field settles to a calm equilibrium instead of running away, and **reflective (Neumann) edges** via clamped neighbour indexing fold every ripple back — that interference is what makes the standing-wave **Chladli figure** form. c²=0.24 keeps the Courant number well under the 0.5 stability wall (hardcoded, never derived from a clock); the step runs 2 sub-steps/frame for crisp propagation. **Input:** a smoothed low-band mic RMS envelope becomes the drive amplitude of a slow, wide radial Gaussian excitation injected at a few fixed off-centre sites (a separate FORCE compute pass); louder/steadier breath fills the field toward a shimmering equilibrium, silence lets it decay toward a faint breathing ground — never fully flat. The mic feeds an `AnalyserNode` ONLY (never `.connect()`-ed onward → feedback impossible by construction). **Render:** a render pass maps `|u|` to a dim→bright violet ramp, antinodes peaking ~0.53 (comfortably under the ≤0.7 clamp — no white-out), nodal lines reading as dark violet filaments, full-viewport and boundless (no frame). **Audio:** a soft pad of detuned + slightly **INHARMONIC** partial voices (ratios just off the harmonic series → the sustained chord shimmers/beats instead of locking — **not** the consonant-JI drone the jury banned) brightens/swells as field-energy fills → shared `createVoidReverb` → `DynamicsCompressor` → gain 0.15. **Auto-demo:** with NO mic (headless 06:30 box, no display/speakers) a deterministic ~0.08 Hz **ghost breath** over the integer frame counter drives the same field, so the piece is alive + audible unattended; a mic denial surfaces a `text-destructive` note but never stops the piece. **Degrade:** no-WebGPU → an on-brand notice + a DOM radial glow breathing on the same field-energy signal, audio still running. **Safety:** brightness hard-clamped ≤0.7 in the shader, only a slow ~0.06 Hz luminance drift (well below any photosensitive band), `prefers-reduced-motion` slows the stir + flattens the drift — **no strobe**. **Named refs (README):** *ākāsānañcāyatana* — the formless jhāna "sphere of boundless/infinite space" (Buddhist Abhidhamma) · **Ernst Chladni (1787)** — cymatics / nodal figures on a driven plate, which the reflective-boundary wave equation reproduces literally · **d'Alembert** — the 2D wave equation being integrated. **Ambition — honest 4/5:** **#1** first real-time wave-equation **PDE solver** in the lab (grep-verified; 1740-breath-nebula was curl-noise *advection*, not a PDE grid solve — a genuinely new algorithm on the WebGPU-compute substrate) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (mic-analysis + WebGPU compute PDE + instanced render + inharmonic audio bed = 4) + **#3** the named refs + rare-technique (WebGPU-compute, jury's forced lane, still near-0× across ~744 protos); research-cited to the §789 dive (the anti-realist inversion of the now-mature GPU wave-solver → today's research → tonight's build). **#5 NOT claimed** — jury-retired-in-practice (4th jury). **diversity:** `banned=[Canvas2D OUTPUT(jury 7×) · raw-WebGL2 OUTPUT(§785 4×) · physical-model-instrument + self-writing-score TECHNIQUE(jury 4×+4×) · touch/pointer-drag INPUT(jury 5×) · keyboard-as-instrument INPUT(on-watch 5×) · visionary state-intense-only VIBE(on-watch)]`; `picked=[WebGPU-compute OUTPUT (off-Canvas2D & off-raw-WebGL2, the jury's forced lane) · wave-equation-PDE-solver TECHNIQUE (not instrument/theory, first-in-lab) · mic-breath-RMS-excite INPUT (not touch/keyboard) · meditative-boundless/cosmic-ambient VIBE (the thin pole, not visionary state-intense)]` — clears every jury hard-ban on all four axes and fills the thin cosmic-ambient/meditative pole. **Love-signal:** squarely inside Karel's loved gentle-boundless-field cluster (`84-wave-fluid`, `130-tsl-particle-compute`, `243-spectral-cloud`, `267-spectral-drift`, `107-ocean-presence` all ❤). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` WebGPU + Web Audio; **The screen breathes with your lungs — and rewards you for slowing down.** Winner of a **DEEP** 3-renderer fire (ONE concept — *a breath-biofeedback boundless field* — attacked via WebGL2 radial-bloom mist / 60k-mote nimbus / Canvas2D caustic-mandala), the **COSMIC-AMBIENT counterweight** to the recent INTENSE run (1700 visionary state-bloom + 1714 tesseract), cashing the ⭐⭐ top-banked `1712-breath-void` (§782) — jury-2026-07-14 provocation **#3** (cash the banked cycle-2) + criterion **#4** (multi-cycle follow-through). **How it works — input:** `getUserMedia({audio})` → `MediaStreamSource.connect(analyser)` and **nothing else** (the analyser is read-only, never `.connect()`-ed onward, so the mic can never reach `ctx.destination` — feedback is impossible by construction). ### [1714-tesseract-melt](/dream/1714-tesseract-melt) · visionary / **tilt your phone to steer a real 4-dimensional tesseract melting through hyperspace — a visionary state "more axes than physical reality allows" breakthrough (INTENSE pole; NOT an instrument, NOT a harmony engine, NOT a JI drone, NOT cosmic-starfield, NOT three.js)** · **DEVICE-TILT `deviceorientation` (beta/gamma → the XW/YW 4D rotation-*hyperplane* rates) + pointer-drag desktop fallback + iOS `requestPermission` + always-on deterministic ghost auto-rotation — fresh non-keyboard non-pointer non-camera input** / **raw WebGL2 4D-vertex/projection pipeline (16 verts/32 edges, six-plane 4D rotation, 4D→3D→2D double perspective divide), additive edge-glow frag with thin-film iridescence + chromatic aberration + N-fold kaleidoscope + Reinhard tone-map; 9-partial inharmonic bank coupled to the 4D rotation angle (no JI drone)** · cycle 782 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-15) · demoable · `state: visionary breakthrough-hyperdimensional · pole: intense`
**Tilt into a fourth dimension and watch the cube turn inside-out.** Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three unrelated non-keyboard altered-states pieces spanning mic / tilt / audio-file inputs and both poles), chosen as the most **headless-verifiable** of the three — its jeweled 4D melt is self-evident on any display via pure deterministic ghost rotation, needing no sensor, no dropped file, no headphones (the §779/§780 review-box lesson). The **INTENSE** counterweight to the recent cosmic-ambient run (1708 cathedral + banked voids). **How it works — visual:** genuine four-dimensional geometry, *not* a spinning 3D cube and *not* three.js. The 16 tesseract vertices `(±1,±1,±1,±1)` (32 edges — two verts share an edge iff they differ in exactly one coord) are rotated in 4D across six independent planes `xy,xz,xw,yz,yw,zw`; the three **w-planes** (rotations *into* the 4th axis, which have no 3-D counterpart) are the animated + steerable ones, so projected edges **balloon and turn inside-out** ("the melt") instead of rigidly orbiting. Vertices are projected 4D→3D by a perspective divide `k4=1/(distW−w)` then 3D→2D by `k3=1/(distZ−z)`; the rotated `w` also drives each edge's iridescent hue (hyper-depth → color) and near/far `z` drives brightness. A fragment shader draws the 32 edges as an additive glow with **thin-film iridescence**, 3× **chromatic aberration** sampling, and a 6–8-fold **kaleidoscope** bloom (jeweled, ultra-saturated — palette lives inside the shader). **Input:** `deviceorientation` beta→XW rate, gamma→YW rate (tilt the *phone* to rotate through the 4th dimension); on desktop, pointer-drag maps to the same; with no input, a slow deterministic ghost auto-rotation always melts. **Audio:** a 9-partial **inharmonic** sine bank (stretched, seed-jittered ratios on a low root) whose per-partial **detune + gain track the summed w-rotation angle** — rotating through W audibly re-tunes the timbre; it beats/shimmers rather than resolving (deliberately **not** the consonant-JI drone the 2026-07-14 jury banned) → `DynamicsCompressor` → master 0.12 → shared `createVoidReverb`. **Auto-demo:** with zero input the six angles are a pure function of an integer frame counter, so the headless 06:30 box is **never blank or silent**; no-WebGL2 degrades to a Canvas2D wireframe of the same rotating tesseract. **Safety:** INTENSE by saturation/detail/slow drift — **never flicker**; the only periodic luminance change is one soft ~0.4 Hz breath (floor 0.78) gated through `_shared/visionary/safeFlicker` (≤3 Hz, honors `prefers-reduced-motion`). **Named refs (README):** **H.S.M. Coxeter *Regular Polytopes*** (tesseract/8-cell projection lineage) · **Klüver** form constants · **visionary state** "more axes than physical reality allows" hyperdimensional-geometry phenomenology · **thin-film iridescence**. **Ambition — honest 2–3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (device-tilt input + 4D rotation/projection math + raw-WebGL2 additive-glow polytope render + iridescence/kaleidoscope shader + 4D-angle-coupled inharmonic audio = 5) + **#3** the named refs; research-cited to the §782 audio-reactive-pipeline/saturation dive. **#1 NOT claimed** — 4D/tesseract is owned (1042-hyperspace-bloom / 1051-hand-hyperspace / 1196-fibration); the fresh axis is the **combination** (tilt-steered XW/YW-hyperplane melt + 4D-rotation-angle-coupled inharmonic audio + jeweled kaleidoscope), per the saturation finding. **#5 NOT claimed** — 24th straight <14-day dry (retirement re-escalated). **diversity:** `banned=[keyboard-PLAYED INPUT(4×) · zero-input/watch-only · JI-consonant-drone BED · orbital-gravity · cosmic-STARFIELD palette · (on-watch) touch/pointer INPUT(3×) + three.js OUTPUT + instrument-DSP + harmony-engine TECHNIQUE(3×)]`; `picked=[device-tilt INPUT (fresh, non-keyboard non-pointer non-camera) · 4D-polytope-projection + 4D-angle-coupled-inharmonic-audio TECHNIQUE · raw-WebGL2 OUTPUT (NOT three.js) · jeweled-neon-iridescent PALETTE (NOT starfield)]` — clears every hard ban AND all four on-watch flags on all four axes AND re-balances the pole toward INTENSE. **Love-signal:** squarely inside Karel's most-loved geometric-visionary art cluster (`1482-face-mandala`, `1396-apophenia-field`, `1450-supershape-bloom`, `130-tsl-particle-compute` all ❤). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` WebGL2 + Web Audio; no server/route/secret/network; zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites; `eslint … --max-warnings 0` = **0**; determinism grep clean (state path = integer frame counter + `Math.sin`/`cos`, fixed art randomness via hardcoded-seed mulberry32); authoritative `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0**, `/dream/1714-tesseract-melt` in BOTH route manifests + `page.js` emitted, no `1712`/`1716` leaked. **NOT eye-verified for feel** (headless container — no display): whether the edges read as genuinely hyperdimensional (ballooning/inside-out) vs a spinning 3D cage wants Karel's Chrome; ### [1708-lattice-cathedral](/dream/1708-lattice-cathedral) · visionary / **fly first-person through an endless dark NDE/dissociative cathedral — a receding nave of luminous wireframe arches and rails built as REAL 3-D geometry (no three.js), where each landmark structure sings from its true 3-D position via HRTF spatial audio so sight and sound read one geometry** · **POINTER-drag steers your gaze (yaw/pitch + inertia, auto re-center) over an always-on forward drift — non-keyboard, real first-person agency (escapes the persistent keyboard-PLAYED over-rep)** / **raw WebGL2 hand-built `perspective`×`lookAt` vertex pipeline, additive `gl.LINES` + point-glow bloom; 5 HRTF `PannerNode` beacons → shared `createVoidReverb` cavern; sparse slightly-inharmonic pads (no JI drone)** · cycle 781 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-15) · demoable · `state: dissociative/NDE-void · pole: cosmic-ambient`
**Fly forward, forever, through a vast dark cathedral of light.** Winner of a **DEEP** 3-approach fire on ONE concept — *"The Descent": a steerable first-person passage through an NDE/dissociative architectural VOID where every luminous structure pings from its true 3-D position via HRTF spatial audio* — resurrecting §780's ⭐⭐ top-banked `1702-void-descent` as the whole cycle's concept, and the **COSMIC-AMBIENT** counterweight to §780's INTENSE visionary state bloom (the mandate: cover the whole spectrum, don't camp on one pole). **How it works — visual:** genuine 3-D geometry, *not* a raymarched SDF and *not* three.js. Vertices for each structure are generated deterministically as `gl.LINES` pairs; a hand-built **`perspective`** matrix × a **`lookAt`** view matrix (camera position + a forward vector from yaw/pitch) multiply on the CPU into a view-projection that transforms every vertex in the vertex shader. An **endless nave** of semicircular portal arches plus continuous **floor / springer / ridge rails** is drawn at integer multiples of the bay spacing around the camera, so the corridor never ends and the rails converge on a vanishing point (the dominant depth cue). Five larger **landmark structures** are interspersed — a great double-arch, a ring-portal, a saddle-vault, a girder pylon, and a rose-gate. Additive blending blooms overlapping girders; a second `gl.POINTS` pass adds a soft joint glow (cheap fake bloom); edge color drifts violet→cool-neutral with depth into `exp(-depth·density)` black fog. **Audio (the research hook):** each of the 5 landmarks owns exactly one `PannerNode` (`panningModel="HRTF"`, `distanceModel="inverse"`) placed at its **true world coordinate every frame**, and the `AudioListener` position + orientation are set from the **same camera** the visuals use (feature-detecting `positionX`/`forwardX` AudioParams vs legacy `setPosition`/`setOrientation`). Because both the view matrix and the listener derive "right" from `cross(forward, up)`, **sight and sound read the identical geometry** — the arch you see on your right is heard on your right and a fly-through sweeps front→back. Beacons are soft, slightly-**inharmonic** sustained pads (fundamentals 58.3/77.8/92.5/116.5/138.6 Hz, each with a slow breathing LFO) — a resonant void, deliberately **not** a consonant JI drone (the reflex the 2026-07-14 jury banned) → long `createVoidReverb` cavern tail → `DynamicsCompressor` → master 0.12. **Auto-demo:** an immediate frame-counter ghost flight (forward drift + deterministic `Math.sin`-of-frame yaw/pitch sweep) means the headless 06:30 box is **never blank or silent**; **HRTFformer** arXiv 2510.01891). **Ambition — honest 2–3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (hand-built 3-D geometry + `perspective`/`lookAt` camera matrices + pointer-gaze steering + per-structure HRTF spatial audio + convolution-void reverb = 5) + **#3** the named refs above; ### [1694-reed-column](/dream/1694-reed-column) · adult / **breath-blown single-reed CLARINET physical model — a real self-oscillating 1-D digital-waveguide woodwind (McIntyre-Schumacher-Woodhouse 1983 reed law), completing the lab's physical-model triad pluck→bow[1692]→BLOW; NOT a JI-drone bed, NOT a harmony engine, NOT gravity, NOT cosmic** · **mic BREATH = the exciter (RMS envelope = blowing pressure, NOT the pitch — the bore loop self-oscillates; SILENT below threshold, no drone) + pointer-x = bore length; deterministic ghost-breath auto-demo — real agency, under-rep MIC input (NOT keyboard-played the banned over-rep, NOT pointer-drag, NOT camera)** / **Canvas2D live standing-pressure-wave in the bore + breath-pressure meter + register readout — Blob-URL AudioWorklet reed DSP, NO three.js/WebGL, off-GPU** · cycle 779 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-15) · demoable · `state: breath-blown clarinet you play with your lungs · pole: wind physical-model / live-performance (anti-JI-drone, silent-at-rest, off-GPU)`
**Blow into your laptop mic and it becomes a real clarinet — your actual breath is the exciter of a self-oscillating single-reed woodwind physical model, and it overblows to a *twelfth*, not an octave.** Winner of a DEEP 3-approach fire (single-reed clarinet · air-jet flute · lip-reed brass) completing the physical-model instrument triad: **pluck → bow (`1692-friction-loom`) → BLOW (this)**. **How it works:** a genuine **1-D digital waveguide** running per-sample in a Blob-URL `AudioWorklet` — the bore is a delay line terminated by a **sign-inverting lossy one-pole bell reflection** (a cylinder closed at the reed ⇒ **odd harmonics** ⇒ the hollow clarinet timbre + the signature overblow to the **3rd harmonic, a twelfth**) and by the **reed nonlinearity** at the mouthpiece: each sample forms the pressure difference across the reed `Δp = pBore − pMouth`, looks it up in the STK/MSW **reed table** `r = clamp(offset + slope·Δp, −1, 1)` (the reed *closes* as blowing pressure rises), and re-injects `pMouth + Δp·r` — the **pressure-controlled nonlinearity** that turns steady breath into a self-sustaining limit cycle. Pitch is the bore delay length, **not** the breath; below a pressure threshold the column is **silent** (no drone — jury #2 real agency); the overblow-to-a-twelfth is a hysteretic register-vent retune to 1/3 length. Bounded by construction (bell loss <1, clamped reed table, tanh-saturated output → DynamicsCompressor → master 0.12). **Numerically verified** in a Node harness before baking constants: silent below control-pressure ~0.35, self-oscillates ~202 Hz, overblows to ~604 Hz — a measured ratio **2.99, a true twelfth**. **Controller (non-keyboard):** PRIMARY = mic breath (`getUserMedia`→`AnalyserNode`→per-frame RMS envelope = `pMouth`; mic connects **only to the analyser, never to destination** — no howl); SECONDARY = pointer-x slides the bore length (quantized to a chalumeau pentatonic). **Auto-demo:** a deterministic **ghost breath** from a frame counter (`Math.sin`, never `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`performance.now` in the audio path) plays a tongued phrase — some notes pushed past the overblow threshold to sound the twelfth — so the headless 06:30 box is never blank/silent; live blow takes over, idle returns to the ghost; **mic-denied** degrades to an on-brand `text-destructive` notice while the ghost keeps playing. **The see=hear weld:** Canvas2D **live standing pressure wave in the bore** (antinode at reed, node at bell — the node count visibly *triples* on overblow, the real worklet buffer snapshot overlaid faintly), a breath-pressure meter with speak/blow thresholds marked, and a register readout (Chalumeau / Clarion·12th) — warm amber-reed palette inside the canvas only, violet the sole chrome accent. **Named refs (README):** McIntyre-Schumacher-Woodhouse *"On the oscillations of musical instruments"* JASA 1983 · Perry R. Cook STK `Clarinet` · Julius O. Smith III digital waveguides (CCRMA) · **arXiv 2604.12878 *Four Decades of Digital Waveguides*** (Smith/Välimäki/Reiss, 2026-04-14 — this cycle's research hook). **Ambition — honest 2–3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (mic capture + breath-envelope + reed nonlinearity + cylindrical-bore waveguide + standing-wave viz = 5) + **#3** named refs above + **plausible #1** (a breath-mic-driven self-oscillating reed waveguide is grep-thin — the lab's flutes are envelope toys, 827 is a 2-D mesh). **#5 NOT claimed** — 21st straight <14-day dry (freshest = the April-2026 Smith retrospective at ~3 mo; **Play a synthesized Indian *tabla* through a spoken-rhythm *konnakol tala* cycle — the tala's structure (matras, sam, khali) visible as a turning necklace, the drum voices modeled not sampled.** Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer rhythm/tension fire (tabla · ET-functional-harmony · beatbox-groovebox), the **direct cash of the fresh 2026-07-14 jury's #1 note** — *"break the just-intonation consonance reflex (13 of 15 resolve to a pretty JI drone); force rhythm, grit, groove — a percussion/beat-driven piece."* Tabla is that piece, and it's **grep-0× across ~730 prototypes** (the lab's first tabla/first tala engine, first non-Western rhythmic structure). **How it works:** every *bol* is **modal/banded-waveguide percussion synthesis, no samples** — `modalStroke()` sums a bandpassed white-noise excitation burst (the membrane slap) with a bank of tuned decaying sine partials at per-bol inharmonic ratios (the resonant ring + pitch); roster `na`/`ta` (bright rim), `tin`/`tun` (open ringing), `ke` (dead slap), `ge` (the baya bass with the signature downward pitch-glide, `bendRatio 0.6`), and composites `dha = ge+na`, `dhin = ge+tin`. ### [1664-bytemill](/dream/1664-bytemill) · adult / **bytebeat — the lab's FIRST algorithmic-glitch instrument (music synthesized from a single bitwise formula; NOT a consonant JI drone, NOT a scale-index, NOT visionary)** · **keyboard-PLAYED — you switch formulas, bend the t-rate, and mutate a live constant (real agency — NOT watch-only, NOT touch/pointer, NOT mic, NOT self-playing)** / **Canvas2D CRT oscilloscope + scrolling 8-bit bitfield (glowing green-on-black, off-violet) — NO three.js/WebGL/GPU** · cycle 774 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: raw algorithmic grit · pole: rhythm/dissonance you play (anti-JI, off-GPU)`
**Play raw 8-bit "bytebeat" — music computed directly from one bitwise formula of a running sample counter `t` — switching formulas and bending the math live while a CRT scope shows the waveform and a scrolling bitfield shows the actual bits that make the rhythm.** Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer fire (rhythm/grit night: bytebeat-glitch · acid-303 · real-piano beat-rack), and the **direct cash of the fresh 2026-07-14 jury's #1 note** — *"13 of 15 pieces resolve to a pretty consonant just-intonation drone; ban the JI bed for a week and force rhythm, grit, groove, or real dissonance — a noise/glitch instrument."* Bytebeat is that instrument: **grep-0× across 729 prototypes** (first in the lab), and the literal opposite of a clean tone — harsh, aliased, glitchy, inherently rhythmic. **How it works:** an **AudioWorkletProcessor authored as an inline string and loaded via a Blob URL** (fully self-contained, nothing served from `/public`) evaluates an integer expression like `t*((t>>12|t>>8)&k&t>>4)` or `(t*(t>>5|t>>8))>>(t>>16&31)` per tick, masks to a byte (`&255`), and maps to `-1..1`. The worklet steps `t` at an **authentic lo-fi 2–16 kHz t-rate independent of the AudioContext sample rate** — a fractional accumulator holds the last byte between ticks, and that sample-and-hold aliasing IS the bytebeat character. **The visitor PLAYS it (real agency — the jury's #2 note: "don't relapse into watch-only"):** keys **1–8** switch among 8 curated named formulas (sierpinski, hard glitch, …); **arrows / `[` `]`** bend the t-rate (tempo+pitch); **`↑↓` / `−=`** live-substitute a single numeric constant `k` inside the current formula (the visitor *mutates the sound* — each formula ships a `kDefault`/`kMin`/`kMax` + an on-screen hint like "bit-mask density"); **space** play/pause; every control mirrored as a touch button. **Safety by construction:** formulas come from a **fixed curated library** and `k` is coerced to an integer — `new Function` compiles only library expressions, the visitor can never inject code. **Auto-demo:** a deterministic ghost performance (driven off `audioContext.currentTime`, no RNG) cycles formulas + bends params on load so a cold 06:30 glance is never silent; any real keypress instantly takes over. **The see=hear weld:** Canvas2D **CRT oscilloscope** of the live waveform over a **scrolling bitfield** (each column = the 8 bits of a sample, LSB at bottom) with scanlines + persistence fade — you literally see the bit patterns that make the rhythm. **Audio safety chain:** worklet → soft-clip `WaveShaper` → `DynamicsCompressor` → low master gain **0.11** → destination (bytebeat can be brutally loud; grit is tamed before the speakers); no >3 Hz full-screen luminance flash; `prefers-reduced-motion` degrades the animation; full teardown on unmount (rAF cancel, node disconnect, context close, **Blob URL revoked**, keydown listener removed). **Named refs:** bytebeat discovered & named by **Viznut (Ville-Matias Heikkilä), 2011** (*"Discovering the beauty of new-school algorithmic music"*) · modern browser composers **bytebeat.cloud** / **dadabots ByteBeats.art**; research-chained to this cycle's §774 dive (bytebeat + browser-acid, both anti-consonance). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#1** first bytebeat in the lab (grep-0× — the only candidate this cycle hitting a never-used technique) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (Blob-URL AudioWorklet bytebeat synth + live formula/constant/t-rate steering state + deterministic ghost performer + Canvas2D scope+bitfield render = 4) + **#3** named refs above. **#5 NOT claimed** — 17th straight <14-day dry (bytebeat is 2011-foundational; the *widened net* this cycle, done per the jury's own #5 instruction, confirms the freshest on-brief work is foundational technique being re-webified now — re-escalating the recommendation to formally amend/retire #5's <14-day bar). **diversity:** `banned=[JI-consonant-drone AUDIO-SPINE(13×) · touch/pointer INPUT(6×) · zero-input/watch-only(4×) · orbital-gravity ENGINE · cosmic palette · three.js OUTPUT(on-watch)]`; `picked=[keyboard-PLAYED INPUT (agency; NOT touch/pointer, NOT zero-input, NOT mic, NOT cosmic) · Canvas2D CRT scope/bitfield OUTPUT (NOT three.js) · bytebeat-bitwise ENGINE (rhythm/grit/dissonance — NOT JI-consonant, NOT gravity) · CRT-green off-violet PALETTE · pole rhythmic/gritty/played]` — clears every hard ban and directly answers jury #1+#2. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D; no server/route/secret/network; zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites (already on-brand — semantic tokens, violet the only chrome accent; green is inside the canvas art only); `eslint src/app/dream/1664-bytemill --max-warnings 0` = **0**; ### [1660-fugue-loom](/dream/1660-fugue-loom) · adult / **counterpoint — the lab's FIRST real music-theory engine (a machine that composes a fugue; NOT a scale-drone, NOT a Markov melody, NOT visionary)** · **autonomous self-composition (~90 s, self-plays on load; "New subject" re-seeds) — NOT mic/voice, NOT touch/pointer-drag, NOT keyboard-steer** / **self-writing SVG scrolling piano-roll score (three warm per-voice hues on dark, off-violet) — NO Canvas2D, NO three.js/WebGL, NO GPU render** · cycle 773 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: a three-voice fugue composing itself · pole: architecture-you-can-see-and-hear (off-violet, off-GPU)`
**Watch a three-voice fugue compose ITSELF — the subject enters voice by voice, is answered a fifth up, returns inverted and in new keys, tightens into a stretto, and resolves over a pedal point — and hear the whole architecture unfold.** Winner of a DEEP 3-approach fire (ONE concept — *a machine that composes real counterpoint* — via strict species · fugal architecture · strict canon), and the lab's **first genuine music-theory engine** across ~725 prototypes: counterpoint/fugue/species-counterpoint were **header-core 0×** — the single most composerly idea for a pianist's lab had never been built, and it is the direct cash of the standing jury demand *"give the input a real musical idea; stop manufacturing the score."* **How it works:** from one integer seed, `composeFugue` builds a complete fugue in D minor as an **11-section form state machine** — Exposition (Voice I states the SUBJECT alone → Voice II enters with a genuine **tonal ANSWER** at the fifth, its rising-fifth head *contracted to a fourth*, while Voice I plays the recurring **countersubject** → Voice III enters with the subject in the bass) → Episodes I–IV (modulating **sequences** built only from the subject's head fragment) → Counter-exposition (bass-first re-voicing) → Middle entries (subject in **relative major**, then **melodic INVERSION** mirrored about the tonic, then the **dominant** region) → two rounds of **Stretto** (a voice re-enters with the subject *before* the previous statement finishes, gap tightening) → **Pedal-point close** (bass sustains dominant→tonic under a final subject statement, resolving to a held D-minor triad). Work happens in **scale-degree space** so every transposition/answer/inversion stays in key by construction; `makeSubject`/`makeCountersubject` run once per seed and are **frozen**, so every later entry is literally that same shape transformed — the piece's **memory**, and why minute-3 is a development of minute-0 rather than a loop (the starved long-form-generative-with-state lane). A final voice-leading pass scans every voice pair for **parallel perfect fifths/octaves** and nudges the offending *free* note by a diatonic step (subject statements never altered). **The see=hear weld:** a self-writing **SVG scrolling piano-roll** — three warm per-voice hues, note blocks appearing exactly as they sound and scrolling under a "NOW" playhead, with **every SUBJECT entry outlined/labelled** so you watch the subject enter voice by voice, see the answer sit a fifth above, and see the stretto overlap; a live section label + timeline bar show where you are in the form. **Audio** (Web Audio, output-only, no mic): three independent detuned-oscillator voices with per-note ADSR + lowpass, look-ahead scheduling against `audioContext.currentTime`, master gain ≤ **0.14** → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination + subtle delay; **autonomous self-play on load** (resume-on-gesture fallback for autoplay policy) so a cold 06:30 glance is never blank/silent; "New subject" advances the seed for a fresh fugue. **Deterministic:** seeded `mulberry32`; **no** `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date` in executable code (grep-clean; engine tests confirm identical output per seed, 19 subject statements across 11 sections, 6/6 stretto overlap, 6/6 distinct subjects across the seed chain). **Named refs:** J.S. Bach *Die Kunst der Fuge* (BWV 1080) & *Das Wohltemperierte Klavier* · J.J. Fux *Gradus ad Parnassum* (1725) · G. Mazzola et al. three-voice counterpoint (arXiv 2606.01102, 2026); research-chained to this cycle's §773 dive (Mazzola/Fux first-species + FuxCP). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (fugal-form state machine + subject/answer/countersubject/inversion memory model + parallel-perfects voice-leading pass + polyphonic per-voice synth + self-writing SVG score = 5, coupled every frame) + **#3** named refs above + **#4** long-form stateful with real memory (a whole fugal arc, different at 0:30 vs 3:00) — **declared cycle-1 of a multi-cycle counterpoint line** (cycle-2: fold in the banked ⭐⭐`fux-machine`'s independently-verified species-counterpoint rule engine so the voices become genuinely species-lawful, not just parallel-perfects-nudged; cycle-3: seed the subject from Karel's real Path piano). **#1 NOT claimed** — the fresh weld is the *engine* (real fugal architecture), while individual pieces (canon, generative melody) have prior lab presence; still, counterpoint-as-core is grep-0×. **#5 NOT claimed** — 15th straight <14-day dry (this cycle's Mazzola find is June 2026 ~1 month, the freshest on-concept find in many cycles but not <14d). **diversity:** `banned=[three.js/WebGL GPU-render OUTPUT(7×) · touch/pointer INPUT(4×) · mic/voice INPUT · Canvas2D-render · voice→JI→form-constant ENGINE · cosmic-gravity ENGINE · iridescent-violet+Klüver PALETTE]`; `picked=[autonomous self-composition + "new subject" trigger INPUT (NOT touch-drag, NOT mic, NOT keyboard-steer) · self-writing SVG piano-roll OUTPUT (off-GPU, off-Canvas2D) · fugal-architecture counterpoint ENGINE (NOT gravity, NOT voice→form-constant, NOT Markov) · ink/sepia per-voice off-violet PALETTE · pole contemplative/composerly]` — clears every hard ban AND breaks both the 7× GPU-render and 4× touch runs. **SAFETY:** no strobe — the only motion is the slow score scroll + a ~0.13 Hz glow pulse, well under 3 Hz; `prefers-reduced-motion` honored; full teardown (scheduler stop + rAF cancel + `audioContext.close()`) on unmount. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + SVG/DOM; no server/route/secret/network; ### [1638-reel](/dream/1638-reel) · adult / **cinematic narrative — an ALTERNATE journey-engine arc (NOT visionary, NOT cosmic-gravity, NOT embodied, NOT voice)** · **autonomous long-form (~5.7 min self-playing film; Restart + per-act jump chips) — NOT mic, NOT camera, NOT keyboard-steer** / **three.js WebGL fragment-shader cinematic atmosphere (letterboxed slate/teal-shadow + gold-highlight, off-violet) — NO Canvas2D render** · cycle 770 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: dramatic beat-sheet → tension curve → generative film score + graded image · pole: cinematic (off-violet, off-cosmic, off-embodied)`
**Press Play and Resonance's journey engine tells a wordless CINEMATIC STORY instead of a visionary arc — a ~5.7-minute self-playing short film whose music and image both obey a classic dramatic beat sheet.** Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer fire (markets · cinematic-arc · physics-collision), and the first real answer to the design director's standing **directive #4** — "EDM build-and-drop, ritual, jazz-responsive, **cinematic narrative** as alternate arcs" to the product's fixed 6-phase visionary engine (a lane essentially unbuilt for months). **How it works:** a **beat-sheet state machine** (Freytag's Pyramid / Snyder's *Save the Cat*) walks seven acts — Setup → Inciting Incident → Rising Action → Midpoint → Climax → Falling Action → Resolution — each with a target tension, key/mode, tempo/density, and color grade; a smooth curve eases the tension between acts and `stateAt(t)` interpolates one **shared tension signal** that drives BOTH sound and image so they never disagree. **The score** (4 detuned pads + sub drone + look-ahead-scheduled recurring **motif**) travels A lydian → C phrygian climax → home to **A major**; tension drives detune/dissonance (a semitone cluster appears above 0.72), filter brightness, register, and motif density. **The image** is a three.js WebGL fragment-shader widescreen atmosphere (fbm fog, horizon glow, particulate light, slow filmic push, non-strobing grain) whose glow/turbulence/warp/grade bend off the same curve. **Memory / state (the anti-loop):** the motif (scale degrees `0 4 3 5 7 4 2`) is the piece's memory — stated plainly in Setup, returns **inverted an octave up** at the Climax, and finally **resolves on the tonic** in the Resolution, returning to the opening's home key; minute five is genuinely a different place than minute one. **Self-demonstrating unattended:** on the Play gesture it rolls start-to-finish autonomously (the best 06:30 self-demo — no camera, no live feed, no input needed); Web Audio built only on gesture, mastered through a `DynamicsCompressor` at gain `Math.min(0.14, peak)`, full teardown (rAF cancel + audio disconnect + three.js dispose + `ctx.close()`) on unmount; `prefers-reduced-motion` calms the camera to a slow drift; no-WebGL shows an on-brand notice while the score still walks the whole arc. **Deterministic:** seeded `mulberry32` (`SEED=0x1638`) for every generative choice, all timing from `audioContext.currentTime` deltas + a frame counter — **no** `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date`, **no** Canvas2D (verified). **Named refs:** Gustav Freytag *Die Technik des Dramas* (1863) · Blake Snyder *Save the Cat!* (2005);
