### [1630-string-loom](/dream/1630-string-loom) · adult / **embodied — the WHOLE body as a string instrument, off the violet AND off the cosmic-gravity run (NOT visionary, NOT gravity, NOT voice)** · **camera / MediaPipe PoseLandmarker full-body tracking (nose · wrists · elbows · knees · ankles cross the strings) + seeded ghost-skeleton auto-demo — NOT mic, NOT voice, NOT touch, NOT keyboard** / **three.js WebGL 3D string field with standing-wave vertex shiver (warm bronze/amber/bone on warm charcoal) — NO Canvas2D render, NO WebGPU** · cycle 769 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: embodied full-body Karplus-Strong string instrument · pole: embodied / warm-daylight (off-violet, off-cosmic)`
**Stand in front of your webcam and your whole body becomes the bridge of a giant harp — sweep a wrist, elbow, knee or ankle across a hanging string and it plucks a real physically-modeled note you watch shiver and hear decay.** Winner of a 3-approach embodied DEEP fire, and the head-on answer to the **2026-07-13 jury's #1 / oldest / still-unmet provocation** — "get a *body* in the room" (in that window: exactly 1 camera, 1 tilt, 0 pose/body-tracking). Chosen over two siblings — a precise two-hand ⭐⭐`1632-hand-lyre` + an ML-free optical-flow ⭐`1634-flow-choir` (both banked §769) — because it puts the *whole body* in the room (not just hands) and keeps the lab's **proven discrete-causal see=hear weld** (a limb crossing a named string plucks + shivers that exact pitch) rather than an aggregate drone. **How it works:** CDN-loaded **MediaPipe PoseLandmarker** (33 landmarks, VIDEO mode, no npm dep) tracks ~8 joints into a field of **15 vertically-hanging strings** tuned to a **just-intonation pentatonic over 3 octaves** (spatial pitch — the column you cross is the note, never a centroid→pitch reflex); a column-crossing with sufficient velocity plucks that string. Audio is **genuine Karplus-Strong** — per-string delay line of length `sampleRate/freq`, seeded noise-burst excitation, two-tap averaging lowpass feedback, one buffer pre-rendered per string and re-triggered through a brightness lowpass into a compressor + feedback-delay ring at master **0.13**. The **see=hear weld:** a single string index drives BOTH the 3D standing-wave vertex shiver (`sin(πu)·exp(−t/τ)`, higher strings shimmering faster) and the KS pluck of that same fixed frequency — the string you watch wobble is exactly the pitch you hear. **Never blank/silent, self-demonstrating unattended:** with no camera / permission denied / MediaPipe load failure it shows a `text-rose-300` notice AND auto-runs a **deterministic (`mulberry32`) ghost skeleton** — five joints sweeping the field on Lissajous paths through the *identical* crossing→pluck code path, so it plays itself at a 06:30 glance with no webcam. Warm bronze→amber→bone strings on warm charcoal; full teardown (stream/AudioContext/RAF/three.js dispose); `prefers-reduced-motion` damps the shiver + demo. **Named refs:** Karplus & Strong (1983) plucked-string algorithm · Michel Waisvisz *The Hands* (1984) · the 2026 *Fluid Body* embodied-sonification research (Springer). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (MediaPipe pose-tracking + spatial crossing/velocity pluck-detection + Karplus-Strong string DSP + three.js 3D standing-wave render = 4, coupled each frame) + **#3** named refs above + **#4** declared cycle-1 of a multi-cycle embodied-instrument line (README declares a cycle-2: two-hand fingertip precision from 1632 + damping/harmonics; a cycle-3 spatial venue/pose-duet mode). **#1 NOT claimed** — MediaPipe body-tracking (1590-body-mirror) and Karplus-Strong both appear in lab history; the fresh weld is the full-body-joints-as-bridge spatial string instrument, absent from the recent window. **#5 NOT claimed** — 18th straight <14-day dry; re-affirms retiring #5. **diversity:** `banned=[mic/voice-INPUT · Canvas2D-OUTPUT · voice→JI-tone→form-constant ENGINE · iridescent-violet+Klüver PALETTE · keyboard-steer WATCH · cosmic-gravity/orbital-resonance ENGINE (recent 3×)]`; `picked=[camera / full-body pose-tracking INPUT (only 1 camera in last window) · three.js/WebGL 3D-render OUTPUT · Karplus-Strong embodied-string ENGINE (NOT gravity, NOT voice→form-constant) · warm bronze/amber/bone off-violet PALETTE · pole embodied (off-cosmic)]` — clears every hard ban AND breaks the cosmic-gravity run. **SAFETY:** no strobe — motion is smooth joint drift + string shiver (well under 3 Hz); `prefers-reduced-motion` honored. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` three.js + Web Audio + a runtime CDN import of MediaPipe; no server/route/secret; zero new npm deps — `three` already a dependency; MediaPipe is a runtime browser CDN load, not a build dep). **Validation:** `eslint src/app/dream/1630-string-loom --max-warnings 0` = **0**; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = compiled (warnings only, in unrelated pre-existing `1085-lightning-organ`), past "Collecting page data" + "Finalizing page optimization", `page.js` (37.7 kB) emitted + `"/dream/1630-string-loom"` in BOTH `routes-manifest.json` and `app-path-routes-manifest.json`; ### [1628-chladni-choir](/dream/1628-chladni-choir) · adult / **physical-acoustics — cymatics, off the violet AND off the cosmic-gravity run (NOT visionary, NOT gravity)** · **touch / drag to sweep the driving frequency (horizontal = mode, vertical = excitation) + seeded idle auto-sweep — NOT mic, NOT voice, NOT camera, NOT keyboard-steer** / **WebGL2 fragment-shader Chladni field + additive GL-points "sand" migrating to the nodal lines (sand-on-steel monochrome) — NO Canvas2D, NO three.js scene-graph** · cycle 768 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: Chladni modal plate / bidirectional pattern↔interval sonification · pole: physical-acoustics (off-violet, off-cosmic)`
**Drag across a brushed-steel plate and WATCH the sand collect on the silent nodal lines — the standing-wave figure you see IS the chord you hear, in both directions.** Tonight's WIDE fire deliberately broke the recent cosmic-gravity 3× run (1600/1608/1622) with a completely different physical grammar, seeded by a fresh paper: **arxiv 2605.09846 *ChladniSonify* (May 2026)**, a bidirectional Chladni-pattern↔frequency mapping grounded in Kirchhoff–Love plate theory. A WebGL2 fragment shader renders `|f|` of the square-plate Chladni field (`cos(mπx)cos(nπy) − cos(nπx)cos(mπy)` — bright antinodes, dark nodes) over brushed steel; ~6,500 warm-white "sand" grains each take a clamped, damped **Newton step down the analytic gradient toward the nearest field zero** (`Δp = −relax·f·∇f/|∇f|²`), so as the frequency sweeps the grains visibly **flow** from one nodal figure into the next rather than snapping — the money shot. **Bidirectional sonification:** the same Gaussian-weighted top modes drive both the field/sand AND an additive sine bank at `f = 55·√(m²+n²)` Hz (plate modal scaling), and the ratio of the two loudest partials is octave-folded to the nearest just interval and named on screen — the figure and the chord are one object. **The whole field floods with language you can't quite read — then a pool of light glides across it and the words *resolve*, bright and legible, and ring.** Winner of a visionary **DEEP** 3-approach fire on ONE concept: *language that reads itself into being via the grep-0× **CSS Custom Highlight API***, finally cashing the banked ⭐⭐ #1 (was `1582-scripture` §760) — and framed by this cycle's research dive, the **C×G×D computational-neurophenomenology** model (*Frontiers in Psychology*, 20 May 2026, doi 10.3389/fpsyg.2026.1819038): a hallucination is the brain's **Generator** replaying learned structure top-down — *meaning-shaped, not noise* — so an **asemic pseudo-language flood that reads as meaning without reference is a faithful model of the altered-state Generator**, and each aperture of light is the **Classifier** momentarily finding "effective causes" (legible words) in it. **The technique (the whole novelty):** the viewport fills edge-to-edge with 47 drifting rows of real seeded pseudo-language in ordinary `Text` nodes, painted near-invisible; **8 highlight buckets** (`lume0…lume7`, bright→dim) are registered once via `CSS.highlights.set(...)` + styled through `::highlight(lumeN){ color; text-shadow; -webkit-text-stroke-color }`; every frame the moving aperture centers rebuild `Range` objects (`new Range(); r.setStart(node,i); r.setEnd(node,j)`) over nearby characters and **distribute them across the buckets by distance** (closest = brightest) — so pools of legibility glide over the language with **zero per-glyph DOM**, all motion from re-ranging (since `::highlight()` may only restyle color/shadow/stroke, never position). **Play self-organized criticality as an instrument: grains rain onto a molten landscape, slopes steepen invisibly to the critical angle, then TOPPLE in scale-free avalanches — and the avalanches ARE the music (mostly tiny ticks, the rare "big one" a full-spectrum DROP).** The lab's **first ecstatic build-and-drop piece** and first adult self-organized-criticality instrument (`sandpile`/`self-organized criticality` grep-**0×** for adults — only a paused-lane kids cascade `377` before). A real **abelian sandpile** (`sandpile.ts`, 80×80 integers, **Bak–Tang–Wiesenfeld**, *Self-Organized Criticality*, PRL 59, 1987; Per Bak, *How Nature Works*, 1996): the canonical **slow-drive** protocol (a grain rains only while the pile is quiescent, so cascades don't smear and the **power law survives**), cells with `h≥4` topple `−4`/`+1`-to-4-neighbours, open boundary; relaxation is **budgeted (≤3500 topples/frame) and carried forward** so a huge cascade unfolds over several frames as a visible **wave of light**. ## `/dream/1444-troxler-void` — *hold still and the screen dissolves. A soft central fixation glyph anchors your gaze; the low-contrast **Ganzfeld** field around it slowly adapts away under steady fixation (**Troxler fading**) until the periphery melts into a uniform void — a drug-free staging of sensory- and ego-boundary dissolution. Move the pointer and the field (and the drone) re-bloom where you disturbed it. The lab's first Troxler/Ganzfeld piece (grep-0×).* **How it works:** **Begin — sound on** gesture-gates the AudioContext. A **per-region adaptation buffer** (40×40 grid) raises each cell's adaptation the longer it goes without change — faster in the periphery than at the fixated centre — collapsing its contrast/saturation toward the mean field colour (`pow(1-adapt,1.6)`); pointer movement near a cell resets it, so motion re-forms the world. **Output = WebGL2** fragment-shader Ganzfeld (fbm colour-drift, adaptation uploaded as an `R8` texture, vignette + dither) with a Canvas2D per-pixel fallback. **Audio** (Web Audio): a detuned-oscillator **drone** → lowpass → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter → master ramp 0→0.18; as the void deepens the drone **thins** (partials drop, reverb send opens via shared `convolutionVoid`), and it re-blooms on movement — so sound and image dissolve together. **Idle self-demo:** with no pointer for a few seconds a drifting virtual gaze + a slow ~13 s global "breath" run the melt/re-form cycle on their own (never a dead screen). `prefersReducedMotion()` slows/freezes motion. **SAFETY:** the opposite of flicker — only sub-Hz luminance/contrast drift, no strobe, no full-screen flash. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure client; zero new npm deps). **Ambition 2/5:** #1 never-used technique (Troxler/Ganzfeld per-region adaptation buffer, grep-0×) · #3 named refs **Ignác Troxler (1804)** / **Wolfgang Metzger — Ganzfeld (1930)**. **diversity:** `banned=[Canvas2D-primary · SVG-primary · JI/pentatonic-scale-index · dissonance-theme(×4) · three.js(×3) · DOM/CSS-3D(×2) · mic-sole · kbd-sole · camera] · picked=[Troxler/Ganzfeld perceptual-dissolution TECHNIQUE(0×) · pointer-stillness INPUT · WebGL2 Ganzfeld field OUTPUT · thinning drone (not a scale-index) · cosmic-ambient meditative VIBE]` — clears every live ban. Winner of a visionary **WIDE** 3-explorer fire; honest knocks (own README): the subjective fade only fully lands on a real display at rest (the on-screen sim approximates the retinal effect); palette/fade-rate want a hardware tuning pass. `state: sensory/ego-boundary dissolution · pole: cosmic-ambient meditative`. `status: demoable`. ## `/dream/1440-thread-scan` — *one unbroken thread weaves a whole painted field into a single continuous line of light and pitch. You paint luminous marks into a dark field; a **Hilbert space-filling curve** threads every cell, and a bright reading-head travels the thread and **sounds whatever it passes** — so the field is heard as ONE connected line rather than separate notes. Because the Hilbert curve preserves locality, a shape you paint becomes a **coherent gesture in time**: the drug-free staging of the ego-dissolution UNITY phenomenon (DMN-dissolution — "the field becomes one continuous thing"). The lab's first space-filling-curve instrument and first continuous-no-scale pitch (grep-0×).* **How it works:** **Begin — sound on** gesture-gates the AudioContext (a pre-painted glyph is already weaving before you touch it, so never blank/silent). **Drag on the field** to paint glowing marks (colour follows the vertical axis, violet→amber, the same axis pitch maps to). **order (3–6)** zooms the weave (coarse calm → fine dense); **speed** sets head travel; **let go** on = the head drifts itself, off = a **scrub** slider steers it by hand; **clear field** wipes. **Output = WebGL2:** the painted field is an RGBA texture drawn as a quad, the whole Hilbert curve is a faint additive `LINE_STRIP`, and the head + comet trail are additive glow sprites; WebGL2-absent → a reduced Canvas2D fallback draws the same three layers and still plays. **Audio** (Web Audio): pitch is a **continuous glissando** from the head's vertical field position — *not* a scale, *not* pentatonic, *not* a JI index (deliberately stepping off the lab's ~10×/15 always-consonant crutch — the thread is a *continuum* of pitch, which is what makes the field read as one line); brightness→loudness, hue→timbre, local density→shimmer + longer grains. A single sustained thread voice is always the line; crossing into a bright mark plucks a soft panned grain (polyphonic, 12-voice cap). Master ramps 0→0.2 into a `DynamicsCompressor` limiter; full teardown (rAF, AudioContext, GL) on unmount. **SAFETY:** no strobe — the only luminance pulse is a ~0.12 Hz breathing drift; `prefers-reduced-motion` slows head travel + shrinks the breath. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure client; zero new npm deps). **Ambition 4/5:** #1 first space-filling-curve instrument + first continuous-no-scale pitch (grep-0×; honestly declared — Hilbert *rendering* is common in generative art, the fresh axis is the space-filling curve as a PLAYED unity instrument) · #2 ≥3 subsystems (Hilbert curve generator + paint-field engine + locality→continuous-pitch mapper + WebGL2 renderer + voice pool = 5) · #3 named refs **David Hilbert (1891)** / Giuseppe Peano (1890) / **Carhart-Harris — entropic brain / REBUS** · #5 today's §734 dive. **diversity:** `banned=[dissonance/inharmonic-tuning-theme(×4) · DOM/CSS-3D(×2) · three.js(×3) · Canvas2D-primary · SVG-primary · pentatonic/JI-scale-index · camera(729)] · picked=[space-filling-curve UNITY TECHNIQUE(0×) · pointer-paint/scrub INPUT · WebGL2 field+thread OUTPUT · CONTINUOUS-pitch glissando (steps off the JI crutch entirely) · unity/ego-dissolution VIBE · PLAYED]` — clears every live ban. zero new npm deps; `three@0.182`). **Ambition 4/5:** real-world live-data sonification (menu category, 2nd since `1374`) · ≥3 subsystems (live USGS fetch + data→field mapping + three.js point-shell render + data-derived inharmonic drone/granular audio) · named ref **Refik Anadol — DATALAND / "Machine Dreams: Rainforest"** (opened 2026-06-20, LA) + the seismic-sonification lineage · #5 research-in-last-14-days (today's §731 dive). **diversity:** `banned=[Canvas2D-primary · SVG-primary · JI/pentatonic-always-consonant · Reich-phasing-as-TIME · mic-sole · home-row-keyboard-as-SOLE] · picked=[real-world-live-data-sonification TECHNIQUE (data-derived inharmonic — antidote to always-consonant) · three.js point-field OUTPUT (off Canvas2D+SVG) · live external-data + pointer INPUT · data-driven evolving TIME · cosmic-ambient/planetary VIBE · PLAYED]` — clears every 2026-07-10 ban. ## `/dream/1418-beat-field` — *detune a stack of four voices and **play the beating itself**. A single **beat-rate** control splits each voice's partials `h·f ± h·bt/2` so upper partials roughen first, sweeping one continuous axis: pure **lock** (silence-of-beating, dark calm) → ~1–3 Hz **shimmer** → **AM tremolo** → dense **roughness** (the howl). Dissonance is the sculpted expressive medium — not minimized (unlike `496`/`508`), not merely visualized (unlike `947`), not a discrete temperament step (unlike `1408`). The 2nd GPU-compute piece the jury demanded across four verdicts, finally shipped — and the direct cash of jury #2 ("break the always-consonant spell").* **How it works:** hit **Begin** (gesture-gates the AudioContext), then **drag anywhere** — horizontal = beat rate `bt` (left lock → right howl, log 0.25→42 Hz), vertical = drive/brightness; **keys `1`–`5`** pick a chord preset (Unison lock / Octave / Just fifth / Major triad / Cluster), **`↑ ↓`** move the root, **`← →`** nudge `bt`. **Output = a genuine WebGPU compute tier:** `gpu.ts` dispatches a **WGSL compute shader** over a 256×256 grid that Gaussian-splats the Plomp–Levelt/Sethares roughness of each partial-pair blob (`s = 0.24/(0.021·min(f1,f2)+19)`; `r = a1·a2·(e^{-3.5·s·df} − e^{-5.75·s·df})`) into an `rgba16float` storage texture, blitted with a cosmic→howl palette + additive glow. **Never-black fallback chain:** the canvas context is bound LAST so a WGSL init failure leaves it clean, then `gl.ts` (WebGL2 fragment computing the same field) → `canvas2d.ts` (72×40 coarse grid) take over; ## `/dream/1412-time-smear` — *perform in front of your webcam and **play TIME itself**: instead of the live frame, only a thin vertical slice of each camera frame is kept and scrolled across the screen, so the horizontal axis becomes time — a person moving is stretched into eerie liquid time-ribbons that **sing**. A true **live-camera slit-scan / chronophotography** instrument (the fresh camera interaction the lab had never built — dozens of mirror/hand/dance pieces exist, none is a time-smear), reviving the camera/embodied lane the 2026-07-10 jury flagged as collapsed to 1×.* **How it works:** hit **Start camera** (or **No camera — use pointer**) — the AudioContext gesture-gates and the RAF loop begins the same click. Each tick a WebGL2 **ring-buffer** stamps only the camera's centre column into a 1px viewport at the advancing head; the display shader unwraps the ring (`fract(head−1+uv)`) so the newest slice sits at the leading edge and older slices scroll away — one axis is literally time. Orientation toggles horizontal↔vertical (wipes history on switch); scroll-speed is a live slider. **Sonification** (make it sing): a separate `readPixels` pass reads the newest vertical slit, divides it into luminance bands, and each band drives a voice in a **16-voice inharmonic/spectral bank** (deliberately NOT a pentatonic scale-index — the over-used lab crutch the jury bans), with frame-to-frame motion energy driving overall brightness/filter — so your movements paint an evolving drone-timbre. Master ramps from silence to 0.18 (≤0.20) behind a `DynamicsCompressor` limiter; `synthMix` starts at 0.6 so it's audible from frame one. **Never blank/silent:** dark-violet floor + pre-start radial gradient; camera denied/failed → clear `text-rose-300` message and it continues on a synthetic drifting blob through the identical pipeline; camera-idle (no motion ~3 s) fades that blob in; pointer mode injects a bright blob at the pointer; WebGL2 absent → notice. Full teardown stops all oscillators, `close()`s the context, cancels the RAF, and **stops every MediaStream track**. **SAFETY:** no strobe — slow luminance drift only; `prefers-reduced-motion` honored. **Ambition 3/5:** #5 revives the camera lane (jury-named, 1×) with a fresh interaction model (slit-scan grep-0×) · #1 lands on a thin surface (WebGL2, off Canvas2D+SVG) · ≥3 subsystems (getUserMedia capture + WebGL2 slit-scan ring-buffer + `readPixels` motion/luminance analysis + 16-voice inharmonic spectral sonifier + pointer/synthetic fallback) · named refs **Golan Levin** (slit-scan works / *The Manual Input Sessions*) & **Zbigniew Rybczyński** (*Fourth Dimension*). **diversity:** `banned=[Canvas2D-primary · SVG-primary · JI/pentatonic-always-consonant · Reich-phasing-as-TIME · mic-sole · home-row-keyboard-as-SOLE] · picked=[live-camera-slit-scan TECHNIQUE(0×) · CAMERA INPUT (revives 1× lane) · WebGL2 time-ribbon OUTPUT · time-as-the-axis · uncanny/hypnagogic VIBE · PLAYED]` — clears every 2026-07-10 ban. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure client; zero new npm deps). Winner of a visionary **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (cashed jury #5 head-on + love-backed camera cluster); honest knock (own README): the audible slit is always the centre *vertical* column even in vertical-scan mode, so vertical scan is visually but not sonically distinct; the illusion wants Karel's camera+speakers. `state: chronophotographic-time-smear · pole: hypnagogic / uncanny`. `status: demoable`. ## `/dream/1408-wolf-ring` — *walk the circle of fifths inside a **real circulating historical temperament** and play the **wolf**. In ¼-comma meantone or Pythagorean, most fifths & thirds are **purer and sweeter than the equal-tempered piano** — but that purity is bought: all the leftover comma-error has to be banked somewhere, and these old tunings dump it almost entirely into ONE fifth (G♯→E♭), which then **HOWLS**. Here that fifth is a place on a 3-D ring you walk into on purpose. The wrong note is the point — the direct cash of jury #2 ("break the always-consonant spell"), and the antidote to the lab's ~10/15 JI-pentatonic monoculture where a note can never sound wrong.* **The wolf is not hand-placed:** `temperament.ts` builds each temperament's 12 notes genuinely by walking the chain of generating fifths outward from C, then reduces to one octave, so the wolf **emerges** as the gap where the broken chain wraps (`isWolf` = actual detuning `|cents-from-pure| > 20`) — it appears in meantone (737.6¢, +35.7¢, ~14 Hz beat) / Pythagorean and **vanishes in 12-TET**; each edge exposes its fifth size, deviation from a pure 3:2, and acoustic beat rate. **You play it:** hit **Begin**, **tap a tile** to walk fifth-by-fifth (you hear the held fifth between where you were and where you land), **drag** to rotate the ring in 3-D, **← →** as a secondary walk; flip the **temperament toggle** (12-TET · ¼-comma meantone · Pythagorean) to hear the *same* fifth retune — the meantone thirds sweeten and the wolf materializes on the spot; walk onto the **wolf** edge and it flares rose, the tiles **shear/recoil**, and the drone beats violently. **Output = a genuine DOM/CSS-3D instrument** (deliberate — 12 real `<button>` tiles in `transform-style: preserve-3d`, `rotateY(i·30°) translateZ(radius)` under perspective; **no canvas, no WebGL, no three.js** → deterministic + headless-verifiable, on the jury-named thin surface only `1362` had touched). **Audio** (Web Audio, output-only): three persistent voices (root, major third, fifth) with partials to the 3rd harmonic so the root's 3rd partial and the fifth's 2nd partial **beat** on a tempered fifth — the howl is *real acoustic roughness from real detuning*, not an effect; steps glide the oscillators + pulse a swell (gestural TIME, no drum grid, no phasing), routed through shared `createVoidReverb` → master ≤0.20 → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter, full teardown. **Never blank / never silent:** a soft held fifth + the visible ring from Begin, and after ~5 s idle it **walks itself around the ring, crossing the wolf every lap** so a cold 06:30 glance sees the payoff. Readout shows the fifth's cents, distance from pure 3:2, and beat rate in Hz — the howl made legible. **SAFETY:** all motion (wolf recoil, halo pulse) held ~1.1 Hz, well under the 3 Hz ceiling; `prefers-reduced-motion` keeps colour changes but stills the motion; no strobe. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure client; zero new npm deps). **Ambition 3/5:** #1 walkable circulating-temperament-with-a-played-wolf as an instrument (grep-0×; the wolf emerges from the broken chain, distinct from `404`-drift / `538`-exotic-scales / `947`-passive-visualizer) · #2 ≥3 subsystems (genuine per-temperament tuning engine + detunable additive triad + DOM/CSS-3D ring renderer + walk/tap/drag input + shared drone/reverb) · #3 named refs Pietro Aron ¼-comma meantone (1523) / Andreas Werckmeister *Musicalische Temperatur* (1691) / Vallotti; living: **Adam Neely** (tuning/temperament videos). **diversity:** `banned=[Canvas2D-primary · SVG-primary · JI/pentatonic-always-consonant · Reich-phasing-as-TIME · mic-sole · home-row-keyboard-as-SOLE] · picked=[circulating-temperament-with-played-wolf TECHNIQUE(0×) · walk/tap/drag INPUT · DOM/CSS-3D ring OUTPUT · gestural-agogic TIME · out-of-tune/uncanny VIBE · PLAYED]` — clears every 2026-07-10 ban. Winner of a visionary **DEEP** 3-approach fire (cashed jury #2 head-on); honest knock (own README): the third above the wolf root uses each temperament's nominal third size rather than re-deriving the enharmonic note through the broken chain — the *fifth* (the wolf) is fully genuine, the third kept quieter so the fifth stays the star; headless box can't judge the audible drama. `state: out-of-tune / the-uncanny-of-mistuning · pole: cosmic-ambient (near-pure) ↔ intense (the wolf)`. `status: demoable`. ## `/dream/1398-ear-of-static` — *auditory pareidolia made an instrument: sweep a listening focus across a bed of pure filtered noise and dwell, and a hidden melody **resolves itself out of the hiss** — seven tuned resonances are genuinely running inside the static from the first sound (gated to silence), so when you park your ear over one and it rings out the experience is "I **found** what was already there," not "I triggered a note." The REBUS / "perception is controlled hallucination" (Anil Seth) phenomenology: the brain's generative model, running loose over noise, finds structure.* **You play it** by hunting: pointer-drag sweeps the focus, `A S D F G H J K L ;` jump to preset frequency bands, arrows nudge, `space` locks; a **dwell** (~0.35 s, `DWELL_MOVE_TOL=0.007`) over a resonance snaps its fragment into a held consonant weave (generous `ALIGN_TOLERANCE=0.06` wide-gaussian so seeking is reliably rewarded — the deliberate over-fitting that IS apophenia). Each resonance has a bandpass **ring reading the same noise** (the "it was always there" tone) PLUS an always-running gain-gated **melody oscillator** on a look-ahead scheduler (timing only, NOT a step grid); as it resolves a soft **notch thins the hiss at that pitch** so the melody emerges from a gap in the static (the "revelation, not added layer" trick). Output = **WebGL2 spectral "ear" ribbon** (dim animated hiss sharpening/brightening under the focus, bright pitched ridges where a resonance locks; <0.5 Hz luminance drift — no strobe). Shared low `startDroneBank` bed through `createVoidReverb`. **Never blank/silent:** the hiss field + drone sound from Begin, the canvas animates from mount, and after 5 s idle a self-demo glides to a resonance every ~5.5 s so a cold visitor immediately hears the effect (yields on first input); WebGL2-absent → amber notice + SVG focus-meter fallback that still runs the audio. ## `/dream/1396-apophenia-field` — *the visionary act of finding meaning in noise, made an instrument: a dark field of ~190 slowly-drifting noise-points holds **no pre-authored pattern**, but wherever your ATTENTION dwells near a cluster whose geometry passes a **generous latent-pattern test** (a near-collinear chain, or local mirror-symmetry, over the 12 nearest points) those points snap bright, LINK into a constellation "sign," and ring a **5-limit-JI chord** derived from the geometry (spacing→interval, count→voicing thickness, height→register). ## `/dream/1384-gravity-choir-points` — *a swarm that doesn't **react** to music — it **makes** it. Place gravitational **stars** (attractors) in a boundless indigo star-void; **24,000** GPU point-cloud motes fall into orbit around them, and their **orbital motion IS the sound** (cross-modal geometry→sound, the arrow run backwards from every audio-reactive particle piece). **How:** a `THREE.Points` cloud (custom additive `ShaderMaterial`, violet→cyan by speed) integrated on the **CPU each frame** under softened inverse-square gravity + a faint bounding spring + drag + a hard velocity clamp (three independent anti-blow-up safeties, so the field is eternal, never explodes, swallowed motes respawn far out). **The sonification:** each star is tuned to a pitch and holds one sustained **additive voice** (fundamental + octave + twelfth); every frame the sim measures, per star, three geometric facts — **density** of motes inside its periapsis **resonance shell** → blooms the tone's amplitude, **mean speed** → opens a gentle lowpass + a whisper of detune, **inward crossings** → fire soft enveloped-sine **grains**. The rhythm is **emergent** — written by orbital periods, no sequencer, no drum grid. **You play it:** two stars sing on Start; **click the void** to place a star (up to 6) or **click an existing** one to select it; **number keys 1–7** (or the on-screen row) tune the selected star across an A-minor-pentatonic set (A2·C3·D3·E3·G3·A3·C4, always consonant); Remove star · Mute · Stop (ramps to silence ~60 ms + freezes the swarm). **Never blank:** a deep star-void gradient is always painted behind; WebGL-absent → a readable `text-rose-300` notice; context-loss handled; full three.js disposal on unmount; slow (<3 Hz) boundless camera drift, no strobe. Honest limits: GPU/point-cloud particle fields + CPU n-body have deep lab prior art — the fresh axis is narrow but real, a gravitational swarm that plays **itself** from its own orbital geometry rather than reacting to a track; the CPU integrator caps count at 24k (a WebGPU build — banked `1382` — could push 100k+), and with many stars the drones can crowd toward a wash; headless box can't judge the feel. Refs (living): *Party* (2026, WebGPU particle-physics playground) · Robert Borghesi, *ASTRODITHER* (2026). `state: cosmic gravity-swarm / boundless star-void · pole: cosmic-ambient`. `status: demoable`*

## `/dream/1380-overtone-throat` — *sing ONE sustained note and **play its hidden overtone ladder** like a Tuvan throat singer. The mic feeds an **autocorrelation f0 detector** (or lock the fundamental by hand, A1–A3) and an **f0-relative FFT** that reads the energy at each **harmonic 1–12** of your note; a fast-attack/slow-release follower drives a **12-partial self-sustaining sine drone bank**, so leaning your vowel/timbre makes those overtones **bloom and hold** into a shimmering chord and walks a bright cursor up the ladder — the overtone series made playable. **Output = a living GLYPH-TERMINAL** (deliberate **cycle-2 of `1270-glyph-organ`**): 12 monospace rows (harmonic 12 → fundamental), each labelled with its ratio + nearest interval, each an R→L oscilloscope trace through a `` ·:+*#█`` density ramp with a violet→cyan hue and an emerald ► dominant-cursor row — an oscilloscope-meets-poem, updated DOM-direct (no 60 fps React re-render). **Feedback-safe:** the raw mic is an analyser sink ONLY, never routed to output (nothing recorded or sent). **Never blank / never silent:** an idle sweep animates the ladder from load, and if the mic is denied/silent a **Gaussian auto-sweep** walks the ladder so the drone bank keeps singing — badged `● mic` (emerald) vs `○ auto` (amber). Master ≤0.2 behind a limiter, ramp-from-0 + ~1.5 s fade + `AudioContext.close()` teardown; `prefers-reduced-motion` calms the animation. Honest limits: monophonic autocorrelation f0 wanders on breathy/quiet/noisy input (hence on-demand detect + a manual note-lock, not continuous tracking); overtone-from-voice has lab-prior cousins (`1114-tanpura-throat`, `200-harmonic-series`) — the fresh axis is the glyph-terminal ladder surface + the throat-singing framing; headless box can't judge the feel. Refs (living): Tanya Tagaq (throat singer) · Wolfgang Saus (overtone-singing pedagogy). `state: overtone-trance / harmonic-ladder · pole: cosmic-ambient`. `status: demoable`*

## `/dream/1374-sky-strata` — *the **live sky over Earth composes this piece right now** — three real NOAA SWPC space-weather feeds (solar-wind **speed** & **density**, interplanetary-field **Bz**, planetary **Kp**) set the music's key, tempo, palette and mode, and you play the second voice over it. The lab's **first real external-world-data sonification.** **The data is the composer:** one pure `skyToDrivers(sky)` mapping is consumed **identically** by audio and visuals — **speed → arp tempo + band drift speed**, **density → number & thickness of light-strata**, **southward Bz → minor mode + higher, more-saturated aurora bands**, **Kp → overall energy + palette** (calm teal → storm violet/red). **You play it:** tap a strata band or press `A S D F G H J` to pluck a brighter foreground voice a whole octave above the sky's generative pentatonic arp (always consonant — pentatonic scale-indices), each pluck **flaring** its band for ~1 s; drag left↔right to shift the played register (emphasis). **Output = deterministic inline `<svg>`** (no Canvas, no WebGL, no GPU — chosen so the render is *eye-verifiable*): drifting translucent horizontal light-strata (CSS-animated gradient offsets), a seeded twinkling starfield, a horizon glow, and a legible **solar-wind speed "score ribbon"** tracing recent history across the top — you can *read* the sky's recent state like a staff. **Audio** (Web Audio, output-only, nothing recorded): shared `startDroneBank` cosmic pad (its drive follows the mapping `energy`) under a self-scheduling generative arp through the shared `createVoidReverb` void, master ≤0.22 behind a `DynamicsCompressor` limiter with a ~2 s exponential fade-in, gesture-gated behind **Begin**. **Never blank / never silent:** the strata drift on load before Begin, and after ~4 s idle the generative arp plays to itself, so a cold 06:30 glance always shows a living sky. **Degrades gracefully:** if the NOAA feeds are unreachable it falls to a slowly-drifting **synthetic sky** clearly badged `simulated` (amber) vs `LIVE — NOAA SWPC` (emerald), so it's honest about whether real data loaded. Server-safe (`"use client"`, all `AudioContext`/listeners behind effects + the Begin gate); **no strobe** — band motion is slow CSS drift (well under 3 Hz), `prefers-reduced-motion` stretches drift to ~140 s and stills the twinkle; full teardown on unmount (rAF cancel, 60 s data interval cleared, `AudioContext.close()`). Honest limits: mapping has distant lab-prior (the fresh axis is *real external live data as the composer*, 0×); a headless box can't confirm the live fetch actually returns from a browser on Vercel (falls to synthetic here) or judge audio balance. Refs (living): Ryoji Ikeda, *datamatics*. Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center. `state: cosmic-sky / boundless-strata · pole: cosmic-ambient`. `status: demoable`*

## `/dream/1366-answer-piano` — *play a short phrase and a patient partner **answers you in the same key** — a call-and-response duet, not a recording you sculpt. You play (sing/play into the **mic** → real-time autocorrelation pitch detection snapped to **D-major pentatonic**, OR tap the on-screen keys / `A S D F G H J K L ;` QWERTY row — always-works, phone-friendly); the system **segments your phrase** on ~0.9 s of silence, then a distinct **partner voice** replies in-key. The responder reads your phrase's contour and applies one of four in-key transforms — a rising *question* → an **inverted line that resolves to the tonic**; a falling line → an **ascending sequence** left open on the dominant; a flat phrase → a **gentle echo up a third** resolving home; a single note → rise-and-resolve — and because everything is expressed as **pentatonic scale-indices**, an answer can never sound wrong. It reads as a **duet, not an echo** (the mic is deliberately ignored while the partner speaks — real turn-taking). **Output = deterministic `<svg>`** (no Canvas, no WebGL): each note is a node placed by pitch (y) over conversation-time (x); two smooth **voice ribbons** braid along a faint conversation thread — **amber = you, violet = partner** — so the alternation is *seen* as well as heard. **Audio** (Web Audio, output-only re-synthesis — the mic is a controller, **nothing is recorded or sent**): you = a soft triangle with gentle attack; partner = a warmer FM pad (sine carrier + fifth modulator, low-passed); a quiet JI **drone bed** in D (`_shared/visionary/droneBank`) through a code-generated **convolution reverb** (`_shared/visionary/convolutionVoid`); master ≤0.2 with exponential fade-in into a `DynamicsCompressor` limiter. **Never blank / never silent:** after ~4 s of no interaction an **idle auto-demo** plays a seed phrase to itself and answers it, looping until you take a turn. **Degrades gracefully:** no mic permission → a `text-rose-300` notice + the keyboard path still fully works. Server-safe (`"use client"`, all `AudioContext`/mic/key listeners behind effects + the Begin gate); **no strobe** — the only luminance motion is a ≤~0.4 Hz node halo, disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`; full teardown on unmount (rAF cancel, timers cleared, mic tracks stopped, `AudioContext.close()`). Honest limits: monophonic pitch detection (one note at a time; noisy rooms miss); coarse rhythm capture (fixed cadence, not true transcription); rule-based (four contour transforms), a consistent partner not an unpredictable one; headphones recommended (speaker bleed can phantom-trigger between turns). Refs (living): Dan Tepfer *Natural Machines* · Roger Dannenberg / score-following. `state: musical-mirror / call-and-response duet · pole: cosmic-meditative`. `status: demoable`*

## `/dream/1362-lattice-loom` — *weave **polymetric light** through a crystalline lattice of **real DOM cells floating in CSS-3D space** — no `<canvas>`, no WebGL, no three.js; the whole instrument is `<button>` cells in a `transform-style: preserve-3d` scene, three stacked fanned planes rotating slowly as one volume. Each plane is a **metric layer** of coprime length — **3** (keys `1 2 3`, ×1 octave), **5** (`q w e r t`, ×2), **7** (`a s d f g h j`, ×4) — and a cell's **column is its pitch** on a shared **just-intonation** scale (1·9/8·5/4·4/3·3/2·5/3·15/8 above 110 Hz), so every cell is a rational ratio of one root and the whole lattice stays **consonant no matter what you weave**. **You play it** by keyboard (the three physical key-rows map to the three layers, key position = column) or by **tapping** the ≥52 px cells (phone-friendly; pointer is a secondary nicety, keyboard/tap primary). **The TIME mechanic (the point):** three **phase-cursors** sweep their layers at their own periods (0.40 / 0.50 / 0.60 s per step); as a cursor crosses a seeded cell it **flares** it and **sounds** that column's tone. Because the lengths **3·5·7 are coprime** (LCM = 105 steps) and each cursor runs its own pulse, the lit cells continuously **de-phase** — the sweeps slide out of step, cross, and only slowly drift back toward alignment: **Steve Reich's phase music spread across SPACE instead of carried by a 4/4 beat** (the direct, *visible* answer to the jury's "find TIME off the drum grid"). This is an explicit **cycle-2 of the lab's celebrated-but-zero-follow-up `1272-lattice-tracker`** (which the concept jury named), keeping "the DOM grid IS the instrument, tuned to a JI lattice" but answering a new question — not a playhead down a sequencer, but three independent phase-cursors weaving polymeter through a rotating volume — and landing on the **DOM/CSS-3D substrate the lab is 0× on in-window** (the render-surface demand missed across four straight juries, and the one substrate a headless box can actually verify renders). **Audio** (Web Audio, output-only, no mic): the shared `startDroneBank` JI drone bed (its `setDrive` follows recent strike density) + a per-cell **bell voice pool** (triangle + detuned sine through a lowpass, fast attack / ~1.4 s exp decay), master ≤0.22 behind a `DynamicsCompressor` limiter with an exponential fade-in, gesture-gated behind **Begin**. **Never blank / never silent:** a default woven pattern animates silently on load (preview clock) before Begin, and a deterministic **idle auto-demo** drifts the weave if you walk away, so a cold 06:30 glance always shows light moving. **Reweave** throws a fresh deterministic pattern; **Clear** empties the loom. Server-safe (`"use client"`, all `AudioContext`/key listeners behind effects + the Begin gate); **no strobe** — cell lighting is smooth continuous fades (fastest any cell flashes is ~0.8 Hz, far under 3 Hz), global "breathing" routes through the shared `SafeFlicker` (~0.09 Hz), `prefers-reduced-motion` slows the sweeps + rotation + idle drift; full teardown on unmount (rAF cancel, keydown listener removed, drone stopped, `AudioContext.close()`). Deliberately **sparse** (15 seedable cells) — legibility of the de-phasing over density/spectacle. Refs (living): Ryoji Ikeda *datamatics*; lineage `1272-lattice-tracker`. `state: synaesthetic-cells / spatial-phase lattice · pole: cosmic-ambient`. `status: demoable`*

## `/dream/1354-glyph-canon` — *play a visionary instrument that lives **entirely inside a monospace TEXT field** — its sense of TIME comes not from a beat but from a **Steve-Reich phase canon**. A full-screen grid of Unicode characters is rendered to a `<canvas>` with `fillText` on a fixed cell grid — the **characters are the art**, not pixel blobs (the glyph-terminal surface, a cycle-2 of `1270-glyph-organ`, deliberately NOT a Canvas2D pixel-field). A slow **log-polar spiral** of glyphs scrolls inward as a hypnagogic ambient field so the screen is never blank. **You play it:** three QWERTY rows (`z x c v b n m` / `a s d f g h j k l` / `q w e r t y u i`) are three octaves of a **just-intonation** scale (A2≈110 Hz, ratios 1·9/8·5/4·4/3·3/2·5/3·15/8), mirrored by **on-screen tappable key rows** (phone-playable, no hardware); each keypress fires a soft **FM voice** AND injects a bright expanding **glyph-ring** that ages down a luminance ramp `·.:-=+*#%@` (bright→dim). **The TIME mechanic (the point):** every note is captured into a short looping phrase, and **two players** replay it — **Player A** (violet stream, "you") at the base step interval, **Player B** (teal stream, the twin) at **base × 1.012**, a hair slower — so they start in unison and slowly **de-phase**, exactly like Reich's *Piano Phase*. There is **no BPM step-sequencer**: each player is scheduled directly against `audioContext.currentTime` with a ~120 ms look-ahead, so rhythmic TIME emerges purely from the drift between the two voices — and you **see** it (two stereo-split, differently-tinted ring-families separating and, over minutes, re-aligning) as well as **hear** it. **Idle auto-demo:** a gentle consonant motif re-seeds after ~4 s of silence so the canon always plays itself. **Audio** (`glyph-engine.ts`, Web Audio, output-only, no mic): FM voices (sine carrier + decaying-index modulator), soft attack / medium release, pitch- and stream-panned, voice cap 12 oldest-steal; a root+fifth+sub **drone bed** with a ~0.07 Hz amplitude drift + a light feedback-delay space; master ramps from 0, caps 0.22, into a `DynamicsCompressor` limiter; self-contained (no shared audio helpers = lower risk). In the lineage of **Steve Reich** (*Piano Phase*), **Ryoji Ikeda** (*datamatics* — clinical phosphor-on-near-black data field), and the **teletype/ASCII-art** tradition. **Degrades gracefully:** no Web Audio → a `text-rose-300` notice + the glyph field keeps animating (idle demo drives visual-only pulses). Server-safe (`"use client"`, all `AudioContext`/key listeners behind effects + the Begin gate); **no strobe** — glyph pulses are *local per-cell* brightenings that fade smoothly, global luminance stays near-constant (spiral drifts ≪3 Hz), `prefersReducedMotion()` slows the field; instant **Stop** ramps master to 0 in ≤80 ms, clears pulses, closes the context; full teardown on unmount (rAF cancel, listeners removed, `AudioContext.close()`). Refs (living): Steve Reich · Ryoji Ikeda. `state: hypnagogic / synaesthetic-text · pole: cosmic-ambient`. `status: demoable`*

## `/dream/1332-liquid-light` — *tilt your phone to **pour a 1960s visionary liquid light show** — molten pools of colored oil that a projectionist once pushed across a hot plate by heat and gravity, here flowing and blooming as you **lean the plate**. You don't strike a note and wait; you **tilt** and the oil runs the way you tilt it, gathering, blooming, and separating. **Input = device tilt** (`DeviceOrientationEvent`; iOS `requestPermission()` fired inside the Begin tap): tilt **direction** (`gamma`/`beta`) sets the gravity vector the dye advects along + the audio stereo pan; tilt **magnitude** sets the "heat" — bigger/hotter blooms, a longer smear, the drone's lowpass opening 300→2100 Hz and the chord bending up ~22 cents. **Output = Canvas2D** (deliberately no WebGL — dependency-light + ship-safe): a coarse **dye-advection** on a small offscreen ping-pong buffer (`fluid.ts`) — each frame the previous buffer is redrawn translated slightly along the pour vector and multiplied by a decay < 1 (so pools *smear* downhill and churn), then a handful of magenta/cyan/amber/violet/green emitters drift with the flow and stamp translucent radial gradients under `globalCompositeOperation = 'lighter'` (additive glow → pools bloom, merge, separate; a complementary outer stop gives the thin-film iridescent rim). **Real TIME in the audio** (`audio.ts`): a warm swirling just-chord drone (root A1, stacked pure ratios, detuned pairs for chorus) over a felt **~0.3 Hz LFO throb** — a breathing bed that lives in time, NOT a struck bell. Server-safe (`"use client"`, all `window`/`AudioContext`/canvas/`DeviceOrientationEvent` behind effects + the Begin gate, iOS `requestPermission` feature-detected); **no strobe** — the bloom is smooth continuous luminance drift, peak brightness capped three ways (per-frame multiplicative decay bounds additive glow + a vignette darkens corners against a full-white blowout + the only global luminance oscillation is a shallow ≤0.3 Hz "breath"), `prefers-reduced-motion` slows churn/throb + softens contrast; master ≤0.26 → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter, 3 s fade-in, full teardown on unmount. ## `/dream/1316-moire-drift` — *tune a visionary trance by hand: two (really three) fine op-art gratings are summed in a WebGL2 fragment shader in **cortical (log r, θ) space**; where two near-equal spatial frequencies add they **beat** out a slow low-frequency envelope — and that envelope IS a Klüver form constant (concentric rings→**tunnels/funnels**, radial rays→**spokes/cobwebs**, cortical diagonals→**spirals**, a hex term waking near the peak→**honeycomb**). **The core surprise — one number, seen and heard:** the **detune** you set with vertical drag fixes a single `beatHz` that (1) advances the movable grating's temporal phase so the whole **visual moiré envelope drifts at that rate**, and (2) sets the frequency gap of a **detuned oscillator pair** (138 Hz + beat) so the **audio amplitude-beats at the same rate** — tune the moiré tighter and you watch the fringes settle AND hear the acoustic beats slow toward alignment; a live HUD prints the Hz. **Drag anywhere:** horizontal (←→) = **rotation offset Δθ** between layers (blooms spokes/spirals), vertical (↕) = **spatial-frequency detune Δk** (top=aligned/slow, bottom=detuned/fast), **drag speed / hold** = entropy energy pushing the arc forward (more grating octaves, faster drift, looser symmetry — REBUS "priors relax"); release and it drifts on its own. **Entropy arc** (~3 min, onset→come-up→peak→settle) grows octaves/drift/symmetry-looseness and shifts the palette from stark near-black + bone-white with an electric-cyan accent toward **saturated neon/iridescent** at the peak — genuinely different at minute 3 than 0:20. **Audio has TIME:** the detuned-beat pair (+ a quiet octave pair for body) is the star, a soft **low pulse/transport** at 0.7–2 Hz tightens toward the peak (rhythm, not a flat pad), and a faint downward **Shepard** undertow (`_shared/visionary/shepard`) sits underneath; master ≤0.28 + 1.2 s exp fade-in + `DynamicsCompressor` limiter, fixed small voice count. ## `/dream/1314-motif-weave` — *a dream that REMEMBERS you — the memory made musical. A single-performer echo of **teamLab's *The World of Irreversible Change*** (2026): every phrase you play is permanently absorbed into the material the piece is made of. **Drag** anywhere (vertical position = pitch) to perform a phrase — you hear each note instantly; on release, if it's ≥2 notes it's captured as a **motif** `{pitch, onset-in-beats, duration, velocity}` and pushed into a library that is **never cleared** during a run. A rAF-driven **beat clock** walks a generative score and on each beat may **recall an earlier motif, transformed** — `gentle` (diatonic pentatonic transpose), `harmonize` (a parallel third above), `canon` (a staggered transposed answer one beat later), `reverse` (contour backwards), or `stretch` (time-stretched long, as the dream dissolves). Recall is weighted toward rarely-recalled motifs so the whole library keeps circulating, and in the *deepens* / *lucid-bloom* phases it sometimes **forces the OLDEST phrase you played** to return; the library cap (72) sheds auto-seeds first so it **never drops your first performance** — so the phrase from minute one audibly comes back, changed, minutes later (the min-1→min-6 promise). Each stored motif is also a **persistent luminous thread** in a Canvas2D woven light-field (dusk-violet → indigo → dawn-gold), blooming while it sounds — the visual is the record too. **Long-form arc** (genuinely different at minute 5 than minute 1 because the library has grown, NOT a loop): *drifting-off* 52 bpm (sparse, sows idle seed phrases) → *the dream deepens* 63 bpm (recall rises, harmonies appear) → *lucid bloom* 82 bpm (dense canon/reverse/harmony, brightest — the intense pole) → *dissolution* 57 bpm (time-stretched, thinning) → *waking* 50 bpm (settles; the grown weave persists). **Audio has TIME:** a soft sub root on alternate beats + off-beat pulses in busier phases (tempo + rhythmic movement that changes across the arc), each note a triangle + detuned sine through a per-note lowpass that opens with phase brightness, a **feedback delay** carrying the tails of recalls/canons (memory literally echoing), and a faint shared **Shepard** undertow (`_shared/visionary/shepard`) whose drive rises with brightness + breath. **Mic breath** (optional) brightens the dream, lifts the undertow, and summons more remembered threads — the raw mic is an AnalyserNode **sink only** (never routed to destination → no feedback howl). ## `/dream/1308-piano-freeze` — *reach into Karel's recorded piano with your bare **hand** and FREEZE a moment into an infinite shimmer. His real *Welcome Home* solo piano (fetched from `/api/audio/549fc519…`, with an OfflineAudioContext synthesized solo-piano fallback so it's alive headless) is fed to a **granular resynthesis engine** whose READ position (where grains are sampled from) moves **independently of grain playback** — so scrub and freeze fall straight out. A webcam **MediaPipe HandLandmarker** (client-side, GPU→CPU, loaded at runtime from the `@mediapipe/tasks-vision@0.10.14` CDN via a `/* webpackIgnore: true */` dynamic import so no npm dep is added): **hand-X scrubs the pitch-independent playhead** through the whole recording; **raise the hand UP → FREEZE** — the read-position chase scales by `(1 − freeze)`, so at full freeze the overlapping ~135 ms Hann grains (~60% overlap, ~20 ms lookahead, 48-grain cap) re-read a single slice forever = a **Paulstretch-style infinite shimmering drone**; tiny per-grain read-jitter + detune keep it glistening not buzzing, and a **parallel DRY grain path** fades in with freeze so the frozen moment stays legible while it holds (the Sampleson *Aeronaut* 2026 freeze-against-a-parallel-looper idea, done granularly so it never clicks). **Pinch ↔ spread** (thumb-tip to index-tip) drives a low-shelf / high-shelf **spectral tilt** (spread=brighter, pinch=darker). **Viz (Canvas2D):** a scrolling violet/indigo **spectral curtain** (AnalyserNode FFT) that **crystallizes** on freeze — the scroll halts, a slow (<3 Hz) cyan-white core bloom breathes as a pure luminance drift (never a strobe), an amber **playhead timeline** shows scrub position, and a small mirrored webcam thumbnail with amber landmark dots proves the tracking works. Deliberately breaks the lab's recent monoculture: a **real recording** as source (NOT a synth JI-drone/void-reverb/strike-chord bell), driven by the **camera-hand embodied lane** (the specifically-jury-named 0×-until-recently sensor), a freeze-drone *texture* distinct from the recent groove/cross-synth window. **Degrades gracefully:** no camera / getUserMedia denied / CDN fails → a **mouse driver** (X scrubs, near-top = freeze, wheel = tilt) + a gentle **auto-drift** so a cold 06:30 glance is never dead or silent; audio fetch fails → the synth carrier. Server-safe (`"use client"`, all behind the Start gate); `prefers-reduced-motion` gentles the shimmer; full teardown on unmount (rAF cancel, engine stop, `HandLandmarker.close()`, camera tracks stopped, ctx close, listeners removed); instant **Stop** ramps master to 0 in ~60 ms then closes the context. A single-performer echo of **Robert Henke / Monolake**'s granular time-stretching, **Paulstretch** (Nasca Octavian Paul), and **Sampleson *Aeronaut*** (2026). ## `/dream/1310-piano-duet` — *sing **into** Karel's recorded piano — a duet with a recording. His real *Welcome Home* solo piano (fetched from `/api/audio/549fc519…`, with a synthesized looping solo-piano fallback so it's alive headless) **loops continuously as the harmonic carrier**; your **live microphone is the sculptor, not a gain meter.** The mic is FFT-analysed into a smoothed **20-band spectral envelope** (~130 Hz–6 kHz, log-spaced, normalized to a *shape* so a vowel's formant peaks stand out regardless of volume). A **channel-vocoder cross-synthesis**: a bank of **20 parallel bandpass BiquadFilters** splits his piano across those same 20 bands, and each band's gain is driven every frame by the matching band of your voice — so humming "ahh" vs "ooo" audibly **morphs his chord toward that vowel** (`bandGain_i ← mix × loudness × voiceEnv_i`, steered by `setTargetAtTime` ~50 ms so it's click-free, no zipper noise). A **dry path** keeps his piano clearly audible so it stays a **duet, not a gate**; an on-screen **intensity slider** (also mapped to mic loudness — sing louder, sculpt harder) rides the wet/dry. **Feedback-safe:** the raw mic is an `AnalyserNode` **sink only** — never routed to `destination`, so there is no mic→speaker howl; only its *analysis* moves the filter gains. **Viz (Canvas):** three overlaid spectra on a shared log-frequency axis — **violet/indigo** his piano carrier, **amber/rose** your live voice envelope + the sculpt being applied, and a **bright ridge** for the resulting cross-synthesized output — plus a VU bar and a "singing detected" indicator, so the *your-voice-shapes-his-sound* story reads at a glance. Deliberately breaks the lab's recent monoculture: **mic-as-real-controller** (the jury-named 0× input, NOT passive gain), a **real recording** as carrier (NOT a synth JI-drone/void-reverb bell), PLAYED not watched. **Degrades gracefully:** no recording → synth carrier; **no mic** → a `text-rose-300` notice + the same filter bank driven by a synthetic voice envelope (slow auto-morph) **plus an XY pad** (drag to move the vowel formant across his spectrum) — the cross-synthesis still plays and Karel still hears his sound being sculpted; piano + auto-morph begin immediately on Start (never dead/silent). ## `/dream/1291-rijke-flame` — *play a **singing flame**. A **Rijke tube** is a real thermoacoustic instrument: a vertical open-ended pipe with a heat source inside; when the heat sits in the lower half — where **Rayleigh's criterion** is met (heat added where acoustic pressure is rising drives the standing wave) — the pipe spontaneously breaks into a loud fundamental, and moving the heat to the upper half silences it. Modeled as a genuine limit-cycle: a signed Rayleigh gain curve `sin(2πh)` (fundamental) + `sin(4πh)` (second mode) drives an onset-swell/decay integrator, so amplitude depends smoothly on heat position and the player finds the sweet spot (peak at h≈¼, a pure-octave pocket near h≈0.62) by ear and hand. **Played:** drag the glowing gauze up/down for timbre + onset, drag the tube's top cap for pitch (just-intonation length→pitch); a live HUD shows Hz / drive / zone; idle 3s and the flame drifts to the sweet spot and slowly sweeps length so it plays itself. Audio is pure Web Audio: fundamental + 2f/3f/4f harmonic stack + a breath-noise band (loud at onset, fades to pure) + sub/ember rumble through a drive-opening body lowpass. Visuals (Canvas2D): brushed-copper rails + open-end rings on charcoal, a pressure standing-wave glow whose lobes track the live amplitude, flame tongues flickering harder with drive, rising heat-shimmer — deliberately copper/ember, NOT cosmic-glow, NOT parchment. Server-renders cleanly (no top-level `window`/`AudioContext`), honours `prefers-reduced-motion`, all luminance modulation gated through `_shared/visionary/safeFlicker` at ≤3 Hz (no strobe). Refs: P.L. Rijke, "singing tube" (1859); Lord Rayleigh's criterion (1878). `status: demoable`*

### `/dream/1284-quantum-etch` — *quantum probability drawn as a living copper ETCHING. The 2D time-dependent Schrödinger equation (iħ∂ψ/∂t = −½∇²ψ + Vψ, ħ=m=1) is integrated by the split-step Fourier method (Feit–Fleck–Steiger 1982): half potential phase-kick → forward FFT → kinetic drift e^{−ik²dt/2} in Fourier space → inverse FFT → half kick — every factor a pure phase, so the scheme is UNITARY and conserves ∑|ψ|² (console self-check: ~0.005% drift over 300 steps, k=0 packet). PLAYED: Inject/Wall/Well tools — tap to fire a momentum-aimed Gaussian packet, drag to paint the potential; 4 presets (double-slit, Bunimovich stadium → Heller scars, well lattice, harmonic trap) + Clear. ## ⭐ Prior (Cycle 671 — **adult** **WIDE** — 3 orthogonal **fresh-VOICE** explorers, each a DIFFERENT non-JI synthesis engine, directly cashing the 2026-07-05 jury's two headline provocations (#1 kill the bright-daylight monoculture → chromatic range; #2 ban the JI-choir/drone voice → build on a fundamentally different synthesis). Ships `1203-gendy` — **hold a living waveform and tune it from a pure tone to a stochastic roar.** A hands-on realisation of **Iannis Xenakis's Dynamic Stochastic Synthesis (GENDYN)** — a synthesis voice this lab has NEVER built (Xenakis was only ever *referenced* re: cellular automata `622` / UPIC `704` / granular `1140`; true stochastic-waveform synthesis is grep-0×). The tone is not sampled or oscillated — it is **drawn**: one waveform cycle is 12 **breakpoints** (each a duration + amplitude), linearly interpolated; after every cycle each breakpoint's amp AND duration is nudged by a **Gaussian random walk** (a *second-order* stochastic process — the breakpoints walk, not the samples) and **reflects off elastic mirror barriers** so it stays bounded yet never settles. **A single drag = order↔chaos:** up/right → tight barriers + small steps → a nearly periodic pitched tone; down/left → loose barriers + big steps + pitch wobble → a gritty living roar. Three voices (×0.5/×1/×2). Rendered as a **WebGL2 oscilloscope of the actual current waveform** — a glowing ribbon filament redrawn each frame as its corners drift, over a ping-pong feedback afterimage field so you *see* the random walk, in **electric-violet (calm) → hot-amber (chaotic) chromatic chiaroscuro on deep-teal/near-charcoal** (neither the banned bright-daylight nor a flat near-black glow). **Won the WIDE race** over `1201-ignition` (Izhikevich spiking-neuron sheet you ignite with a touch → inharmonic **modal percussion**; ⭐ banked **RESURRECT-FIRST**, strongest 4/5 floor) and `1202-torsion` ((p,q) torus-knot you drag to re-tie → **Karplus–Strong waveguide**, strict two-colour ink-blue+vermilion Ikeda — **now with a TRUE projected-crossing detector**, the exact fix the §669-banked `1197-torsion` lacked, so it supersedes that bank) on being the single **freshest VOICE** — a whole synthesis category the lab has never had, the most direct answer to the jury's headline that *the ear is bored* (six of fifteen a JI choir). **Research→build:** §671 grep audit killed spectral-resynthesis / scanned-synthesis / waveshaping / WebRTC as non-fresh (all lab-prior), confirmed Izhikevich + GENDYN grep-0×, and **GendyJS** (github.com/abbernie/gendy) proved GENDYN is `AudioWorklet`-buildable today. Named refs: **Iannis Xenakis** *GENDY3* (1991) / *Formalized Music*; **Peter Hoffmann** (GENDYN analysis); **Nick Collins** / **Andrew Brown** (realtime stochastic synthesis); GendyJS. Banks `1201-ignition` (⭐) + `1202-torsion` as IDEAS §671.)

Ships `1193-tremor-core` — **press "Listen to the Earth" and the planet's real, live seismicity rings a cut-open, glowing Earth.** USGS's public **past-24h earthquake feed** (keyless GeoJSON, verified live this cycle — 230 quakes/24h) drives an inharmonic **modal bell-gong**: bigger quake = **lower, longer** bell (magnitude → a fundamental snapped to a just-intonation pentatonic grid so overlapping strikes stay consonant); **depth shapes the timbre** (deep = darker/muffled + more inharmonic detune, shallow = bright); and — the §668 research refinement — each strike opens with a short **stick-slip friction onset** (a bandpass-swept noise burst, from *"Echoes of the Land"* arXiv 2507.14947, which models quakes as stick-slip friction) so the gong feels *seismic*, not a clean mallet. The 24h are **time-compressed into a ~150 s chronological loop** (250 ms min inter-onset → a slow bell-choir, not a machine-gun). The visual is a **WebGL2 fragment-shader Earth CROSS-SECTION** — a bright cream/bronze cutaway of inner-core → outer-core → mantle → crust — where **each quake rings at its TRUE DEPTH** (radius from center = `surface·(1 − depth/700)`, azimuth from longitude), so the depth→timbre mapping is made *visible*: a bright additive flash + expanding concentric depth-rings, slow luminance decay (no strobe). **This is the ⭐ §667 top-resurrect `1191-tremor-gongs` shipped** — but deliberately rendered as depth-*structure*, NOT the bright-2D-world-map form it was banked on (which repeats `1173`/`1161`), cashing the still-open jury provocation #5 (real-world data, was 0×). **Won the DEEP race over `1194-tremor-strata`** (the same gong engine on a bright SVG depth-strata *column* — the legible/diagrammatic sibling) on being the more physically *transporting* rendering + WebGL2 being fresher in the last-10 window than SVG. ## Cycle 666 — **adult** **DEEP** — ONE concept, *Karel's real "Welcome Home" piano gives itself a **time of day**, painting a bright daylit sky that evolves dawn → midday → golden dusk across the whole piece*, raced via two renderers of the same day-clock engine. Live features bend the weather: **energy (RMS)** → cloud coverage + thickness + sun bloom (loud = thick dramatic sun-lit clouds; quiet = clear open sky), **centroid** → warm↔cool light + wispy-high vs heavy-low clouds, **flux (onsets)** → a soft light-shaft brightening near the sun (smoothed, never a strobe). ## Cycle 665 — **adult** **WIDE** — 3 orthogonal sensor/embodied explorers, each clearing the ambition floor via a DIFFERENT input the recent window has starved, all bright/high-key; directly cashing the 2026-07-04 jury's **#1 headline gap** — *"zero embodied prototypes in fifteen cycles; camera/body-tracking/MIDI/tilt all 0×, touch 8×"*. Ships `1185-face-organ` — **sing a shimmering choir with your face — no hands, no keys.** MediaPipe **FaceLandmarker** (CDN-loaded, GPU→CPU) reads your **52 facial blendshapes** live: open your mouth and the choir sings (jawOpen → loudness + vowel openness), shape your lips to move through the vowels /u/→/o/→/a/→/e/→/i/ (pucker↔smile morphs the formant targets), raise your brows to climb the pentatonic scale, tilt your head to pan + bend, blink for a soft accent. The sound is a **real 3-formant vocal synth** (a sawtooth glottal source + breath through parallel F1/F2/F3 bandpass filters swept between the **Peterson & Barney (1952)** vowel table) so it reads as sung "aah/ooo/eee", not a buzzer — a small detuned unison stack gives the choral shimmer, pitch is pentatonic-quantised so it's always consonant. No camera / MediaPipe fail → an on-screen **vowel-pad + pitch-slider** fallback plays the identical engine. Chosen over two strong siblings on **the jury gap + 06:30 phone-reviewability + surprise**: `1187-quietude` (⭐ banked — a conceptual **inversion** where SILENCE is the instrument: an adaptive-noise-floor gates a just-intonation drone-choir that blooms only when the room goes quiet — the freshest *vibe*, but it needs a silent room + headphones + patience, a harder morning sell) and `1186-tilt-field` (a Tonnetz tilt-navigated organ — banked lower because tilt just shipped at `1170-tilt-pool`). **Research→build:** §665 dive — MediaPipe FaceLandmarker's LIVE_STREAM 52-blendshape pipeline (Google AI Edge, current) as a real-time facial *instrument* is an under-explored use (docs cover avatars/filters, not music). Named refs: **Peterson & Barney (1952)** vowel formants; **Zach Lieberman** / **Daito Manabe** facial-performance work.)

## Cycle 664 — **adult** **DEEP** — ONE concept, *an audio-first generative minimalist ensemble that performs forever and is genuinely different at minute 6 than minute 1*, raced via two process-music philosophies (discrete cell-advancement vs. continuous-tempo phasing); ships the ⭐ TOP RESURRECT the last two cycles queued. Ships `1183-in-c-loom` — **a faithful Terry Riley *In C* that performs endlessly.** Twelve virtual players each move forward-only through **53 authored melodic cells** (C-major rise → a B♭-shaded mixolydian middle → a bright resolution back to a C octave), each repeating a cell a probabilistic number of times before advancing, all loosely held by a steady high-C eighth-note **pulse** and a warm low-C drone. A ≤3-cell **herding rule** keeps the ensemble from scattering, so the players phase apart and re-converge into ever-shifting interlocking patterns; when a player finishes cell 53 it wraps to a new pass, so it never stops. **This directly cashes the jury's #4 gap** — "the screen bias is near-total: one audio-first piece in fifteen" — with a genuinely *audio-first, long-form-stateful* piece (a spare 53-tick ring with 12 gliding dots is the only visual). It stays **bright** (warm parchment/ivory-amber, dark stone ink — honors the still-active near-black-glow ban) and needs zero setup: press Begin and it plays. Chosen over its DEEP sibling `1184-phase-mill` (a rigorous **Steve Reich** continuous-tempo *phasing* engine — the same idea via players looping one cell at a hair-different tempi that drift out of unison and slowly re-gather) on **06:30 phone-reviewability**: In C delivers the interlocking-ensemble payoff within ~15 seconds and is anchored by its recognizable pulse, where the phasing engine's signature drift→re-convergence unfolds subtly over minutes. **Research→build:** §664 dive — *Smol Sequencer* (Synthtopia, 2026-06-26) confirms browser generative-minimalism is a live 2026 lane; build consumes the banked §663 IDEAS entry. Named refs: **Terry Riley *In C*** (1964); **Steve Reich *Piano Phase*** (1967). Banks ⭐ `1184-phase-mill` (the continuous-phasing deepening — a "cell-advance ↔ tempo-drift" mode toggle, and the fix for 1181's grid-quantized honest gap).)

## Cycle 662 — **adult** **DEEP** — ONE concept (*hear the sun's live weather as a choir* — the ⭐ banked resurrect cycle 661 explicitly teed up) raced via 2 rendering philosophies (bright daylit readout vs. immersive dark magnetosphere field). Ships `1173-solar-wind-choir` — **hear the sun's weather hitting Earth right now.** Three live, keyless **NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center** feeds — solar-wind plasma (speed/density), interplanetary magnetic field (Bz/Bt), and the planetary K index — are fetched *client-side* every ~60s and sung by an **8-voice just-intonation choir** over a **bright, daylit** sun→Earth Canvas2D scene: wind **speed** lifts the register + streak speed, **density** fills the chord + particle flow, **Bz** (southward = geomagnetic storm) cross-fades harmony consonant→tense and tints the sky violet, **Bt** raises the shimmer, **Kp** lights an aurora ribbon + sparkle voices. Chosen over the immersive sibling `1174-magnetosphere-song` **on the jury's decisive gate:** 1174 is the more *transporting* build but renders a violet field over a near-dark base (`bgL≈12–17%`) — the exact "near-black glow" under the fortnight ban — so it's banked (IDEAS §662, ⭐ resurrect when the glow-ban lifts / a "readout↔field" toggle on 1173). **Research→build:** §661 dive (Helioradar AV 2026) → §662 re-anchor (NASA **IMAP I-ALiRT** real-time solar-wind pipeline begins 2026, replacing ACE/DSCOVR; arXiv 2206.04279 ULF-audibility method). ## Cycle 660 — **adult** **DEEP** — ONE fresh audio-first concept, *the instrument is inside your own ear*, raced via 2 approaches (active phantom-**melody** vs immersive phantom-**field**). Ships `1165-third-ear` — **a melody you hear that no speaker plays.** Two loud, close pure tones (the "primaries", ~1.2–2.7 kHz) sound together and the nonlinear mechanics of your cochlea generate an audible **difference tone** at their gap `Δ = f₂ − f₁` — a *third* tone ("Tartini tone", Maryanne Amacher's "ear tone") that is NOT in the signal. The composition lives entirely in Δ: a seeded just-intonation pentatonic melody develops (statement→variation→rest→return, drifting over minutes) while the two real primaries ride high and nearly still. A **carrier-height** sweep moves both primaries together so the played pitch climbs but the phantom melody holds — the proof it's in your head — and an **A/B toggle** mutes one primary so the phantom vanishes (proof it was never played). Eyes-closed, headphones, deliberately minimal instructional visual. **The direct answer to the 2026-07-04 jury's provocation #4** ("the screen bias is near-total — one audio-first piece in fifteen"), on a grep-0× technique (`otoacoustic`/`Tartini` = 0×; the lab's isochronic/binaural-beat entrainment is a *different* psychoacoustic family) — and NOT another entrainment/meditation piece (1138-theta-ear already owns that). Banks ⭐ `1166-ear-tone-field` (the SAME otoacoustic phenomenon as a sustained immersive Amacher *field* — 9 just-tuned pairs whose Δ's stack into a harmonic phantom chord, a 14-stage ~10-min seeded evolution + binaural bed; the ⭐ TOP resurrect for the next immersive/cosmic-ambient-audio lane, once the near-black-glow ban lifts). **Research→build:** §660 dive — Sonorities 2026 (Belfast) symposium session on Amacher's "ear tones" confirms the technique is live current-year, not archival. Named refs: Maryanne Amacher *Sound Characters (Making the Third Ear)* 1999; Giuseppe Tartini *il terzo suono* 1714; Alvin Lucier.)

A purely AUDITORY percept manufactured inside you.** **Zero-input passive headphone-listen INPUT → audio-first OUTPUT (a sparse Canvas2D companion, not the artwork).** Three files: **(1)** `voice.ts` — `renderWord` builds the word **offline**: a sawtooth glottal buzz at f0≈110–125 Hz through **three parallel band-pass "formant" filters** (F1/F2/F3) automated along a short **vowel script** (canonical Peterson & Barney 1952 values; diphthongs as glides) + band-passed **noise bursts** for fricatives, then **peak-normalized** and **cosine-faded to exact silence at both edges** so the loop seam is click-free; plus `VerbalOracleEngine`, a 25 ms **look-ahead scheduler** staying ~0.2 s ahead of `ctx.currentTime` that fires a *fresh* `AudioBufferSourceNode` playing the **same** buffer at `nextTime += period` (1.2–3 Hz) → master gain → `DynamicsCompressor` soft-limiter → destination. **Every repetition is sample-identical — that invariance IS the illusion** (VTE's strict precondition; a seam click weakens or kills it). ## Cycle 623 — **adult** visionary **DEEP** (2 parallel technical approaches to ONE concept, orchestrated) — the lab **finally SHIPS an embodied hand-tracked piece** — the jury's begged-for #3, un-cashed for four windows: your two hands are electrodes and a real **Dielectric-Breakdown / Laplacian-growth** discharge forks between them, every branch ringing a note; raw-WebGL2 output, electric-intense pole; a DEEP fire *committed* to shipping it, with a self-sufficient autonomous storm that dissolves the "zero-permission sibling always wins the glance" pattern)

[/dream/1085-lightning-organ](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/1085-lightning-organ) — **"Lightning Organ": your two hands are electrodes, and every branch of lightning that cracks between them rings a note — but the discharge is not drawn, it is *simulated*. On a 128×72 potential grid the two terminals are held at φ=1 (Dirichlet sources) and the growing discharge at φ=0; each frame a handful of Gauss–Seidel sweeps relax ∇²φ=0, then a frontier cell is chosen with probability ∝ |φ|^η (roulette) and joins the cluster — real Laplacian growth, the same model used to predict the fractal dimension of dielectric breakdown. An η slider (1→6) is the signature control: η≈1 gives bushy DLA-like growth, η≈3–6 gives sharp forked lightning. When a discharge bridges the terminals it flashes, fires a sub-boom, and re-seeds, so the storm is continuous. Each new branch rings an FM pluck (pitch ∝ height → a downward strike sweeps a descending pentatonic arpeggio) with band-passed crackle. Grant the camera and your two palms BECOME the electrodes (MediaPipe HandLandmarker, 21 keypoints/hand via CDN ESM): palm centroids set the terminals, hand separation + finger openness set the field voltage. A moon-ball rolls under tilt and dents the sheet (sphere-vs-cloth push-out). **Render:** own `perspective`/`lookAt` matrices (no three.js), a camera that gently orbits so the sheet visibly stretches toward/away in depth — reads as a real 3D scene, gold/white star-glints at the nodes over a deep-indigo starfield, a soft additive moon-ball. **Audio (Eb-major lullaby, no wrong notes):** membrane-mode synthesis — **dent depth bends the low fundamental DOWN** (real tension-modulation physics: partials shift at large membrane amplitude, per Avanzini & Marogna), **ripple energy** opens higher drum-skin modes (partials ≈1/1.59/2.14/2.30/2.65), **settle** = a sustained warm chord, **bounce** = a soft bloom; always-on Eb+Bb drone (never silent), kids-safe `gain ≤0.26 → lowpass 6500 → comp(−10/20:1)`, ≥30ms attacks, ~12-min goodnight fade. **Input chain:** `DeviceOrientationEvent` (iOS `requestPermission()` inside the Start tap) → pointer-drag → arrow keys/space → ~2s-idle auto-demo (moon drifts a slow circle so it's always moving + singing). Refs: Provot (1995) mass-spring cloth; Avanzini & Marogna membrane-percussion synthesis; arXiv:2507.11794 (WebGPU cloth feasibility). An always-on soft G2+D3 drone keeps it never-silent; successive shakes walk a ~2-octave **G Mixolydian (G A B C D E F♮)** ladder UP then turn around and DESCEND (a rising-then-falling shimmer, not a fixed loop); shake intensity (0..1) sets both *how many* bells ring (gentle = 1–2 soft tones, big = a 3–5 bell sparkling arpeggio) and strike brightness. **Real modal bell synthesis, not samples and not a single sine** — each bell is a small bank of inharmonic partials (~1, 2, 2.4, 3, 4.5) with independent exponential decays + slight per-partial detune so the bell *beats* and shimmers; polyphony √-normalized so a big arpeggio never clips. **Deliberately NOT a pentatonic no-wrong-notes scale and NOT a I–IV–V / V→I functional cadence** (the jury's hardest KIDS ban #1) — modal *color* via the lowered-7th F♮, a different musical idiom from the lab's recent cadence toys (957/974). **Shake-onset detection** (`motion.ts`): `accelerationIncludingGravity` low-passed to estimate gravity → subtract → linear-accel magnitude → downward threshold crossing just past the peak with a ~150ms refractory → intensity; iOS 13+ `DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission()` fired synchronously in the Start tap; thresholds exported as top-level constants (`SHAKE_THRESHOLD`/`SHAKE_SENSITIVITY`/…) flagged for real-device tuning. The engine computes Chew's **three tension measures — cloud diameter (dissonance) · cloud momentum (tonal movement) · tensile strain (distance from home key)** — on a real 3D Spiral-Array helix `P(k)=(sin kπ/2, cos kπ/2, k·0.4)`, blends them (`0.34·diameter + 0.18·momentum + 0.48·strain`, strain dominant — distance-from-home is the strongest felt cue), and at each step runs a **beam search (width 3) over a real harmonic vocabulary** (diatonic triads/7ths + Neapolitan-6, German-aug-6, dim7, secondary dominants, tritone-sub, modal mixture) scoring each candidate `|tension−target|·1.0 + voiceLeading·0.22 + repeatPenalty·0.15` — so it picks the chord whose measured tension best moves the music toward the arc, then **shows the "why" tag near the playhead** (`tensile strain 0.61 · tension +0.04`). **Long-form WITH memory (the lab's thin menu category):** stateful key/previous-CE/section tracking + seeded **mulberry32** PRNG (`DEFAULT_SEED=0x7e551042` → a given arc+key reproduces exactly) + phrase-boundary fifth-pivot/mode-flip modulations, so **minute 5 is in a different key and character than minute 1** — not a loop.
