## (Cycle 568 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal non-pointer/real-harmony explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/978-kids-cloud-weather](/dream/978-kids-cloud-weather)** — Conduct the Sky: **a 4-year-old conducts a bright musical SKY with their whole BODY — and it's the *quality* of the movement (gentle vs. big, sudden vs. smooth, high vs. low) that shapes the music, never a finger on glass.** `demoable` · Cycle 568 (kids 4+ / **front-camera whole-body motion — frame-difference, NO ML model, the non-pointer/embodied input**, with a ghost auto-conductor fallback / **Canvas2D painterly daytime sky** / **Laban Effort movement-quality → musical-expression mapping** / bright daydream-meadow vibe). **The directest answer to JURY 2026-06-26's loudest standing structural ask (#3): "force a non-pointer input — drag-on-glass is back to 7×; embodied, not a finger"** — here nothing touches the glass; the child stands back and *moves*. Three **Laban Effort** qualities each drive a distinct musical dimension: **Space/height** (motion-weighted vertical centroid → register, reach up = higher), **Weight/energy** (total frame-difference motion → dynamics + how many flowers bloom, a big sweep = loud bright bloom), and **Time — sudden vs. sustained** (the time-derivative of energy → articulation, a sudden burst = a staccato sparkle-pluck + shooting star, smooth motion = a legato sung tone). The harmony is a real **C-Lydian** mode (C D E F♯ G A B — the raised-4th "wonder/magic" color over a Cadd9↔D/C lift pad) — **explicitly NOT a pentatonic no-wrong-notes safety scale** (the jury's hardest KIDS ban, #1). **Input technique = pure frame-difference, no ML:** each frame drawn to a 64×48 offscreen canvas, per-pixel luminance differenced vs. the previous frame, thresholded mask → (energy, vertical centroid, suddenness), adaptive baseline self-calibrating to room light — no MediaPipe/TensorFlow/npm-ML deps. **Output = Canvas2D** (the jury blessed Canvas2D as "fresh-again, earns its place" — deliberately not the over-rep raw-GPU shader): glowing sun, parallax clouds, rolling meadow, flowers that bloom on notes, birds/sparkles on sudden bursts; warm saturated daylight palette, **deliberately OFF the (adult-side) cosmic/bioluminescent-glow cluster**. **Grounded in THIS cycle's research dive (RESEARCH §568, research→build chain visible):** **BeSound** (embodied music education for children mapping whole-body movement qualities to rhythm/melody/harmony via **Rudolf Laban's Theory of Effort**, surfaced alongside the 2026 Sound Scene embodied-sound program + Antle "embodied metaphors help children learn"). ## Cycle 565 — **adult** build · DEEP, 1 concept × 2 technical approaches, shipped 1

- **[/dream/973-wave-terrain](/dream/973-wave-terrain)** — Wave Terrain: **the glowing 3D landscape you SEE is literally the sound you HEAR — an orbit tracing a closed path over a height-terrain reads out the audio waveform sample-by-sample, so reshaping the land sculpts the timbre and spinning the orbit faster plays a higher note.** `demoable` · Cycle 565 (adult / **computer-keyboard + Web MIDI velocity (primary, non-pointer)** / **raw WebGL2 perspective heightfield + Canvas2D carved-waveform strip** / topographic bronze-relief vibe). **The lab's FIRST wave-terrain synthesizer** — grep-verified 0× (`wave terrain`/`wave-terrain` never appear in any prior prototype). Wave-terrain (a.k.a. terrain) synthesis defines a height surface `z=f(x,y)`; a **closed orbit** traced across it, sampled at audio rate over one full loop, *is* one period of a waveform — so the terrain's shape **is the timbre** and the orbit's traversal rate **is the pitch**. Implementation: `terrain.ts` walks the orbit at **1024 points**, reads the height, **DC-blocks** (subtracts the mean, since terrains carry an offset) + peak-normalizes → one period; `audio.ts` turns that period into a `PeriodicWave` via a real DFT (`createPeriodicWave`), played by up to **6 `OscillatorNode` voices** sharing the current wave (pitch = note frequency; `1/√n` normalization; `Gain → lowpass 8 kHz → DynamicsCompressor` limiter, peak < 0.3); on morph/orbit change the wave is rebuilt + re-applied to live voices. `gl.ts` is **hand-rolled WebGL2 (no three.js)** — a 96×96 perspective heightfield sampling an `R32F` height texture, warm topographic elevation palette, relief shading, contour bands, a luminous orbit ring on the surface + a glowing moving read-point; a carved-waveform strip below shows the exact period being played with a scrub marker, so you can *see* orbit-shape → waveform → sound. **The directest answer to JURY 2026-06-26 #2** ("make the SOUND the primary object, the resonating body — not a GPU sim you pulse a bell off of"): here the visible terrain *is the oscillator itself*, not a screensaver read for a pitch. Also clears #3 (non-pointer: computer keyboard `A–L`/`Q–P` = D-Dorian ~2 octaves primary; `1–5` presets; `[ ]`/arrows = orbit radius/lobes; `M` = morph; Web MIDI velocity when present, never required) and #5 (register that isn't cosmic: topographic bronze-relief). **Grounded in THIS cycle's research dive (RESEARCH §565, research→build chain visible):** the **2025–2026 wave-terrain revival** — **Scaler Music *Carbon Electra 2*** (announced **May 28, 2026**), engine "produces sound via a 2D trajectory that scans over a 3D surface or terrain", + **Conductive Labs *Terrain*** hardware synth (2025) — a commercial revival with *no* free browser-native counterpart; this is that. ## Cycle 564 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal non-pointer/real-harmony explorers, shipped 1

- **[/dream/972-kids-sing-garden](/dream/972-kids-sing-garden)** — Sing Garden: **a child SINGS any note and a real harmonic garden grows a chord that genuinely SUPPORTS it — no wrong notes, but REAL functional harmony underneath, not a safe pentatonic.** `demoable` · Cycle 564 (kids 4+ / **microphone — live voice pitch (YIN/autocorrelation), the non-pointer input** / **Canvas2D watercolor-ink garden** / functional voice-leading accompaniment / ink-and-watercolor vibe). **The directest answer to JURY 2026-06-26's hardest KIDS provocation (#1): "pentatonic-no-wrong-notes is the new kids crutch — ban it; give them a real mode, a functional progression, or genuine tension/resolution."** Here the child's voice is the melody (snapped to C-major scale degrees so it's always in tune = no wrong notes), but the harmony is genuinely functional: each sung scale-degree drives its real diatonic triad (1→I, 2→ii, 3→iii, 4→IV, 5→V, 6→vi, 7→vii°) and **three inner voices + a bass voice-lead** to the nearest chord tones by smallest-motion assignment (Aldwell & Schachter), so a drawn melody makes real chord changes emerge; landing on 5→1 or holding the leading-tone 7→1 fires a true **V→I cadence** with an audible resolution + a warm gold "home" halo. **Input = mic** — the live analyser time-domain buffer is run through a YIN-style cumulative-mean-normalized-difference pitch detector with parabolic refinement + an RMS gate + a 90 ms held-degree debounce (clamped to a child-voice 150–700 Hz); the voice is **never recorded, stored, or transmitted** — pitch is detected in place and thrown away every frame. This dodges the jury-banned **pointer-drag-as-primary-input** (7×) and is NOT the jury-over-represented input (mic is uncommon; the tired "hum→RMS-paint" is explicitly *not* what this is — it reads real pitch and builds real harmony). **Output = Canvas2D** watercolor/ink garden (the jury blessed Canvas2D as "fresh-again, earns its place" — deliberately NOT WebGPU/three.js): singing higher grows a tall plant, lower a low spreading one (pitch→height); each chord blooms a flower whose **color encodes harmonic function** (tonic gold = home, dominant orange = tension, subdominant green, predominant/minor cool blue & violet), louder voice = bolder stroke; the painting accumulates as a calm, building garden. **Vibe = ink-and-watercolor on warm paper** — explicitly OFF the (adult-side) cosmic/bioluminescent-glow cluster. ## Cycle 563 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal physical-modeling explorers, shipped 1

- **[/dream/970-tension-gong](/dream/970-tension-gong)** — Tension Gong: **strike a metal gong on your keyboard and it bends — a hard hit starts SHARP and glides DOWN in pitch as it rings out, because the synthesis itself is non-linear, the way real bronze blooms.** `demoable` · Cycle 563 (adult / **computer-keyboard + Web MIDI velocity (primary, non-pointer)** / **AudioWorklet non-linear modal synthesis + Canvas2D Chladni nodal plot**). **The lab's FIRST non-linear modal synthesis** — every prior modal/Karplus piece (960-friction's modal body, plucked strings, bell banks) used a *linear* fixed-frequency resonator bank; this is the first where the mode frequencies **change with vibration energy in real time**, which is what gives metal its life. Each of four bodies (bell-plate / gong / tam-tam / cymbal-disc) is a bank of 12–16 two-pole inharmonic resonators with three live non-linearities running per 128-sample control block in the worklet: (1) **tension modulation** — a running `energy = Σ amp²` resets every mode's instantaneous frequency `f_i = f0_i·(1 + beta_i·betaScale·energy)`, so a loud strike rings sharp and **glides back down** to rest pitch as energy bleeds away (the gong "bloom" — produced by the resonators *changing frequency*, not by pitch automation/LFO); (2) **mode coupling** — while loud, a fraction of each mode's state transfers to its spectral neighbor (`coupleAmt·energy`), so the spectrum shimmers up during the attack then **clarifies and settles** as the coupling term vanishes; (3) **strike-velocity dependence** — a hard hit (Shift) drives energy into the *high* modes (brighter) with a larger `betaScale` (bends more); a soft hit stays near the linear pitch on the low modes. **Directest answer to BOTH of JURY 2026-06-26's hardest adult provocations at once** — #2 (*kill the "ship-a-GPU-sim-and-pulse-a-bell" reflex — make the SOUND the primary object, the resonating body, the way 960-friction and 965-oscilloscope did*) and #3 (*force a non-pointer input — drag-on-glass is back to 7×*). Here the sound IS the object (the non-linearity is the instrument, not a screensaver) and the playing surface is the **computer keyboard** (`A S D F G H J K` strike; **Shift** = hard pitch-bending hit; fast play + hold-duration shape velocity; `1–4` switch bodies) with **Web MIDI** note-on velocity when a controller is present (silent keyboard fallback otherwise — MIDI is the rare 1× sensor the jury asked to revive). **Grounded in THIS cycle's research dive (RESEARCH §563, the research→build chain made visible):** **arXiv:2603.10240 "nlm: Real-Time Non-linear Modal Synthesis in Max" (March 2026)** — which models exactly tension modulation, pitch glide, and mode coupling for real-time physical synthesis; this is a faithful simplified browser port. **Visual READS the audio, never drives it** (the inverse of the banned sim-pulse-bell move): Canvas2D **Chladni-style nodal field** — each live mode draws its `sin(mπx)·sin(nπy)` nodal lines, brightening as it rings and fading as it decays, so you *see* which modes are alive and watch the spectrum settle after a strike; a per-mode strip below shows amplitude + a **pitch-glide tick** marking how far above rest frequency each mode currently sits. **Palette = clinical / metallurgical** (brushed-steel greys on near-black, hot-amber/steel-cyan accents) — deliberately OFF the banned adult cosmic/bioluminescent-glow vibe (4×). **Ambition floor 3/5** (#1 never-used technique [**non-linear modal synthesis** — energy-driven tension-modulation + mode-coupling; ## Cycle 561 — **adult** build · DEEP, 1 concept × 2 approaches, shipped 1

- **[/dream/965-phosphor-draw](/dream/965-phosphor-draw)** — Phosphor Draw: **draw a shape on a glowing oscilloscope and you HEAR that exact shape — because the green figure on screen and the stereo signal in the speakers are literally the same signal.** `demoable` · Cycle 561 (adult / **draw + pointer** input / **WebGL2 RGBA16F phosphor-feedback** scope). **The lab's FIRST true oscilloscope vector-synthesizer.** In an XY ("vectorscope") oscilloscope the left audio channel drives the horizontal beam and the right drives the vertical — so a stereo signal *draws a shape*; this inverts it: any drawn closed loop is resampled to a constant-arc-length pen-path and **emitted AS the stereo signal** (`L[i]=x[i]`, `R[i]=y[i]`), looped at an audible rate, so **the shape you hear IS the shape you see** — sample-for-sample, one signal feeding both senses. **Geometry becomes timbre** (a circle ≈ near-sine, a square ≈ rich odd harmonics, a star ≈ bright buzz); the loop's **retrace rate is the pitch** (40–400 Hz slider), set via `playbackRate` so retuning *never rebuilds the buffer* — which is why the scope renders the played audio *continuously*, not in throttled steps. **Deliberately NON-sim and NON-harmony:** chosen *after* the research dive surfaced a fresh 2026 Neural-Cellular-Automata wave (arXiv 2601.16096 Jan 2026) AND a grep proved the lab has already mined the entire self-organizing-life family (Lenia `264`, physarum `327`, reaction-diffusion `9`, particle-life `8`, differential-growth `964`) — JURY 2026-06-25 flagged "ship a sim, pulse a bell off it" as the hardening adult move — so the pick pivoted OFF the sim it surfaced and ONTO its **mirror image**: an instrument where the signal IS the image, with no field/particles and no harmony engine (pitch is a byproduct of draw-speed, the *idea* is contour/timbre). It also breaks the **re-emerged harmony-engine monoculture** (7 of the last 10 committed reasoned about voice-leading: 954/952/950/947/942/941/957). **Phosphor render:** `phosphor-gl.ts` is a hand-written WebGL2 vectorscope — an `RGBA16F` ping-pong feedback texture fades the previous frame (CRT persistence), the new beam is drawn additively as a `LINE_STRIP` with **dwell-based brightness** (slow beam = brighter, exactly like a real scope), then a bloom + filmic-tonemap pass blooms hot spots to white-green; Canvas2D `shadowBlur`-trail fallback (`phosphor-2d.ts`) if WebGL2/float-render-targets are unavailable. **Controls:** 6 one-tap presets (figure-8, circle, square, star, lissajous, heart) so it sings instantly; draw-your-own (Pointer Events → iPad-ready); pitch, spin (slowly rotates the figure — audible *and* visible), brightness, persistence. **Autoplay:** after the single Start tap (creates+resumes `AudioContext` inside the gesture for iOS), a slowly-spinning figure-8 already draws itself and sings, so a hands-free 06:30 glance immediately sees + hears the idea. **Extends Karel's strongest loved cluster — draw→sound** (`223-fourier-paint`❤️, `153-paint-compose`❤️, `100`/`152`/`158`/`160`❤️) with a fresh technique (the drawn line and the sound are one thing). **Ambition floor 4/5** (#1 never-used-as-core [true oscilloscope/vector synth; ## Cycle 553 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1

- **[/dream/909-resonant-field-volume](/dream/909-resonant-field-volume)** — Resonant Field: sing, and your voice blooms as a volume of light + grains placed in space by its **timbre, not its pitch** ☁️🔊. `demoable` · Cycle 539 (adult / **mic** / **three.js raymarched volume**). **For**: anyone with a voice or instrument / immersive listening / headphones · **mic INPUT** (non-touch — sing/hum/speak/play; **zero pitch detection** — a pitch-free extractor reads only RMS, spectral centroid [brightness], flatness [noisy↔tonal], flux [change], and an 8-band silhouette; mic→Analyser + a rolling ~3.5s capture ring, **never routed to destination** [anti-feedback]; no-mic → synthetic auto-demo) · **three.js fullscreen raymarched volumetric OUTPUT** (a fragment-shader nebula — 24-step domain-warped FBM whose density/turbulence/hue/altitude ARE the timbre, with a `uAge` **memory** accumulator that warms while you sound and slowly cools in silence so it evolves like a long-form cloud, not a VU meter; runs on **any WebGL** → actually GPU-renders on a phone; Canvas2D glow fallback on no-WebGL) · **timbre-features → HRTF spatial-granular re-synth TECHNIQUE** · **immersive / Anadol-volumetric VIBE**. **What if you composed by TIMBRE × SPACE instead of pitch — your own captured sound scattered back as a 3D cloud of grains, each placed around your head by how bright / noisy / loud it is, over a single dumb drone so harmony is held deliberately flat?** Each Hann-windowed grain reads from the rolling capture buffer and is panned through its **own HRTF `PannerNode`** at a 3D position dictated by timbre (brightness→elevation/forward, flatness→azimuth spread, RMS→grain density); grains keep the source's own pitch — we never repitch by any musical rule. A fixed 55 Hz + 82.5 Hz drone pins harmony flat so the piece **lives entirely in texture and placement**. Master chain `gain(≤0.28) → lowpass(7 kHz) → compressor → destination`; idle nebula breathes from load; ~1s auto-demo (synthetic evolving-noise + formant sweep through the identical pipeline) blooms + sounds on mic-deny or 2.5s silence; full teardown (rAF, oscillators, mic tracks, three.js dispose + `forceContextLoss`). **The directest answer to JURY 2026-06-24 #3** ("make music from rhythm, **timbre, texture or space** — NOT pitch theory") **and #1** ("swing back to GPU, full stop") in one piece. **The inversion of a brand-new instrument:** Delta Sound Labs **XStream** (NAMM, 25 Jan 2026) is a *spatial live granular* synth where the **producer hand-dials** grain placement; this makes placement **automatic & timbre-driven** — played by sounding, not by tweaking. **Named refs:** Delta Sound Labs XStream (2026) · **Curtis Roads *Microsound*** (2001) · **Trevor Wishart *Audible Design*** (timbral morphology) · Refik Anadol (volumetric light). ## (Cycle 537 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/902-harmonic-mirror](/dream/902-harmonic-mirror)** — harmonic mirror: your chord, completed in just intonation 🎹✨. `demoable` · Cycle 537 (adult / harmony / **Canvas2D**). **For**: pianists & composers (Karel's exact audience) / harmony-curious / playable with zero hardware · **MIDI / on-screen-piano / computer-keyboard INPUT** (Web MIDI `requestMIDIAccess` + a clickable white/black one-octave piano + `a w s e d f t g y h u j k` map — all feed the identical pipeline; no-MIDI → `text-rose-300` notice + the on-screen paths still play) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (a circle-of-fifths constellation — bright white held nodes, soft violet **mirror** halos joined to the root by luminous completion lines carrying ratio labels `5/4`/`3/2`, the inferred chord name at center, 60fps amplitude pulse; deliberately the JURY-scarce Canvas2D surface, **no WebGL2/three.js/WebGPU/SVG**) · **just-intonation chord-completion TECHNIQUE** (deterministic Riemann-template inference + JI retuning — fresh for the lab) · **harmonic / luminous-clinical VIBE** (violet on near-black). **What if, as you play, your instrument completed the chord you imply — adding the 1–2 notes you DIDN'T play, tuned in pure JUST INTONATION to your root — so the harmony locks beat-lessly under your hands?** You play the keys you press in **equal temperament** (warm detuned saws); a **mirror** reduces your held notes to a pitch-class set, matches it against a small template bank (dom7 `0 4 7 10` · maj `0 4 7` · min `0 3 7` · sus4 `0 5 7` · bare-fifth `0 7`; anything else → a **cluster** heuristic completed with a safe fifth), and synthesizes the **missing** template tones in **just intonation** (small-integer ratios 9/8 · 6/5 · 5/4 · 4/3 · 3/2 · 5/3 · 9/5 · 15/8 over the inferred root's fundamental) so their partials align and the beating cancels — the just `5/4` third (~386¢) locks where the ET third (400¢) is restless. When the root shifts (C maj → A min) the persisting mirror voices **glide-retune** over ~180 ms rather than re-attack. **The deterministic, zero-latency cousin of a predictive AI accompanist** (RESEARCH §537 / **arXiv 2604.07612**, Apr 2026): it predicts nothing — it *finishes the chord you are already playing*. 2s-idle → a gentle **I–vi–IV–V** auto-demo arpeggiates through the identical path so a silent 06:30 glance is sounding + moving; first real note stops it. **Named refs:** Harry Partch & Ben Johnston (JI / small-integer ratios) · Hugo Riemann (functional-harmony templates) · arXiv 2604.07612. README cites **RESEARCH §537 (2026-06-24)** as the build hook — landing the in-README dated citation (criterion #5) JURY flagged **0-for-15 across five windows**, now **3 cycles running** (535/536/537). **Clears 3/5 of the ambition floor** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [MIDI/kbd input + chord-template inference + JI synth w/ glide-retune + Canvas2D constellation] · #3 named refs · #5 dated RESEARCH citation). `diversity: banned=[raw-WebGL2, data→roughness/detune, no-wrong-notes-safe-scale, 3rd-renderer-pass-on-847/872] · picked=[MIDI/keyboard, Canvas2D (scarce 2×), just-intonation-chord-completion, harmonic/clinical]`. **2 sibling explorers banked (IDEAS §537):** **`903-living-stave`** ⭐ (mic · **SVG** · live NSDF pitch+onset detection inks a self-drawing engraved treble staff — owns the 0× SVG lane, **resurrect-first**) + **`904-tide-organ`** (live **NOAA** tide data · **three.js** · the sea decides which organ pipes enter/leave & the arc's form — data→STRUCTURE, ref the Zadar Sea Organ). **Compile + ESLint + type-check clean** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build`: **`✓ Compiled successfully in 102s`**, lint phase ran [only runs post-compile] with **zero warnings in the 902 folder**; all warnings pre-existing `src/lib/**`); **static-gen blocked by the standing container `EMFILE` fd ceiling** (infra, not code — identical every cycle since ~472; Vercel deploys normally). **NOT browser/ear-verified** (no audio in container — whether the JI completion *audibly* locks vs the ET played notes, the glide-retune feel, and constellation legibility are unverified; the zero-hardware on-screen piano + auto-demo guarantee a sounding/moving glance).

## (Cycle 536 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/899-kids-moire-beats](/dream/899-kids-moire-beats)** — moiré beats: roughness & calm 〰️. `demoable` · Cycle 536 (kids 4+ / **touch** / **Canvas2D**). **For**: a 4-year-old on an iPad / immediate-cause-and-effect / no-reading · **touch-drag INPUT** (one finger, Pointer Events → touch + mouse; ~280px swing covers the full range, huge & forgiving) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (two op-art grids — fixed concentric **rings** under twistable **stripes**, composited `multiply` so they physically interfere into a rolling moiré band; deliberately the JURY-reopened scarce Canvas2D surface, **no WebGL2/three.js/SVG**) · **moiré-interference TECHNIQUE** (grep-verified **0× in the lab**) · **op-art VIBE** (Bridget Riley cream/ink, fresh for the lab). **What if a 4-year-old could SEE and HEAR a sound's roughness at the same time — by sliding two striped patterns over each other so the moiré band they make IS the acoustic beating they hear?** A warm consonant **fifth drone (A2 + E3)** is always playing, each pitch built from two sine oscillators. The child's twist doesn't change the *pitch* — it changes the **detune** of the second oscillator (0→~9 Hz). Lined up: the moiré band slows to almost nothing AND the tones converge to **one clear calm tone** (a green ring shrinks to a dot); twisted apart: the band shimmers fast AND the sound throbs **WAH-WAH-WAH** (amber ring pulses). The coupling is literal — the visual band's roll speed and the audio beat rate are driven by the **same** `twist` value, so *moiré beat = acoustic beat*. **The clean template-break:** the child plays **roughness↔calm over a fixed consonant fifth — NOT a scale**, sidestepping the no-wrong-notes pentatonic crutch entirely; nothing can ever be "wrong." Kids-safe (master ≤ 0.24, 6 kHz lowpass, soft fades, never silent), 2s-idle auto-demo drifts the layer so a hands-off 06:30 glance is moving + sounding within ~1s, `text-rose-600` notice + live visuals if Web Audio is unavailable, full teardown. **Named refs:** Gerald Oster *Moiré Patterns* (Scientific American, 1963) · Bridget Riley op-art · acoustic beating. README cites **RESEARCH §536 (2026-06-24)** as the build hook — landing the in-README dated citation (criterion #5) JURY flagged **0-for-15**, now 3 cycles running. **Clears 3/5 of the ambition floor** (#1 never-used technique [moiré 0×] · #3 named refs · #5 dated RESEARCH citation). `diversity: banned=[raw-WebGL2, three.js, data→roughness, no-wrong-notes-safe-scale] · picked=[touch, Canvas2D (scarce 2×), moiré-interference (0×), op-art]`. **2 sibling explorers banked (IDEAS §536):** **`900-kids-rope-singer`** ⭐ (touch · **SVG** · a *catenary* hanging-rope you hang beads on to sag→lower the pitch, pluck for a damped twang — owns the 0× SVG lane, resurrect-first) + **`901-kids-water-bowl`** (mic-hum · **three.js** · *Faraday* standing-wave patterns bloom on a vibrated water surface in time with the note you sing). **Compile + ESLint + type-check clean** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build`: lint phase ran [only runs post-compile] with **zero warnings in the 899 folder**; all warnings pre-existing `src/lib/**`); **static-gen blocked by the standing container `EMFILE` fd ceiling** (infra, not code — identical every cycle since ~472; Vercel deploys normally). **NOT browser/ear-verified** (no audio in container — whether the band reads as "the same wobble I hear," small-iPad op-art readability, and the twist feel are unverified; always-on drone + auto-demo guarantee a sounding/moving glance).

All pitches snap to a fixed consonant **Bb pentatonic/Dorian** mode across 3 octave bands, so **the data decides FORM while the mode keeps it in tune — data → structure, NEVER → roughness/detune.** This is the **direct answer to JURY #3** ("the next data piece must sonify STRUCTURE; `842`→`864` already cloned the detune move — retire it"). Per-voice chain: `OscillatorNode(triangle + sine partials) → Gain envelope → lowpass Biquad → StereoPanner → master → ConvolverNode(algorithmic IR) + dry → DynamicsCompressor limiter → destination` (shared `AudioContext` on the gesture; reverb IR synthesized in code; limiter keeps swarms un-clipped). ## Newest (Cycle 532 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/891-kids-sing-a-path](/dream/891-kids-sing-a-path)** — sing a path 🎤🪰. `demoable` · Cycle 532 (kids / storybook-night / **SVG**). **For**: kids (iPad/phone, 4yo-usable, no reading) · **mic/voice INPUT** (`getUserMedia` → `AnalyserNode`; real-time fundamental-frequency estimate via a normalized-square-difference / YIN-lite `trackPitch` + RMS loudness gate, so quiet = no draw) · **animated SVG OUTPUT** (a scrolling glowing `<path>` extended point-by-point + a firefly riding the tip + trailing sparkles + gradient night sky/moon/stars, all driven by rAF mutating SVG attributes — **no canvas, no webgl, no three.js**; SVG is the freshest visual surface, 1×/10, dodging the jury #1 raw-WebGL2 HARD-ban AND Canvas2D's near-cap 3×) · **real-time pitch-contour TECHNIQUE** (NEW to the lab) · **warm storybook-night VIBE**. **What if a 4-year-old could SING and watch their own voice draw a glowing path a firefly flies along — and it always sounds beautiful because we follow the SHAPE of their voice, not whether they hit a "correct" note?** The key move (RESEARCH §532 / **PESTO**, arXiv 2508.01488 — *transposition-equivariance*): the robust, meaningful quantity in a sung signal is the **contour** (relative up/down/hold motion), not absolute Hz. A `ContourEngine` maps the pitch stream to relative motion against a slow-drifting baseline (the child can wander up forever and stay on screen) → path height; a **`HarmonyVoice`** sings a soft companion tone back, **quantized to C-major pentatonic** with portamento, over a gentle pad drone + sparkle twinkles, through a master limiter (kids-safe, never harsh). The result is a **no-wrong-notes piece that is NOT the banned snap-to-safe-scale template** — the visual follows the child's raw gesture (never "wrong"); only the audio is quantized. Hands-free auto-demo (~0.6s) drives the *same* pipeline so the page sings + animates with zero hardware; a giant 🎤 Sing! button requests the mic; `text-rose-300` notices for demo/denied. Short-term RMS feeds a **stillness timer**: while you stay below threshold the timer grows and a warm additive chord-bloom rises one consonant voice at a time (root→fifth→octave→third→twelfth→high color) toward a full chord; any sound above threshold rushes a fast **duck** (reverse-sidechain) and **freezes** the bloom where it is — it **resumes building from there** when quiet returns (no reset). Signal chain voices → master → `ConvolverNode` synthesized-impulse reverb → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter → destination; an always-on near-silent root means it's never fully dead. **Visual:** Canvas2D — silence blooms a luminous field outward from center (monochrome→violet as the chord fills + faint concentric "voice" rings per lit partial); sound floods dark grain/static inward from the edges + a closing vignette and the light recedes; sized via `ResizeObserver`, animated by a single rAF that runs energy→stillness→audio→draw in lockstep. iOS-safe: AudioContext + `getUserMedia` created inside the Begin tap. **Degrades fully:** mic denied/absent → a scripted **synthetic** energy envelope (silence→burst→silence) runs through the **identical** `stepStillness` pipeline so the inversion proves itself hands-free within ~1.5–4s + a `text-rose-300` "no mic — showing a demo" notice; a **"Make a sound"** button lets a no-mic reviewer trigger the duck/erode manually; live mic yields the demo the moment real audio arrives. Full teardown (cancel rAF, `track.stop()` the mic, stop/disconnect oscillators, `audioCtx.close()`, clear timers, remove listeners). **No API route → no `guard`**; **zero new npm deps**. Pluck gently → a sweet in-tune note. **The stakes:** over-stretch a band and it **latches `detuned`** — sags, glow dies, twangs ~2 semitones flat/dull/sub-buzzy, an amber halo pulses on the loose peg — and it **STAYS that way** (no timeout, no auto-resolve). To fix it the child **drags the tuning-peg knob back up** until `taut` crosses the threshold and the band snaps true + glows again. The wrong choice is visible, audible, lasting; the child earns the fix — mapped onto a real-world intuition (tension sets pitch; you tune a string with a peg). Kids-safe chain `master 0.26 → lowpass 7.2kHz → DynamicsCompressor → destination`, always-on soft warm pad (never silent), the out-of-tune note an **unmistakable LARGE contrast** but **never louder/harsher** (quieter decay, loop filter drops ~5.2→1.4kHz, soft sub-buzz — per the developmental finding that a 4yo registers dissonance only with a large contrast). - **[/dream/877-biosphere-score](/dream/877-biosphere-score)** — *"Biosphere Score": every bird, mammal, insect and fungus just observed on Earth becomes an orchestra — the live **GBIF** biodiversity feed decides which taxonomic **section** plays when. Each observation brings its section's voice in; pitch is **always** a scale-degree quantized to that section's register band against a slowly-modulating modal scale, so it stays harmonic by construction — the data shapes the **ensemble and the form, never the detuned pitch of a note.*** A deliberately **structural** sonification (the jury's standing #3 ask: stop mapping a feed to "roughness fouls the harmony" — sonify who-plays-when/form instead); a sibling lab piece (`233-earth-pulse`) already does note-per-datum, so this is different *in kind*. Degrades: live fetch fails/offline → seamless curated 40-occurrence fallback + hands-free auto-demo sees+hears within ~1s; no Web Audio → visuals only. Full teardown. ## (Cycle 524 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/868-kids-monster-keys](/dream/868-kids-monster-keys)** — Monster Keys 👹🎹. `demoable` · Cycle 524 (kids / freedom-to-be-wrong / raw WebGL2). **For**: kids (4+) · **on-screen creature-keys + Web MIDI INPUT** (12 big toggle-to-stack keys as the always-available primary; native `requestMIDIAccess` as an optional bonus — MIDI is the scarce stage input, off the jury's touch+mic-only ban) · **raw WebGL2 OUTPUT** (hand-written additive GLSL ES 3.00 glow-creatures — the SCARCEST GPU surface, 2×/10; shipping it kept three.js [867] off the 4× audit-ban AND avoided a 4th-WebGPU-in-4-cycles monoculture [870]; NOT three.js, NOT Canvas2D) · **interval-clash scoring → spawn-a-wobble-monster → resolve-by-consonance** technique · **warm playful friendly-monster vibe**. **What if a 4-year-old had the freedom to play a genuinely WRONG (dissonant) note — and dissonance was a friendly wobbly MONSTER they could CALM by resolving it, instead of a forbidden mistake?** **The directest answer to JURY 2026-06-22 #3** — the #1 unfilled kids ask ("give a kid the freedom to be WRONG — dissonance reachable AND resolvable, a real harmonic decision with a consequence; 841 only *gestures* at this, commit to it fully"). **Every one of the 12 chromatic notes always plays** — no pentatonic gating, no lockout, no "wrong note." Tap a glowing creature-key to toggle its note on; tap again to remove — stacking 2–3 builds a chord with no precise multi-touch-hold. When the sounding set contains a **clearly-beating clash** (minor-2nd / major-7th / tritone — `harmony.ts` flags only the LARGE, unmistakable interval classes, per the developmental finding **PMC11336827** that a 4yo perceives consonance preference only with a *large* dissonant contrast), the offending creature grows shivering soft spikes (WebGL) + a **~+6-cent beating partner partial + a 3.2 Hz shimmer LFO** (Web Audio) — the wobble/beating is the **ONLY** change, **never louder, never harsher, never higher**. `suggestResolution` computes the one consonant note (a 3rd / 5th / octave) that removes the clash and that key gently **pulses as a glowing invitation**; adding it settles the monster into a round steady happy creature with a soft bloom reward + a warm resolved chord. Real tension→release, **zero fail state, zero scolding sound**. Kids-safe chain `osc → voiceGain → masterGain(0.26) → BiquadFilter lowpass(6.5kHz) → DynamicsCompressor(−10,20:1) → destination`, ≥40 ms attacks, always-on warm ambient pad (never silent), `AnalyserNode` taps master but never routes to output. iOS gesture-gated: AudioContext + `requestMIDIAccess` both inside the first ≥72px "Play" tap. **Degrades fully:** no AudioContext → `text-rose-300` notice; no WebGL2 (or renderer init throws) → `text-rose-300` notice, audio + auto-demo keep playing (keys still sound); no Web MIDI → "tap the keys" status, on-screen keys remain primary (connected/none = "🎹 connected" / "🎹 plug in a keyboard — optional"). **Auto-demo:** untouched ~1.5 s → the page loops the full arc hands-free (sound two clashing notes → a visible+audible wobble-monster spawns → add the resolving 5th → it settles + blooms), so an unattended 06:30 glance SEES and HEARS the spawn-then-calm story within ~1 s with zero hardware. Full teardown (rAF cancel + osc stop + delete GL programs/buffers/VAO/texture + `WEBGL_lose_context.loseContext()` + remove MIDI listeners + `audioCtx.close()`). **No API route → no `guard`**; **zero new npm deps** (hand-written WebGL2; native WebMIDI DOM types — a redundant local shim was deleted). Shake-energy drives **only rain density** (`densityToRate` ~1.2→14 droplets/sec, hard-capped) + drift — **never loudness, never harshness**: a hard shake just makes *more soft drops*, which IS the "auditable safe envelope" (arXiv 2602.22813, Feb 2026). Warm C-pentatonic marimba/bell droplets (≥40ms attacks, no wrong notes) over an always-on C2+G2+C3 drone, all through the fixed kids-safe chain `masterGain(0.26) → BiquadFilter lowpass(6kHz) → DynamicsCompressor(−10,20:1) → destination`; analyser tapped off master, never routed to output. Visual = a **WGSL `@compute` pass integrating 60k falling raindrop/star particles** (gravity + gentle curl wind + wrap-around) → additive glowing point-quads, indigo→violet→warm-gold (stars brighter when calm). iOS gesture-gated: AudioContext + `DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission()` both inside the ≥72px Start-cloud tap. **Degrades fully:** no WebGPU → a hand-written ~3k-particle **WebGL2** version on the SAME shake→density mapping (audio keeps playing); no WebGL2 → `text-rose-300` notice, audio still runs; no motion sensor / desktop → pointer drag-to-"shake" + an **auto-demo** that rains + chimes + drifts on its own within ~1s (a hands-free 06:30 glance both SEES and HEARS it). Full teardown (rAF cancel + remove devicemotion listener + stop drones + `GPUDevice.destroy()`/`WEBGL_lose_context` + `audioCtx.close()`). A keyless, CORS-enabled **Open-Meteo Marine API** fetch (client-side, **no api route, no guard**) pulls live `wave_height/period/direction/swell` for four contrasting presets — **Oahu North Shore · Bay of Biscay · Drake Passage (big seas) · Maldives (calm)** — re-polling every 5 min. One normalized `seaToDrive()` signal feeds BOTH a **modal physical-modeling bronze engine** (each key = a filtered noise exciter → a bank of **high-Q BiquadFilter bandpass resonators** at inharmonic partial ratios `[1, 2.76, 5.4, 8.93]`, slendro/pelög) AND a hand-written **WebGL2 GLSL-ES-3.00 caustic water-light shader** (domain-warped value-noise interference, ridged veins, foam crests, violet strike-bloom) — so sound and image never disagree. **The consequence is the point and it's audible:** a single `roughness` (clamp `wave_height/6`) simultaneously **(a)** densifies strike rate (~0.8→~7/s), **(b)** drops register, **(c)** collapses resonator **Q** (~38 *sings* → ~6 *clangs*), and **(d)** detunes each bronze partial up to **±35¢** — heavy seas beat into a detuned clang, calm seas stay sparse/high/sweet; `period`→tempo+wave-speed, `direction`→pan+shader-drift, `swell`→drone+undulation. **Deepening 1:** a **groove-quantize toggle** snaps strikes to a tempo grid derived from `wave_period` (the swell becomes a GROOVE; off = free Poisson-ish ocean pings). **Deepening 2:** a **dual-sea equal-power crossfade** + its own B-location picker — hear **Drake Passage's storm beating against the Maldives' calm**, each sea driving its own strike stream + roughness. **Ear-safety:** master compressor → brick-wall limiter, 2s fade-in, panic mute, gesture-gated AudioContext in the Start tap (iOS), analyser taps the master for the bloom (never routes to output). **Degrades fully:** fetch fails/blocked → a **synthetic evolving sea** per preset (Drake stays stormy, Maldives stay calm) keeps it sounding + animating within ~1s + a `text-rose-300` "(live feed unavailable — simulated sea)" badge; no WebGL2 → notice, audio keeps playing; no Web Audio → notice, visuals keep running. Full teardown (rAF cancel + abort both fetches + clear intervals + delete GL program/buffers/VAO + `WEBGL_lose_context` + `ctx.close()`). **No API route → no `guard`**; **zero new npm deps** (hand-written WebGL2, NOT three.js, NOT Canvas2D — the only `getContext` is `webgl2`, so the main viz is genuinely GPU). A front-camera **MediaPipe HandLandmarker** (CDN `webpackIgnore` runtime import, pinned `tasks-vision@0.10.14`, analysis-only, never bundled) → a geometric **7-sign classifier** (`classify.ts`: per-finger extended/curled booleans + coarse hand orientation → do/re/mi/fa/sol/la/ti) with a **~250 ms dwell** so only a HELD shape rings (flicker never triggers); **hand height** shifts octave + brightness; after **~2 s of stillness** the choir replays the last ~6 signed notes as a gentle tune (the **Kodály echo** call-and-response game). **three.js (v0.182)** choir: 7 **additive-halo glow orbs** in a warm rising arc, color-coded by a consistent pitch→hue palette, the signed orb blooms + lifts with hand height, a faint starfield breathes; a tiny **Canvas2D HUD** draws the live hand skeleton so the child feels "seen" (the ONLY 2D surface). Kids-safe `voices → masterGain(0.26) → BiquadFilter lowpass(6.5kHz) → DynamicsCompressor(−10,20:1) → destination`; always-on soft **open-fifth drone (C+G)** so it's never silent; gentle ≥40 ms attacks; analyser taps the master, never routes to output; **NO wrong notes possible**. **iOS:** AudioContext + getUserMedia both inside the ≥72px Start tap. **Degrades fully:** no camera / permission denied / MediaPipe load-fail → `text-rose-300` notice + a **ghost-hand auto-demo** (cycles a do-re-mi-sol-mi phrase through the IDENTICAL classifier→choir→scene pipeline, drawing a believable ghost skeleton in the HUD, so a hands-free 06:30 glance both SEES the orbs bloom and HEARS the tune within ~1 s) + a row of **≥72px press-and-hold tap-sign buttons** (emoji + color, no reading) driving the same pipeline (fully playable, zero camera); no WebGL → notice, choir keeps singing. Full teardown (rAF + camera tracks stop + landmarker close + three.js dispose + `forceContextLoss()` + osc stop + `audioCtx.close()`). **No API route → no `guard`**; **zero new npm deps** (three present; MediaPipe is a CDN runtime import, NOT Canvas2D). Ambition honest **2/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [MediaPipe hand-tracking + geometric 7-sign Curwen classifier + kids-safe choir synth w/ Kodály-echo scheduler + three.js additive-glow choir scene = 4] · #3 named refs [**John Curwen 1870** Tonic Sol-fa hand-signs · **Zoltán Kodály** method + echo game · **arXiv 2604.27957, April 2026** "Real-Time Control of a Virtual Orchestra by Recognition of Conducting Gestures" — conducting as a musical sign-language recognized in real time]; soft lab-first — solfège-sign *classification* is grep-0× though MediaPipe-hands as input exists [853/731/444]). **Source:** §520 dive (conducting-as-recognized-sign-language, museum-robust) → AGENT.md path (c) IDEAS §518's ⭐ 855 + path (a) the dive hook → kids **DEEP** fire. **Diversity:** `banned (jury 2026-06-22 + audit)=[OUTPUT Canvas2D 7×/15 (HARD) · OUTPUT raw-WebGL2 4×/10 (audit-ban threshold) · INPUT touch+mic-only 8× · kids always-consonant-morph 5×]` · `picked (winner 862)=[MediaPipe-hands INPUT (1×/10, off-glass) · three.js OUTPUT (scarcer GPU, 2×/10) · solfège-sign-classification TECH (never used) · warm-wondrous kids vibe]` — clears every ban AND dodges the raw-WebGL2 over-rep that decided the curation. **DEEP fork (banked, IDEAS §520):** **`863-kids-solfege-choir`** ⭐ (the SAME concept as a raw-WebGL2 GLSL **"ladder of light"** — 7 luminous rungs do→ti bottom→top that renders **Kodály's pitch-height innovation literally**; **top kids RESURRECT-FIRST** — de-selected purely because raw-WebGL2 is 4×/10, the audit-ban threshold, NOT quality) — built complete + clean, removed before the winner-only build (not committed), full brief in IDEAS §520. ⚠️ **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build`: **`✓ Compiled successfully in 118s` → Linting + TypeScript type-check PASS → reached `Collecting page data`**; 862 folder grep-clean — zero warnings, no `any`/`@ts-ignore`/`use*`-helper/api-route, the single `getContext("2d")` is the permitted skeleton HUD); **NOT browser/device-verified** — the standing container ~4096-fd `EMFILE` at `next-font-manifest.json` blocks static-gen (infra, fails identically on pristine `main` every cycle since 472; Vercel deploys normally). Unverified by hand/eye/ear: whether the 7-sign classifier reliably distinguishes the signs on a real child's hand across lighting/angles (`classify.ts` favours distinct shapes over clinical accuracy), and the choir balance + orb bloom feel; the always-on drone + ghost-hand auto-demo + press-and-hold tap fallback guarantee a sounding, blooming glance with zero hardware.

## (Cycle 519 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/859-paths-compute-bloom](/dream/859-paths-compute-bloom)** — Compute Bloom 🎹✨. `demoable` · Cycle 519 (adult / GPU-compute / live-performance fitness). **For**: adults · **audio-file INPUT** (drag-drop / file-picker your own piano recording — Karel's-music directive; built-in generative tape-piano default so it plays with zero interaction) · **WebGPU compute OUTPUT** (the SCARCEST surface in the lab — **0× in the rolling 15-window**; clears the jury's HARD Canvas2D ban head-on) · **FFT-band-driven 500k-particle curl-noise GPU-compute sim with memory** technique · **cosmic/Anadol latent-flow vibe**. **What if a piano performance bloomed a living particle ecosystem computed entirely on the GPU — half a million points pushed by the music's spectral bands via a WGSL compute shader?** Directly answers **JURY 2026-06-22 #1** — the loudest standing directive ("Canvas2D back to 7-of-15; **WebGPU 0×**, WebGL2 1×, three.js 2× — make the next 3-4 builds GPU-only") — by landing the literal scarcest surface. An `AnalyserNode` 8-band FFT (sub-bass→air) packs a uniform read each frame by a WGSL **compute pass** that integrates **500,000** particles: sub-bass+bass swell the core outward, low-mid pulls a gentle gravity return (it breathes, not explodes), highs scatter sparkle at the rim, and every onset blooms the whole cloud then settles. **Memory:** velocity damping (`0.965 − energy·0.02`) keeps the cloud visibly expanded during a loud passage and settled inward during silence — different at minute 5 than minute 1. A WGSL **render pass** draws each particle as a 6-vertex additive glow quad, coloured deep-indigo → violet → magenta → warm-gold by speed; drag to orbit, scroll to zoom, live 8-band meter. **iOS:** AudioContext created/resumed inside the Start tap. **Degrades:** no WebGPU → `text-rose-300` "(WebGPU unavailable)" + a **WebGL2 ~6k-particle fallback** on the SAME band→force mapping (audio keeps playing, never a dead screen); no WebGL2 either → notice but audio plays. Full teardown (rAF cancel + buffer stop + `audioCtx.close()` + revoke object URL + destroy all GPUBuffers/GPUDevice or GL resources). **No API route → no `guard`** (built-in piece synthesised locally, user files via `decodeAudioData`, no external fetch); **zero new npm deps** (hand-written WGSL + GLSL, NOT three.js, NOT Canvas2D). Ambition honest **2/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [audio decode/playback + drag-drop intake · OfflineAudioContext tape-piano · `AnalyserNode` 8-band FFT + onset · WGSL compute sim · WGSL additive render = **4–5**] · #3 named refs [**Refik Anadol** latent/particle-flow aesthetic *Machine Hallucinations* · **Robert Bridson, *Curl-Noise for Procedural Fluid Flow*, SIGGRAPH 2007** — divergence-free curl-of-noise field in WGSL]). **#1 NOT claimed (honest):** WebGPU is not lab-first (60× historically) — its novelty here is being **0× in the rolling window** (the diversity axis that matters now). **Source:** §519 dive (**WebGPU just became iOS-deployable** — Safari 26 / three.js r171, Sep 2025; compute-particles are the live June-2026 register) → jury #1 (WebGPU 0× / GPU-only) → adult **WIDE** fire. **Diversity:** `banned (jury 2026-06-22, last 15)=[OUTPUT Canvas2D 7× (HARD ban) · INPUT touch+mic-only 8× · kids always-consonant-morph 5× (N/A adult)]` · `picked (winner 859)=[audio-file/his-piano INPUT (dropped) · WebGPU-compute OUTPUT (scarcest, 0×) · FFT→curl-noise GPU-particle TECH · cosmic/Anadol VIBE]` — clears every active ban. **WIDE fork (banked, IDEAS §519):** **`860-marine-gamelan`** ⭐ (live **Open-Meteo wave data** → modal bronze-gamelan where rough seas audibly DETUNE the metal ±35¢; WebGL2 caustics; **top adult RESURRECT-FIRST** — lowest runtime risk, the jury-praised real-world-data-with-consequence register) + **`861-flow-veil`** (**webcam optical-flow** → advected dye veil + granular audio; WebGL2; needs a 1-line `OffscreenCanvas`→`ImageBitmap` texImage2D fix before resurrect) — both built complete, removed before the winner-only build (not committed), full briefs in IDEAS §519. ⚠️ **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build`: **`✓ Compiled successfully` → Linting + TypeScript type-check PASS → reached `Collecting page data`**; ## (Cycle 517 — **adult** build · DEEP, 3 parallel approaches to one concept, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/853-motet-room-reach](/dream/853-motet-room-reach)** — The Motet Room (Reach) 🎼🖐️. `demoable` · Cycle 517 (adult / spatial-installation / live-performance fitness). **For**: adults · **two-hand bare-hand-tracking INPUT** (MediaPipe HandLandmarker — the starved embodied input the jury demanded; NOT touch, NOT mic; pointer + auto-demo fallback) · **raw WebGL2 OUTPUT** (the SCARCEST GPU surface, 1× in the last 15 — beats the over-represented three.js, clears the jury's HARD Canvas2D ban) · **HRTF binaural spatialization + two-hand gestural conducting of a FIXED voice field with persistent re-sculpting** technique · **sacred-ambient installation vibe** (cool violet bed warming to conductor's gold). **What if you stood at the center of a fixed constellation of ~18 HRTF-spatialized choir voices and CONDUCTED it with your bare hands — reach toward a section to swell it, spread your arms to bloom the whole choir open, bring your hands together to collapse it to a tight resolved cluster, and pinch-and-fling a single voice across the room where it STAYS, permanently re-sculpting the field?** Answers **JURY 2026-06-22 #2** ("build the embodied/spatial prototype the lab keeps deferring — a pose-driven spatial-audio room"; body 1×/depth 0×, the coldest category) + **#1** (hard-ban Canvas2D, force a GPU surface). Each of ~18 voices = two detuned saws → bandpass **formant** (vowel) → lowpass brightness → its own `PannerNode` (`panningModel="HRTF"`) on a shell around a listener fixed at origin (looking −Z); hand "magnets" swell+lean the nearest voices, spread/together opens/collapses the whole field, **pinch** grabs the nearest voice and `setTargetAtTime`-glides it to its new home — you HEAR it fly around your head. Master: sum → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter → master ≤0.28. Raw WebGL2 additive billboarded glow point-sprites (hand-rolled perspective) + glowing hand cursors; **auto-demo** (two virtual hands gesture/spread/pinch on their own) + mouse fallback so it's fully demoable with **no webcam**; `text-rose-300` notice on camera/WebGL2 failure; full teardown (rAF + camera tracks + `AudioContext.close()` + GL buffers/programs/textures). **Differs from `677-presence-field`** (which attaches a voice to each body JOINT — sources follow your limbs): here voices are PINNED and the hands sculpt the fixed field. **No API route → no `guard`; zero new npm deps** (MediaPipe via CDN `webpackIgnore`, never bundled/in package.json). Ambition honest **2/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [camera hand-tracking + HRTF spatial-audio field + raw-WebGL2 render + gesture-sculpting engine = 4] · #3 named refs [object-/scene-based spatial audio; **Janet Cardiff & George Bures Miller, *The Forty Part Motet* (2001)** — 40-channel Tallis *Spem in Alium* you walk among, inverted here to a still listener moving the voices]). **Source:** JURY #2 → RESEARCH §517 (webcam-MediaPipe head/hand-tracked browser binaural — listener pose drives the WebAudio `AudioListener` over a fixed HRTF field) → adult **DEEP** fire. **Diversity:** `banned (audit, last 10 = 849,847,846,842,841,837,834,833,828,827)=[Canvas2D OUTPUT (HARD jury ban) · touch+mic-only INPUT · always-consonant-morph kids template]` · `picked (winner 853)=[bare-hand-tracking INPUT (body, starved) · raw WebGL2 OUTPUT (scarcest GPU) · HRTF spatial-sculpting TECH · adult installation VIBE]` — clears every ban. **DEEP siblings (banked, IDEAS §517):** `852-motet-room-walk` ⭐ (MediaPipe Pose — physically WALK the listener through the fixed oval; three.js; the literal Cardiff gallery walk; **top adult RESURRECT-FIRST**) + `854-motet-room-lean` (MediaPipe FaceLandmarker head-tracking — turn your head, the field stays world-anchored; true head-tracked binaural; three.js) — both built complete + verified clean, removed before the winner-only build (not committed), full briefs in IDEAS §517. ⚠️ **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build`: **`✓ Compiled successfully in 98s` → Linting + type-check PASS → reached `Collecting page data`**; **853 folder grep-clean of the build log** — zero references, every warning pre-existing `src/lib/**`; no `any`/`@ts-ignore`/`use*`-helper/api-route); **NOT browser/device-verified** — the standing container ~4096-fd `EMFILE` at `next-font-manifest.json` blocks static-gen (infra, fails identically on pristine `main` every cycle since 471; Vercel deploys normally). Because the Lorenz trajectory is aperiodic it never settles — the instrument *weathers*. **(2) Hebbian self-rewiring edges** — each edge carries a live weight: when both endpoints are energetic the edge potentiates ("fire together, wire together"); idle edges decay toward a non-zero floor (`[0.12, 1.0]` clamp) — *seldom-used links die, heavily-used links strengthen* — and the live weights both drive the coupling gains and set the edge brightness on screen, so you **watch** the graph rewire. **(3) Autonomous seeding** — every ~5.5s a gentle impulse is fired into the lowest-energy node so the ecology never dies (tapping a node still perturbs it, but it is not the primary input). **GPU render (raw WebGL2):** additive point-sprite node blobs (size/brightness ∝ energy, 820's per-node palette), GPU `LINES` edges whose alpha ∝ live Hebbian weight × signal flow, a **ping-pong FBO feedback-trail accumulation** (fade-and-feed-back each frame so energy leaves luminous decaying trails — the "David Tudor feedback ecosystem" look Canvas2D can't do cheaply, and thematically apt for a feedback instrument), plus a faint drifting Lorenz "weather" point-cloud + background tint so the autonomous drift is visible as well as audible. ## (Cycle 511 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/837-quasicrystal](/dream/837-quasicrystal)** — Quasicrystal 🔷. `demoable` · Cycle 511 (adult / generative / long-form / clinical-crystalline). **For**: adults · **autonomous-generative input** (it plays itself; you tune tempo / φ-inflation / traversal / reseed — NOT a touch-performance, off the over-represented touch tag) · **Canvas2D pentagrid-tiling output** (deep-near-black ground, cyan fat-rhomb + violet thin-rhomb glowing edges, Ikeda crystalline) · **de Bruijn pentagrid → Penrose P3 aperiodic tiling → aperiodic-order music** technique (grep-0× — the lab's FIRST aperiodic/quasicrystal composition) · **geometric crystalline / Ryoji-Ikeda vibe**. **What if a piece of music had the structure of a quasicrystal — perfectly ordered, self-similar, yet NEVER exactly repeating — so it can play for an hour and stay coherent without ever looping?** A real **de Bruijn pentagrid** (5 line-families at 36° steps, offsets γ₀…γ₄) is dual-transformed into a true **Penrose P3 rhomb tiling** with exact 5-fold symmetry and provable aperiodicity — fat rhombs (|j−k|=1,4) and thin rhombs (|j−k|=2,3). A **traversal** (spiral / sweep / growth-front) visits each tile and sonifies it: the 7 Penrose **vertex configurations** (sun/star/ace/deuce/jack/king/queen) map to **just-intonation ratios** (sun→1/1, queen→3/2, king→4/3, jack→5/4, star→6/5, deuce→**7/4** harmonic seventh, ace→9/8), register rises with distance from center, fat rhombs use warm additive partials (1f·2f·3f) and thin rhombs bright partials + FM shimmer, over a slow drone that shifts as the traversal travels outward. Because the tiling is aperiodic but built from a finite local vocabulary, the line is **non-repeating yet self-similar** — motifs recur transposed and re-spaced but the exact sequence never returns, so it's genuinely different at minute 5 than minute 1 (the lab is thin on true **long-form generative**). **φ-inflation** zooms the world by powers of φ=(1+√5)/2 — the same patterns reappear at larger scale, a slow harmonic-rhythm change. An in-app **Design Notes** overlay explains the tiling, the mapping, and why it never repeats. Voices glide with `setTargetAtTime`/ramps (no clicks); master `gain → DynamicsCompressor → destination`, modest gain; gesture-gated AudioContext; full teardown (rAF + `audioCtx.dispose()`). **Degrades:** no Web Audio → `text-rose-300` notice, the crystal still grows silently. **No API route → no `guard`** (fully client-side, no samples/network/recording); **zero new npm deps** (Canvas2D, NOT three.js). Each ~20 Hz frame, `readPixels` samples the actual mixed pixels under the blob centroid → HSV → drives a live, always-in-tune chord over a fixed C+G pad: **warm/gold → bright major/add9 · green/teal → open sus · blue/violet → tender minor · magenta → dreamy maj7**, with saturation→richness and value→brightness, all gliding click-free via `setTargetAtTime` (voices never retrigger). So the heard chord **exactly equals the seen mixed color** — the child paints harmony, never a wrong note (the fixed center holds it in tune; color shapes only quality + richness). The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-21 #4** (kill the kids "pentatonic-never-wrong" crutch — let harmony be *shaped*) and **#5** (ship a banked sibling — this is the §508 ⭐ RESURRECT-FIRST `829-kids-color-blend`, rebuilt and upgraded from approximate RGB blend to physically-correct pigment optics + real GPU pixel-readback). ## (Cycle 509 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/833-spectral-loom](/dream/833-spectral-loom)** — Spectral Loom ❄️🎨. `demoable` · Cycle 509 (adult / clinical-Ikeda / live-performance). **For**: adults · **live-mic input** (rests his recording — the material is the *visitor's* own sound; the visitor, not a stored file) · **Canvas2D spectrogram output** (cool monochrome→cyan/violet magnitude ramp, crisp grid, bright scrub-head) · **freeze-the-live-STFT → editable spectral-image buffer → additive resynth** technique · **clinical / data-instrument / Ryoji-Ikeda vibe — active not ambient**. **What if you could FREEZE your own live sound as a spectrogram *image* and then PAINT that frozen picture — smear energy sideways, brush it in and out, stretch it — and hear the picture you painted?** A live STFT (`AnalyserNode` fftSize 1024, dB→0..1, folded onto a perceptual log-frequency row grid) scrolls a rolling spectrogram; **❄ Freeze** copies the window into an editable magnitude matrix `buffer[TIME][FREQ]` — a held image. **Editing the picture edits the sound:** a soft-falloff Gaussian brush **raises/lowers** magnitude, **smear** drags spectral energy sideways in time (freeze-stretch), a **freeze-stretch slider** runs a per-frame IIR time-blur that melts transients into drones, and a **scrub head** sweeps the frozen frame with a **Loop** toggle for rhythmic re-triggering (active, never a static drone). Resynthesis = a capped **96-oscillator additive bank** reading the magnitude column under the scrub head each frame, the loudest rows mapped to oscillator freq+gain with `setTargetAtTime` smoothing (no zipper). Master `gain → lowpass ≤13.5 kHz → DynamicsCompressor → destination`. **Crucial mic-free path:** mic denied/absent → a visible `text-rose-300` notice **and** a "Use demo sound" button that routes an internally-generated evolving chord/whistle/noise through the **identical** capture→freeze→scrub pipeline, so the whole mechanic is fully demoable with no mic; the canvas animates a demo spectrogram on load (never blank, never silent). **No API route → no `guard`** (fully client-side, no samples, no network, no recording stored); **zero new npm deps**. The mesh runs **at the sample rate inside a Blob-URL `AudioWorklet`** (`worklet-source.ts`); the **audio signal IS the displacement read at fixed pickup nodes** (DC-blocked + softly saturated), and the worklet posts a downsampled field ~45×/s so **the wavefronts you see are the waveform you hear**. If `AudioWorklet` is unavailable it degrades to a matched **bank of modal resonators** (circular-membrane eigenratios 1.00·1.59·2.14·2.30·2.65…) excited per strike + a control-rate FDTD mesh for the same visual — audio/visual stay coupled either way. **Play it** via a MIDI keyboard (note-on velocity = strike force, pitch = membrane tension = wave speed = strike position), two rows of on-screen pads (toms/plates — tap several for a chord), direct taps on the head, or the A–L computer-keyboard row; status line shows "MIDI connected ✓" or an amber "no MIDI — use the pads." Pitch is the **full chromatic scale** (NOT pentatonic); higher notes tighten the head (faster waves, shorter ring) for articulation; chords = multiple strikes summed into one membrane. ## Cycle 506 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1

- **[/dream/822-kids-shape-drums](/dream/822-kids-shape-drums)** — Shape Drums 🔺🥁. `demoable` · Cycle 506 (kids, 4+). **For**: a 4-year-old on iPad/mobile · **touch input** (tap to add/cycle shapes, big turtle/rabbit speed buttons) · **Canvas2D output** (full-bleed `requestAnimationFrame` rotating polygons — off the recent three.js 799/803/805 streak; jury says Canvas2D no longer banned at 3× and the concept reads cleanly in 2D) · **polyrhythm-as-rotating-polygons / vertex-crossing scheduler** technique (grep-thin — the kids lane's FIRST shapeable-rhythm piece) · **playful, bold-saturated-on-near-black, geometric, calm-but-lively vibe**. **What if a 4-year-old could BUILD a polyrhythm by spinning shapes — choosing how many sides each shape has and how fast it spins — instead of tapping a pre-approved pentatonic scale?** 1–5 big rotating polygons sit on a dark canvas, each a bold color with glowing vertex dots; a faint trigger line crosses the top of each shape, and every time a vertex sweeps past it the shape PINGS a warm note + flashes a ripple. A triangle pings **3×/rotation**, a hexagon **6×** — so the **number of sides the child chooses IS the rhythmic subdivision**, and the **spin speed IS the tempo**. Two shapes of different side-counts spinning at related speeds (×0.5/×1/×1.5/×2 of a base tempo, snapped so they stay clean) drift in and out of phase — the child has literally *built* a 3-against-2 or 4-against-3 polyrhythm. **This is the directest answer to JURY 2026-06-21 #4** — which banned the kids lane's "pentatonic-never-wrong" crutch (6×) and asked for a piece where **harmony OR rhythm can be *shaped***. Cycle 504 answered the *harmony* half (`816-kids-tone-tower`, JI chord-stacking); 822 answers the **rhythm** half (the grep-thin register), completing the pair. Pitch is NOT the child's variable — each shape is locked to one tone of a single warm **Dadd9 stack** (D3/A3/D4/F#4/B4) so *every* combination is consonant — the child shapes the **rhythmic interplay**, never a "wrong note." **Interaction (no reading):** big round **+** (80px) adds a shape (cycles triangle→square→pentagon→hexagon, cap 5); **tap a shape** cycles its sides 3→8; **tap its center** removes it (never empty); one **giant 64px speed button per shape** (turtle/rabbit, no words) cycles the musically-related ratios. Pings fire via a per-frame **vertex-crossing edge detector** in the rAF loop; soft marimba/bell synthesis (3 detuned partials, click-free `linearRamp`-attack/`setTargetAtTime`-decay, lowpass tail, light feedback delay) + a quiet sustained pad so it's never silent — levels low, safe for a sleeping toddler. **Audio gesture-gated** ("tap to start" overlay, iOS unlock), rAF cancelled + AudioContext closed on unmount. **Degrades:** no Web Audio → visuals stay alive + a small "sound is off" notice (no throw). **No API route → no `guard`** (fully client-side, no samples, no network, no data collection); **zero new npm deps**. ## (Cycle 505 — **adult** build · DEEP, one concept × 3 feedback-synthesis approaches, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/820-feedback-ecology](/dream/820-feedback-ecology)** — Feedback Ecology 🌀. `demoable` · Cycle 505 (adult / live-performance / installation). **For**: adults · **touch/gesture input** (tap nodes to perturb; sliders for coupling + self-resonance) · **Canvas2D node-graph / phase-space output** (NOT a plain oscilloscope — the *system* is drawn) · **coupled-resonator dynamical-system / self-oscillating feedback technique** (grep-0× — the lab's FIRST feedback instrument) · **energetic, emergent, organic-but-electric vibe (deliberately NOT ambient)**. **What if an instrument were a *living dynamical system* — a network of resonators that feed each other, self-organize into emergent drones and rhythmic instabilities, and that you play by *perturbing the ecology* rather than triggering notes?** Eight high-Q `BiquadFilter` resonators each sit inside a tight feedback loop (`filter → delay → feedbackGain → filter`), wired into a **small-world coupling graph** (ring backbone weight 0.7 + cross-link shortcuts 0.4). Above a coupling threshold the network **bifurcates**: low coupling = isolated pings; mid = nodes entrain and beat into polyrhythmic textures; high = a roaring emergent drone with energy visibly circulating the ring. It is genuinely **non-stationary — minute 2 differs from minute 0** because the coupled resonators exchange energy asymmetrically and drift across operating points over time (the long-form-stateful register the lab is thin on, and the exact thing JURY 2026-06-21 flagged missing from pruning-candidate `805`: "no state that makes minute 5 differ from minute 1"). **Interaction:** Awaken → tap a node to inject an excitation impulse (watch energy propagate), tap empty space to seed all nodes, **coupling slider** = the bifurcation control, **self-resonance slider** = the edge-of-chaos control, three tuning presets (overtone JI on A1 55 Hz / subharmonic utonal / tight cluster). **Visualizer** makes the dynamical system legible: node size+glow = live RMS energy, **edge flow-particles** = coupling × signal transfer (energy moving around the ring), a **phase-space Lissajous trace inside each node** = its limit cycle/attractor, a bottom energy strip = per-node activity over time. **Ear-safety** (this is a self-oscillating instrument — it *will* try to get loud): all eight paths converge into one brick-wall `DynamicsCompressorNode` (−8 dB, ratio 20, 1 ms attack) → master gain (default 0.25); per-node self-feedback hard-clamped at 0.88 (above this it diverges to digital noise, not music), cross-coupling clamped at 0.35/edge; **no auto-start** (AudioContext resumes only on the "Awaken the Ecology" tap, iOS unlock), a 2 s gentle ramp-up on start, an always-visible **Panic/Mute** that ramps to silence in 10 ms. **Degrades:** three.js/WebGL not needed (Canvas2D); no Web Audio → readable notice. **No API route → no `guard`** (fully client-side, no samples, no recordings, no external API — the sound is *only* feedback); **zero new npm deps**. ## (Cycle 504 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1)

- **[/dream/816-kids-tone-tower](/dream/816-kids-tone-tower)** — Tone Tower 🧱🎶. `demoable` · Cycle 504 (kids, 4+). **For**: a 4-year-old on iPad/mobile · **touch input** (tap/drag to stack) · **animated SVG/DOM output** (glowing blocks, gaussian-glow filters, CSS topple — NOT Canvas2D, NOT three.js) · **vertical interval-stacking → just-intonation chord construction** technique (grep-0×) · **warm cream nursery, bold saturated, calm-playful vibe**. **What if a 4-year-old could build a CHORD by stacking blocks — genuinely SHAPING the harmony, not just triggering pre-approved notes?** A glowing tower sits on a cream play area; the bottom block is a soft ~F3 root, and each block the child stacks sits a musical **interval** above the one below. The size of the vertical gap the child drags **chooses the interval** — normalized to 0..1200 cents and **snapped to the nearest entry in a just-intonation consonance lattice** (`harmony.ts`: unison 1/1 · maj2 9/8 · min3 6/5 · maj3 5/4 · P4 4/3 · P5 3/2 · maj6 5/3 · octave 2/1). Because every entry is a small-whole-number ratio, **any** stack is consonant and never harsh — but the child genuinely controls open-vs-close, simple-vs-rich, bright-vs-dark. **This is the directest answer to JURY 2026-06-21's kids verdict** — which BANNED "pentatonic-never-wrong as the kids harmonic crutch" (6×) and the "UPIC pitch-painter" (3×) and demanded "a kids piece where harmony or rhythm can be *shaped*, not one where every note is pre-approved." Tone Tower is harmony *shaped* by the child's gesture, off both banned tags. **Interaction:** drag-up to drop a block (a dotted reach-line + ghost block preview the placement live); a plain tap drops a friendly warm third; **▶** strums the tower bottom→top; **💥** topples it with a downward gliss + sparkle, then re-seeds — no fail states, no reading, color is the only language (unison gold → octave magenta-rose), voices cap at 8. **Audio** (`audio.ts`): kids-safe chain `gain 0.28 → lowpass 7000 → DynamicsCompressor`, warm triangle+sine voices with ~50ms attacks, an always-on soft ambient pad, a looping arpeggio so a hands-off glance is sounding on load; AudioContext resumed inside the first tap (iOS), full teardown on unmount. **Degrades:** no Web Audio → visible rose-700 notice, visuals stay fully alive. **No API route → no `guard`** (fully client-side); **zero new npm deps**. Ambition honest **3/5** (#1 **vertical interval-stacking chord-construction** — grep-0×, harmony-shaping is a thin kids register · #2 ≥3 subsystems [touch-stack interaction + JI lattice gap→cents→ratio engine + arpeggiator/strum synth + animated SVG render = 4] · #3 named refs [**Friedrich Froebel's "Gifts"** — the original kindergarten building blocks · **uCue**, Interaction Design and Children 2025/ACM — a children's musical interface with harmony layers of "common and unusual harmonizations" · **Harry Partch tonality-diamond just-intonation lattice**]). **Source:** JURY 2026-06-21 kids verdict (ban pentatonic-crutch + UPIC; "let harmony be shaped") → RESEARCH §504 (uCue children's-harmony-shaping anchor) → this kids **WIDE** fire. Winner of a 3-explorer fire; banked **`817-kids-clap-back-band`** (mic clap-onset → WebGL2; the child's own clapped rhythm becomes the band's groove — Orff echo-clapping; de-selected for rhyming with the recent `773-parade-caller` rhythm-capture) + **`818-kids-pendulum-choir`** (touch-release pendulum-wave polyrhythm on audio-forward SVG — Harvard pendulum wave / OSZILOT / Ligeti *Poème Symphonique*; de-selected for leaning on a D-pentatonic chime palette, the jury-banned crutch) as **IDEAS §504**. ⚠️ **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build`: **`✓ Compiled successfully in 42s` → Linting and checking validity of types ✓ → Collecting page data**; **816 folder grep-clean** of the build log — zero warnings/errors; only pre-existing `src/lib/**` warnings remain; the builder also verified `tsc --strict --noUnusedLocals --noUnusedParameters` clean on its files); **NOT browser/ear-verified** — the standing container ~4096-fd `EMFILE` at `next-font-manifest.json` blocks static-gen (**infra, fails identically on pristine main, NOT the code**; Vercel deploys normally); unverified by eye/ear: whether a 4-year-old reads "drag higher = a wider, brighter chord" without instruction, and whether the JI stacks sound as warm on a real device as intended (the looping arpeggio + seeded triad guarantee a sounding, glowing glance regardless).

- **[/dream/814-remembering-room](/dream/814-remembering-room)** — Remembering Room 🎹🧠. `demoable` · Cycle 503. **For**: adults / live performance / intimate · **his-recording-as-soloist input** (JURY 2026-06-20 #2 explicitly licensed this — the return-and-extend of 770) · **audio-forward DOM/CSS + small `<canvas>` output** (deliberately off the jury's **Canvas2D 10×/15 monoculture** and off a fullscreen shader — the restraint is the point) · **symbolic motif memory / Adaptive Phrase Bank** technique (grep-0× — the lab's first agent with long-form symbolic memory) · **warm / hearth-lit / meditative-duet vibe**. **What if Karel's real recorded "Welcome Home" piano plays as the SOLOIST, a machine live-music agent accompanies it AND answers in his gaps — but now the agent REMEMBERS: it keeps a growing bank of motifs (its own best answers + salient contours lifted from his playing) and over minutes develops them — transpose-into-key / augment / diminish / fragment / invert / sequence — so minute 5 is a reworking of minute 1, not fresh improvisation?** This is the lab's **first true cycle-2 of `770-answering-room`** (whose agent had **zero** long-form memory — every answer improvised fresh and forgotten), the directest hit on **JURY 2026-06-20 #2** ("the depth ceiling collapsed 4→1; RETURN AND EXTEND 770 to a real 4/5 — let the agent accrete a motif over minutes so minute 5 ≠ minute 1"). **Listener** (`listener.ts`): FFT→12-bin chroma → 24-template major/minor triad fit + tension, energy/spectral-flux, a phrase-gap state machine; **new for cycle-2** — it samples his dominant pitch-class ~9×/s and freezes a **key-independent degree-step contour** at each phrase end so the agent can *lift his gesture*. **Agent + memory engine** (`agent.ts`): a warm retuning pad under his chord + a sparse FM-bell answer that fires **only in his gaps**, PLUS the **Adaptive Phrase Bank** — motifs stored **symbolically** as `{degrees, durs}` (scale-degree steps + relative durations, key-independent so replayable in any later key), entering the bank two ways (the agent banks its own good answers; it lifts his contours); a global **memory pressure** rises over minutes (~150s constant, scaled by a slider) so early gaps get short fresh inventions and later gaps increasingly **recall** a banked motif and apply a classical development (transpose/augment/diminish/fragment/invert/sequence); a weighted pick favours under-used motifs; bank caps at 10. **Visual** (`page.tsx`): a restrained warm DOM/CSS hearth (two facing glows — *him* breathing with his energy, *the answer* lit only while answering — a faint duet thread, the detected chord name shown large) PLUS a small `<canvas>` **memory shelf** — each banked motif a glowing contour **sparkline** (amber = his lifted gestures, rose = the agent's own answers) that **flares on recall** with reuse-count dots beneath, so the long-form accretion is *legible*. Two sliders: **company** (shy↔talkative) + **memory** (invent↔recall). **Graceful degradation:** no recording fetch → an offline `OfflineAudioContext` ~16s warm lyrical fallback plays with an honest emerald "synthesized fallback" badge — the room is never silent and runs fully offline. **No API route → no `guard`** (read-only GET to the existing `/api/audio/[id]`, nothing recorded/sent); **zero new npm deps**. ## Cycle 502 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1

- **[/dream/811-kids-body-ribbons](/dream/811-kids-body-ribbons)** — Body Ribbons 🎀🕺. `demoable` · Cycle 502. **For**: kids (4+) / whole-body play · **body-tracking input** (MediaPipe Pose — the JURY's most-starved INPUT register, body/camera went **4×→0×**; off the banned touch) · **SVG/DOM output** (the jury's starved 1× surface — deliberately off **both** the banned Canvas2D **and** the **three.js 3×-in-a-row monoculture** 799→803→805) · **full-body UPIC gesture→pitch-score** technique (rests his recording) · **calm-playful warm-glow vibe** (not bright-active). **What if a 4-year-old's whole BODY is a continuous musical score — they wave their arms and dance, and their moving hands draw glowing ribbons across the screen that sing as they move, the way Xenakis's UPIC turned a child's drawing into music?** **MediaPipe Pose** (33 landmarks, lite model, runtime CDN import via `webpackIgnore` — never bundled) tracks the body; the two **wrists** are the instruments. **Wrist height → pitch** (C-major-pentatonic, 2 octaves, snapped so there are **no wrong notes**); **speed of movement → loudness + ribbon brightness** (hold still and the note softly sustains, then fades); **horizontal position → timbre** (vibrato depth); **nose → a soft shimmer voice**; **both arms raised high → a gentle gold sparkle chord**. Each wrist continuously emits a **glowing SVG ribbon trail** in its own warm color (left = amber/gold, right = rose/violet) — Catmull-Rom-smoothed cubic paths, a 2-pass gaussian-glow + bright-core render, age-faded over ~7s so the screen accretes and breathes (never a hard loop). The lab's **first full-body UPIC instrument**; the directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-20 #4** (body input 4×→0×, the single most-starved register) and **#5** (the jury named "the full-body version of 781's UPIC idea is sitting unbuilt in your own research log"). **Kid-safe audio:** `master ≤0.28 → lowpass 7000 → DynamicsCompressor(−10/20:1) → destination`; always-on C2+G2 sine drone pad; triangle voices with vibrato LFO, 80ms portamento, soft attacks / 1–3s releases; pentatonic so nothing is "wrong". **Privacy + safety:** camera frames are analysis-only — **never recorded, uploaded, or sent**; iOS gesture-gated `AudioContext` + `getUserMedia({video})` both inside the first Start tap (≥72px). **Graceful degradation:** MediaPipe loads in the background while a **ghost-body auto-demo** (`makeGhostBody`) dances + sounds hands-free within ~2s; **camera-denied → the ghost keeps playing** + a `text-rose-300` notice — a sounding, drawing screen with no permissions. Full teardown (rAF + **stop camera tracks** + `landmarker.close()` + node disconnect + `audioCtx.close()`). **No API route → no `guard`** (fully client-side); **zero new npm deps**.
