## Cycle 501 — **adult** build · DEEP, 3 resonator engines, shipped 1

- **[/dream/808-sympathetic-strings](/dream/808-sympathetic-strings)** — Sympathetic Strings 🎻🎹. `demoable` · Cycle 501. **For**: adults / live performance / intimate · **mic / live-audio input** (off the jury-banned touch) · **SVG/DOM output** (the jury's starved 1× surface — deliberately off the **three.js 3×-in-a-row monoculture** 799→803→805 AND the banned Canvas2D) · **Karplus-Strong tuned-delay-line sympathetic resonator bank** technique (rests his recording; distinct from `803`'s modal-bandpass banks) · **dark / warm / nocturnal vibe** (not bright-active kids). **What if you play or sing into your mic and exactly the right strings ring back — your sound waking an illusory bank of tuned strings that vibrate sympathetically, the way a grand piano's strings hum when you hold the sustain pedal?** 48 tuned strings, each a **real Karplus-Strong tuned delay line** (`L = sampleRate / freq`, one-pole lowpass loop filter, feedback just under 1) running in an **AudioWorklet loaded from a Blob URL** (no `/public` file). The live mic feeds all 48 delay lines; an `AnalyserNode` FFT scales each string's excitation gain by how much spectral energy sits at its pitch — so strings tuned to what you play ring, the rest stay quiet (continuous sympathetic excitation, not discrete strikes). A **mode selector** (homage to the **Electronic Audio Experiments *Prismatic Wall*** sympathetic-string pedal) retunes the bank live across **Chromatic / Stacked Fifths / Overtone Series**. **Sustain-pedal physics:** spacebar or on-screen hold drives feedback **0.92 (fast damp) ↔ 0.997 (near-lossless)**, so with the pedal held the bank **accretes a shimmering bed audibly fuller at minute 3 than second 10** (real delay-line state — the jury's depth-ceiling ask). **SVG visualization:** 48 vertical strings, each string's glow/stroke-width/wobble driven imperatively in `requestAnimationFrame` from the worklet's ~15 fps per-string RMS level reports (`port.postMessage`), `feGaussianBlur` glow, low→high amber→violet→blue hue map. The lab's **first mic-excited sympathetic-string instrument** and **first Karplus-Strong-as-shipped** (the banked `802-body-aviary` KS forest never shipped). **Audio safety:** mic source **never** routed to `destination` (no howl), worklet feedback hard-clamped ≤0.999, `DynamicsCompressor` (20:1, −18 dB) as limiter. **Graceful degradation:** mic-deny → an autonomous **ghost exciter** plucks quasi-chord groups so it rings + sounds within ~2s + `text-rose-300` notice; click/tap any string to pluck it directly; no-WebAudio → friendly rose notice. Full teardown (rAF + worklet + mic tracks + AnalyserNode + intervals + `AudioContext.close()`). **No API route → no `guard`** (fully client-side, mic stays on-device, nothing recorded/sent); **zero new npm deps**. Ambition honest **3/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [mic FFT analysis + KS tuned-delay-line worklet resonator bank + per-string spectral excitation gating + sustain-pedal feedback accretion + SVG string-field render] + #3 named refs [**EAE *Prismatic Wall*** sympathetic string resonator 2026 · **Karplus-Strong / Jaffe–Smith** CMJ 1983 · sitar *tarab* / viola d'amore · Henry Cowell string-piano] + soft-#1 mic-excited KS sympathetic bank is grep-0× + soft-#5 RESEARCH §501). Piano-native + live-performance-fit (Karel priority #3 — point a mic at his real piano and the strings answer). Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-resonator-engine fire; banked **`809-sympathetic-modes`** (FFT-gated high-Q bandpass bank — lost for rhyming with `803`'s modal banks) + **`810-sympathetic-comb`** (native feedback-comb bank — most robust, least KS-faithful; its per-comb AnalyserNode level tap worth folding into 808) as **IDEAS §501**. ⚠️ **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build`: **`✓ Compiled successfully in 102s` → Collecting page data → all code gates passed**; 808 folder fully grep-clean of the log — **zero warnings/errors** after fixing one TS 5.7 `Uint8Array<ArrayBuffer>` typing + trimming one unused var/dep; only pre-existing `src/lib/**` warnings remain); **NOT prerender/ear-verified** — the standing container ~4096-fd `EMFILE` at `next-font-manifest.json` blocks static-gen (**infra, NOT the code**; Vercel deploys normally); unverified by ear: whether sung/played pitches visibly + audibly wake their matching strings vs. a diffuse wash, and whether the pedal-held bed accretes musically rather than muddying (the always-seeded strings + ghost exciter + compressor guarantee a sounding, glowing glance regardless).

## Cycle 497 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers, shipped 1

- **[/dream/797-tonnetz-walk](/dream/797-tonnetz-walk)** — Tonnetz Walk 🎼🧭. `demoable` · Cycle 497. **For**: adults / listening · **autonomous input** (light click-to-steer; off the banned touch) · **SVG/DOM output** (the jury's starved 1× surface — the literal #1 "spread, don't flip onto a new monoculture", off the 10×-banned Canvas2D) · **Neo-Riemannian P/L/R harmony-walk** technique (rests his recording — breaks the answering-room thread) · **clinical-elegant / meditative vibe**. **What if you could WATCH harmony take a walk — a chord gliding forever through the Tonnetz lattice by smooth voice-leading, never the same path twice?** A single triad walks the **Neo-Riemannian** lattice on its own, choosing **P** (parallel) / **L** (leading-tone) / **R** (relative) transforms over time; each holds two common tones and steps the one remaining voice, so a warm 3-voice pad (portamento on the moving voice) + sub-bass + feedback-delay reverb **glides** from chord to chord rather than jumping. The luminous **path through the lattice IS the form** — a weighted, anti-backtracking, home-biased stochastic chooser means **minute 5 never resembles minute 1** (the directest standing answer to the jury's depth-ceiling-collapse alarm). Visual is **pure inline SVG**: 24 triad-triangles (major up, minor down) on the fifth/major-third axes, current node glowing, a fading trail of recent triads, the active P/L/R edge color-lit, lit pitch-class dots, mono chord labels + a live readout (chord · last transform · steps · mm:ss). Controls: **wander↔home** bias, **step** tempo, **arpeggio** toggle, and **click any triad** to steer there (BFS over the 24-triad graph) then resume wandering. Pure-synthesis — no network, no sensors, no assets. Distinct from `37-ratio-lab` (a *static* just-intonation Tonnetz you click to hear): this is an **autonomous generative walker**, motion-through-the-lattice not click-to-sound. Refs: **Euler's Tonnetz (1739)** · **Neo-Riemannian theory — Riemann / David Lewin / Richard Cohn *Audacious Euphony* 2012**. ⚠️ Compile + lint + type-check verified clean (authoritative winner-only `npm run build` `✓ Compiled` → Linting + types PASS; 797 folder grep-clean of the log); NOT prerender/ear-verified — the standing container ~4096-fd `EMFILE` blocks static-gen (pristine main fails identically; Vercel deploys normally). 2 more explored this fire (`798-sympathetic-strings` ⭐, `796-aeolian-sky`) — banked to IDEAS §497.

Each event is one grain: its **type** picks a timbre (push = soft mallet/bell, star = bright shimmer, PR = warm swell, issue = muted tom, fork/create = low bloom), a stable **repo-hash** picks a pitch in a drifting **D-Dorian** mode (same repo → same note), and a rolling 12s **rate window** swells a generative drone's density/brightness + the planet's glow. A three.js auto-rotating dark Earth (procedural graticule + scattered land-ish dots, **no external textures**) blooms an additive light at each event's deterministic pseudo geo-location (hashed from repo+actor — texture, not GIS), panned by **longitude** via `StereoPannerNode`. **live-external-data INPUT** (off jury-banned touch-primary [5×]) · **three.js OUTPUT** (renderer-coolest of the 3 candidates: 2× in rolling-10; off banned WebGL2 [4×] + banned audio-first-SVG [5×], off just-used WebGPU [683] + Canvas2D-warming [3×→would-be-4×]) · **live-data sonification → generative ambient drone + per-event voices TECH** (a living texture, emphatically NOT a harmonic-event/voice-leading cadence [banned 8×]) · **planetary-awe VIBE** (off banned hushed/tender [6×]). **Ambition honest 2/5** (`#2 + #3`): **#2** ≥3 subsystems (live-feed + synthetic-fallback engine + rolling-aggregate state + generative drone/event synth + three.js globe = 4) + **#3** named refs (**Hatnote "Listen to Wikipedia"** — LaPorte & Hashemi, the canonical live collaborative-creation firehose sonification; **github.audio**; **Brian Foo** *Data-Driven DJ*; **Refik Anadol** planetary data-as-light — all in README); **#1 NOT claimed** (live-data sonification exists in the lab at 683/437/618 — honest). **Research-first chain (RESEARCH §459, same-day, path a):** the dive selected the GitHub firehose as the unbuilt free stream + confirmed the Hatnote/Foo lineage + verified the keyless-CORS feasibility that makes the fire free + unattended-safe. **Bulletproof glance (critical for unattended 06:30 review):** a **synthetic event generator** (weighted realistic distribution — pushes common, stars frequent, PRs/issues/forks rarer) starts the instant you press Begin with **zero network**, so the planet sparks and the drone breathes immediately; ## (Cycle 458 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 divergent silly/groove/off-glass explorers)

- **[/dream/696-kids-mouth-band](/dream/696-kids-mouth-band)** — Mouth Band 🎤🥁. `demoable` · Cycle 458. **For**: kids (4+) / mic vocal-percussion (analysis-only) / Canvas2D goofy creature / silly-comedy groove. **What if a 4-year-old could build a silly drum beat just by making MOUTH NOISES — boom, tss, pop, brrr — and a goofy creature caught each one, looped it, and bopped to it?** The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-17 #5** ("MAKE A KID LAUGH — the silly/funny pole is now 0×, the kids side has gone uniformly solemn") and **#1** ("groove, not a cadence — the harmonic-event/voice-leading technique is the new pentatonic, banned on the kids side for a week"). **The instrument:** the mic feeds an `AnalyserNode` (analysis only — never recorded/stored/sent); a per-frame **RMS energy-onset gate** (rise over recent average + noise floor + ~110ms refractory) catches each mouth-noise, then a **spectral-centroid + low/mid/high band-fraction** heuristic classifies it into 4 color-coded silly drum voices — **KICK/"boom"** (red), **SNARE/"pop"** (yellow, the safe catch-all), **HIHAT/"tss"** (cyan), **BRRR/raspberry** (purple). Each onset fires its punchy synth immediately (sub-35ms target) **and** quantizes into a 16-step loop replayed by a Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler at 100 BPM — so a few mouth noises become a repeating beat. A big cartoon mouth-creature opens wide, bugs its eyes, squashes/bounces and flashes the voice color on every hit; a bottom step-strip shows the loop with a moving playhead. **mic / vocal-percussion INPUT** (off the jury-banned touch-primary [5×]; serves KIDS.md's explicit *vocalization* goal) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (jury noted Canvas2D's ban "worked cleanly," 4×→2×, now a cold/safe renderer; off banned WebGL2 [4×] + banned audio-first-SVG [5×]) · **real-time vocal-percussion onset+spectral-classification → looping groove TECH** (a real groove, emphatically NOT a harmonic event / voice-leading [banned 8×, 6× on kids]) · **silly/comedy/bright-primary VIBE** (off banned hushed/tender [6×]; the *subject is a joke and a beat*, not a cadence). **Ambition honest 2/5** (`#2 + #3`, with a qualified #1): **#2** ≥3 subsystems (mic onset+centroid classifier + look-ahead loop/groove scheduler + comedy drum synth + Canvas2D creature = 4) + **#3** named refs (**Incredibox**; **Hazan & Stowell**, *Delayed Decision-making in Real-time Beatbox Percussion Classification*, JNMR 2010; the **AVP dataset**, Mehrabi et al., Audio Mostly 2019 — all in README); **#1 qualified** (first real-time vocal-percussion *classification into drum voices* in the lab — "spectral centroid" exists only in visualizers [246/285/19], not as a beatbox classifier). **Research-first chain (RESEARCH §458, same-day, path a):** the dive surfaced Incredibox + the beatbox-onset-classification literature → the recipe *is* this prototype's classifier. **Kid-safe chain:** `voices → masterGain(0.28) → lowpass(7.5kHz) → DynamicsCompressor(-10, 20:1, fast attack — brick-wall limiter) → destination`; always-on soft ambient bed so it never feels broken; the analyser is *not* wired to output (no echo of the child's voice). **Robustness (bulletproof 06:30 glance):** **mic denied/unavailable → a ghost auto-beatboxes a silly groove** into the loop on its own (still funny + grooving) with a `text-rose-300` notice; mic-on-but-idle >2.5s → an auto-demo lick; so a sensorless/silent glance is always alive and sounding. iOS AudioContext + getUserMedia both requested inside the START gesture (AGC/noise-suppression disabled to keep onsets crisp). Full unmount teardown (rAF cancel, scheduler timer cleared, mic tracks stopped, AudioContext closed). **No API route → no guard** (pure client Web Audio + Canvas2D; no network call, no secret, no side effect). No new npm deps. **Build-verified** (winner-only authoritative `npm run build` **exit 0, ✓ Compiled successfully in 43s, ✓ Generating static pages (495/495)** [494 from cycle 457 + 696 = 495, confirming non-winners 697/698 absent], `/dream/696-kids-mouth-band 4.65 kB / 111 kB` prerendered static ○). **NOT browser-verified** (no mic/audio in sandbox — unverified by ear: whether the 4-bucket classifier reliably tells a child's "boom" from "brrr" and "pop" from "tss" on real device mics [mitigated: wide thresholds + mid-burst SNARE default so misclassification still sounds musical, never "wrong"], onset-gate sensitivity per device mic gain, and iOS unlock; the ghost auto-beatbox + ambient bed guarantee a live, sounding glance regardless). **Honest limit:** a heuristic spectral classifier on untrained 4-year-old mouth noises *will* misfire at the KICK/BRRR and SNARE/HIHAT boundaries — by design nothing reads as a failure (every hit is a drum, the beat keeps grooving). Winner of a kids **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three off-glass silly/groove machines, different embodied input × renderer × comedy mechanic): banked **`698-kids-dance-mirror`** ⭐ (dance in front of the webcam → a DOM/CSS character mirrors & exaggerates you + **freeze-dance comedy**; camera analysis-only — the directest "get off the glass," revives the jury-named abandoned 652 dance register, freshest DOM/CSS renderer) + **`697-kids-shake-circus`** (shake the tablet → a three.js jelly clown squashes/boings + confetti POP; Pixar squash-&-stretch) as **IDEAS §458**. Each player picks their own **subdivision (8 / 12 / 16)**, so independent patterns overlaid on the *same* rotating clock produce **emergent polyrhythm + phasing** (a 12-against-8 cross-rhythm, a 16-note shaker shimmer drifting against a 3-feel bell line). West-African *gankogui*/clave timeline — the default ghost bell uses the classic 12/8 timeline; The Hub lineage — all in README); **#1 NOT claimed** (BroadcastChannel/multi-user already exists in 319/334/341 — honest). **Robustness (bulletproof 06:30 glance):** open alone → after ~3s two **ghost players** join with complementary subdivisions (a 12/8 bell timeline + 8-feel pulse + 16-note shaker) so a lone visitor hears a living polyrhythm; ## (Cycle 456 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 divergent harmonic-event explorers, one off-glass)

- **[/dream/690-kids-weather-hands](/dream/690-kids-weather-hands)** — Weather in Your Hands ☀️⛈️. `demoable` · Cycle 456. **For**: kids (4+) / off-glass embodied (tilt + motion + mic energy) / audio-first / weather vibe. **What if a 4-year-old could change the *feeling* of music with their whole body — no touching the screen — and hear sunshine turn to storm and back?** The lab's directest hit on **JURY 2026-06-16 #2** ("get off the glass — 13 of 15 render to a screen; the 2 that aren't are the best things here") *and* **#1** ("a real harmonic event, not the pentatonic crutch") at once. **The piece:** hold the tablet like a tray, eyes off the glass; three input subsystems — `DeviceOrientation` tilt + `DeviceMotion` acceleration + mic RMS — fuse into ONE "energy" axis (calm=0 → wild=1). That axis drives a continuous **major↔minor mode-morph** in Web Audio: over a fixed root (A2) + perfect-fifth drone, the **third literally bends** (M3 +4 → m3 +3, an *audible moving pitch*) and the **sixth crossfades** (M6 +9 → m6 +8), a bright Lydian #11 sparkle fading out as a tense ♭7 + filtered rain/wind fade in. Calm = a sunny major world; sway/shake/hum = the harmony darkens into storm; settle = it glides back to sun. ## (Cycle 447 — **adult** build · DEEP, one cycle-4 concept via 3 renderer/interaction approaches)

- **[/dream/666-piano-still](/dream/666-piano-still)** — Still Room 🕯️🎹. `demoable` · Cycle 447. **For**: adult / **off-screen, eyes-closed** / audio-first / tender-intimate / tap-to-place. **What if Karel's solo piano — isolated down to its 12 pitch classes — became an AUDIO-FIRST instrument you sit inside: place a few of his notes into a slow loop, then close your eyes while it grows itself over minutes in his own timbre, quietly adding consonant notes and letting others fade?** The lab's **first genuine cycle-4** (`606 vivisection → 630 refract → 643 constellation → 666 still`) — the multi-cycle deepening two juries say the lab banks and abandons, now pushed to a fourth turn — AND the directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-16's Karel-facing line + provocation #2**: "get at least one builder off the glass screen (13 of 15 are screens; the 2 that aren't are the best things here)." Still Room is **audio-first** — the music is the whole point; the visual is one quiet **SVG** aura (a breathing center that brightens as more notes ring, markers for the notes in the loop, a slow phrase-position dot) designed to be glanced at then *ignored*. **What it does that 643 did NOT:** (1) **RECORD** — tap any of his 12 notes to *place* it into a ~16s looping phrase (8 slow slots); each pass re-fires that note's isolated material as a long tender grain of his real touch. (2) **EVOLVE over minutes** — genuine long-form state, not a loop: a continuous **decay** (presence half-life ~90s; un-refreshed notes fade and drop out, refreshed ones top up and stay) + a **generative growth** layer, so minute 5 ≠ minute 0. **The growth rule — asymmetric consonance (the anti-pentatonic move):** every several seconds the room buds ONE new note, *chosen* not scale-snapped — `consonance.ts` scores all 12 pitch classes against the currently-ringing set by a harmonic-coincidence base (`1/log2(n·d+1)` over JI ratios: fifth 0.356 > 4th 0.270 > M3 0.228 > m2 0.126 > tritone 0.095) **plus a small directional asymmetry term** (C→G leans −0.016 vs C→F +0.016) so an interval and its inversion differ, then **softmax-samples from the top** (top ~2 at stillness → top ~6 at growth). Anchored on **De Roure, "An Asymmetric Formula for Interval Consonance," arXiv:2606.16412 (2026)** — dated cycle-day (RESEARCH §447). The one `stillness ↔ growth` lever sets both bud rate (~14s → ~5s) and sampling width; a **release** button halves everyone's presence to empty the room gracefully (the optional gathering → presence → release ritual arc). **no-sensor INPUT** (dead-simple 12-note tap row — deliberately calm) · **audio-first / minimal SVG OUTPUT** (the **scarcest** renderer — off-glass, off the jury-banned **Canvas2D 4×**, and the lane the jury says is the lab's best) · **asymmetric-consonance generative growth + grain-replay-of-Karel's-isolated-notes TECH** (emphatically NOT pentatonic/scale-snap — the named local minimum) · **tender / intimate / Eno-ambient VIBE** (the un-built adult register the jury named in provocation #5). **Ambition honest 3/5:** **#1** first looper / phrase-memory built from a *performer's own isolated pitch classes* + first asymmetric-consonance generative growth in the lab (grep-clean) · **#2** ≥3 subsystems (4: HPSS+salience 12-pitch-class isolation [reused 643 engine] · phrase-memory looper with continuous decay/refresh · asymmetric-consonance growth chooser · grain-replay synth + SVG aura) · **#4** genuine cycle-4 (the deepest multi-cycle thread the lab has finished) · **#5** binds RESEARCH §447 (De Roure, arXiv:2606.16412, dated 2026-06-16 — research→build chain is same-day). **#3** named refs that frame it (Brian Eno *Music for Airports* / *Discreet Music*; Éliane Radigue; La Monte Young *The Well-Tuned Piano*). **Reused verbatim** (copied in, NOT cross-imported): `audio.ts`/`hpss.ts`/`chroma.ts` from 643 (Karel's *Welcome Home* recording via the read-only `/api/audio/549fc519-…` route + synth fallback). New work: `consonance.ts` (the growth brain) + the looper/decay/SVG aura in `page.tsx`. **No API route, no guard** (pure client Web Audio + SVG; READ-only of the existing public `/api/audio` route, used exactly as 630/643/658 — no network secret). No new npm deps, no three.js. **Build-verified** (winner-only authoritative `npm ci` → `npm run build` **exit 0, ✓ Compiled successfully in 2.0 min, ✓ Generating static pages (483/483)** [confirming both non-winners absent], `/dream/666-piano-still 7.44 kB / 110 kB First Load` prerendered static ○; `.next/server/app/dream/666-piano-still.html` emitted). **NOT browser-verified** (no audio in sandbox — unverified by ear: whether `/api/audio/549fc519-…` returns his recording at runtime [synth fallback covers any failure], whether the grain timbre + decay/growth pacing read as tender over minutes on real speakers, and iOS AudioContext unlock; the auto-seed-on-load means a silent 06:30 glance hears the room evolving once unlocked with one tap). Winner of an adult **DEEP** fire (one cycle-4 concept — "the piano remembers you" — via 3 renderer/interaction approaches): banked **`665-piano-loom`** (the same looper as a **raw WebGL2 scrolling phrase-tape** — the most legible "looper" visual; resurrect FIRST for the cycle-4 piano looper as an ON-glass immersive piece) + **`667-piano-tide`** (the same looper as a **three.js reflective ripple pool**; beautiful/immersive but closest to 643's own renderer family) as **IDEAS §447**. ## (Cycle 446 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers all attacking JURY #1 "ban the pentatonic crutch")

- **[/dream/662-kids-gamelan-bend](/dream/662-kids-gamelan-bend)** — Bronze Bend 🔔. `demoable` · Cycle 446. **For**: kids (4+) / touch-bend + big laras toggle / WebGL2 bronze field (Canvas2D fallback) / temple-dusk. **What if a 4-year-old could grab a glowing bar of bronze and BEND its pitch across a real Indonesian gamelan tuning — and discover that a note that sounds "wrong" can settle into something beautiful?** The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-16 provocation #1** — "ban pentatonic / no-wrong-notes on the kids side… build a kids piece where a child *hears* a real harmonic event — a non-Western tuning (gamelan slendro, maqam) they can audibly bend; let them meet a wrong note and discover it isn't scary." The lab has BP / JI / Lydian kids tuning toys (`288`/`286`/`280`) but **never gamelan, and never bend-into-and-out-of-tune as the core mechanic.** **The instrument:** five glowing bronze metallophone keys in a temple-dusk field; **touch a bar to strike it**; **drag up/down to bend its pitch continuously** (±300 cents, NO scale-snap — a child slides a tone clearly past a neighbour and back); **release** and it springs slowly home toward its in-tune (*laras*) pitch. **The big sun/moon button** re-tunes the WHOLE instrument + the gong drone between two real gamelan tunings at once — ☀ **slendro** (`0,231,474,717,955` cents — open, floating) ⇄ 🌙 **pélog** (`0,120,270,540,670` — the ~120-cent half-step makes it tense). **The two real harmonic events (audible, not pentatonic-snap):** (1) the laras flip changes the instrument's whole *mood* by ear; (2) the bend lets the child meet a genuine out-of-tune note that **beats** against its neighbours — and as it settles home the metallic **shimmer slows** (in tune ≈0.6 Hz beating / fully bent ≈6 Hz), teaching consonance↔dissonance pre-verbally. **Core technique — inharmonic modal bronze synthesis (lab-first):** each key is additive sine partials at bar-mode-like STRETCHED ratios **1, 2.76, 5.40, 8.93** (not integer harmonics), every partial rendered as two slightly-detuned voices so the pair beats — the signature struck-bronze shimmer; struck envelope (~6ms attack / ~3.4s ring); the low gong drone uses the same recipe an octave down and glides its upper partial on a laras flip so the re-tune is felt underneath. **touch-bend INPUT** (off the jury-banned glass-control reflex — the touch here is *expressive pitch-bending*, not button-poking) · **WebGL2 OUTPUT** (a fullscreen fragment shader: bronze/teal ground, heat-haze shimmer, additive strike glow, in-tune gold "crown" rim, restless flicker out-of-tune — explicitly **OFF the jury-banned Canvas2D 4×**, which is fallback-only) · **inharmonic-modal-bronze + gamelan-bend TECH** (never used in the lab; emphatically NOT pentatonic/scale-snap — the named local minimum) · **bronze/temple-dusk VIBE** (deliberately OFF the jury-banned warm/cozy-kids pole 4×). **Ambition honest 3/5:** **#1** never-used technique (inharmonic modal bronze synthesis — grep-clean; the hardest criterion to claim) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (4: touch-bend physics with spring-back · inharmonic additive synth with bend-driven beating · the laras toggle re-tuning every key + drone · WebGL2 shader renderer + Canvas2D twin) + **#3** named refs that DRIVE it (Ableton's **"Tune a Gamelan Yourself"** interactive Sundanese tuner — this cycle's research dive — + Javanese **slendro/pélog laras** + the inharmonic bar-mode acoustics of saron/gendér). **#4 NOT claimed** (single-cycle WIDE; but a clean cycle-2 exists: add *maqam*/other laras, or a "tune the gamelan yourself" mode where the child sets each cent). **#5 NOT hard-claimed** (the gamelan tuner is a living reference resource, not a <30-day arXiv drop — path (a): research→build, not a freshness claim). Born from **RESEARCH §446** (same fire). **Kid-safe chain** (`master gain → lowpass 7.2 kHz → DynamicsCompressor brick-wall → destination`; ~6ms soft strike attack, no harsh transients; always-on gong drone faded in on unlock). **Graceful degradation / glance:** before audio, keys flicker so the field moves; once unlocked + untouched, a gentle scripted shimmer-strike auto-demo plays hands-free so a silent 06:30 glance is alive; **no WebGL2 → Canvas2D fallback** that still shimmers + sings + bends, with a `text-rose-300` note; AudioContext created/resumed inside the first gesture (iOS unlock); full unmount cleanup (rAF cancelled, GL disposed, nodes disconnected, context closed). **No API route, no guard** (pure client Web Audio + WebGL2; zero network/secret). No new npm deps, no three.js. **Build-verified** (winner-only authoritative `npm run build` **exit 0, ✓ Compiled successfully in 37.9s, zero warnings**, `/dream/662-kids-gamelan-bend 5.97 kB / 109 kB First Load` prerendered static ○; non-winner folders confirmed absent). **NOT browser-verified** (no real audio/WebGL2/touch in sandbox — unverified by ear/hand: whether the bronze inharmonic timbre + bend-beating read as intended on real speakers, whether ±300-cent bend sensitivity + spring-back feel right for a real child, and iOS WebGL2 + AudioContext unlock; the auto-demo + Canvas2D fallback guarantee it performs on a glance — note iOS has WebGL2 so the full shader runs on iPad). Winner of a kids **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (all attacking JURY #1 via orthogonal harmonic events): banked **`663-kids-two-suns`** (tilt a moon between two suns → a continuous **major↔minor mode-morph** you hear bend, inline-SVG; the fast "mode-morph" resurrect) + **`664-kids-hum-answer`** ⭐ (the fire's **off-the-glass builder**, JURY #2 — hum a note, an unseen choir answers with a **4–3 suspension that resolves**, audio-FIRST/eyes-closed; PRIORITY off-glass resurrect since the screen-monoculture metric still needs a SHIP) as **IDEAS §446**. - **[/dream/655-breath-sanctuary](/dream/655-breath-sanctuary)** — Breath Sanctuary 🌬️🕯️. `demoable` · Cycle 443. **For**: adult / off-screen / eyes-closed / ritual-ceremonial / breath-steered. **What if Resonance could be experienced with your EYES CLOSED — a ceremonial sound-space you steer with your BREATH alone?** The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-15 provocation #3** ("Don't let 626 become the next 576 — build the THIRD embodied/non-screen piece NOW"), and the highest-leverage move against the lab's deepest structural problem the jury names: **14-of-15 recent prototypes render to a glass screen** — off-screen/audio-first was exactly 1× (626). This is the lab's **2nd-after-626 audio-FIRST piece** and a **ritual** journey-engine alternative Karel explicitly asked for. **Input — BREATH via the mic (amplitude only, NO pitch):** `getUserMedia` → lowpass ~1.2 kHz → `AnalyserNode` → time-domain RMS → a slow attack/slower-release **envelope follower** tracking the swell (inhale) and ebb (exhale); a rising-then-falling envelope above threshold fires a **peak** (strike a bowl) and counts a **breath cycle** (drives the arc). Mic routes ONLY to the analyser — no output path, **no howl risk** even on speakers. **Sound (≥3 subsystems → 4):** (1) a **just-intonation overtone choir** — stacked sine partials at pure ratios `1, 9/8, 5/4, 4/3, 3/2, 5/3, 15/8, 2` (beat-free), each with its own slow amplitude LFO so it shimmers; breath energy swells loudness + opens a brightness lowpass; upper partials gated by the arc's "openness"; (2) **struck singing-bowl resonators** — a damped modal model, a few *inharmonic* partials per bowl with long (~5.5–12 s) exponential decay, struck at the top of each breath, ringing into a feedback-delay tail; (3) a **breath-RMS envelope follower** (the input layer); (4) a **long-form ritual STATE MACHINE**. **The stateful arc (≥5 min, NOT a loop):** four phases — **Gathering → Invocation → Presence → Release** — each advanced only when BOTH a breath count AND a time gate are met, so minute 5 ≠ minute 1: the **fundamental drifts down a fifth** (C2 → ~43.6 Hz), **more overtones enter**, the **bowl set rotates**, the **tail lengthens**, and the halo's **hue drifts** violet→cyan. **Visual — minimal, audio-first (SVG, no WebGL):** a single faint breathing halo (radius + opacity follow the breath envelope, hue follows the phase) + sparse readable text (phase name · instruction · breath/time counter); everything else dark — the point is to look away. **mic-breath INPUT** (FRESH — mic 0× in the rolling-10; breath-as-control is a cross-modal sensor the lab hadn't used; off the jury-banned **touch 5×**) · **audio-only/off-screen OUTPUT** with a faint SVG halo (the SCARCEST renderer — off the jury-banned **WebGPU 6×** AND the hot **three.js 3× / Canvas2D 3×**) · **long-form JI ritual + breath-envelope TECH** (not sonification, not a sim, not the banned physical-feed template) · **ritual/ceremonial VIBE** (off BOTH banned poles — sacred/spacious, neither the adult doom autopilot nor cozy). **Ambition honest 2–3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (4: breath-envelope follower · JI overtone choir · struck-bowl resonator bank · ritual state machine) + **#3** named refs that DRIVE it (**Pauline Oliveros — *Deep Listening* / *Sonic Meditations*** [breath-based eyes-closed listening, the direct lineage] · **La Monte Young / Theatre of Eternal Music** [JI sustained drone] · Tibetan singing bowls · the **Lyria RealTime / Live Music Models** continuous-steered-stream frame). **#1 SOFT** (additive JI drone + modal bowls are foundational; ## (Cycle 440 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 registers of the jury's "active-wonder middle")

- **[/dream/645-kids-piano-creatures](/dream/645-kids-piano-creatures)** — Piano Creatures 🎹🌱. `demoable` · Cycle 440. **For**: kids (4+) / Web MIDI + keyboard / active-wonder musical / play-an-instrument. **What if a 4-year-old could PLAY a real keyboard and instantly sound like a musician — every note blooms a living creature, and an invisible band plays along in real time so there are no wrong notes?** The lab's **FIRST kids MIDI piece** (grep-verified 0× — no prior kids prototype calls `requestMIDIAccess`), and the kids-register answer to the **JURY 2026-06-15** "missing middle" (the kids side is "warm-or-silly with nothing between" — this is the active-wonder *musical* register where the child PERFORMS). **Input (NON-touch primary):** **Web MIDI** (`navigator.requestMIDIAccess()` in try/catch, `noteon`/`noteoff` on all inputs, `onstatechange` hot-plug) → falls through to a **computer-keyboard** piano row (`A W S E D F T G Y H U J` upper octave + `Z X C V B N M` lower, no auto-repeat) → last-resort ≥64 px on-screen pads. **No-wrong-notes engine:** every incoming note `snapToPenta`'d to C-major pentatonic → always consonant → a soft two-partial bell/marimba voice. **The accompaniment "agent" (4 subsystems):** a **Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler** (~25 ms poll, ~120 ms horizon) driving (1) an **auto-harmony PAD** on an 8-bar diatonic progression that advances per bar, (2) a **walking root/fifth/octave BASS**, (3) a **groove bed** (kick + noise hats) that grows/thins with a decaying `energyRef` raised on each played note — so the more the child plays, the fuller the band, and the harmony evolves so minute 2 ≠ minute 0; (4) the MIDI/keyboard input + snap layer. **Visual (three.js):** a garden of orbiting emissive **note-creatures** (color by pitch class, radius/height by register) that pulse on strike and breathe with band energy; ## (Cycle 439 — **adult** build · DEEP, a TRUE cycle-3 of the `606`→`630` piano spine)

- **[/dream/643-piano-constellation](/dream/643-piano-constellation)** — Piano Constellation 🎹✨. `demoable` · Cycle 439. **For**: adult / audio-file (Karel's real piano) / clinical-analytical / make-an-instrument-of-his-own-touch. **What if Karel's solo piano could be taken apart down to its 12 individual notes — each pitch class isolated from the recording — and then PLAYED BACK as an instrument made of his own touch, where tapping a note re-fires that note's isolated material?** The lab's **first cycle-3** — the genuine continuation of the `606-piano-vivisection` → `630-piano-refract` arc, claiming **ambition #4 (multi-cycle commitment) honestly** (the move the jury says is "theater — banked every DEEP cycle, claimed never," the reason the lab has **zero 4/5s in two juries**). 606 split the piano into HARMONIC (strings) vs PERCUSSIVE (hammers) via median-filter HPSS; 630 fanned the harmonic layer by NMF into **4 register bands**; 643 goes **finer than register bands** — it isolates the **12 PITCH CLASSES** (C, C#…B) of his playing **and makes them playable**. **The cycle-3 leap = a NEW interactive layer (REPLAY).** **Isolation method (salience-mask, 4 subsystems):** (1) the proven **HPSS ground** isolates a clean harmonic layer; (2) on the harmonic complex STFT, a **Klapuri salience** function scores each candidate fundamental as the summed harmonic-comb amplitude (Σ over 6 partials, weights decaying 0.78^(h−1)) so a real note lights its whole comb while spurious single bins don't; (3) each candidate's salience is splatted back onto its comb bins and **folded by octave into its pitch class** (Fujishima chroma) → 12 dense per-bin support spectra → **soft masks that form a partition of unity** (`M_c = S_c / Σ_j S_j`; the 12 masks sum to 1 at every bin, scaling re+im together → phase preserved, exact reconstruction), each ISTFT'd → **12 isolated pitch-class buffers + the Hammers buffer**; (4) a **three.js** constellation renderer. **The REPLAY layer (the distinguishing cycle-3 feature):** every isolated buffer also feeds a replay bus — tapping a note-orb or pressing a key (`A W S E D F T G Y H U J` → the 12 chromas, `X` → hammers) plucks a **~0.34 s enveloped grain** from a salient region of that note's own material, with a tiny random playback-rate shimmer so layered taps don't phase-cancel; **multiple taps stack** → you re-perform Karel's recording as chords and rhythms built from his own notes (granular per Roads). The 13 base voices always loop sample-aligned; solo/mute/gain are instant click-free gain ramps. **Visual:** 12+1 **orbiting star-constellations** (three.js) that brighten/expand with each note's live level and **FLARE** when you replay it; soloed pulled forward + glowing, muted dimmed; idle orbit on mount + a 2.5 s-idle auto-demo that cycles the soloed note **and replays it** (showing off the REPLAY layer); full geometry/material/renderer disposal. **audio-file INPUT** (Karel's real recording — only 1× in the rolling-10; his explicit "use his actual music" directive) · **three.js OUTPUT** (under-used, 1× in rolling-10 — off the jury-banned **WebGPU** and off the over-rep **Canvas2D 3×/WebGL2 3×**) · **salience-chroma partition-of-unity isolation + granular-replay TECH** · **clinical/analytical VIBE** (the register the jury PRAISED in 606 — "his own music, clinical not cozy" — neither the banned doom nor the banned warm). **Ambition honest 3/5, reaching for the lab's first 4/5:** **#4** real multi-cycle commitment (an honest cycle-3 of 606→630 — the rare criterion the jury says is claimed *never*) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (HPSS · salience/chroma isolation · granular replay engine · three.js constellations = 4) + **#3** named refs that DRIVE it (**Fujishima 1999** chroma/pitch-class profiles · **Klapuri 2006** summed-harmonic-amplitude salience · **Fitzgerald 2010** median-filter HPSS · **Roads 2001** *Microsound* granular). **#1 SOFT** (granular exists in the lab via `227-paths-granular`; per-pitch-class partition-of-unity isolation is fresh but not hard-claimed), **#5 NOT claimed** (the backing restoration paper arXiv 2603.16926 is ~3 mo, not <14 days). - **[/dream/640-kids-day-wind](/dream/640-kids-day-wind)** — A Day on the Wind 🌬️. `demoable` · Cycle 438. **For**: kids (4+) / tilt / contemplative-wonder / long-form generative. **What if a 4-year-old TENDS a self-evolving day-meadow by TILTING the iPad — steering a glowing wind that PLANTS where it lingers AND PLAYS the garden like a wind-harp where it sweeps, with no touching at all?** The lab's **first honest cycle-2 on the kids side** — a genuine deepening of the jury-named kids standout `624-kids-day-meadow` ("A Whole Day"), directly answering **JURY 2026-06-15 provocation #1** ("finish a cycle-2 for once") while honoring **provocation #4's touch ban** (input swapped touch→**tilt**, pulled by Karel's loved `83-kids-tilt-rain`❤️). **Engine (reimplemented compactly from 624, NOT imported — 4 subsystems):** (1) a **diurnal phase state machine** — a ~9-min day (`DAY_SECONDS=540`) cross-faded through dawn→morning→midday→dusk→night via soft circular smoothstep weights (scale, root, tempo, brightness, 3-stop sky gradient, sun/moon arc, star opacity all blended); (2) a **motif-memory bank** — every planted thing stores an abstract scale-degree motif that `voiceDegree()` **re-voices into the day's current scale** and `mutatedDegrees()` ages (transpose/ornament/thin) so minute 8 ≠ minute 1; (3) a **Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler** (~25 ms poll, ~120 ms ahead) driving an always-on phase-shifting drone bed + ostinato + every planted voice + the traveling-motif replay; (4) a painterly **Canvas2D** side-on meadow diorama. **The cycle-2 contribution:** `DeviceOrientation` `gamma`/`beta` (neutral-hold-zeroed, clamped, eased) steer a **luminous wind spirit**; **dwell-to-plant** (lingering ~0.75 s over empty ground grows a flower/bird/star — no tap); **sweep-to-play the wind-harp** (passing within ~46 px of a planted thing rings its motif's next note in passing order, rate-limited 120 ms/thing — the child draws glissandi by leaning); and a **traveling-motif memory** — the last ~8 brushes (degree + octave + inter-brush timing) are captured into a rolling buffer the scheduler **replays quietly, re-voiced into the current phase + transposed a step**, so a gesture swept at morning returns transformed at dusk. Everything scale-snapped → no "wrong", no fail, no score, no reading. **tilt INPUT** (off the jury-banned **touch 5×**; arrow-key fallback) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (off the jury-banned **WebGPU 6×** and over-rep WebGL2; zero GPU failure surface) · **embodied wind-harp + procedural-MMR TECH** over a generative diurnal arc · **kids contemplative-wonder VIBE** (the active-wonder *middle* the jury says the kids side lacks — neither warm-cozy nor silly-funny). **Ambition honest 3/5** (a reach above the 2/5 kids norm): **#4** genuine multi-cycle commitment (a real cycle-2 of 624, the move two juries say the lab never finishes — claimed honestly) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (diurnal machine · motif bank · scheduler · wind-harp sweep-play = 4); **#1** SOFT (the tilt-wind-harp "play your own garden" is grep-fresh but the diurnal/motif engine is 624's), **#5** NOT claimed (refs ~4–9 mo old, conceptual grounding only). Born from **RESEARCH §438** (2026 long-form-coherence literature independently converged on exactly 624's remembered-and-re-voiced-motif architecture → deepen by making that memory *playable*). **Kid-safe chain** (`masterGain ≤0.55, 2.5 s fade-in → lowpass ≤7000 Hz → DynamicsCompressor −18/6/12 → destination`; AudioContext created inside the "Begin the day ☀" gesture for iOS unlock). **Graceful degradation / glance:** ~2.5 s idle → the wind drifts a Lissajous path, planting + brushing autonomously at **~13× accelerated day rate** so a silent 06:30 glance SEES the sun travel, sky shift, creatures wake/sleep, and the wind sweep the garden with zero interaction or hardware; on first real tilt/key the rate eases to the full ~9-min day; iOS `requestPermission()` path with retry button; arrow-key fallback. **No API route, no guard** (pure client Web Audio + Canvas2D — no network/mic/camera/secret). - **[/dream/637-slow-burn](/dream/637-slow-burn)** — Slow Burn 🕯️. `demoable` · Cycle 437. **For**: adult / tender-sensual / after-hours / make-the-mechanism-legible. **What if Resonance could make the invisible *pocket* of a groove VISIBLE?** A ~72 BPM after-hours **neo-soul vamp** whose centerpiece is an **SVG grid-vs-actual onset plot**: it draws the 16th-note grid, and for every drum hit a hollow ring at the *grid* time + a connecting line out to where the hit **actually landed** + a glowing velocity-sized dot at the real onset. A single **FEEL / looseness lever** (slider + ←/→ or [/]) scales every voice's microtiming lean — kick dead-on, **snare laid-back (~+32 ms)**, **hats pushed early (~−11 ms)**, bass a touch behind — from `0` (robotic/quantized) through `~1.0` (in the pocket) to `1.8` (too loose); as you raise it you **watch the dots peel off the grid** and hear the beat start to breathe. The directest fill of the jury's (2026-06-15) single most-absent corner — the **tender/sensual** register (the adult side went 5× doom; warmth is all kids-side) — and the same "make an invisible musical mechanism legible" quality the jury praised in its TOP standout `606-piano-vivisection` (the grid-vs-actual plot is to *rhythm* what HPSS is to *timbre*). **Engine (4 subsystems):** (1) a **microtiming look-ahead scheduler** (`setInterval` ~25 ms poll, notes ~120 ms ahead of `audioCtx.currentTime`) applying each voice's per-hit timing deviation × FEEL + a hair of human jitter; (2) **from-scratch multi-voice synth** — sine kick, brushed bandpass-noise snare, lazy filtered-noise hats, gliding sine sub-bass, **FM Rhodes** (sine carrier + 1:1 modulator, decaying tine) over **Fm9 → Bbm9 → Eb13 → Abmaj9**, with vinyl crackle + lowpass haze; (3) a **reharmonization state machine** drifting upper-extension voicings, walking-bass passing tones, and ghost-snare fills over "eras" (laps through the progression) so minute 3 ≠ minute 0 (long-form, not a loop); (4) the **SVG grid-vs-actual renderer**. **keyboard + autonomous INPUT** (off the jury-banned **touch 5×**, off mic/real-data) · **SVG OUTPUT** (the **scarcest** renderer, 0× in the window — off the jury-banned **WebGPU 6×** AND the over-rep WebGL2/Canvas2D) · **per-voice microtiming-deviation engine TECH** (grep-0× in the lab — not sonification, not a sim) · **tender / sensual / after-hours VIBE** (the directest opposite of the jury-banned **5× doom autopilot**; distinct from banned kids-WARM by being lean/grown/dissonant). **Ambition honest 3/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems → 4 + #3 named refs that DRIVE it: ***Does it Swing? Microtiming Deviations and Swing Feeling in Jazz*** Sci. Rep. 2019 / arXiv 1904.03442 · **Dan Charnas, *Dilla Time*** 2022 · grounded by **arXiv 2605.10281 *Drum Synthesis from Expressive Drum Grids via Neural Audio Codecs*** May 2026; **#1 SOFT** — the microtiming-deviation engine + grid-vs-actual plot are grep-0× but groove/scheduler infra exists (387/632) so discounted, NOT a faked 4/5; **#5 NOT claimed** — 2605.10281 is server-ML, refs foundational). Born from **RESEARCH §437** (groove humanization = measurable microtiming deviation; the "expressive drum grid" as interface). **Graceful degradation / glance:** **~1.8 s idle auto-demo** self-starts the vamp and sweeps FEEL on a ~14 s breathing cycle, so a silent 06:30 glance with **no audio hardware** still SEES the dots peel off the grid; pure SVG = **zero GPU failure surface** (unlike the recent run of build-verified-not-browser-verified GPU ships). **No API route, no guard** (pure client Web Audio + SVG — no network/mic/camera/secret). - **[/dream/626-empty-room](/dream/626-empty-room)** — Empty Room 🎧. `demoable` · Cycle 433. **For**: adult / eyes-closed / off-screen / embodied-spatial. **What if Resonance could be experienced with your EYES CLOSED?** An **audio-FIRST, off-screen** piece: put on headphones, stand in an otherwise empty room, and **invisible presences drift around you in real 3D binaural sound**. Each is a soft sustained voice in a dark modal register (close, intimate, slightly haunted — an empty-cathedral feeling, *not* warm/cozy). **Turn to face a presence** (phone compass via `DeviceOrientationEvent`, or drag on desktop) and it brightens, opens, and sings more clearly while the others recede — **active listening is the whole game**. The lab's **FIRST audio-FIRST off-screen piece** — the screen is deliberately near-black, showing only an austere Canvas2D compass/radar as a glance-aid; the experience lives in the headphones. This finally gives the **off-screen / embodied-spatial lane its second real entry** beyond the screen-led `576-presence-room` — the 0× lane the jury has named "every fortnight." **Engine (3 subsystems):** (1) true binaural spatialization — each of 5 presences is a Web Audio `PannerNode` (`panningModel:"HRTF"`, `distanceModel:"inverse"`) in 3D world space; the `AudioListener` forward vector rotates as you turn (modern `forwardX/Z` AudioParams, feature-detected fallback to deprecated `setOrientation`); (2) a generative moving-presence engine — each voice has its own orbit `azimuth(t)`, a radius wobble that brings it close past your head, two detuned oscillators + a breath-tremolo LFO, and slow multi-minute pitch-detune drift so the room is genuinely different at minute 4 than minute 1 (it evolves, it doesn't loop); (3) a facing-reward layer — per-frame `cos(angle)` between heading and each presence (cubic-sharpened) swells gain and opens a brightness lowpass on the faced voice. Dark modal pitch set (G-Phrygian-ish over a drone with b2 + tritone tension); damped feedback-delay "empty-cathedral" tail (no IR file). **device-orientation INPUT** (off the glass; drag fallback) · **audio-only OUTPUT** (Web Audio binaural — the *scarcest* renderer, 0× in the rolling-10; austere Canvas2D compass is a glance-aid only — off the diversity-banned **WebGPU 5× + WebGL2 4×**) · **HRTF moving-source binaural TECH** · **intimate / dark / unsettling VIBE** (edges, not cozy). **Graceful degradation:** no orientation sensor / declined → drag-to-turn (rose notice); no HRTF panner → equal-power `StereoPannerNode` (amber note); **~2.5 s idle → heading auto-rotates** so a silent reviewer still HEARS presences sweep the stereo field and SEES the compass dots orbit, zero interaction. **Ambition honest 2–3/5** (#2 ≥3 distinct subsystems + #3 named refs that DRIVE it [**Janet Cardiff — *The Forty Part Motet* / *Her Long Black Hair***; **Pauline Oliveros — *Deep Listening***; HRTF background **ImmersiveFlow arXiv 2601.12950** + **ASAudio survey arXiv 2508.10924**]; **#1 SOFT, said plainly** — NOT lab-first binaural [`576-presence-room` did head-tracked binaural], the fresh axes are the **audio-FIRST / eyes-closed off-screen register** + the **facing-reward mechanic**). **Consumes the §429-banked `620-empty-room` seed** (research-grounded, the perennially-0× off-screen lane) — a clean "build a queued research-bound idea" path. **No API route, no guard** (pure client Web Audio + Canvas2D — no network/mic/camera/secret). ## (Cycle 432 — **kids** build · DEEP, ONE long-form concept × 3 non-GPU renderers)

- **[/dream/624-kids-day-meadow](/dream/624-kids-day-meadow)** — A Whole Day 🌅. `demoable` · Cycle 432. **For**: kids (4+) / long-form generative journey / calm-contemplative. **What if a kids music toy were a whole DAY?** A slow, self-evolving **~9-minute journey** through **dawn → morning → midday → dusk → night → back to dawn** that is genuinely *different at minute 8 than at minute 1* — not a loop, not a one-shot. The piece **plays itself** and the child decorates it: **tap low** → a **flower** (blooms by day, closes & sleeps at night), **tap mid** → a **bird** (glides & sings in the morning, roosts at night), **tap the sky** → a **star** (only twinkles & sings at night). The lab's **FIRST kids long-form generative journey-arc with state & memory** — a kids-register answer to Karel's standing "journey-engine alternatives" priority (a diurnal/cinematic arc, not the visionary 6-phase one), and the long-form-generative menu category the jury keeps flagging as thin. **Engine (3 subsystems):** (1) a **diurnal phase state machine** — a continuous `phase∈[0,1)` over `DAY_SECONDS≈540` cross-fades 5 musical regions with soft circular-bump weights (no hard cuts): dawn = major-pentatonic/Lydian shimmer, slow, indigo→rose; morning = bright major, livelier, clear blue; midday = fullest playful major, brightest, sun at arc-top; dusk = warm Mixolydian, amber→violet, slowing; night = low glassy lullaby pentatonic + drone, near-black + stars + moon — phase also drives the sky gradient, the **sun/moon traveling a visible arc**, star opacity, brightness, cloud tint. (2) a **motif-memory bank** (the ambition — the "anchor" idea from **arXiv 2604.05343 Anchored Cyclic Generation**): each planted creature stores an abstract **scale-degree** motif that `voiceDegree` re-projects into whatever scale the day is in *right now*, so everything stays in-key as the harmony moves, and `mutatedDegrees` slowly transposes/ornaments/thins it with age — coheres yet evolves. (3) a **Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler** (~25 ms pump, notes ~120 ms ahead) driving an always-on phase-shifting drone bed (never silent) + an evolving ostinato + every planted voice; notes never scheduled from rAF. **touch-to-plant + watch INPUT** (off recent camera 617 / mic 603,609 / real-data 613,618) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (off the diversity-audit-banned **WebGPU 5× + WebGL2 4×** of the rolling-10 — the lab over-corrected INTO GPU, so Canvas2D at 1× is now the scarce renderer; the jury's 2026-06-14 Canvas2D ban is ~10 cycles stale + the data inverted) · **diurnal generative state-machine + motif-memory re-voicer TECH** (distinct from recent CA/physics/sonification/segmentation) · **calm / awe / journey VIBE** (deliberately OFF the kids **funny** autopilot — 603/609/617 went funny 3× in a row). **Renderer**: a single `<canvas>` 2D painterly **side-on landscape diorama** — full-height day-cycling sky gradient, a sun/moon traveling an arc, drifting tinted clouds, layered parallax hills, twinkling night stars, and **cut-paper creatures with simple friendly faces whose eyes close as they fall asleep**; DPR-aware, resize listener, rAF + scheduler + AudioContext torn down on unmount. Kid-safe master `gain (≤0.55) → lowpass (≤7.5 kHz) → DynamicsCompressor (-18/6/12) → destination`, 2.5 s master fade-in, AudioContext created inside the first gesture (iOS unlock). **Ambition honest 3/5** (#1 first kids long-form generative journey-arc with state/memory [qualified — kids "evolving" toys are short loops/one-shots; this is a stateful multi-minute arc] + #2 ≥3 subsystems + #3 named refs that DRIVE it [**Brian Eno — *Music for Airports* / *Bloom***; **Gary Hustwit — *ENO* 2024**, the generative film that plays differently every time; **arXiv 2604.05343 Anchored Cyclic Generation** — the motif-anchor]; **#5 NOT hard-claimed** — the 2026 papers are heavy server-side DNNs, the engine implements their browser-feasible Eno-generative ancestor, said plainly). Born from **RESEARCH §432** (long-form coherence is the live 2026 cs.SD problem — ACG anchor-features + MusicWeaver plan-then-render). **Love-aligned** to Karel's loved contemplative/persistent kids cluster (`133-kids-ripple-pond`❤️, `166-kids-lantern`❤️, `169-kids-marble-run`❤️, `152-kids-star-paint`❤️; additive — the gates governed). **~2.5 s idle auto-demo**: a ghost hand plants a flower/bird/star and the day runs at an **accelerated ~14× preview** so a silent 06:30 glance SEES the sun travel + sky shift through indigo→blue→amber→near-black + creatures wake/sleep AND HEARS the music evolve; on the first real tap it eases to the full ~9-min day. **No API route, no guard** (pure client Web Audio + Canvas2D — no network/mic/camera/secret). No new npm deps. **Build-verified** (winner-only authoritative `npm run build` **exit 0, ✓ Compiled successfully in 32.8s, ✓ Generating static pages (468/468)**, `/dream/624-kids-day-meadow 6.5 kB / 109 kB First Load` prerendered static ○), **NOT browser-verified** (no audio/canvas in sandbox — the region scale-snap smoothness at cross-fade midpoints + the per-voice balance under a dense 24-creature garden are reasoned, gain-crossfaded + capped by the limiter; the auto-demo + Canvas2D guarantee it performs on a glance). Winner of a DEEP 3-renderer fire; banked **`623-kids-day-journey`** (the "massively bigger" **three.js** immersive 3D day-world + Canvas2D fallback — the bolder swing, resurrect when GPU renderers cool) + **`625-kids-day-paper`** (the calmest **inline-SVG** matte cut-paper storybook — resurrect for the explicit bedtime register / to give SVG a fresh entry) as IDEAS §432. - **[/dream/618-solar-organ](/dream/618-solar-organ)** — Solar Organ ☀️🌌. `demoable` · Cycle 429. **For**: adult / real-world-data sonification / cosmic-geomagnetic. **What does the space weather hitting Earth right now sound like? — the live solar wind plays a magnetospheric organ while you watch the aurora that same data is driving.** The lab's **FIRST solar-wind / geomagnetic real-data sonification** — the natural non-duplicative next real-data lane after `613-seismic-choir`'s seismic, and a clean hit on TWO open **JURY 2026-06-14** lanes at once: **#3** "STOP re-shipping the ocean — mine UNMINED real-world data" (the jury literally named *aurora/Kp*; 613 took seismic, 618 takes the named-next — explicitly NOT the twice-occupied ocean) and **#2** "commit to a full WebGPU spectacle or get off the screen; Canvas2D is the new three.js (6×)" (primary renderer is hand-written **WGSL on WebGPU**, Canvas2D only as fallback). **Data**: three **keyless, CORS-open NOAA SWPC** feeds fetched in parallel client-side (`AbortController` 6 s, header-row skip, NaN guards, resampled to a 240-bin/24h series) — planetary **K-index** (`…/products/noaa-planetary-k-index.json`), interplanetary **magnetic field** (`…/solar-wind/mag-1-day.json`; **`bz_gsm` southward = the substorm trigger**), and **plasma** speed/density (`…/solar-wind/plasma-1-day.json`) — with a built-in **synthetic geomagnetic-storm** fallback (a plausible 24h curve with a substorm spike) so it's fully alive with zero network. The last ~24h replays as an evolving ~75 s sweep, then loops. **Mapping (the magnetospheric organ — deliberately NOT a warm just-intonation drone; it has edges)**: a bank of **inharmonic** partials at non-just ratios `1, 2.04, 3.11, 4.33, 5.78, 7.19, 9.02×`; **wind speed → base pitch** (≈300→800 km/s lifts ≈70→165 Hz — higher, more urgent); **southward Bz → the aurora opens** (a lowpass sweeps open + upper partials fade in = the substorm crescendo; northward Bz = quiet/closed); **Kp → intensity AND dissonance** (high Kp detunes the partials up to ~38 cents + raises offset beating oscillators → a tense slow alarm, not a hymn); **density → granular noise texture**. Master `per-partial gain → bus → lowpass → masterGain → DynamicsCompressor → destination`, `webkitAudioContext` fallback, gesture-unlock, ~2.5 s **autostart**. **Visual**: a fullscreen **WGSL** fragment shader builds vertical auroral curtains warped by a **curl of an fBm potential field** (divergence-free flow — Bridson's curl noise); `south`/`kp`/`speed`/`density` drive turbulence, height, flicker, drift, palette — quiet → faint green `#7CFFB2` low on near-black, storm-south → curtains rise + bleed **violet → crimson** at the crown, Kp adds fast shimmer; `navigator.gpu` feature-detected → a real **Canvas2D** aurora fallback sharing the same four uniforms, `WEBGPU/CANVAS2D` backend badge. Subsystems (≥3 → 4): live 3-feed fetch/parse/resample + synthetic fallback (`space-weather.ts`) · inharmonic sonification engine (`audio.ts`) · WGSL curl-noise aurora renderer (`aurora.ts`) · Canvas2D fallback. **real-world-data (live NOAA solar wind/Kp/Bz) INPUT** (off jury-banned touch 4× / mic; never-sonified feed, explicitly NOT ocean, distinct from 613 seismic) · **WebGPU/WGSL OUTPUT** (off jury-banned Canvas2D 6×) · **geomagnetic-data sonification + inharmonic organ + curl-noise aurora TECH** (NOT warm-JI bed [banned], NOT onset/beat) · **cosmic / geomagnetic-storm / ominous-at-peak VIBE** (off jury-banned cozy ~9×). Controls: Start (gesture-unlock), VOL/MUTE, autostart; HUD shows current UTC + live Kp + Bz. **Ambition honest 3/5** (#1 first solar-wind/geomagnetic real-data sonification [grep-verified 0×; 613 seismic ≠ solar wind] + #2 ≥3 subsystems [4] + #3 named refs that DRIVE it [**Andrea Polli — *Sonic Antarctica* / atmospheric data sonification**; **auroral substorm physics — the Dungey cycle / southward-Bz reconnection**; **Robert Bridson — curl noise**]; **#5 NOT claimed** — this cycle's June-2026 spatial-audio finding seeded the banked `620`, not the winner, and the curl-noise/sonification methods are foundational, said plainly). - **[/dream/617-kids-shadow-monster](/dream/617-kids-shadow-monster)** — Shadow Monster Stage 👹🎭. `demoable` · Cycle 428. **For**: kids (4+) / funny / embodied-spatial. **Stand in front of the camera and your whole BODY becomes a giant glowing googly shadow-puppet monster on a lit stage — wave and the air WHOOSHES, jump and it BOINGs, get big (step in / arms wide) and it ROARs.** The directest KIDS-register answer to TWO standing **JURY 2026-06-14** provocations at once: **#2** ("commit to a full WebGPU spectacle or get off the screen; Canvas2D is the new three.js, 6×") — the primary renderer is **hand-written WGSL on WebGPU**, Canvas2D only as fallback; and **#5** ("embodied-spatial got exactly one entry [576] this window then went cold — don't let it be a singleton") — this is the whole-body, off-the-glass follow-through, in a 4-year-old's register. **INPUT — body SILHOUETTE mask**: the webcam frame → **MediaPipe ImageSegmenter** (selfie/person segmentation, loaded dynamically from the jsDelivr CDN at runtime — **no npm dep**, wrapped in one `try/catch`), the filled body **mask** downsampled into an occupancy grid (deliberately the MASK, *not* pose/skeleton landmarks — grep-distinct from the lab's landmark vision pieces 234/419/568 hands+pose, 258/423/576 face). **Signals from the mask each frame** (`mask.ts`): frame-to-frame change (motion energy) → **WHOOSH** intensity; centroid rising fast (a jump) → **BOING**; mask area growing (steps toward camera / arms up) → a swelling **ROAR**. **CREATURE**: the mask becomes a dark friendly puppet body with a glowing wobbling breathing outline (squash-and-stretch), a soft inner glow that pulses with the roar, whoosh streaks that smear with motion, and two procedural **googly eyes** placed near the top of the mask's bounding box with pupils rolling toward the body's motion. **OUTPUT — WGSL/WebGPU**: the mask uploads as an `r8unorm` texture → a hand-written fragment shader renders the glowing creature field on a spotlit stage; a **full Canvas2D fallback** (`render2d.ts`) draws the same silhouette + glow + googly eyes, auto-selected when `navigator.gpu` is absent or WebGPU init fails (live backend badge). **SOUND** (`audio.ts`): an always-on warm theatre bed (never silent), a continuous airy whoosh, a soft-attacked heavily-low-passed ROAR (a happy dinosaur, never a scary growl), and a comic spring boing — kid-safe master `gain (0.55) → lowpass 7.5 kHz → DynamicsCompressor (-18/6/12) → out`, pre-created voices (<50 ms). Subsystems (≥3 → 4): camera capture + MediaPipe ImageSegmenter mask + WGSL/WebGPU stage renderer (+Canvas2D fallback) + motion-energy-driven foley synth. **camera/body-segmentation INPUT** (whole-body, off jury-banned touch 4× / mic; camera/vision was 0× in the rolling-10) · **WebGPU/WGSL OUTPUT** (off jury-banned Canvas2D 6×) · **silhouette-mask→creature + motion-energy→synth TECH** (grep-distinct from the lab's landmark/pose vision pieces; NOT warm-JI [banned], NOT onset/beat) · **silly-friendly giant-shadow-monster-theater VIBE** (funny/edges — the kid-safe form of "off cozy"; NOT a warm drone). **Ambition honest 2/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [4] + #3 named refs that DRIVE it [**shadow-puppet / wayang-kulit theatre**; **Daniel Rozin's mechanical mirrors** — a viewer's silhouette materialised as a living reflection; **Tex Avery / Looney Tunes squash-and-stretch**; **MediaPipe ImageSegmenter**]; **soft #1 / #5 NOT hard-claimed** — segmentation-mask-as-creature is grep-distinct but body vision isn't lab-first, and the technique is foundational with no <30-day bind, said plainly). ## (Cycle 427 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal edged / off-Canvas2D / non-fingertip explorers)

- **[/dream/613-seismic-choir](/dream/613-seismic-choir)** — Seismic Choir 🌍🌋. `demoable` · Cycle 427. **For**: adult / real-world-data sonification / ominous-geological. **What does the planet sound like right now? — the live global earthquake feed of the last 24 hours, turned into an ominous trembling sonification: every real quake on Earth becomes a deep resonant groan over a slowly rotating WGSL/WebGPU globe of tectonic light.** The lab's **FIRST seismic / this-class real-data piece** — and the only build this fortnight to hit **THREE JURY 2026-06-14 provocations at once**: **#1** build with EDGES, off cozy (deep inharmonic rock-rumbles + a tritone tectonic drone — the opposite of the banned warm chord); **#2** "commit to a full WebGPU spectacle or get off the screen; Canvas2D is the new three.js (6×)" (primary renderer is hand-written **WGSL on WebGPU**, Canvas2D only as fallback); **#3** "STOP re-shipping the ocean — mine UNMINED real-world data" (live **seismic**, explicitly not the now-twice-occupied ocean). **Data**: USGS `summary/all_day.geojson` (every quake on Earth past 24h; no key, CORS, fetched client-side), with a bundled ~46-quake **synthetic fallback** across real fault zones (Honshu/Cascadia/Chile/Sumatra/Tonga/Nepal/Italy + a deep-Benioff subset + a late-day aftershock swarm) so it's fully alive with zero network — a `DATA: LIVE/SAMPLE` badge says which. **Mapping**: magnitude → loudness + rumble duration + lower fundamental + sub-bass swell (≥4.2); depth_km → brightness (shallow = bright crack, deep = dull groan); longitude → stereo pan; latitude → resonance tilt. The 24h window replays in ~60s on a loop (speed-adjustable) so you hear the **day's seismic rhythm** — clusters, swarms, the silence between. **Synthesis**: each quake = a filtered-noise impact excitation through a bank of **low, slightly-inharmonic bandpass resonators** (ratios 1/1.94/2.41/3.77 over 32–120 Hz — inharmonic so it reads as *rock*, not a synth pitch), mag-scaled decay, sub-bass sine swell on the big ones; under it a continuous dark **tectonic drone** built on tension intervals (minor-2nd beat, tritone-ish, inharmonic) — explicitly NOT a warm JI chord. Ear-safe master `gain → lowpass ~7k → DynamicsCompressor (brick-wall limiter) → Analyser → out`, capped gains, soft sub attacks. **Visual**: a WGSL fragment shader raymarches a dark rotating globe of tectonic light; each quake blooms at its true (lon,lat) and ripples outward as an expanding geodesic ring, the whole field trembling in sympathy with the audio (uniforms driven by the `AnalyserNode`) — big quakes flare + shake the screen, shallow = magma-orange, deep = oxblood-red, over ash-grey ridges on black; `navigator.gpu` feature-detected → a real **Canvas2D** globe fallback (same map/pulses/graticule), `RENDER: WebGPU/Canvas2D` badge. Subsystems (≥3 → 3 independent): live USGS fetch/parse (`quakes.ts`) + physical-modeling sonification engine (`audio.ts`) + WGSL WebGPU renderer (`gpu.ts`) + Canvas2D fallback (`render2d.ts`). **real-world-data (live seismic) INPUT** (off jury-banned touch 4× / mic; explicitly NOT ocean) · **WebGPU/WGSL OUTPUT** (off jury-banned Canvas2D 6×) · **data-sonification + inharmonic physical-model resonant-body rumble TECH** (NOT warm-JI bed [banned], NOT onset/beat) · **ominous/geological/tectonic VIBE** (off jury-banned cozy ~9×). Controls: **Start** (audio gesture-unlock + `webkitAudioContext`), `Space` play/pause, `M` mute, `[`/`]` slow/speed the timeline; on-screen buttons mirror all (≥44px); ~2.5s idle auto-start so a muted 06:30 glance already shows the globe pulsing. **Ambition honest 2–3/5** (#1 first seismic/this-class data in the lab [grep-verified; ocean ≠ seismic] + #2 ≥3 distinct subsystems + #3 named ref [**Florian Dombois — *Earthquake Sounds* / auditory seismology**]; **#5 NOT hard-claimed** — this cycle's bound research finding [arXiv 2603.09391 engine-synthesis] seeded the banked `614`, not the winner, said plainly). Honest weak spots (per builder): the WGSL globe is procedural (graticule, not real coastlines) and the per-quake resonator bank is a stylized physical model, not a literal seismogram convolution — so it's *Dombois-adjacent*, not a 1:1 seismogram-to-audio transform. **Love-aligned** to Karel's loved spectral/particle/data adult cluster (`323-latent-condensation`❤️/`321-spectral-flight`❤️/`262-aurora-particle`❤️; additive — the gates governed the pick). Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer fire; banked **`612-piano-larynx`** (LPC cross-synthesis "talking piano" on Karel's material — WebGL2 "spectral throat", refs Lansky *Six Fantasies* / Dodge *Speech Songs*; LOST: strong but `606` just mined the his-material vein, and its "his material" is diluted by a synthesized default modulator [file-drop is the real-piano path]) + **`614-combustion`** (procedural combustion-engine instrument — pulse-train fired at RPM → recursive Karplus-Strong exhaust resonators, AudioWorklet, off-glass keyboard+tilt, WebGPU; implements this cycle's research dive arXiv 2603.09391; LOST: edgiest + cleanest research chain, but its abrasive lane was just visited by `601-feedback-howl` two adult cycles ago) as IDEAS §427. **No API route, no guard** (client-side `fetch` of the public USGS feed — GET, no key, no side effects; no secret). No new npm deps. **Build-verified** (authoritative `npm run build` exit 0 after a `.next`-corruption clean [3 concurrent builder builds raced the shared `.next` → ENOENT pages-manifest → `rm -rf .next` rebuilt clean], `✓ Compiled successfully in 38.6s`, `✓ Generating static pages (464/464)`, `/dream/613-seismic-choir 8.9 kB / 115 kB First Load` prerendered static ○), **NOT browser-verified** (no real GPU/audio/network in sandbox) — the auto-start + sample dataset + Canvas2D fallback mean the globe pulses + groans on a glance with zero hardware, and Karel sees the real planet's last 24h at his desk. ## (Cycle 426 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal funny / off-Canvas2D / non-fingertip explorers)

- **[/dream/609-kids-blow-parade](/dream/609-kids-blow-parade)** — Blow Parade 🎈💨. `demoable` · Cycle 426. **For**: kids (4+) / funny / loud. **BLOW into the mic and a parade of googly balloon-creatures puffs up bigger and bigger — then rips a whoopee-cushion RASPBERRY and zooms off when you stop.** A full hand-written **WGSL/WebGPU** spectacle (Canvas2D fallback) driven by **breath** — the directest KIDS-side hit on **JURY 2026-06-14 provocation #2**: "commit to a full WebGPU spectacle or get off the screen; Canvas2D is the new three.js (6×)." Now that **Safari 26 (Sept 2025) put WebGPU on iPad/iOS** (RESEARCH §426), a WGSL kids spectacle is an iPad-native path, not a desktop flex. Technique: a **breath-energy blow detector** (`detect.ts`: spectral **flatness** + **peakiness** + energy gate over ~120 Hz–6 kHz, fast-attack/slow-release smoothing) fires only on loud-AND-noise-like-AND-non-tonal breath, so a yell or sung note is **rejected** — only true breath inflates; the active balloon's radius grows with sustained blow (rising stretched-neck squeak), and on release it enters a fly/tumble/deflate/recycle phase while a **whoopee raspberry** (detuned saw+square through a flutter-square-LFO'd moving lowpass + escaping-air noise, falling pitch) rips. **WGSL renderer**: one instanced quad per balloon, per-instance data (center/radius/hue/squash/spin/eye-look/blink/mouth) → storage buffer each frame, the fragment shader draws the whole googly creature procedurally; a **Canvas2D fallback** draws the identical parade (auto-selected on no `navigator.gpu`, live backend badge). Subsystems (≥3 → 5): blow detector + inflation physics + raspberry synth + WGSL renderer + Canvas2D fallback. **mic-BLOW/breath INPUT** (non-fingertip — off jury-banned touch 4×; grep-distinct from yell/voice) · **WebGPU/WGSL OUTPUT** (off jury-banned Canvas2D 6×; the spectacle lane the jury keeps begging to revive) · **breath-energy + balloon-physics + raspberry-synth TECH** (NOT a warm-JI bed [banned], NOT onset/beat) · **giggly-raspberry FUNNY VIBE** (off jury-banned cozy ~9×; extends the lone 603 funny register so it isn't a singleton). Kid-safe: `masterGain (≤0.55) → lowpass 7.5 kHz → DynamicsCompressor (-18/6:1/12) → out`, soft attacks, capped gains, pre-built nodes (<50 ms first blow), never-silent playful bed (NOT a warm drone), no fail states, ≥64px targets. Full graceful degrade: no mic → big **💨 hold-to-blow** button + **Space**; no WebGPU → Canvas2D; ~2.5s idle → a **ghost-blow auto-demo** inflates + pops on a loop so the silent 06:30 glance still sees + hears it. **Ambition honest 2/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [5] + #3 named refs that drive it [party-blower/whoopee-cushion foley; balloon inflate→release physics; Toca Boca]; **#1 NOT claimed** — `95-kids-breath-bubbles` already did blow-via-loudness, so this is a *refinement* [flatness/peakiness blow-vs-voice gate], not a first-breath-input, said plainly; **#5 soft** — WebGPU-on-iPad is the enabling shift but ~9 mo old). - **[/dream/606-piano-vivisection](/dream/606-piano-vivisection)** — Piano Vivisection 🎹🔬. `demoable` · Cycle 425. **For**: adult / his real music / clinical-dissective. **Take Karel's OWN recorded piano APART into the singing strings (harmonic) vs. the hammer/key noise (percussive) — and remix the two layers live.** The lab's **FIRST audio source-separation instrument** (grep-verified: NMF/HPSS/SMS/source-separation/stem-split all **0×** across 600+ prototypes) — and the directest hit on **JURY 2026-06-14 provocation #4**: "mine the vein that produced both 4/5s [557 splat, 583 musaicing] — a fresh analysis/resynthesis technique on *his own* material; do it again — neural source separation, NMF, DDSP." Technique: **median-filter HPSS** (Fitzgerald, DAFx 2010) — his real solo piano is fetched, sliced (~9s mono @22kHz), STFT'd (Hann 1024/hop 256, complex bins kept), then a **time-median** filter (~17 frames/bin) isolates the sustained horizontal harmonic trails (strings) while a **freq-median** filter (~17 bins/frame) isolates the vertical transient strikes (hammers); soft power-2 Wiener masks → phase-preserving ISTFT overlap-add → two independently-mixable layers. Subsystems (≥3 → 5): STFT analysis + median-filter HPSS solver + phase-preserving mask resynthesis/ISTFT + WebGL2 vivisection render (harmonic = cyan/steel horizontal streaks, percussive = magenta/white vertical strikes, balance-weighted, sweeping playhead, R32F texture w/ 8-bit fallback) + off-glass keyboard/tilt control. **audio-file (his piano) + keyboard/tilt off-glass INPUT** (NOT a fingertip [jury-banned touch], NOT mic, NOT camera) · **WebGL2 OUTPUT** (off Canvas2D [jury-banned 6×]) · **median-filter HPSS source-separation TECH** (NOT warm-JI bed [jury-banned], NOT onset/beat, NOT concatenative) · **clinical/dissective "vivisection" VIBE** (REVEALS the machine inside his warm piano — the opposite of the cozy register the jury banned ~9×). Controls: keyboard `1`/`2` solo/mute strings/hammers, `←/→` morph balance, `↑/↓` gain, `space` play/pause; iOS-gated device-tilt morphs balance on mobile; secondary on-screen faders. ~2.5s idle auto-demo sweeps the balance so a silent 06:30 glance shows the field separating + (un-muted) hears the layers. Born from **RESEARCH §425**. ## (Cycle 417 — **adult** build · DEEP, 3 technical approaches on one concept. Ships **`583-piano-mosaic-field`**: *reach INTO Karel's recorded piano and re-voice it — drag a luminous probe through a 2-D timbre field and the instrument answers with his own closest-matching grains, painting with his timbre in real time.* The lab's **first concatenative-musaicing / corpus-based resynthesis** — Karel's real Welcome-Home solo piano is decoded client-side and shattered into a corpus of ~120 ms Hann grains, each precomputed (per-grain FFT) with a **spectral centroid** (brightness → field X), **RMS loudness**, and a **crude dominant pitch** (FFT peak + parabolic refine → register, field Y). On a steady ~18 grains/sec tick a **CataRT-style matcher** scores the whole corpus by weighted distance to the cursor target in (brightness, pitch) space — plus a small loudness preference, a short repeat penalty (never machine-guns one grain), and a touch of jitter — launches the best grain, and overlaps ~4–8 through Hann envelopes so the stream glides and never clicks (warmth lowpass + `DynamicsCompressor` limiter). **This is target-driven grain SELECTION, not blind random granular scatter** — the cursor's position MEANS a timbre and his corpus answers with its nearest sound (the genuine distinction from loved `227-paths-granular`❤️'s blind scatter). Visual = one additive point per grain laid out in the timbre field, dim violet at rest → blooming **warm ember** when voiced, a soft luminous probe + haze following the cursor; the field breathes while idle and a slow **Lissajous auto-demo** drives the cursor after 2.5 s idle so the silent 06:30 glance still sings. ## (Cycle 415 — **adult** build · WIDE, 3 orthogonal explorers all chasing the jury's WARMTH dare. Ships **`580-tide-breath`**: *the real ocean breathes a warm chord — a direct, keyless, client-side fetch of your coast's LIVE marine conditions makes the actual swell the breath of a sustained just-intonation drone, over a WebGPU water-surface that rises and falls with the live tide.* The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-13** on THREE axes at once: **#1** revive the starved WebGPU (1× across the last 15; the lab fled into a three.js monoculture) — 580 renders a WGSL fragment-shader water-surface with a Canvas2D hot-downgrade; **#2** real-world-data sonification (**0× the whole window**, named-starved every jury) — I curled the endpoint live (`marine-api.open-meteo.com/v1/marine`, no key, `access-control-allow-origin: *`, returned wave 1.28 m / swell 12.1 s); **#4** chase WARMTH, not a puzzle — no interaction after the play gesture, no melody, no beat, just a luminous sea and a chord the ocean is playing. On play: optional geolocation (3 s timeout → silent Monterey-Bay default) → keyless Open-Meteo Marine fetch (baked sample on offline/failure, shown amber **"Sample swell (feed offline)"** vs emerald **"Live · Open-Meteo Marine · {place}"**). Three live numbers drive the whole piece: **swell_wave_period** → a sine breath LFO on master gain + lowpass (one inhale/exhale per swell cycle, ~6–18 s), **wave_height** → breath depth, **sea_surface_temperature** → timbre warmth.
