## Cycle 362 — **kids** build · WIDE, 3 unrelated NON-percussion registers; the winner is a real **GPU fluid finger-paint** — a 4-year-old smears glowing liquid that swirls like ink in water and *hums*, breaking the recent kids-percussion rut and riding the most-loved paint + `84-wave-fluid`❤️ lineage

- **[/dream/433-kids-fluid-paint](/dream/433-kids-fluid-paint)** — Fluid Paint 🎨. `demoable` · Cycle 362.

  **For kids 4+ — finger-paint where the paint is REAL flowing liquid, and the motion of the fluid IS the music.** Pick one of five big (≥72px) emoji color swatches — violet · teal · amber · rose · cyan — then drag anywhere: glowing color pours out and **keeps swirling and blending like ink in water long after you lift your finger**, and the painting **hums** a soft, sustained, consonant chord that swells when you paint and settles when you rest. It is a deliberately **calm, dreamy, NON-percussion** kids instrument — the answer to the recent kids rut (the last several kids ships, `419` pose-beat / `423` face-beat / `429` noise-foley, were all rhythm/percussion) and to KIDS.md's named market gap (the *contemplative, parent-tolerable* option in a space full of loud high-energy toys). Rides the lab's most-loved lineage in one move: the **paint** family (`100`❤️/`104`❤️/`152`❤️/`160`❤️/`223`❤️) **and** `84-wave-fluid`❤️ (GPU fluid).

  Three subsystems (≥3 → 4): (1) **`fluid.ts`** — a faithful **Jos Stam "Stable Fluids" (SIGGRAPH 1999)** incompressible Navier-Stokes solver on **WebGL2** ping-pong framebuffer textures (RGBA 16/32-bit float): semi-Lagrangian **advect velocity** → **splat** Gaussian velocity+dye on drag (force ∝ drag speed) → **divergence** → **20-iteration Jacobi pressure solve** (`∇²p=∇·u`) → **gradient-subtract** (enforce `∇·u=0` so it swirls rather than expands) → **advect the separate dye field** by the divergence-free velocity → tone-mapped display (`1−exp(−dye·2)` soft-HDR, dark-suppressed). 128² velocity/pressure grid, 512² dye grid (the standard Stam real-time tradeoff). (2) **`audio.ts`** — sustained/evolving, **never percussion**: a five-oscillator open major-9 pad (C2 G2 E3 B3 D4, sine+triangle, ±4¢ detune) whose gain tracks a **JS-side energy accumulator** (`energy*=0.985`/frame — no GPU readback to stall the pipeline), the active swatch's **hue → lowpass cutoff** (cool=dark ~350 Hz, warm=bright ~3200 Hz — cross-modal color↔timbre), **drag-speed → 0.3–4.3 Hz tremolo LFO** (shimmer on fast strokes), a near-silent bandpassed noise bed (never silent), all through a `DynamicsCompressor` brick-wall limiter (−8 dB / 20:1) → master 0.22 (can't blast small ears). (3) **input/auto-demo/lifecycle** in `page.tsx` — pointer splat injected synchronously (<50 ms), a hands-free **auto-demo** at 1.8 s that strokes all five colors on a loop (a phone reviewer sees swirling glowing color with zero taps), a **tap-to-start** overlay creating/resuming the `AudioContext` in-gesture (iOS-safe), DPR-aware (capped 2×) `ResizeObserver` sizing, full teardown (`cancelAnimationFrame`, `sim.destroy()` deletes all GL resources + `WEBGL_lose_context`, `audio.destroy()`). Degrades cleanly: no WebGL2 → readable `text-rose-300` notice; autoplay blocked → tap prompt. Camera/mic: **none**. **No API route, no `guard` needed — no network at all** (no mic, camera, fetch, secrets, FAL_KEY). Zero new npm deps.

  References: **Jos Stam, "Stable Fluids"** (SIGGRAPH 1999) — the foundational semi-Lagrangian incompressible solver this follows · **Mark Harris, "Fast Fluid Dynamics Simulation on the GPU"** (GPU Gems Ch. 38, NVIDIA 2004) — the canonical GPU/ping-pong-FBO mapping · **Pavel Dobryakov, WebGL-Fluid-Simulation** — the definitive browser lineage. Born from RESEARCH §362. Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer kids fire (three genuinely different non-percussion registers); siblings `434-kids-lantern-sky` (tap to launch glowing lanterns into a 3D night sky, true **HRTF binaural** spatial audio that tracks your head as you tilt the phone, three.js — the cosmic-wonder/headphone take) + `435-kids-air-ribbon` (paint music in the AIR — MediaPipe HandLandmarker fingertip → a glowing singing light-ribbon, a sustained air-theremin, the melodic *inverse* of the recent face/pose beats) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §362. **Ambition 2/5** (stated plainly, no stretch): ≥3-subsystems(#2 — Stam GPU fluid solver + evolving Web-Audio pad + WebGL2 render + pointer/auto-demo = 4) + named-reference(#3 — Stam 1999 · Harris 2004 · Dobryakov). **#1 honestly NOT claimed** — Navier-Stokes fluid is saturated in the lab (`3-fluid` WebGL2, `15-webgpu-fluid`, `84-wave-fluid`❤️, `119-poem-fluid`); the fresh move is a **kids finger-paint application** of the technique + the calm liquid register, not a new primitive (grep audit, RESEARCH §362). **Diversity**: **touch INPUT** (3× recent, allowed; clean dodge of jury-banned mic) · **WebGL2 OUTPUT** (the decisive dodge — 1× recent, fresher than the over-represented Canvas2D 3× and jury-banned SVG; also dodged sibling `435`'s Canvas2D) · Stam-fluid TECHNIQUE · **liquid-dreamy non-percussion VIBE** (the explicit break from the recent kids-percussion rut; calm consonant is fine for kids — VIBE is parity-exempt). **Build-verified, not browser-verified** — unverified surface: half-float FBO completeness on mobile GPUs (the `EXT_color_buffer_(half_)float` fallback path), whether the dye actually reads as "ink-in-water swirling" vs. a smear at 128² velocity res on a phone, perceived loudness/tremolo feel (compressor + master are conservative first-guesses), and the iOS AudioContext-in-gesture path (no audio/GPU in this sandbox).

## Cycle 361 — adult build · WIDE, 3 unrelated explorers; the winner makes **gravity compose the music** — a chaotic N-body orbit that never repeats, the most elegant answer yet to the jury's "make the one that doesn't harmonize" mandate

- **[/dream/432-three-body](/dream/432-three-body)** — Three-Body. `demoable` · Cycle 361.

  **What if Resonance's music was generated by gravity?** Press **Begin** and 3–6 massive bodies start orbiting under a real-time Newtonian N-body simulation — they slingshot, perturb, and chaotically swing around each other, and the **motion itself is the score**: a **close approach** swells into a Doppler-glide event (pitch rises into the encounter then falls), a **slingshot** fires a downward noise-whoosh, and every body emits a continuous drone whose frequency tracks its speed. Because the three-body problem is deterministic but non-repeating (Poincaré: sensitive dependence on initial conditions), the piece is **genuinely different every minute and never resolves or loops** — that unresolved, ever-evolving quality is the whole point and the most direct answer to the **JURY 2026-06-08** central mandate ("make the one that *doesn't* harmonize"; ~13/15 recent pieces converged to gentle consonance). The default `chaos trio` seed is tuned to fire audible close-approaches within seconds, so a phone reviewer hears+sees a mesmerizing gravitational ballet hands-free.

  Three subsystems: (1) **physics engine** — a **velocity-Verlet** symplectic integrator (substepped 6× per frame for stability — naive Euler blows up), **softened gravity** `a_i = Σ G·m_j·(r_j−r_i)/(|r_j−r_i|²+ε²)^(3/2)` so close approaches slingshot dramatically without singularity-exploding, plus a soft radial bowl + tiny velocity damping past `BOUND` so no body is ever ejected to infinity and the piece never goes empty; three presets (`chaos trio`, the Chenciner–Montgomery `figure-8` choreography, `random cluster`) + re-seed; (2) **audio** — per-body triangle + inharmonic-sine (×2.41) drones mapped from speed via a stretched non-linear curve (**continuous, never snapped to any scale** — the deliberate anti-consonance move), close-approach sawtooth swells with Doppler glide derived from relative velocity + combined mass, slingshot filtered-noise whooshes, and total **kinetic energy** opening a master brightness lowpass so violent epochs sound turbulent and calm orbits spacious; always-on quiet bed; master `DynamicsCompressor` brick-wall limiter + 0.55 gain so a burst of simultaneous close-approaches can never blast; (3) **Canvas2D render** — glowing mass-sized discs with **comet trails** (translucent-dark-rect fade trick), close-approach flash lines, a cosmic per-body-hue palette; DPR-aware (capped 2×), resize-handled. **Interaction:** drag a body to fling it, drag empty space to drop a new mass (up to 7 bodies), forgiving grab radius, all controls ≥44px. Degrades cleanly: no Canvas2D → readable `text-rose-300` notice; AudioContext blocked/throws → visuals keep running silently + a `text-rose-300` "audio was blocked" notice (sim still interactive); AudioContext created **inside the Begin gesture** (iOS). Full teardown (cancel rAF + close AudioContext) on unmount. **No API route, no `guard` needed — no network at all** (Web Audio + Canvas2D + touch; no mic, camera, fetch, secrets, FAL_KEY). Zero new npm deps.

  References: the **three-body problem** & **Henri Poincaré**'s discovery of deterministic chaos / sensitive dependence on initial conditions; the **figure-8 choreography** (**Chenciner & Montgomery, 2000**, one preset). Born from RESEARCH §361. - **[/dream/422-shatter-piano](/dream/422-shatter-piano)** — Shatter 🩻. `demoable` · Cycle 357. **A calm, consonant piano phrase — and we refuse to let it land.** Tap **Shatter it** and a gentle ascending/descending figure (C4 D4 E4 G4 E4 D4, voiced to *want* to resolve to C4) plays once clean, then a **granular spectral-freeze engine** disassembles it: short 20–160 ms grains (Hann-windowed) are re-scattered at jittered read-positions, detuned ±180¢, and played reversed (≈25%→45% across the demo arc); a **FREEZE** locks the read-head on the leading-tone "almost-cadence" and lets it *drift* so it hangs forever without arriving. The auto-demo makes the move audible in one tap — **clean phrase (0s) → dissolving (2.2s) → chaos (5s) → frozen cloud (8.2s)**. **The lab's deliberate Ikeda/Akten counter-piece** — where Conchordal blooms into consonance and the cradle hums you to sleep, this one keeps the warm material and *denies its resolution* (jury #2/#1). **Subsystems (4):** (1) `OfflineAudioContext` phrase synth (the consonant source, rendered once, zero network); (2) granular/freeze engine (grain scheduler + position jitter + detune spread + reverse-probability + freeze-drift); (3) **AnalyserNode-driven DOM/CSS spectral grid** — 512 absolutely-positioned `<div>`s (32×16 freq-bin × time-smear), opacity/scale/hue/blur/transform mutated per rAF (no canvas, no SVG, no WebGL); (4) optional source-loader doors. **Input = synthesized phrase** (default) with **optional doors to Karel's real music** — paste a recording ID → `fetch('/api/audio/[id]')` (an *existing* route, not created here) or drag-drop an audio file, both `decodeAudioData` wrapped in try/catch that fails silently back to the synth phrase. **Output = pure DOM/CSS.** Master through a **DynamicsCompressor brick-wall limiter** (−6 dB, ratio 12) so dense grain clouds can't clip. Clean teardown (cancel rAF, stop grains, close AudioContext). No API route, no `guard` (the only network is the *optional* read of the existing `/api/audio/[id]`; no mic, no camera, no recording, no secrets, no FAL_KEY). Zero new npm deps. Typography-compliant (≥44px buttons, `text-amber-300/95` notices, `text-2xl` hero). **Ambition 2/5:** ≥3-subsystems (#2 — the 4 above) + named-reference (#3 — **phase vocoder: Flanagan & Golden 1966 / Dolson 1986**; **granular: Roads *Microsound* 2001 / Xenakis *Formalized Music* 1971**; contemporary touchstone **arXiv:2507.19202 "Latent Granular Resynthesis," 2025**). **#1 honestly NOT claimed** — granular synthesis exists in the lab (`227-paths-granular`❤️); the fresh move is the *consonance-denial framing* + the DOM/CSS spectral render, not the grain engine. **#5 honestly NOT claimed** — the granular-resynthesis touchstone is 2025, not <30d (this fire's fresh anchor, the NOAA-SWPC transition, went to the banked `421-solar-drone` sibling). **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-08 bans + the audit): **synth-phrase/audio-file INPUT** (dodges the banned **mic**) · **DOM/CSS OUTPUT** (dodges BOTH over-represented renderers — **SVG** 4× and **Canvas2D** 5× in the last 10 — and WebGL2/three.js; DOM/CSS = 0× in the last 10) · **granular spectral-freeze TECHNIQUE** (dodges the banned **Kuramoto**) · **abrasive consonance-denial VIBE** (the explicit answer to the banned **just-intonation / consonant-resolving** register). **Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer fire**; siblings `420-slime-static` (WebGPU compute physarum slime sonified as an abrasive roar) + `421-solar-drone` (live NOAA solar-wind audio-only off-screen drone — the real-data lane's cycle-2) build-verified (tsc+ESLint clean) and banked in IDEAS §357. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no audio in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether the frozen cloud reads as "deliberately denied/suspended" vs. "broken" on phone speakers (the legible clean→dissolve arc hedges it), the iOS AudioContext-in-tap path, DOM-grid perf with 512 cells on a low-end device, and whether the `/api/audio/[id]` door succeeds against a real Welcome-Home ID (defaults to the synth phrase regardless). ## Cycle 356 — kids build · DEEP, 3 approaches to ONE concept: *your body, seen through the camera, generates a BEAT, not a chord*; the winner answers the jury's #1 "rhythm/timbre/noise, not tuning" **and** #6 "camera embodiment / MediaPipe" in one fire — pure percussion that breaks the consonance rut

- **[/dream/419-kids-body-band](/dream/419-kids-body-band)** — Body Band 🥁. `demoable` · Cycle 356. **For kids 4+ — dance in front of the camera and your whole body plays a live DRUM kit: no melody, no tuning, just the beat you're making.** Tap the big **Start the band 🥁** and the front camera (mirrored, dimmed, with a glowing skeleton over your joints) turns your body into a drum kit via **MediaPipe Pose** (33 real-time landmarks): **left hand up → TOM · right hand up → SNARE/clap · both hands thrown wide/up fast → CRASH · knee-lift / body-drop → KICK · head-bob → HI-HAT ticks.** A **groove engine** runs a steady ~100 BPM 16th-note grid and **quantizes every gesture onto the nearest slot**, so even a flailing toddler locks into a beat; a soft always-on pulse keeps a groove when still, and motion energy raises its fullness. Hit velocity = how fast/big the move; each hit fires a colored burst at the triggering limb + lights its drum pad. **PURE PERCUSSION** — synthesized kick (pitch-enveloped sine + click), snare/clap (filtered noise burst), hi-hat (high-passed noise), tom (pitched sine), crash (bright bandpassed noise) — all through a master **DynamicsCompressor brick-wall limiter** (−6 dB, ratio 12) + soft master gain so it can **never blast small ears**. **The lab's first body-tracking piece that makes a BEAT instead of a chord** — every prior pose piece (`287-mirror-choir`, `302-mirror-canon-round`, `234-kids-hand-creature`❤️) maps the body to *harmony*; this maps it to *rhythm/noise* (jury #1) and uses **camera** input (jury #6) to dodge the over-represented mic. **Subsystems (4):** (1) `pose.ts` — MediaPipe-fed **stateful forgiving gesture detector** (per-gesture cooldowns, per-limb speed→velocity, head-bob zero-crossing hi-hat, smoothed motion energy) + a sine-driven **ghost dancer**; (2) `groove.ts` — ~100 BPM 16th-grid look-ahead scheduler with gesture quantization + energy-scaled always-on pulse; (3) `drums.ts` — limiter'd pure-percussion Web-Audio synthesis; (4) Canvas2D render (mirrored cover-fit video, dark veil, glowing bones/joints, additive limb-flash bursts, DPR/resize-aware). **Input = camera / MediaPipe Pose** (NOT mic). **Output = Canvas2D.** **Graceful degradation:** AudioContext + getUserMedia + MediaPipe all start inside the **one tap**; if the camera is denied or MediaPipe fails to load, a **ghost dancer** drives the *identical* gesture-detector + groove so a 06:30 phone reviewer hears + sees a full beat **hands-free within ~2s**, and the five drum pads are directly **tappable** as a third input path. Clean unmount teardown (rAF / `landmarker.close()` / stop tracks / `ctx.close()`). No API route, no `guard` (camera is local; the only network is the public MediaPipe CDN — no mic upload, no recording, no secrets, no FAL_KEY). Zero new npm deps (MediaPipe via the proven runtime CDN dynamic-import). Typography-compliant (84px start button, `text-rose-300` denied notice). **Ambition 3/5:** ≥3-subsystems(#2 — the 4 above) + named-reference(#3 — **"Dance Motion-Guided Music Generation via RVQ," *Electronics* 15(10):2098, May 2026**; **BlazePose**, Bazarevsky et al. 2020; **Lee et al. "Dancing to Music," NeurIPS 2019**) + recent-research(#5 — RESEARCH §356 this fire, the May-2026 RVQ paper, <30d). **#1 honestly NOT claimed** — MediaPipe Pose/Hand/Face were used before (`287`/`302`/`234`/`258`); the *fresh* move is the body→**percussion** mapping, not the tracker. **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-08 bans): **camera/body-pose INPUT** (dodges the banned **mic**; camera = 0× in the last 10 shipped) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (dodges the banned **SVG**) · **body-motion→quantized-drum-kit TECHNIQUE** (dodges the banned **Kuramoto**) · **kids energetic/percussive VIBE** (dodges the banned **just-intonation / consonant-resolving** register — pure noise/rhythm, the explicit counter to "everything resolves to gentle consonance"). Squarely in Karel's **loved camera-body-kids lineage** (`101-camera-song`❤️, `104-kids-mirror-draw`❤️, `217-dance-avatar`❤️, `234-kids-hand-creature`❤️). **Winner of a DEEP 3-approach fire**; siblings `420-kids-motion-storm` (a **no-ML** webcam frame-differencing motion-energy groove — dependency-free, builds even if the CDN is down) + `421-kids-beat-puppet` (a MediaPipe-Pose **continuous polyrhythm** where each limb drives a layer's density) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §356. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no camera/audio in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether the gesture thresholds feel right against a real moving toddler (first-guess constants — the central tuning bet), whether MediaPipe Pose loads + tracks fast enough on a phone, the iOS getUserMedia + AudioContext gesture path, and whether the discrete hits read as "I'm playing drums!" vs. noisy on phone speakers (the always-on pulse + tappable pads hedge it). ## Earlier (Cycle 355 — adult build · WIDE, 3 unrelated explorers; the lab's **first real-world-data sonification** — the planet's actual last-24h earthquakes, sonified so it *never resolves*)

- **[/dream/418-seismic-pulse](/dream/418-seismic-pulse)** — Seismic Pulse 🌍. `demoable` · Cycle 355. **Hear the whole planet shaking: the last 24 hours of real earthquakes (live USGS feed), sonified so it never lands on a chord.** Press **▶ Play the last 24 hours** (or wait 2.5 s for the auto-demo) and the day's seismicity — compressed into a 75-second loop — plays across a dark equirectangular world map: each quake fires an expanding ring at its true lon/lat and a sound transient mapped from the data — **magnitude → loudness + sub-bass weight, depth → filter pitch (shallow = bright crack, deep = low rumble), longitude → stereo pan, latitude → filter resonance.** Big events (M3.5+) drop a short non-musical sine **boom** (~38–65 Hz, raw data value — *no scale snapping*); shallow small ones snap a high **crack**; underneath, a continuous **tectonic drone** of two detuned sub-oscillators (28.3 / 31.7 Hz) **beats at ~3.4 Hz** so even the silent gaps feel like a restless, unresolved planet. **The lab's FIRST real-world-data sonification** — the jury's named "music about something other than music," which it flagged as *zero in 15 cycles* and the move that "breaks the mic rut **and** the consonance rut in one fire." It is also the lab's first piece whose audio source is a **live external API** (USGS GeoJSON, public-domain, no key, CORS), with a robust **offline fallback** (43 hard-coded Ring-of-Fire quakes + an amber "feed unreachable — playing a recorded day" notice) so it's always demoable. **Subsystems (4):** (1) `data.ts` — USGS fetch with 5 s AbortController timeout + offline fallback; (2) the 24h→75s **scheduling engine** (`setTimeout`-sequenced events, looped); (3) `sonify.ts` — data-mapped **noise-burst + sub-sine + high-crack** synthesis through per-event `StereoPanner` + `BiquadFilter`, master `DynamicsCompressor` limiter, no scale quantization anywhere; (4) Canvas2D **world-map + 24h timeline** render (graticule, continent polylines, persistent dots, expanding flash rings, moving playhead, live M/place/depth readout). **Input = external data (USGS)** — NOT mic, NOT camera, NOT touch. **Output = Canvas2D.** No API route, no `guard` (USGS is a public read-only client-side GET; no secrets, no FAL_KEY). Zero new deps. Typography-compliant; graceful amber/"tap to enable sound" fallbacks. **Ambition 3/5:** never-used-technique(#1 — **first external-API real-world-data sonification**, grep-verified lab-first) + ≥3-subsystems(#2 — the 4 above) + named-reference(#3 — **Ryoji Ikeda *data-cosm*, 180 Studios, on view through Feb 2026**; **USGS audification — "From Wiggles to Pops, Booms and Rumbles," AGU/Eos**). #4/#5 honestly NOT claimed (single-cycle; the seismic-audification corpus is foundational). **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-08 bans): **external-data-API INPUT** (dodges the banned **mic**) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (dodges the banned **SVG**) · **real-world-data audification TECHNIQUE** (dodges the banned **Kuramoto**) · **geologic / Ikeda-clinical / abrasive-unresolved VIBE** (dodges the banned **just-intonation / consonant-resolving** register — it is atonal noise, the explicit counter-piece). **Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer fire**; siblings `419-webgpu-storm` (the lab's first **WebGPU compute shader** — a 500k-particle curl-noise storm + abrasive bed; answers jury #3, build-reviewed, banked because its GPU headline is unverifiable here and degrades to CPU on mobile Safari) + `420-test-pattern` (a Ryoji-Ikeda **test-tone / beating / glitch** piece that flatly refuses to resolve; answers jury #2) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §355. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no audio/network in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether the live USGS fetch + CORS works in prod (sample fallback hedges it), whether the data-mapped booms/cracks read as "the planet, abrasive-but-intentional" vs. just noise on phone speakers, and the iOS AudioContext-autoplay gesture path. Design notes: `src/app/dream/418-seismic-pulse/README.md`
- **[/dream/417-kids-cradle-song](/dream/417-kids-cradle-song)** — Cradle Song 🌙. `demoable` · Cycle 354. **For kids 4+ — an almost-screenless, audio-first lullaby you ROCK like a cradle: a humming companion locks to your rhythm, then gently leads your rocking *down* toward sleep.** Tap **Begin**, close your eyes, and rock the tablet gently side to side. A soft humming voice (additive sine/triangle partials shaped by two vowel-formant bandpass filters — pure synthesis, **no AI/sampled voice**) hums a whole-tone arpeggio in time with each rock over a warm drone, panned with a slow stereo sway; over ~12 minutes its tempo **drifts from ~65 down to ~45 rocks/min**, and because the music is *coupled* to you, it carries your rocking down with it — then fades to "Goodnight." **The lab's first BIDIRECTIONAL sensorimotor-entrainment piece** (the music both follows *and leads* you) and its **second truly off-screen / audio-first** piece (after `346-sound-hunt`) — the running screen is near-black with a **single faint breathing dot** as the only visual; *all* the information lives in the ears. This is the **DEEP off-screen cycle the JURY 2026-06-07 explicitly asked for** (#5: "still only ONE truly off-screen piece … spend a DEEP cycle on the non-screen / spatial-audio / haptic shelf … the lab keeps *researching* embodiment and never building it"). It's distinct from the lab's existing movement piece `402-kids-steady-walk`, which only *analyzes* your beat one-way (steadiness → a creature's gait) and never leads. Subsystems: (1) **`entrain.ts → stepMusicOsc`** — a genuine **Kuramoto** single-pair coupling `dθ_music/dt = ω(t) + K·sin(θ_rock − θ_music)` (K=2.2, Euler-integrated), where the music's natural frequency `ω(t)` drifts linearly from `OMEGA_WAKE` (~65 cpm) toward `OMEGA_SLEEP` (~45 cpm) over the session — the `sin(·)` nonlinearity makes it a true coupled oscillator (stable lock near Δθ=0, graceful saturation far away), not a PLL; (2) **`makeRockDetector`** — EMA-smoothed gravity-tilt (`accelerationIncludingGravity.x`), upward zero-crossing detection → IIR-smoothed rock-period estimate → interpolated instantaneous rock phase; (3) **additive formant hum-voice synth** (fundamental sine + octave triangle + 3rd-harmonic shimmer, routed through bandpass formants at ~680/1150 Hz "aah/ooh") + warm drone + code-generated **ConvolverNode** reverb + **StereoPanner** phase-sway, all → **DynamicsCompressor brick-wall limiter** (−8 dB, ratio 12, 1 ms attack) + master gain so it can never blast small ears. **Input = DeviceMotion** (iOS 13+ `requestPermission()` + `AudioContext` both created inside the **Begin** tap), with a **pointer-drag fallback** (drag left-right to "rock") and a **2.5 s auto-demo** that synthesises a gentle 0.82 Hz rock and feeds the same Kuramoto step — so a sensor-less 06:30 phone reviewer hears the full hum-and-lead-to-sleep arc **hands-free**. Optional tiny `navigator.vibrate(28)` per rock (guarded; iOS ignores it). 🎧 headphones recommended. **Degrades gracefully:** motion denied → readable `text-rose-300` notice + drag fallback + auto-demo still runs; no Web Audio → readable notice; clean unmount teardown (rAF / listener / timer / `ctx.close()`). **No `<canvas>`, no SVG, no WebGL, no three.js** (audio-only render — dodges the JURY-banned raw-WebGL2/three.js, the over-represented Canvas2D, *and* SVG, which just hit 4× in the last 10 shipped and is banned this cycle). No API route, no `guard` (Web Audio + DOM only, all client-side; no mic, no camera, no network, no recording, no secrets). Zero new deps. **Ambition 4/5**: never-used-technique(#1, **bidirectional human↔music entrainment — a music oscillator that LEADS the listener's tempo** — grep-verified lab-first; `402` only analyzes one-way, `384`'s Kuramoto couples organism↔organism, never human↔music) + ≥3-subsystems(#2, rock-detector + Kuramoto entrainment engine + formant hum synth + drone/reverb/sway) + named-reference(#3, **Kuramoto 1975** · **D-Jogger / Moens, Leman et al. ~2014** · **interactive-RAS / Hove et al. 2012** · **Repp 2005** SMS review · **Oliveros *Deep Listening* 2005**) + multi-cycle-commitment(#4, **cycle 1 of a new bidirectional-entrainment thread** — cycle 2 = the DOM-CSS *visible* leads, §354 siblings; cycle 3 = Karel's *Welcome Home* piano as the entrainment bed). **#5 honestly NOT claimed** (the entrainment corpus is foundational, 2005–2014; the dive's only <90d hits were spatial-audio pieces the build doesn't use — RESEARCH §354). **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-07 bans + the SVG-now-4× / Canvas2D over-rep): **device-motion (rocking) INPUT** (NOT touch/tap, NOT MIDI/keyboard) · **audio-only / off-screen OUTPUT** (NOT WebGL2, NOT three.js, NOT Canvas2D, NOT SVG) · **bidirectional Kuramoto-entrainment TECHNIQUE** (lab-first) · **whole-tone / just-intonation calm VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian, NOT C-pentatonic). Winner of a **DEEP** 3-approach fire (one concept — *music that locks to your movement and leads your tempo* — three engines/directions); siblings `415-kids-rock-the-moon` (DOM/CSS breathing-moon wind-down, **Large & Jones 1999 adaptive oscillator**, JI-major) + `416-kids-wake-the-band` (DOM/CSS parade *wake-up* with a legible "Together!" phase-lock meter, **ADAM phase+period correction**, Lydian — leads tempo *up*) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §354. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no sensor/audio in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether the downward lead *perceptibly* carries a real child's rocking toward sleep within the session (K / ω-drift constants are first-guess and the central bet), whether the formant-hum reads as a *soothing companion* vs. uncanny on phone speakers, the gravity-tilt rock detector on a real tilting hand (vs. the synthetic demo), the iOS DeviceMotion-permission + AudioContext gesture path, and whether a near-black audio-only screen reads as "intentional/calming" vs. "broken" at a 06:30 glance (the single breathing dot is the hedge). ## (Cycle 353 — adult build · DEEP, one LISTENING-A-LIFE concept via 3 renderers; winner makes the lab's emergent-harmony garden **LISTEN to real piano** — cycle 3 of the a-life/JI thread, stacking the two *expensive* ambition criteria the jury said are nearly absent)

- **[/dream/414-conchordal-listen](/dream/414-conchordal-listen)** — Conchordal Listen 🎼. `demoable` · Cycle 353. **The living chord that LISTENS — play piano and a self-composing pure-intonation harmony grows itself *around what you play*.** Cycle 1 (`410-conchordal-garden`) was the lab's first **artificial-life audio piece** — sound-organisms forage a continuous Plomp–Levelt consonance landscape and emergent just intonation arises *in a vacuum*, no scale ever specified. This cycle adds the missing third leg: **a "listen" subsystem** so the organisms forage around the pitches of *real audio*. Tap **"▶ Self-play demo"** and within ~2 s an internal gentle JI piano phrase begins; amber SVG "sunlight wells" bloom at the heard pitches and 28–40 microtonal flower-organisms visibly drift toward them, assembling pure intervals (octaves, fifths, just-thirds) around the phrase — **hands-free, so the 06:30 phone reviewer sees+hears it self-organize untouched.** Or tap **"🎹 Play piano"** to feed a live mic, or paste a **Welcome Home recording ID** to forage around Karel's real piano (the `163-paths-visualizer` `/api/audio/{id}` pattern; graceful `text-rose-300` error, demo keeps running). **Why it matters:** the JURY 2026-06-07's loudest call (#3) was *"deepen, don't defer — stack the EXPENSIVE criteria #4 multi-cycle + #5 recent research, extend a thread instead of opening a fresh explorer."* This is exactly that: **cycle 3** of the JI/roughness/a-life thread (404 adaptive-JI → 410 emergent-JI → **414 listening-JI**), and it honors Karel's standing **real-music directive** (use his actual *Welcome Home* tracks as input). Five subsystems: (1) **`engine.ts → plRoughness`** — the **Plomp–Levelt 1965** critical-band roughness curve `a₁a₂(e^{-3.5sx}−e^{-5.75sx})`, summed over all partial-pairs against *both* the heard spectrum and the other organisms; (2) **a-life organism sim** — each organism is an additive Web-Audio voice at a *continuous* microtonal pitch (no fixed scale, **no D-Dorian**) foraging via **Metropolis–Hastings** pitch moves (accept-if-better, accept-worse with `exp(−ΔF/T)`, T cooling) toward lower roughness + a harmonicity bonus to the strongest heard partial; consonant organisms thrive, chronically dissonant ones die and **re-seed near heard partials**; (3) **the listen subsystem (the cycle-3 addition)** — `extractFftPeaks` finds the top ~4 spectral peaks (robust for polyphonic piano — *no* full in-browser transcription, per musicalboard.com 2026-05-05) and `detectFundamental` adds one monophonic f₀ via **MPM/autocorrelation** (McLeod & Wyvill 2005) with parabolic interpolation; these become the landscape's attractor wells; (4) **Kuramoto phase coupling** (`θᵢ += dt·(ωᵢ + K·Σⱼ sin(θⱼ−θᵢ))`, K=1.5) over mutually-consonant voices so a discovered chord *breathes together* (empirical backing: consonance increases interpersonal phase sync — **PMC11534602, 2024**); (5) **audio chain** — additive voices → master → ConvolverNode reverb + **DynamicsCompressor brick-wall limiter** (−6 dB, ratio 12) so it can never clip or blast. **Renderer: inline SVG** (dodges the JURY-banned raw-WebGL2/three.js *and* the now-over-represented Canvas2D ≥5× in the last 10): amber radial-gradient wells at heard pitches, 5–8-petal blooms that open with health and pulse with Kuramoto phase, swaying Bézier stems, consonant-pair connection threads, and a legible HUD (heard-pitch note names + a mean-consonance meter that climbs as harmony settles). **Degrades gracefully:** `AudioContext` created inside the Start tap (autoplay-safe); mic denied/absent → readable `text-rose-300` notice + the self-play demo still runs (never blank); failed recording fetch → readable error, demo continues. ## (Cycle 352 — kids build · DEEP, one ARTICULATORY-MIRROR concept via 3 renderers; winner is the lab's first formant-to-tongue **articulatory-inversion** toy + its first use of real **LPC** formant tracking — a child sings a vowel and *sees inside the mouth*)

- **[/dream/413-kids-mouth-mirror](/dream/413-kids-mouth-mirror)** — The Magic X-Ray Mouth Mirror 👄. `demoable` · Cycle 352. **For kids 4+ — sing a vowel and SEE INSIDE the mouth: a friendly side-view cartoon head whose tongue, jaw, and lips physically move to the shape your voice implies, then sings the vowel back.** Tap **Start 🎤**, sing a long `aaah` / `eee` / `ooo` and watch the paper-cream animal head (drawn in cross-section, facing left) glide its articulators in real time — `aaah` drops the jaw and flattens the tongue low-and-back; `eee` nearly closes the jaw and pushes the tongue high-and-front; `ooo` purses the lips and pulls the tongue back. A little **vowel-quadrilateral inset** plots where your tongue is; after ~1.2 s of quiet the head **sings your vowel back** in a dreamy **whole-tone** voice. **The lab's first articulatory-inversion toy and its first use of real LPC formant tracking.** This answers JURY 2026-06-07 **provocation #6** head-on ("a *kids* listening/analysis toy — a child sings, the machine shows what it heard — would break both macro-ruts in one fire") and feeds the standing legible/instructional lane: it's the AURORA formant-to-tongue-inversion idea done **literally** (you see the tongue, not a flat color) and it fixes the exact gap the lab's prior vowel piece `393-kids-vowel-color` flagged — 393 used crude FFT peak-picking and its own README concedes that is **unreliable precisely for children's high voices** (wide harmonic spacing makes the "formant" peak land on whichever harmonic falls in-band). Three subsystems: (1) **`lpc.ts`** — real **Linear Predictive Coding**: pre-emphasis (0.97) → Hamming window → autocorrelation → **Levinson–Durbin recursion (order 14)** → evaluate the all-pole spectral envelope on a frequency grid → peak-pick **F1** (~250–900 Hz) and **F2** (~900–2800 Hz) with parabolic interpolation → **articulatory inversion** to (jaw, tongue-height ∝ 1/F1, tongue-frontness ∝ F2, lip-rounding ∝ low-F2) → α=0.15 exponential smoothing → Peterson–Barney nearest-vowel label. LPC models the *vocal-tract filter* independent of pitch, which is exactly why it survives a child's f0 where FFT peak-picking fails; (2) **`page.tsx`** — an all-**SVG** side-profile head whose tongue-body path, jaw, and lip curves are rebuilt every frame from the *raw smoothed* (F1,F2) so the articulators **glide continuously**, never snapping between 5 fixed poses, plus the vowel-quadrilateral dot, a big readable vowel label, and a live F1/F2 readout; (3) **`synth.ts`** — a **whole-tone** sing-back (C-D-E-F#-G#) shaped through **two bandpass filters tuned to the heard F1/F2** so the machine actually *sounds* like the vowel, soft attack/release, idle-breath pad, everything → master gain → `DynamicsCompressor` brick-wall limiter so it can never blast small ears. The mic feeds an `AnalyserNode` **only** — never recorded, routed to speakers, or transmitted. **Degrades gracefully:** mic denied/absent → readable `text-rose-300` notice + a hands-free **attract mode** that cycles the head through /a/→/e/→/i/→/o/→/u/ (moving the tongue + singing each) so a no-mic 06:30 phone reviewer sees+hears the whole call-and-response within a few seconds; with mic, ~4 s of silence drifts to a gentle idle breath; `AudioContext` created inside the Start tap (autoplay-safe). **No WebGL2, no three.js, no Canvas2D** (SVG only — dodges both the JURY-banned GPU renderers and the now-over-represented Canvas2D). No API route, no `guard` (Web Audio + SVG, all client-side; no camera, no network, no recording, no secrets). Zero new deps. **Ambition 3/5**: never-used-technique(#1, **real LPC / Levinson–Durbin formant tracking + articulatory inversion** — grep-verified lab-first; 393 used FFT peak-picking and explicitly lacked LPC) + ≥3-subsystems(#2, LPC formant tracker + articulatory-inversion SVG renderer + formant-shaped whole-tone sing-back) + named-reference(#3, **AURORA formant-to-tongue inversion, arXiv:2603.17543, Mar 2026** · **Peterson & Barney 1952** · the **vowel-quadrilateral / IPA articulatory model** · **Levinson–Durbin / Fant 1960 source–filter**). **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-07 bans + the Canvas2D watch): **mic-voice INPUT** (breaks the banned touch/tap reflex) · **SVG OUTPUT** (NOT raw-WebGL2, NOT three.js, NOT Canvas2D) · **LPC-articulatory-inversion TECHNIQUE** (lab-first) · **whole-tone VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian, NOT C-pentatonic). Crosses **JURY #6** — a kids *listening/analysis* toy (breaks the kids emergence-sim reflex). Winner of a **DEEP** 3-renderer fire (one concept — *a creature that physically copies your mouth from a sung vowel and sings it back* — three attacks); siblings `411-kids-copycat-mouth` (front-facing SVG clay creature, **LPC**, just-intonation — the warmest/most kid-delightful, cleanest modular code) + `412-kids-vowel-puppet` (Canvas2D gooey clay puppet, **cepstral** formant extraction, gamelan slendro — the distinct-technique A/B) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §352. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no mic/audio in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether real children's voices track cleanly on the F1/F2 bands (LPC order/band edges are first-guess and the central bet of the whole piece), whether the moving tongue reads as *delightful* vs *clinical* at a 06:30 phone glance, the silence-gate timing for sing-back in a noisy room, and iOS Safari AudioContext gesture-unlock. Design notes: `src/app/dream/413-kids-mouth-mirror/README.md`

## (Cycle 351 — adult build · DEEP, one EMERGENT-HARMONY concept via 3 renderers; winner is the lab's first ARTIFICIAL-LIFE / a-life audio piece where a chord is alive and discovers just intonation with no scale specified)

- **[/dream/410-conchordal-garden](/dream/410-conchordal-garden)** — Conchordal Garden. `demoable` · Cycle 351. **The lab's first ARTIFICIAL-LIFE audio piece — a chord that's *alive*. A garden of ~24 sound-organisms drifts through continuous pitch space hunting consonance; the ones that find it bloom and grow loud, the ones that clash wilt and die, and a self-composing just-intonation-like harmony *emerges with no scale ever specified* — genuinely different at minute 5 than minute 0.** Tap **Start Garden** (it plays itself — no interaction needed) and watch: each organism is a sustained additive voice plotted by pitch on the vertical log axis (130–780 Hz). A **Plomp–Levelt roughness** model (the standard `a₁a₂(e^{-3.5x} − e^{-5.75x})` critical-band curve summed over 5 partials per voice) plus a **harmonicity bonus** for proximity to small-integer ratios (1/1, 9/8, 6/5, 5/4, 4/3, 3/2, 5/3, 2/1) defines a continuous **consonance fitness landscape**; each organism proposes small Gaussian pitch moves (±15¢) and accepts them **greedily-or-via-Metropolis** if dissonance drops, with a **crowding penalty** so they don't pile onto one note. **Metabolism**: consonant organisms gain health (bloom: petals open, glow brightens), persistently rough ones lose it and **die** (wilt, red dissonance ring, fade out); healthy ones **reproduce** (a seed sprouts nearby), so the garden self-sustains and re-seeds if it crashes. **Kuramoto phase coupling** synchronizes the amplitude tremolo + visual breathing among consonant clusters, so a discovered chord visibly/audibly **pulses together** — the "togetherness" payoff. Rendered in **inline animated SVG** (radial-gradient blooms, glow auras, curved vine-threads between consonant pairs that pulse with shared phase, Kuramoto-swayed stems) — **no Canvas2D, no WebGL/three.js**. Audio = additive sine voices (gain ∝ health × tremolo, frequency **glides** via `setTargetAtTime`) → synthetic-IR `ConvolverNode` reverb → `DynamicsCompressor` limiter; calm, ambient, never harsh. Optional **click-to-plant** a seed at a chosen pitch (NOT required — the piece is fully autonomous). Live stats: elapsed time, population, **mean-consonance** climbing as the garden self-organizes. **Degrades gracefully:** no Web Audio → readable `text-rose-300` notice + the visual ecosystem keeps running silently. No API route, no `guard` (Web Audio + SVG, all client-side; no mic/camera/network/recording/secrets). Zero new deps. **Ambition 4/5**: never-used-technique(#1, **artificial-life consonance-foraging / agents that survive on consonance** — grep-verified lab-first; the lab has *fixed-ratio* JI (397/400) and *adaptive* JI (404) but never an *emergent, scale-free, evolutionary* harmony) + ≥3-subsystems(#2, Plomp–Levelt fitness-landscape engine + a-life organism life-sim + Kuramoto coupling + additive Web-Audio synth + SVG garden render = 5) + multi-cycle(#4, **cycle 2 of the JI/roughness thread** that 404→405 opened — promotes roughness from a *readout* to the *physics that drives the population*; designed to deepen with Karel's real piano as future organisms) + recent-research(#5, **"Conchordal: Emergent Harmony via Direct Cognitive Coupling in a Psychoacoustic Landscape," arXiv:2603.25637, submitted 2026-03-26** — current-quarter, directly on-technique; honest caveat: ~74 days, not strictly <30, so claimed as **borderline/current-quarter**, the freshest on-technique anchor in ~9 dives). **Stacks the two *expensive* criteria (#4 + #5) the jury said are nearly absent**, and crosses **jury #6** — it's an *adult emergence-sim sonified as a generative form*, breaking the adult-analysis-engine reflex. **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-07 bans + the now-over-represented Canvas2D): **autonomous-generative INPUT** (NOT MIDI/keyboard, NOT touch-as-instrument) · **inline-SVG OUTPUT** (NOT raw-WebGL2, NOT three.js, **NOT Canvas2D** — which appeared ≥4× in the last 10 shipped, so it was banned by the diversity audit this cycle) · **a-life consonance-foraging TECHNIQUE** (lab-first) · **emergent microtonal, no-fixed-scale VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian, NOT C-pentatonic — the literal antidote to the jury's #2). Winner of a **DEEP** 3-renderer fire (one concept — *a chord that is alive, foraging a psychoacoustic landscape* — three visual attacks); siblings `409-conchordal-field` (the same a-life engine rendered as a **Canvas2D dissonance heatmap** — agents settle into glowing consonance *valleys*; the most faithful realization of the paper's "psychoacoustic landscape") + `411-conchordal-spiral` (the same engine on a **Canvas2D log-spiral** where one turn = an octave, so emergent pure fifths/thirds snap into recurring color-coded geometric constellations) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §351. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no audio hardware in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether the emergent chord *perceptibly* reads as "settling from chaos into consonance" by ear on phone speakers within the first minute, whether the population finds stable JI intervals or wanders (the metabolism/Metropolis/coupling constants are first-guess), per-frame SVG `innerHTML` rebuild perf at ~36 organisms on a low-end tablet, and the iOS AudioContext gesture-unlock path. ## (Cycle 350 — kids build · DEEP, one long-form-STATEFUL concept via 3 renderers; winner is the lab's first BREATH-GROWN LONG-FORM piece that *remembers every breath* + replays its own growth)

- **[/dream/408-kids-breath-grove](/dream/408-kids-breath-grove)** — Breath Grove. `demoable` · Cycle 350. **The lab's first LONG-FORM STATEFUL kids piece: breathe slowly and a glowing tree grows branch-by-branch over a few minutes — and because it *remembers every breath*, you can tap "replay" and watch the whole grove's growth race by in seconds.** Tap the big Begin button (or just wait — it auto-demos) and breathe out: a mic **RMS breath-envelope** detector (smoothed RMS + an **auto-calibrating noise-floor EMA** so a quiet child still crosses the gate; analysis-only, never recorded/uploaded) fires ONE event per exhale, carrying its duration + strength. Each exhale feeds an **L-system-inspired recursive-branching grove** (`grove.ts`): early breaths sprout saplings, later ones extend tips and **split branches** (split probability + length scale with breath strength), maturing branches accrete leaves → flowers → embers. Every segment and blossom is stamped with the **breath index that created it**, so the grove carries genuine memory — and a deterministic xorshift RNG seeded per session means `buildTimelapse()` can faithfully **rebuild the entire growth history from the recorded breaths** for the replay. A 4-stage arc driven by cumulative breath count gates the look: **(1, breaths 1–4)** bare saplings rise · **(2, 5–9)** branches split, first leaves · **(3, 10–14)** blossoms open, fireflies drift among the branches · **(4, 15+)** the night sky deepens to violet, a moon + aurora glow, the grove is full. Audio (`audio.ts`) is a **pelog-like INHARMONIC** drone — 5 stage-gated sine voices (55 / 82.41 / 110 / 164.81 / 185 Hz, each bent 8–22¢ off 12-TET with a per-voice vibrato LFO + a soft 2nd-partial) that **thicken voice-by-voice as the grove grows**, plus a per-exhale **inharmonic bell bloom** (partials 1 : 2.756 : 5.404 — a real metallophone-like spectrum, not a harmonic tone), all through a **`DynamicsCompressor` brick-wall limiter** at low master gain so it can never blast small ears (KIDS-safe: no harsh transients, never silent). Renderer is **Canvas2D** (DPR/resize-aware; background gradient + aurora + moon + stars + glow-pass branches + leaves/flowers/embers + drifting fireflies) — **no WebGL/three.js** (the jury's standing output ban). **Degrades + auto-demos:** deny/ignore the mic → readable `text-rose-300` notice + an **auto-demo** that fires synthetic breaths every ~3.2s (also auto-triggers after 8s of mic silence) so the full arc grows hands-free and reaches **Stage 4 in ~48s** — a 06:30 phone reviewer sees grass→grove→moon and the timelapse replay with zero permission; provenance badge shows emerald "Listening 🎤" vs amber "Auto-demo (breathing)". No API route, no `guard` (Web Audio mic-analysis + Canvas2D, all client-side; no recording/upload/network/secrets). Zero new deps. **Ambition 3/5**: ≥3-subsystems(#2, breath-RMS detector + L-system grove state-machine + Canvas2D renderer + pelog drone/bell synth = 4) + **multi-cycle / long-form-STATEFUL(#4, the *expensive* criterion the jury said is nearly absent — the grove is genuinely different at minute 3 than minute 0, accretes indefinitely, and the timelapse makes the "remembers every breath" thesis literal)** + named-reference(#3, **L-systems (Aristid Lindenmayer)** recursive branching · **pelog / Indonesian gamelan inharmonic tuning** · Brian Eno generative-ambient lineage). Honest #5: no <30-day client-buildable hit this dive (the dive surfaced the live 2026 generative-ambient + guided-breathing wave as supporting context, soundverse 2026 / isotonik generative-worldscape — but no dated technique anchor), so #5 is **not** claimed. **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-07 bans): **breath-RMS INPUT** (NOT MIDI/keyboard, NOT touch/tap) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (NOT raw-WebGL2, NOT three.js) · **L-system-grove / breath-accretion TECHNIQUE** (lab-first) · **pelog long-form-stateful VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian, NOT C-pentatonic) — and it directly stacks the categorical menu's thin **"long-form generative — state, memory, evolution, not loops"** shelf. Winner of a **DEEP** 3-renderer fire (one concept — *your breathing grows a night-garden that remembers every breath* — three technical attacks); siblings `407-kids-breath-garden` (the canonical **inline-SVG** meadow: grass → swaying flowers → fireflies → crescent-moon violet sky — the most legible literal-imagery bedtime read) + `409-kids-breath-tidepool` (a **pure DOM/CSS** bioluminescent reef: each breath blooms a glowing anemone/jellyfish/plankton that pulses forever — extreme renderer diversity) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §350. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no audio/mic hardware in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether the pelog detuning reads as "warm + other" vs merely "out of tune" on phone speakers, whether a quiet child's exhale reliably crosses the auto-calibrated gate on a real phone mic in a bedroom, the iOS AudioContext gesture-unlock path, and per-frame Canvas2D redraw perf as branch/blossom counts grow on a low-end tablet. Design notes: `src/app/dream/408-kids-breath-grove/README.md`

## (Cycle 349 — adult build · DEEP, one fresh foreign-tonal concept via 3 approaches; winner is the lab's first ADAPTIVE / DYNAMIC just-intonation piece)

- **[/dream/404-comma-pump](/dream/404-comma-pump)** — Comma Pump. `demoable` · Cycle 349. **The lab's first piece in ADAPTIVE (dynamic) just intonation — and a piece of music that, by mathematical necessity, can never come home.** Press **Start**: an autonomous, slow, soft pad-progression `I → IV → ii → V → I` plays, but unlike the lab's earlier *fixed-ratio* JI pieces (394/397/400) every chord is voiced from PURE 5-limit ratios above a root that is itself reached by PURE interval *root motions* (×4/3, ×5/6, ×4/3, ×2/3). The product of one full loop is exactly **80/81** — the **syntonic comma** — so the tonic sinks ≈ **−21.5 ¢ per cycle, indefinitely**: a long-form **stateful** drift where minute 5 sits audibly flat of minute 1 (≈ a whole tone down after ~15 min). The Canvas2D **"pitch river"** scrolls time left→right over a log-frequency axis; a dim blue line marks the original home tonic (A3 = 220 Hz, fixed forever) and a bright violet line marks the current drifting root — you literally *watch home sink away from the music*, with a live **cents-from-home** counter. The payoff control is **JI ⇄ 12-TET**: flip to equal temperament and every voice snaps to the nearest tempered pitch — the drift stops (ET *tempers out* the comma) but you immediately hear the **beating** of impure thirds (400¢ vs the pure 386¢) and fifths; flip back and the chords lock beat-free. A **tempo** slider scales the harmonic rhythm without touching the tuning math. Synth = additive pad (5 sine/triangle partials per voice) → `ConvolverNode` reverb → `DynamicsCompressor` brick-wall limiter (never blasts). No mic/camera/MIDI/touch-as-instrument, **no WebGL/three.js** (Canvas2D only), no API route, no `guard` (pure client-side Web Audio + Canvas2D; no network/recording/secrets). Zero new deps. **Ambition 3/5**: never-used-technique(#1, **adaptive/dynamic JI + comma-pump drift** — grep-verified lab-first; prior JI is fixed-ratio, and 37-ratio-lab is a *static* click Tonnetz) + ≥3-subsystems(#2, adaptive 5-limit tuner + generative progression scheduler + additive pad/reverb/limiter synth + Canvas2D scrolling river) + named-reference(#3, **syntonic comma / comma pump (81/80)** · **Pivotuner arXiv:2306.03873** adaptive real-time JI · **Ben Johnston / Harry Partch** · **La Monte Young, *The Well-Tuned Piano***). Honest #5: no <30-day client-buildable hit again (the dive widened to the AI-music/hardware changelog space — soundverse 2026, SONICWARE Ambient Ø 1.5 — but Pivotuner is 2023/foundational), so #5 is **not** claimed. **Diversity** (vs JURY 2026-06-07 bans): **autonomous-generative INPUT** (NOT MIDI/keyboard, NOT touch-as-instrument) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** (NOT raw-WebGL2, NOT three.js) · **adaptive-JI / comma-pump TECHNIQUE** (lab-first) · **5-limit-JI drift VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian, NOT C-pentatonic) — answers JURY #1 (non-GPU renderer) + #2 (foreign tonal world) + #6 (generative, not the adult analysis reflex), and stacks the long-form/stateful menu shelf the lab is thin on. Winner of a **DEEP** 3-approach fire; siblings `405-pure-lock` (autonomous chords gliding 12-TET→JI under a live **Plomp–Levelt roughness meter** that collapses to zero as partials lock — the lab's most legible/pedagogical JI demo) + `406-drifting-choir` (5–7 sustained voices that **glissando-retune to pure ratios** as a wandering pivot moves, Pivotuner-style ambient drone) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §349. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no audio hardware in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether the JI-vs-ET beating contrast reads as *striking* on phone speakers, whether the comma drift is *perceptible* as "sinking" by ear over minutes (it's slow by design), reverb/limiter balance, and whether the pitch-river home/root lines read clearly at a 06:30 phone glance. Design notes: `src/app/dream/404-comma-pump/README.md`

## (Cycle 348 — kids build · WIDE, 3 listening/analysis toys each on an un-centered analysis dimension, all SVG output + non-D-Dorian; winner is the lab's first pulse-STEADINESS / entrainment toy)

- **[/dream/402-kids-steady-walk](/dream/402-kids-steady-walk)** — Steady Walk. `demoable` · Cycle 348. **The lab's first pulse-STEADINESS / entrainment toy: a little creature walks *smoothly* only while you keep a steady beat — clap or say "bup bup bup" — and *stumbles* the moment your beat gets wobbly.** Tap **Start** (or **Watch it play** for the no-mic demo) and clap a pulse: a mic **onset detector** (half-wave-rectified **spectral flux × high-frequency-content**, adaptive running-mean threshold, ~120 ms refractory per Repp 2005) fires one step per clap/percussive vocal hit; the last 8 **inter-onset intervals** feed a steadiness score = **1 − CV** (CV = stddev/mean of the IOIs) and a tempo = 60000/median(IOI). **Steadiness drives the gait** — high → even alternating SVG walk-cycle at your tempo, smiling, clear spots; low → lurching uneven legs, body wobble, a worried face. Each step plays a footstep tone cycling a **slendro** pentatonic (Indonesian gamelan, ≈[196, 226, 258, 296, 342] Hz + octave — a non-Western, **non-D-Dorian** world); hold steady for 8 steps and the creature **hops** and a flower blooms ahead on the scrolling path. This is the single-fire **double-rut break** the JURY (2026-06-07) asked for in provocation #6: it takes the lab's *adult analysis-engine reflex* (onset/IOI/tempo tracking — the 358/365/370/375/380 family) and turns it into a *kids listening toy*, and it scores the child's **internal pulse steadiness** (sensorimotor entrainment), NOT pattern recall — so it's distinct from the existing clap-*echo* toys (154-clap-back, 371-clap-along). **Renderer is inline SVG** (creature, scrolling path, footprints, steadiness meter, reward flowers) — the direct answer to jury #1 ("raw-WebGL2 is the new Canvas2D — ban it"): zero canvas, zero WebGL. **Degrades + auto-demos:** deny/ignore the mic → readable `text-rose-300` notice + a **Watch it play** demo that scripts a steady→wobbly→steady onset stream so the whole mechanic (smooth walk → stumble → recover) is legible hands-free at a 06:30 phone glance; a **Use mic** button promotes the demo to live. No API route, no `guard` (Web Audio mic-analysis + SVG, all client-side; no recording/upload/network/secrets). Zero new deps. **Ambition 3/5**: never-used-technique(#1, IOI-variance **steadiness / entrainment scoring** — grep-verified lab-first; prior clap toys echo *patterns*, none score *pulse steadiness*) + ≥3-subsystems(#2, spectral-flux onset detector + IOI/tempo/steadiness tracker + SVG gait/scene render + slendro footstep synth) + named-reference(#3, **Repp, "Sensorimotor synchronization: A review of the tapping literature," Psychon. Bull. Rev. 2005**). **Diversity** (vs jury bans): **mic-onset INPUT** (NOT MIDI, NOT touch) · **inline-SVG OUTPUT** (NOT raw-WebGL2/three.js/Canvas2D) · **onset/IOI-steadiness TECHNIQUE** (lab-first) · **slendro / entrainment VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian). Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer fire; siblings `403-kids-breath-garden` (long-form **stateful** breath→night-garden that *evolves over minutes & remembers every breath*, pelog-inharmonic drone — the strongest bank, an explicit multi-cycle thread for the next kids DEEP) + `401-kids-sound-zoo` (voice-**timbre** classifier via spectral-flatness / Wiener entropy → wake the matching animal, no pitch/scale) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §348. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no audio/mic hardware in this sandbox) — unverified surface: whether a child's claps reliably cross the onset threshold on a real phone mic vs. room noise (the adaptive threshold + 0.05 floor may need tuning), whether the CV→gait mapping *reads* as "smooth vs stumbling" by eye, and the slendro footstep balance on phone speakers. Design notes: `src/app/dream/402-kids-steady-walk/README.md`

## ⭐ (Cycle 347 — adult build · DEEP, 2 approaches to "walk through + feel the ambisonic room" · cycle 2 of the spatial-audio thread)

- **[/dream/400-soundwalk-room](/dream/400-soundwalk-room)** — Soundwalk Room. `demoable` · Cycle 347. **Cycle 2 of the spatial-audio thread — and the lab's FIRST HAPTIC OUTPUT. Where 394 let you *rotate* a fixed first-order ambisonic field (turn your head), this lets you *walk through* it (6DoF translation) and *feel* each voice brush past via the Vibration API.** Tap Start (headphones, eyes can be closed) and a wandering auto-pilot walks you on a looping path between **seven just-intonation overtone voices** of A1≈55 Hz (1/1, 3/2, 5/4, 2/1, 5/3, 9/4, 3/1) standing at fixed spots on the floor of a ~9×9 m room. Each voice **swells** as you approach, **swings around your head front → side → behind** as you pass it (the parallax "wow," which falls straight out of recomputing each source's relative azimuth from your live position), and **recedes + dulls** behind you (inverse-distance gain + a distance-driven low-pass = air absorption). Brush within 1.5 m of a voice and your phone fires a short vibrotactile **tap** whose feel encodes *which voice, how close, how loud* — a lightweight signal-processing **Sound2Hap** (pulse length/gap scale inversely with pitch; density scales with proximity + live per-voice RMS; one tap per genuine pass, throttled). **6DoF math from the Google "Ambisonics soundfield navigation (directional decomposition + path-distance estimation)" recipe** — we get the directional decomposition free (each synthesized source IS a known direction) and implement the path-distance re-render via one HRTF `PannerNode` per source (robust, never drifts, identical perceptual result; keeps 394's ambisonic vocabulary, lets the panner be the final decode). Master chain through a brick-wall `DynamicsCompressor` limiter + inverse-distance clamp so it can **never blast** your ears. **Degrades + auto-demos:** tap Start and do nothing — within seconds voices swell/pass/recede, the dot moves on the dim Canvas2D map, and (if supported) you feel taps; no Vibration API → readable `text-rose-300` notice + the map **ring-pulses** on each pass as a visual stand-in; no device-orientation → heading follows the auto-walk + drag-to-steer; no Canvas2D → notice (audio walk keeps running, eyes-closed by design). No WebGL/three.js (dodges the jury's output ban) · device-orientation + auto-walk + drag INPUT (no MIDI/touch-as-instrument) · just-intonation overtone VIBE (not D-Dorian/C-pentatonic). No API route, no `guard` (Web Audio + Canvas2D + Vibration API, all client-side; no mic/camera/network/secrets). Zero new deps. **Ambition 5/5**: never-used-technique(#1, 6DoF soundfield translation + haptic output — both grep-verified lab-first; 394 only rotated) + ≥3-subsystems(#2, JI synth + path-distance re-spatialiser + Sound2Hap haptic engine + auto-walk locomotion + Canvas2D map) + named-reference(#3, Google soundfield-navigation · Sound2Hap · Janet Cardiff · Zotter & Frank 2019) + multi-cycle(#4, cycle 2 of the deliberate spatial thread; cycle 3 = Karel's *Welcome Home* tracks as the spatial sources) + recent-research(#5, **Sound2Hap arXiv:2601.12245, CHI 2026** — the freshest dated anchor, directly on the haptic technique). **The expensive criteria (#4 + #5) the jury said are nearly absent, stacked.** Winner of a **DEEP** 2-approach fire; sibling `401-feel-the-room` (haptic-LED "metal detector for sound" — a parking-sensor pulse train quickens toward the nearest voice, eyes-closed wayfinding, screen optional) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §347 as the cycle-3 / next-off-screen candidate. **Build-verified, NOT browser-verified** (no audio/sensor/haptics hardware in this sandbox) — unverified surface: real binaural quality + how convincingly the parallax swing reads through HRTF, whether the air/distance constants feel balanced by ear, real `navigator.vibrate` pattern feel + throttle in the hand, and `DeviceOrientationEvent` axis/sign conventions across iOS/Android. Design notes: `src/app/dream/400-soundwalk-room/README.md`

## Cycle 346 — kids build · WIDE, 3 explorers each in a different foreign tonal world + non-GPU renderer + non-banned input

- **[/dream/397-kids-crystal-bloom](/dream/397-kids-crystal-bloom)** — Crystal Bloom. `demoable` · Cycle 346. **The lab's first kids piece that lives in JUST INTONATION — blow or hum into the mic and grow a tower of crystal bells tuned to PURE harmonic ratios, whose stacked chord is *beating-free*: a glassy stillness a 12-tone-equal-tempered piano physically cannot make.** Tap to begin, then breathe/hum — mic *loudness only* (RMS envelope, never pitch) climbs a tower of 9 faceted **animated-SVG** gem-bells, each its own bold color (color = the language for pre-readers), lighting + ringing in sequence as the bloom rises; sustained input keeps the whole stacked chord shimmering. Each bell is a pure integer-ratio over A2≈110 Hz — 1/1, 9/8, 5/4 (the pure major third the piano sharpens by ~14¢), 4/3, 3/2, 5/3, 2/1, 9/4, 5/2 — built from a few sine partials with a fast attack + long shimmer tail, over a sustained f0+3/2 drone, through a soft-clip + compressor limiter so nothing ever spikes (kids-safe: no harsh transients, nothing piercing). **Degrades + auto-demos:** deny/ignore the mic and a synthetic ~7s breath swell blooms and rings the tower hands-free in a calm loop, so a phone reviewer at 06:30 hears it sing with zero permission; press-and-hold the tower is the manual fallback; mic errors show in readable `text-rose-300`. **Foreign tonal world by design** — pure just intonation, **not** the jury-banned D-Dorian/C-pentatonic — and a **rare renderer** (animated SVG, used only once before in 393), the deliberate break from the lab's raw-WebGL2 rut. No mic-monitoring (no feedback), no API route, no `guard` (Web Audio + mic analysis, all client-side; no network/recording/upload/secrets). Zero new deps.
  **Why it matters / what's new:** it answers the JURY's (2026-06-07) three sharpest provocations at once — **#1** force a non-GPU renderer the lab avoids (SVG), **#2** build in a genuinely foreign tonal world (just intonation — the jury said D-Dorian is the new C-pentatonic), and **#6** turn the adult analysis-reflex into a kids listening toy. It leads with the **expensive** ambition criterion the jury said has failed ~7–8 dives running: **#5 genuinely-recent research** — the dive this fire surfaced the 2026 microtonal-browser wave (**purified-synth / "Pure Intonation"** computing exact JI ratios in Web Audio, presented at **RubyKaigi 2026**; plus **Scale Workshop** and **Tune.js**) — paired with **#3 named reference** (Harry Partch; Scale Workshop; Tune.js) and **#2 ≥3 subsystems** (mic-RMS follower + animated-SVG render loop + JI additive-bell synth with limiter chain + drone). Honest note: just intonation is **not** lab-first by grep (136/272/etc. used JI before), so **#1 is not claimed** — the build stacks #5+#3+#2 instead. **Diversity** (vs jury bans): **mic breath/hum loudness INPUT** (NOT MIDI, NOT touch) · **animated-SVG OUTPUT** (NOT raw-WebGL2/three.js/Canvas2D) · **just-intonation additive-bell TECHNIQUE** · **pure-JI A-overtone VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian). Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer fire; siblings `398-kids-rainbow-roll` (tilt → **pure DOM/CSS** gong courtyard in Balinese **slendro** with detuned-pair *ombak* shimmer — the most literal answer to jury #1) + `399-kids-aurora-step` (camera frame-difference motion → Canvas2D aurora + **whole-tone** chimes, the floating Debussy sound) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §346. **Build-verified, not browser-verified** — unverified surface: whether a child's quiet breath/hum reliably crosses the RMS gate on a real phone mic, and whether stacked pure ratios *perceptibly* read as "beating-free / glassy" vs. just "a nice chord" on phone speakers.

## Cycle 345 — adult build · DEEP, 3 spatial-audio approaches to one off-screen concept — "a room you navigate by turning your head, eyes closed"

- **[/dream/394-soundfield-room](/dream/394-soundfield-room)** — Soundfield Room. `demoable` · Cycle 345. **The lab's first true Ambisonic soundfield — six just-intonation drone voices float around you in 3D, and turning your head rotates the *entire field as one coherent space*, not source-by-source.** Tap "Enter Space" + headphones + eyes closed. Each voice is encoded into first-order **Ambisonic B-format** (W/X/Y/Z first-order spherical harmonics, ACN/SN3D) and summed into a shared 4-channel field bus; device-orientation (head tracking) builds a **3×3 SO(3) rotation matrix** (yaw·pitch·roll) that rotates the whole soundfield coherently; it's decoded to binaural through **8 virtual loudspeakers** (6 horizontal + 2 elevated, **max-rE** weights from Zotter & Frank 2019), each a Web-Audio `PannerNode` in **HRTF** mode. This is the genuine technical leap past the lab's *existing* binaural pieces (7-spatial / 29-scene-spatial), which pan each source independently — here the field is a unified rotatable whole, the way JSAmbisonics / Google Omnitone do it, implemented from scratch in plain Web Audio. **Off-screen-first by design:** the screen is just a dim Canvas2D radar of voice positions + your facing arrow; the piece is *for the ears*. Degrades cleanly — no sensor / denied / desktop → readable `text-rose-300` notice + drag-to-rotate + an **auto-demo** that slowly sweeps the field hands-free ~3s after Start, so a phone reviewer at 06:30 *hears the whole space rotate around them* without touching anything. Tonal world is **just intonation on the A2 overtone series** (110/165/220/275/330/385 Hz, 1/1·3/2·2/1·5/2·3/1·7/2), two voices placed at elevation to prove the vertical axis — **not D-Dorian, not C-pentatonic** (both jury-banned). No mic, no API route, no `guard` needed (synthesis + sensor, all client-side; no network/secrets). Zero new deps.

  **Why it matters / what's new:** this is the most direct answer to the JURY's (2026-06-07) provocation **#5** — "the lab keeps *researching* the 2026 ambisonics wave and never building it… spend a DEEP cycle on the untouched off-screen / spatial-audio / haptic shelf" (only 1 of the prior 15 pieces was off-screen). It is also the cleanest stack of the two **expensive** ambition criteria the jury said are nearly absent: **#5 genuinely-recent research** — the research dive this fire surfaced two ambisonics-*encoding* papers from **June 4, 2026** (~3 days old: SHB-AE, arXiv:2606.04584; Flow-HOA, arXiv:2606.04570), the freshest dated anchors the lab has cited, directly on this prototype's technique — and **#4 multi-cycle commitment** (cycle 1 of a spatial-audio thread; the two banked siblings are the designated deepenings). Plus **#1 never-used-technique** (grep-verified: Ambisonic B-format / spherical-harmonic soundfield rotation has never appeared in the lab — prior "spatial" pieces are per-source PannerNode panning) + **#3 named reference** (JSAmbisonics/polarch; Google Omnitone; Zotter & Frank 2019). **4–5 of 5.** Three subsystems beyond the synth (SH encoder + SO(3) field rotator + 8-speaker max-rE HRTF decoder). **Diversity** (vs jury bans): **device-orientation/head-tracking INPUT** (NOT MIDI, NOT touch) · **binaural-spatial-audio OUTPUT + dim Canvas2D radar** (NOT raw-WebGL2, NOT three.js) · **Ambisonic soundfield-rotation TECHNIQUE** (lab-first) · **just-intonation A-overtone VIBE** (NOT D-Dorian). Winner of a **DEEP** 3-approach fire (one concept — *an eyes-closed room you turn your head inside* — three spatial-audio attacks); siblings `395-listener-orbit` (rotate the *AudioListener*, not the field — minimal-DSP per-source HRTF) + `396-soundwalk` (locomotion + **Vibration-API haptics** — you *walk through* the field and *feel* each voice; Janet Cardiff audio-walk lineage) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §345 (copies in `/tmp/dream-losers/`). **Build-verified, not browser-verified** — unverified surface: whether the coherent-field rotation *perceptually* reads as one rotating space vs. eight moving speakers, the generic Web-Audio HRTF's localisation accuracy (elevation especially), the 20ms `setTargetAtTime` rotation-smoothing feel under fast head turns, the rotation-by-inverse-speaker-direction equivalence vs. a reference ambisonic decoder, and iOS `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission` on real hardware (no audio/sensor/GPU in this sandbox).

  Design notes: `src/app/dream/394-soundfield-room/README.md`

## ⭐ Cycle 334 — kids build · DEEP, 3 play-models of "Color Hunt: point the camera at real colors, each sings"

- **[/dream/368-kids-rainbow-quest](/dream/368-kids-rainbow-quest)** — Kids Rainbow Quest. `demoable` · Cycle 334.

  Open `/dream/368-kids-rainbow-quest`. **For kids (4+).** A friendly unicorn shows a glowing color and *wants* it — go **point the phone camera at something that color in the real world** (something red, then orange, then yellow…). Get close and the creature **glows warmer** (a rising musical shimmer); hold the match ~0.6s and it **celebrates** — a fanfare, a sparkle burst, and that color fills a **rainbow arc** across the top. Collect all seven → the arc lights up in order and plays a **rainbow song**, then loops with a fresh shuffle. No reading, no timer, no score, no fail — only "found it!" moments, and it gets the child *off the couch and into their room*.

  The lab's **first color-foraging *game*** — the camera sends the child into the physical world to hunt color, rather than tapping the screen (the most direct answer yet to the JURY's "stop staring at the screen"). Color→pitch is the most legible mapping the kids lane can make (KIDS.md: "color is the language"): each rainbow hue maps to a note in **D-Dorian** (D E F G A B C — **not** C-major-pentatonic), grounded by an always-on D+A perfect-fifth drone so any found note rings consonant. **Camera is analysis-only** — central-region `getImageData` → averaged RGB → HSV → angular hue-distance warmth score; never recorded, never uploaded, no network. Dodges every gate this fire: **camera INPUT** (fresh in the last-10 window; JURY banned touch/mic, diversity audit banned raw-WebGL2 4×; camera dodges all and sits in Karel's loved `101-camera-song`❤️/`86-sound-to-video`❤️ cluster), **DOM/CSS OUTPUT** (the lab's cool renderer — not WebGL2, not SVG), color-extraction TECHNIQUE, kids VIBE.

  Subsystems: (1) **color detection** — invisible offscreen canvas samples the central ~40×40 patch each frame, RGB→HSV, hue angular-distance → warmth (0–1), match requires hue-within-tolerance AND min saturation (rejects whites/greys) AND min brightness, with a 0.6s dwell-lock so it can't accidentally trigger; (2) **audio** (`audio.ts`) — D-Dorian fanfare (root→fifth→octave) + warmth shimmer (3 detuned high partials amplitude-mapped to proximity) + 7-note rainbow song + always-on D+A drone, all through a brick-wall `DynamicsCompressor` (sleeping-toddler-safe), AudioContext created inside the tap (iOS-safe); (3) **DOM/CSS visuals** — `<video>` background, a `radial-gradient` warmth glow, the rainbow arc as flex `<div>`s, CSS-custom-property sparkle bursts, an emoji creature scaled by warmth; (4) **graceful degrade / auto-demo** — if camera is denied or no frames arrive in ~2s, a `text-rose-300` notice shows and the **identical** match→fanfare→rainbow pipeline plays itself, completing the whole 7-color quest hands-free and looping (so it's fully alive at the 06:30 phone review with no camera).

  References: **Newton's *Opticks* (1704)** spectrum→scale-degree mapping, **Scriabin's *clavier à lumières* (1911)**, and the **Reggio Emilia** "hundred languages of children" (Malaguzzi, 1993 — color/sound as pre-literate languages). Born from RESEARCH §334 (camera-as-controller is commodity — Google "Jump to Play", 2026-03-24 — but the lab has no color-foraging game). Winner of a **DEEP** 3-play-model kids fire; siblings `366-kids-color-hunt` (free-forage + the melody you built replays as memory) + `367-kids-color-chord` (the whole room as a morphing 4-note chord) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §334. **Ambition 2/5**: ≥3 subsystems (#2) + named references (#3). **Build-verified, not browser-verified** — unverified surface: real hue-extraction feel under a phone camera's auto-white-balance/mixed lighting (the saturation/tolerance thresholds may need tuning), iOS AudioContext resume, and the auto-demo→live-camera handoff (no camera in this sandbox).

  Design notes: `src/app/dream/368-kids-rainbow-quest/README.md`

- **[/dream/365-cadence-ladder](/dream/365-cadence-ladder)** — Cadence Ladder. `demoable` · Cycle 333.

  Open `/dream/365-cadence-ladder`. A real-time **tonal/functional harmonic analyst**: press **▶ Begin** and a known progression plays while the analyzer names the **KEY** you're in (Krumhansl-Schmuckler key-finding), the **Roman-numeral function** of every chord, and renders harmony's pull-and-resolve as a three.js **tension ladder** — Tonic (rest, bottom) / Subdominant (departure, middle) / Dominant (tension, top). Each chord drops into its functional zone; **cadences flash named resolving arcs** — V→I *authentic* (emerald), IV→I *plagal/"amen"* (violet), V→vi *deceptive* (amber); when the music **modulates** a ripple sweeps and every Roman numeral re-contextualises (the same chord changes function as the key shifts). Connect a **MIDI keyboard** to play your own chords into the identical pipeline.

  The lab's **first key-estimation + functional/cadence analysis** — `229-chord-canvas` names chords but does NO key, NO Roman numerals, NO cadence/function. Proves itself 358-style: an internally-authored progression (C major with authentic/deceptive/plagal cadences → modulates to G major) is **known ground truth**, so it's watched proving itself on a phone with no hardware. The most faithful answer to the JURY's #1 adult provocation — *feed the legible/instructional lane* (its named wins were 358/353/345) and *starve the JI-drone monoculture*. **Ambition 4/5** (#1 lab-first technique · #2 ≥3 subsystems · #3 Krumhansl & Kessler 1982 / Temperley 2001 / Riemann functional harmony / Aldwell & Schachter cadence tradition · #5 RESEARCH §333). Input=internal-demo+MIDI · Output=three.js · Vibe=instructional. *Two siblings explored this DEEP fire — `364-tonal-orbit` (Chew Spiral Array, 3D tonal space) + `363-key-compass` (circle-of-fifths wheel) — banked in IDEAS §333.* **Build-verified, not browser-verified.** Design notes: `src/app/dream/365-cadence-ladder/README.md`

- **[/dream/360-kids-sand-choir](/dream/360-kids-sand-choir)** — Kids Sand Choir. `demoable`

  Open `/dream/360-kids-sand-choir`. **For kids (4+).** Press the big amber **▶**, then **tilt your phone or iPad** — a spout pours glowing warm sand that piles into dunes, and tipping the tablet swings gravity so the dunes flow left / right / down and reshape. Seven glowing harp strings cross the lower field; **every grain that comes to rest on a string sings a note**, so the *shape of the dune you build is the song*. No reading, no timer, no fail; it sways and plucks itself hands-free if nobody touches it.

  The lab's **first falling-sand granular cellular automaton** (grep-verified 0 across 350+ prototypes — the lab had Lenia `264`, Game-of-Life `25`, reaction-diffusion `9`, particle-life `8`/`16`/`236`, Navier-Stokes fluid `3`/`84`, n-body and physarum `327`, but never the most famous CA of all). It's also the kids lane's most **legible** cross-modal mapping yet — the direct answer to the JURY's standing #1 ("make it legible"): a 4-year-old sees cause→effect (build sand onto a low string → low note; cascade across all seven → a rippling arpeggio), where a glowing abstract cloud teaches nothing. Pulls on Karel's kids tilt/pluck love-cluster: `83-kids-tilt-rain`❤️ (tilt), `105-pluck-field`❤️ (Karplus pluck), `133-kids-ripple-pond`❤️ (build-it-→-it-sings).

  Four subsystems in one pipeline: (1) **falling-sand granular CA** (`sand.ts`) — a 180×120 grid where each cell is empty or one colored grain; each frame, scanning *against* gravity so a grain advances at most one cell, every grain tries to move in the gravity direction, then the two diagonal-down cells in randomized order (which is what makes sand slump into natural slopes); a top spout drips warm grains and emits a settle event when a grain stops on a string row; (2) **tilt→gravity input** (`page.tsx`) — `deviceorientation` β/γ become a smoothed 2D gravity vector quantized to a dominant fall axis + diagonal bias, so tipping the world flows the dunes; (3) **D-Dorian sonification** (`audio.ts`) — seven strings tuned D E F G A B C (low→high by row; **not** C-major-pentatonic), each a pre-rendered **Karplus–Strong** pluck pitched by row, stereo-panned by grain x, with an 80 ms per-string refractory so an avalanche never machine-guns; a soft always-on D+A triangle pad + a brick-wall `DynamicsCompressor` limiter (safe-sounds rule); (4) **WebGL2 render** (`gl.ts`) — the CA grid is uploaded to an RGBA8 texture each frame and drawn by hand-written GLSL ES 3.00, warm grains over a deep-indigo field with matte alpha-over glowing gold→violet strings that flash on pluck (no additive bloom, per the lab's anti-glow house style). Degrades at every step so it's alive at the 06:30 phone review: iOS 13+ `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission()` is called inside the Start tap (denial → readable `text-rose-300` note); **pointer-drag** tilts gravity on desktop; and a gentle **auto-sway** runs when no tilt events arrive so the choir plays itself with no hands; no WebGL2 → `text-rose-300` notice, audio still runs. `AudioContext` is created inside the Start tap (iOS-safe). No API route, no `guard` needed (Web Audio + WebGL2 are client-side; no mic, no camera, no network, no secrets). Zero new deps.

  References: **Max Bittker's *Sandspiel*** + the **Noita / "powder game" falling-sand cellular-automaton tradition**; **Karplus & Strong, "Digital Synthesis of Plucked-String and Drum Timbres" (Computer Music Journal, 1983)** for the pluck. Born from RESEARCH §332. Winner of a **WIDE** 3-explorer kids fire; siblings `361-kids-coral-bloom` (shake → Diffusion-Limited Aggregation coral growth, Witten–Sander 1981) + `362-kids-tumble-bells` (tilt → Abelian sandpile / SOC avalanche cascade, Bak–Tang–Wiesenfeld 1987) build-reviewed and banked in IDEAS §332 — both grep-verified lab-first CAs. **Ambition 3/5**: never-used-technique (#1) + ≥3 subsystems (#2) + named-reference (#3). **Build-verified, not browser-verified** — unverified surface: the `deviceorientation`→gravity feel and pluck cadence on a real tilting hand, the iOS permission branch, the 180×120 CA's 60fps budget on a phone GPU, and exact shader output (no sensor / GPU in this sandbox).

  Design notes: `src/app/dream/360-kids-sand-choir/README.md`
