### [619-kids-plinko-bells](/dream/619-kids-plinko-bells) · kids / Galton-quincunx-stochastic-physics / emergent-STEM-wonder · cycle 430 · demoable
  **"Marble Bells" — a 4-year-old drops a glowing marble into a peg field and watches *chance itself* play a chord.** Tap anywhere up top to release a little cluster of marbles; they cascade through a triangular **Galton / quincunx** peg lattice (~12 rows), bouncing left or right at every row with a slight center-pull plus real collision jitter (so the binomial → normal distribution emerges and no two runs look alike), and land in one of **9 just-intonation bins**. Each landing rings that bin's warm **struck bell** (additive sines at ~1, 2.0, 3.0, 4.2×, ~4ms attack, higher partials decaying faster). Because more marbles end up in the middle (the bell curve), the **center bins fill fastest** — and the bins are tuned symmetrically so the center IS the root/fifth/octave: the emergent chord is rooted and warm, richest at the middle, gentle color at the edges. The histogram bars ARE the live distribution; counts slowly bleed off so it can play forever. Nine JI bins over F3 ≈ 174.6 Hz (`1/2, 2/3, 3/4, 5/6, 1/1, 5/4, 3/2, 5/3, 2/1`), each a bold saturated hue — color is the language, nothing is ever "wrong." The lab's **first Galton-board / quincunx stochastic-physics instrument** (grep-verified 0× across 618 prior prototypes), and the directest break from the kids **silly-googly-creature 3-peat** (603/609/617): a mesmerizing STEM-wonder register — chance, made audible — not a creature, not mic, not cozy. Renders on **WebGL2** (raw GLSL ES 3.00, instanced glowing marbles/pegs/bins — the deliberately *under*-used renderer, off both the over-corrected WebGPU and jury-flagged Canvas2D), with a full **Canvas2D fallback** + a live backend badge. Kid-safe master chain (`gain → lowpass 7.5kHz → DynamicsCompressor −16/6/12 → destination`, gains capped, bells micro-rate-limited), gesture-gated AudioContext, always-on root+fifth+octave pad so it's never silent. ~2.2s idle **auto-rain** so a silent 06:30 glance is already cascading + singing; real taps preempt instantly. Refs: **Sir Francis Galton's quincunx / "bean machine" (1894)** (central-limit-theorem, binomial→normal); **Wintergatan's Marble Machine** (marbles-as-instrument); **Insook Choi, "Interactive Sonification Exploring Emergent Behavior" (2018)**. Love-aligned to Karel's emergent-music cluster (`236-particle-life-song`❤️, `130-tsl-particle-compute`❤️). Winner of a kids **WIDE** fire (3 orthogonal explorers); banked `620-kids-music-mill` (rotating music-box peg sequencer, self-playing) + `621-kids-duet-bloom` (two-finger cooperative consonance, the social lane) as IDEAS §430. **Build-verified** (authoritative `npm run build` exit 0, `✓ Compiled successfully in 40s`, `✓ Generating static pages (467/467)`, `/dream/619-kids-plinko-bells 5.36 kB / 112 kB First Load` prerendered static ○), **NOT browser-verified** (no GPU/audio/pointer in sandbox) — the auto-rain + Canvas2D fallback mean it cascades and chimes on a glance with zero hardware.

  Design notes: `src/app/dream/619-kids-plinko-bells/README.md`

### [622-wolfram-rhythm](/dream/622-wolfram-rhythm) · adults / 1D-elementary-CA-Wolfram-rule / austere-mechanical · cycle 431 · demoable
  **"Wolfram Rhythm" — a single integer composes the music.** A 1D **elementary cellular automaton** unfolds row by row on a musical clock: each cell's next state comes from its left/self/right neighbourhood via an 8-bit **rule number** (0–255), and every newly-born row's live cells fire short, edged percussion panned by column over a whole-tone set. The **rule number IS the composition** — `30` chaotic/noisy, `90` a self-similar Sierpinski fractal, `110` complex/Turing-complete (gliders collide), `184` traffic, etc. — change it (the one lever: a ±stepper, a 0–255 slider, and six labeled presets) and the entire character transforms. The lab's **first 1D elementary-CA / Wolfram-rule instrument** (grep-verified 0× — the existing CA pieces are 2D: `25`/`180` Conway Life, `264` Lenia, `360`/`377` sandpile), and a deliberate swing OFF the adult **edges/real-data autopilot** (601 howl · 606 vivisection · 613 seismic · 618 solar) into an austere, rule-driven register — edged (Rule 30 is literally chaos) but neither loud-abrasive nor cozy.

  Subsystems (≥3 → 4): (1) **1D-CA rule engine** (`engine.ts`) — toroidal `stepRow`, centered/soup seeds, the 256-rule lookup, `PRESETS`. (2) **long-form watchdog** (`StagnationDetector`) — detects dead / frozen / short-cycle states and `perturb`s (flips cells) or re-seeds so the piece keeps evolving for minutes rather than locking up. (3) **CA→percussion synth** (`audio.ts`) — metal-FM / band-passed-noise-click / snappy-pluck voices, column→whole-tone pitch + column→pan, 24-voice steal-oldest cap, master → brick-wall limiter (no warm drone anywhere). (4) **WebGL2 render** — the iconic scrolling Wolfram diagram via a texture-uploaded grid + fragment shader (newest row flashes at a bright playhead line, old rows fade as they scroll), with a real **Canvas2D fallback** + visible notice. Idle visual auto-start on mount (audio gated behind **Begin** per autoplay), so a silent glance is already a self-drawing diagram. **No API route, no guard, no npm deps** (pure client Web Audio + WebGL2; nothing recorded or sent).

  References: **Stephen Wolfram, _A New Kind of Science_ (2002)** (elementary CA, rules 30/90/110); **Matthew Cook** (Rule-110 Turing-completeness, 2004); **Iannis Xenakis** (cellular automata in composition — the severe/architectural register). Winner of an adult **DEEP** fire (3 CA paradigms — 2D Conway Life, 1D Wolfram, continuous Lenia); the **only duplication-clean** candidate (`620-life-engine` duplicated `25`/`180`, `622-quickening` duplicated `264`), banked both as cautionary IDEAS §431. **Ambition honest 3/5**: #1 first 1D-elementary-CA/Wolfram instrument (grep-0×) + #2 ≥3 subsystems (4) + #3 named refs (Wolfram / Cook / Xenakis); #5 not claimed (foundational). **Diversity** `banned=[WGSL-WebGPU 5× over-corrected · edges/real-data adult autopilot · JURY-14 Canvas2D/touch/warm-JI/cozy/ocean] · picked=[rule-number-stepper + sparse-perturb INPUT · WebGL2 OUTPUT · 1D-elementary-CA TECH · austere-mechanical VIBE]` — clean on every banned tag. **Build-verified** (authoritative `npm run build` exit 0, `✓ Compiled successfully in 73s`, `✓ Generating static pages (467/467)`, `/dream/622-wolfram-rhythm 6.15 kB / 109 kB First Load` prerendered static ○), **NOT browser-verified** (no GPU/audio in sandbox) — the on-mount auto-running diagram + Canvas2D fallback mean it draws on a glance with zero hardware; unverified by ear: that rules 30/90/110 are audibly distinct and the metallic voices read as edged-not-harsh.

### [630-piano-refract](/dream/630-piano-refract) · adults / NMF-spectral-factorization / dissective-prismatic · cycle 434 · demoable
  **"Piano Refract" — the lab's FIRST genuine cycle-2 deepening: Karel's own solo piano refracted like light through a prism into five voices you solo, mute & re-mix.** This is the deepening of the loved standout `606-piano-vivisection` the jury begged for by hand ("606 is the model — it just needed a cycle 2 to actually reach 4/5") two juries running. Stage 1 keeps 606's bulletproof median-filter **HPSS** split (strings vs. hammers) as the legible *ground*; stage 2 is the new refraction — the harmonic (strings) layer is re-analyzed and fanned by **NMF** (non-negative matrix factorization, the lab's first — grep-0× across 600+ prototypes) into **four pitched register voices** (Low / Low-mid / High-mid / High). Five independently-mixable looping voices in total (Hammers + the 4 registers): solo isolates one, mute drops it, faders re-balance — all **instant & click-free** (every buffer plays continuously, sample-aligned; only gain nodes ramp). The technique register the jury praised in 606 ("clinical not cozy, his own music") — analytical and prismatic, neither doom nor warm.

  **The legibility fix (what makes this a real cycle-2, not a restart):** plain unsupervised NMF returns abstract components that are unstable run-to-run and impossible to name — the exact weakness that lost the *original* §425-banked `607-piano-prism` seed to 606. This build **warm-starts** the NMF basis `W`: each of the four columns is seeded as a Gaussian-in-log-frequency bump centered at **~150 / 350 / 800 / 1800 Hz** (with a positive floor so updates still adapt to Karel's real partials), biasing every component to settle into a **stable, musically-meaningful register regardless of the run**. The seeded-basis idea is Smaragdis & Brown (2003) applied for *legibility* rather than transcription.

  Subsystems (≥3 → 6): (1) **audio loader** (`audio.ts`, copied verbatim from 606) — fetches Karel's real solo-piano recording via the read-only `/api/audio/<id>` route, synthesized piano fallback. (2) **median-filter HPSS** (`hpss.ts`, from 606) — STFT/ISTFT, per-bin/per-frame medians, soft Wiener masks (phase kept). (3) **register-seeded KL-NMF** (`nmf.ts`) — warm-started multiplicative updates (~70 iters), chunked with `await` yields + progress bar. (4) **per-component Wiener resynthesis** — `Mk = Vk/ΣVj` applied to the original complex harmonic STFT → ISTFT → four register PCM buffers. (5) **5-voice mixer** — `BufferSource → GainNode → AnalyserNode → master → DynamicsCompressor → destination`, sample-aligned, instant solo/mute/gain. (6) **WebGL2 "prism" render** (`gl.ts`) — an incoming white beam splits into five colored bands (steel hammers + violet→rose→amber→emerald registers), each driven by its live level, soloed glows / muted dims, with a real **Canvas2D fallback** + backend badge; idle animation on mount + ~2.5s auto-demo cycles the solo so a silent 06:30 glance is already alive. **No API route, no guard, no npm deps** (READ-only of the existing audio route; nothing recorded or sent).

  Off-glass controls: keyboard `1`–`5` solo / `0` reset / `m` mute selected / `←→` select / `↑↓` gain / space play-pause; device-tilt "spectral spotlight" (iOS 13+ `requestPermission()` inside the Begin gesture, silent keyboard fallback + `text-rose-300` notice if denied). References: **Lee & Seung, _Nature_ 1999** (NMF + multiplicative updates); **Smaragdis & Brown, WASPAA/ISMIR 2003** (NMF on music spectrograms; seeded basis); **Fitzgerald, DAFx 2010** (the HPSS ground). Born from **RESEARCH §434** (NMF source-separation is a live 2026 front — Deep Non-Negative Autoencoders, arXiv 2510.08816; piano is "particularly amenable, beautiful key-hammer extraction" — Collins, eContact). Winner of an adult **DEEP** fire (one concept, 2 legibility approaches): beat `629-piano-prism` (random-init NMF + post-hoc centroid pitch-SORT) on **reliability + legibility** — the warm start is deterministic where the sort still rode the random-init lottery; banked 629 as IDEAS §434. **Ambition honest 4/5** — the lab's first honest #4 in two juries: **#1** first NMF in the lab (grep-0×) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (6) + **#3** named refs (Lee&Seung / Smaragdis&Brown / Fitzgerald) + **#4** genuine multi-cycle commitment (cycle 2 of the 606 decomposition spine, claimed honestly for the first time). **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-15)=[touch INPUT 5× · WebGPU OUTPUT 6× · adult ominous/dark/austere "edges" reflex 5× · 4th real-data sonification on 588/613/618 template] · picked=[**his-piano-file + keyboard/tilt INPUT** (off-glass, not touch) · **WebGL2 OUTPUT** (not WebGPU; Canvas2D fallback) · **NMF spectral-factorization TECH** (grep-0×, not real-data) · **dissective/prismatic VIBE** (analytical, neither doom nor cozy — the "his own material, clinical" register the jury praised in 606)]` — clean on every banned tag. **Build-verified** (authoritative `npm run build` exit 0, `✓ Compiled successfully in 37.3s`, `✓ Generating static pages (470/470)`, `/dream/630-piano-refract 10.1 kB / 113 kB First Load` prerendered static ○), **NOT browser-verified** (no real GPU/audio in sandbox) — the idle prism animation + auto-demo + Canvas2D/keyboard fallbacks mean it reads as alive on a glance with zero hardware; unverified by ear: that the warm-started registers separate cleanly on Karel's actual recording and that solo/mute is as click-free as designed.

### `632-polymeter-loom` — `demoable` · adult · WIDE-winner (cycle 435, 2026-06-15)
[/dream/632-polymeter-loom](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/632-polymeter-loom) — **"Polymeter Loom": interlocking Euclidean rhythms woven into a hypnotic groove you watch being woven.** Five pitched-percussion voices (kick · bass · marimba · bell · shaker) each play a **Euclidean rhythm** E(k,n) — k onsets spread maximally-evenly over n steps via the **Bjorklund** algorithm — on *different* step-counts (16/8/16/16/12), so the combined groove is **polymetric** and only realigns after the LCM of all step-counts (a long, evolving loop). The marimba+bell share a pattern but one runs **1.2% faster** — **Steve Reich phasing** — sliding out of unison and slowly back, so minute 2 sounds unlike minute 0 (long-form state without a loop). A **three.js loom** renders each voice as a concentric bead ring; beads flash (emissive + scale pop) on each onset, and the phasing rings visibly counter-rotate — the weave tightening and loosening. Off-glass controls: **Weave/Pause**, keys `1`–`5` toggle voices, `q/a w/s e/d r/f t/g` nudge each voice's onset count k, `space` toggles phasing, tempo slider 70–150 BPM. Idle auto-demo (loom rotates/breathes + rings drift before any audio); AudioContext created/resumed inside the first gesture (iOS unlock); graceful `text-rose-300` fallbacks for missing WebGL/AudioContext. References: **Steve Reich** (*Music for 18 Musicians*, *Clapping Music* — phasing); **Godfried Toussaint**, *The Euclidean Algorithm Generates Traditional Musical Rhythms* (2005). Born from **RESEARCH §435** (groove = microtiming/interlocking-meter science; JURY 2026-06-15 provocation #2 "build the missing middle — danceable/groove"). Winner of an adult **WIDE** fire (3 missing-middle registers): beat `631-drop-engine` (euphoric EDM build-and-drop + lab-first sidechain pump) and `633-slow-burn` (tender neo-soul microtiming) on honest ambition (two canonical refs that drive it) + output diversity (three.js, 0× in last 10) + cleanest vibe-threading (groove that dodges BOTH banned poles — doom AND cozy/warm); both losers banked as strong **IDEAS §435** seeds. **Ambition honest 3/5** — **#2** ≥3 subsystems (Euclidean generator + phasing clock/lookahead scheduler + multi-voice FM/pluck synth + three.js loom = 4) + **#3** named refs (Reich + Toussaint). #1 not claimed (euclidean/polymeter/Reich all referenced earlier in the corpus — only `sidechain`, which was 631's, was grep-0×). **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-15)=[touch INPUT 5× · WebGPU OUTPUT 6× · adult ominous/dark/austere "edges" reflex 5× · 4th real-data sonification on 588/613/618 template] + rolling-10 over-rep=[WebGL2 OUTPUT 4×] · picked=[**keyboard + voice-toggle INPUT** (off-glass, not touch) · **three.js OUTPUT** (0× in last 10 — off banned WebGPU AND over-rep WebGL2) · **Euclidean-polymeter + Reich-phasing TECH** · **hypnotic/groove VIBE** (danceable, neither doom nor cozy)]` — clean on every banned tag. **Build-verified** (authoritative `npm run build` exit 0, 471/471 static pages, `/dream/632-polymeter-loom` prerendered static ○, in `app-path-routes-manifest.json`, `.html` emitted), **NOT browser-verified** (no real GPU/audio in sandbox) — the idle loom rotation + bead pulse + WebGL/audio fallbacks mean it reads as alive on a glance with zero hardware; unverified by ear: that the Reich phasing pair audibly drifts and the polymetric weave grooves on-device.

### `636-kids-star-pilot` — `demoable` · kids · WIDE-winner (cycle 436, 2026-06-15)
[/dream/636-kids-star-pilot](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/636-kids-star-pilot) — **"Star Pilot": a 4-year-old flies a glowing comet with a game controller through a field of musical star-gates — and the gates they pass keep echoing back, so a melody builds itself.** Push the **left stick** (or **arrow keys / WASD** — automatic fallback, live `gamepadconnected` switch) to fly a momentum-driven ship through six **just-intonation-tuned star-gates** that bloom and ring soft additive bell-tones; face buttons (or **space / 1–4**) drop sparkly mallet+shimmer percussion. The heart is a **lookahead-scheduled loop-memory sequencer**: the last ~8 gates you visited are remembered and echo back on a slow pulse, so the music *accumulates and evolves* — minute 2 sounds unlike minute 0 (genuine state, not a loop). **No score, no fail state, no reading** — the ship softly bounces off the edges, it can't crash. Idle ~5s and a gentle auto-flight resumes so the scene is never silent and a glance always shows it alive. References: **Toshio Iwai, _Electroplankton_ (Nintendo DS, 2005)** + **Tetsuya Mizuguchi, _Rez_ / _Child of Eden_** (flying-through-a-synaesthetic-music-space). Born from **RESEARCH §436** (kid-native NON-touch inputs are under-used — the kids side keeps reaching for mic + camera-optical-flow; gamepad is 0× recently + jury-blessed via 587; and the active-wonder *middle* register is what the kids side lacks per JURY 2026-06-15). ### `649-chess-duet` — `demoable` · adult · WIDE-winner (cycle 441, 2026-06-16)
[/dream/649-chess-duet](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/649-chess-duet) — **"Chess Duet": a famous chess game played as a slow, inevitable TWO-VOICE counterpoint — White and Black are two instruments, and you hear the whole drama (quiet opening → escalating sacrifices → the sudden-quiet → the inevitable mate) as a piece that composes itself move by move.** The lab's FIRST piece that sonifies a *structured real-world game* as music — not a physical sensor feed, not an FFT of a sound: the combinatorial structure of a played game **is** the score (the directest hit on JURY 2026-06-15 provocation #5, "music about something other than music — a live chess game as a duet"). Bundled game: **Anderssen vs Kieseritzky, "The Immortal Game," London 1851** (45 plies, ending `23. Be7#`), parsed by a from-scratch SAN parser (no npm dep, no network). Two alternating voices read as call-and-response counterpoint — **White** = warm triangle+sine ("left hand", upper staff), **Black** = a darker FM/reedy saw ("right hand", lower staff); file a–h → scale degree in **D harmonic minor** (dramatic mode), rank 1–8 → register, piece type → articulation (pawn short · queen long & rich · knight grace-note leap · bishop gliding · rook firm). Game *events* drive the drama: a **capture** = a dissonant clash that resolves; a **check** = a held low tension pedal tone; **castling** = a settled perfect-fifth cadence; the final **checkmate** = a darkly resolving held chord; a running **material-balance** signal biases the timbre brighter/darker so the arc is *felt*. Renders on **inline SVG** (the scarcest renderer — last SVG was 637; off the jury-banned WebGPU, off the rolling-hot three.js [3×], off the over-rep WebGL2): an 8×8 board lights each move's from/to squares (captures glow red, mate glows indigo) beside an unfolding two-staff score with a tracking playhead, plus the legible SAN of the current move. Ear-safe master chain (`gain 0.42 → DynamicsCompressor → destination`); AudioContext created inside the Play gesture (iOS); **auto-starts the game ~2.5s after load** so a silent 06:30 glance is fully alive (board lighting up move by move + the duet playing, zero interaction/hardware). Tempo slider 1.0–3.5 s/move. **No API route, no guard, no npm deps** (pure client SVG + Web Audio — no network/mic/camera/secret). References: **Anderssen vs Kieseritzky, "The Immortal Game," 1851** (the bundled game); the informal lineage of chess-as-music / game-sonification, reframed here as strict two-voice counterpoint over a real master game with *events* (not just squares) driving the harmony. Born from **RESEARCH §441** (a corpus check killed two "0×" jury claims — MIDI-OUT already exists in `291-harmonograph`, WebRTC in `508-accord-call` — steering ambition toward the genuinely-0× lanes: structured-data-as-counterpoint and AI-pipeline chains; browser generative-composition is a live 2026 front — Loopstate/Riffer/KOSMOS sequencers, GEDMAS/GESMI algorithmic-EDM lineage, SMDIM arXiv 2603.00576 Feb-2026). Winner of an adult **WIDE** fire (3 orthogonal explorers mapping 3 jury-named open lanes): beat `648-latent-chain` (the lab's first 2-model AI pipeline chain, audio→image→words→image — bolder #1 but budget-gated + invisible/unverifiable at a silent glance) and `650-endless-lift` (an ecstatic Shepard-fold gospel key-lift — the bulletproof ecstatic-register fill); both banked as strong **IDEAS §441** seeds. **Ambition honest 3/5**: **#1** first structured-game / counterpoint sonification in the lab (a genuinely new "machine," not the banned 588/613/618 physical-feed template) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (from-scratch SAN parser + board model · two-voice contrapuntal mapper + Web Audio scheduler · event-driven harmony/drama state · SVG board+score renderer = 4) + **#3** the named game. #4 not claimed (single cycle); #5 not hard-claimed (SMDIM ~3.5mo, server-side — grounding only). **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-15)=[touch INPUT 5× · WebGPU OUTPUT 6× · adult ominous/dark/austere "edges" reflex 5× · 4th real-data sonification on 588/613/618 template] + renderer-watch=[three.js hot 3× (632/643/645)] · picked=[**structured-game-data INPUT** (off touch, off recent mic/audio-file/physical-feed) · **inline-SVG OUTPUT** (the scarcest renderer — off banned WebGPU AND off hot three.js AND off over-rep WebGL2) · **game-structure→two-voice-counterpoint sonification TECH** (a new "machine," not the banned physical-feed template) · **cinematic / narrative-tension VIBE** (off BOTH banned poles — dramatic, not the ominous-austere autopilot, not cozy)]` — clean on every binding banned tag. **Build-verified** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build` exit 0, `✓ Compiled successfully in 91s`, `✓ Generating static pages (477/477)` [476 from cycle 440 + 649 = 477, confirming 648/650 absent], `/dream/649-chess-duet 6.93 kB / 113 kB First Load` prerendered static ○), **NOT browser-verified by ear** (no audio in sandbox) — but uniquely low-risk: pure SVG + Web Audio with zero GPU/network/key/sensor surface, the 45 plies were verified against the historical game, and the 2.5s auto-start means the board + duet are alive on a glance with zero hardware; ### `652-kids-dance-band` — `demoable` · kids · WIDE-winner (cycle 442, 2026-06-16)
[/dream/652-kids-dance-band](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/652-kids-dance-band) — **"Dance Band": a 4-year-old makes a whole band play by DANCING in front of the camera — move more and more layers stack and the lights erupt; stand still and it eases back to a gentle pad.** The directest hit on JURY 2026-06-15's standing #1 kids critique ("warm-or-silly with nothing between — build the danceable/groovy register with *body* that nobody is building"). The webcam frame is drawn mirrored into a tiny `32×24` offscreen canvas; each rAF reads that grid, takes the **per-cell absolute frame-difference** from the previous frame (noise floor zeroed), and sums to a **global motion-energy** `0..1` plus a diff-weighted **spatial centroid** — **no ML model, no skeleton, pure pixels** (the ISMM "movement *energy* not pose" insight, RESEARCH §442). Energy passes an asymmetric low-pass (fast attack / slow release) and selects one of **5 groove tiers with hysteresis** (separate UP/DOWN thresholds so layers don't chatter): pad → +kick → +bass+hats → +snare backbeat → FULL-PARTY syncopated melody. A **112 BPM, 16-step Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler** (`setInterval(25ms)` pump, ~120ms ahead of `audioCtx.currentTime`, **never** rAF) clocks every layer change and hit to the step grid, so intensity changes feel musical not twitchy; everything is **A-minor-pentatonic** so all movement is in-key (no wrong). The horizontal centroid pans the melody; energy raises filter/gain and brightness. **Output:** a Canvas2D glowing particle/energy field that erupts from the motion centroid (spark count/speed/hue scale with energy — violet calm → gold full-party), a coarse motion-heat overlay where the body moved, and a ring that flashes on every downbeat. **Privacy:** camera is `getUserMedia` on-device only, **no frames stored or sent** (zero network), with a reassuring note. Audio starts before the camera so the band is **never silent/broken**; soft attack envelopes + 1.2s master fade-in, no harsh transients. **Graceful degrade:** camera denied/unavailable → `text-rose-300` message + large (≥64px) 🌙-calm / **DANCE!** / 🔥-more fallback buttons and Arrow Up/Down, all driving the same energy signal so it fully demos with audio+visuals. References: **Golan Levin & Zachary Lieberman** — *Messa di Voce* / *Manual Input Sessions* (body as continuous reactive AV input); **IRCAM ISMM** research on sonifying movement *qualities* (energy/fluidity/impulsivity) + children's-spontaneous-movement sonification (RESEARCH §442). Born from RESEARCH §442 (movement-energy → groove; the visible research→build chain). Winner of a kids **WIDE** fire (3 orthogonal NON-touch explorers in the missing-middle register, honoring the jury touch ban): beat `651-kids-choir-leader` (mic voice-pitch → in-key choir, tender — the realization of banked seed `635-kids-sing-kite`, love-aligned `158-kids-hum-paint`❤️) and `653-kids-bounce-band` (tilt → collision-quantized beat, bouncy); both banked as built-and-proven **IDEAS §442** seeds. **Ambition honest 2–3/5** (the kids norm): **#2** ≥3 subsystems (camera frame-diff motion-energy + centroid · 5-tier hysteresis mapper · clocked layered look-ahead groove engine · Canvas2D particle/heat field = 4) + **#3** named refs (Levin/Lieberman · ISMM). #1 contestable (optical-flow exists in the corpus; whole-body-motion-energy→layered-groove is application-level, discounted). **Love-aligned** with `234-kids-hand-creature`❤️ (camera/body) + the embodied kids cluster. **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-15)=[touch INPUT 5× · WebGPU OUTPUT 6× · adult "edges" reflex · 4th real-data template] · picked=[**webcam whole-body-motion-energy INPUT** (off-glass, NOT touch; camera absent from last 10) · **Canvas2D particle-field OUTPUT** (NOT WebGPU) · **frame-diff motion-energy → hysteresis-tiered layered groove TECH** · **ecstatic/danceable VIBE** (the jury's exact missing middle — NOT warm-glow, NOT silly-foley)]` — clean on every banned tag. **Build-verified** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build` exit 0, `✓ Compiled successfully in 47s`, `✓ Generating static pages (478/478)`, `/dream/652-kids-dance-band 4.54 kB / 111 kB First Load` prerendered static ○, `.html` emitted, `package-lock.json` restored so nothing outside the dream zone is committed), **NOT browser-verified** (no real camera/audio in sandbox) — the always-on soft groove + the DANCE! fallback button mean it plays + erupts on a glance with zero hardware (Karel can drive it with the on-screen buttons / arrow keys even with no camera); unverified by body: that the motion-energy thresholds + `6×` normalization feel right for a real child in a real room (lighting/distance will shift them — needs live calibration), and that the layered groove actually grooves on-device.

### `659-pulse-cathedral` — `demoable` · adult · WIDE-winner (cycle 445, 2026-06-16)
[/dream/659-pulse-cathedral](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/659-pulse-cathedral) — **"Pulse Cathedral": the lab's FIRST shipped ecstatic/euphoric adult piece — a euphoric EDM build-and-drop journey arc whose energy NEVER lands (riser → impact → DROP → climb → riser), with a sidechain pump that is both audible AND visible, and a Shepard-folded bass so the key reads as forever-rising.** The directest hit on JURY 2026-06-15 provocation #2 ("build the missing middle — ecstatic/danceable/groovy; the lab banks every ecstatic candidate [650/653-endless-lift] and never ships it"), and a journey-engine alternative Karel explicitly asked for (care #4: EDM build-and-drop as an alternate arc — still 0×). Audio: a **Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler** (`setInterval(25ms)`, ~120ms ahead of `audioCtx.currentTime`, **never** rAF) clocks a layered Web-Audio bed — four-on-the-floor kick (sine pitch-drop + click), an offbeat rolling bass that is **sidechain-ducked by the kick** (a "pump bus" gain ramped down on each kick and released — the audible French-house pump), a detuned **supersaw** chord stack + pad, a bandpassed plucky arp, a filtered **noise riser** that sweeps a lowpass up through the BUILD, and a tasteful **impact** at the DROP — all in a bright Lydian-leaning mode. A **BUILD(8 bars)→DROP→SUSTAIN(4 bars)→BUILD arc state machine** (`arc.ts`) raises density/cutoff/intensity through the build and **Shepard-folds the bass octave** each cycle so the energy reads as a forever-climb (the "never-landing causal stream" from RESEARCH §445's LiveBand, made literal). **Output:** a raw **WebGL2** fragment-shader **cathedral nave** — brightness pulses with the kick and the **sidechain duck is *visible*** as a brightness dip-and-bloom, light-shafts/sparks erupt at the DROP, color sweeps violet (BUILD) → gold/white (DROP); animates before audio unlocks, with a **Canvas2D fallback** if WebGL2 is missing. Controls: **Start** (creates/resumes AudioContext in-gesture — iOS unlock + ~0.8s master fade-in), **SPACE / DROP** forces the next drop early, **↑/↓ ENERGY** adds/removes layers, **TEMPO** 120–130 BPM; ~2.5s idle → the arc runs itself (autonomous BUILD→DROP→SUSTAIN) so a silent glance is alive. Ear-safe master `gain ≤0.45 → DynamicsCompressor → destination`. **No API route, no guard, no npm deps, no network/key/mic/camera** (pure client Web Audio + WebGL2). References: the **EDM build-and-drop form** (riser → impact → drop); **sidechain "pumping" compression** (French-house / Eric Prydz lineage), modeled here as scheduled gain automation; **Roger Shepard**, *"Circularity in Judgments of Relative Pitch"* (1964) — the endless-climb illusion, folded into the bass; and the real-time *continuous causal music stream* research it echoes (Google DeepMind **Lyria RealTime** / **"LiveBand," arXiv 2606.03803, June 2026**) — cited as honest conceptual lineage, NOT implemented with ML. Born from **RESEARCH §445** (the reactive-accompaniment headline was killed by a corpus grep [251/256 already own that lane]; its surviving value — LiveBand's never-landing causal stream — bent the flagship into a euphoric arc that climbs forever). Winner of an adult **WIDE** fire (3 orthogonal explorers across genuinely-open adult registers): beat `660-glasswork` (a tender 3am music-box, inline-SVG, Eno/Budd/Satie — the lab's intimacy gap; lower-leverage register + lower ambition) and `661-murmur-engine` (a boids murmuration AS the music, Canvas2D, Reynolds/Vicsek — but Canvas2D is HOT 3×→4× and flocking is not lab-first, so no #1); both banked as strong **IDEAS §445** seeds. **Ambition honest 2–3/5**: **#2** ≥3 subsystems (look-ahead scheduler · sidechain-pumped layered bed · build-drop arc state machine · WebGL2 nave + Canvas2D fallback = 4) + **#3** named refs (EDM build-drop form · Prydz sidechain-pumping · Shepard 1964 · LiveBand/Lyria frame). **#1 SOFT** (Shepard foundational [40/132/187]; the audible+visible sidechain pump is plausibly lab-first but not hard-claimed); **#5 NOT hard-claimed** (LiveBand within-window but server-side ML — lineage only). The real value is the **0×-shipped ecstatic register fill** + a Karel-care-#4 journey-engine alternative. **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-15)=[touch INPUT 5× · WebGPU OUTPUT 6× · adult ominous/dark/austere "edges" reflex 5× · 4th real-data sonification on the 588/613/618 physical-feed template] + renderer-watch=[three.js HOT 3× · Canvas2D HOT 3×] · picked=[**keyboard + autonomous INPUT** (off banned touch; off recent mic/camera) · **WebGL2 OUTPUT** (the SCARCEST screen renderer — off banned WebGPU AND off BOTH hot three.js & Canvas2D; Canvas2D fallback only) · **EDM build-drop-arc + sidechain-pump + Shepard-fold TECH** · **ecstatic/euphoric VIBE** (the jury's exact 0×-shipped missing middle — dodges BOTH banned poles: NOT doom, NOT cozy)]` — clean on every binding banned tag. **Build-verified** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build` exit 0, `✓ Compiled successfully in 77s`, `✓ Generating static pages (481/481)` [480 from cycle 444 + 659 = 481, confirming 660/661 absent], `/dream/659-pulse-cathedral 7.65 kB / 110 kB First Load` prerendered static ○), **NOT browser-verified by ear** (no real audio/GPU in sandbox) — the ~2.5s idle auto-demo runs the BUILD→DROP→SUSTAIN arc and the WebGL2 nave animates before audio unlocks (Canvas2D fallback), so a silent 06:30 glance shows the cathedral pulsing + dropping with zero hardware; unverified: whether the pump *feels* like a pump, the drop *hits*, and the Shepard-fold reads as a forever-climb on real speakers (mix tuned by reasoning, not heard); the autonomous-demo visual kick is an approximation so its beat may drift slightly from the shader pulse.

### `669-kids-hum-answer` — `demoable` · kids · WIDE-winner (cycle 448, 2026-06-16)
[/dream/669-kids-hum-answer](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/669-kids-hum-answer) — **"Hum & Answer": a child hums one note, closes their eyes, and an unseen friend answers — not by resolving sweetly, but by LEANING on a tense note and then SIGHING down to rest, so the child discovers tension→release with no screen at all.** The lab's **FIRST off-the-glass KIDS piece** — the directest hit on the jury's (2026-06-16) loudest, most-repeated, still-unaddressed directive ("get at least one builder off the glass; 13 of 15 render to a glass screen; the 2 that aren't are the best things here" + the Karel-facing line) — and it shipped the ⭐ PRIORITY off-glass banked seed (`664-kids-hum-answer`, §446) while pushing it past the banked single 4–3 into a full chain. **Off-the-glass / audio-first:** near-black screen, ONE soft CSS radial glow that breathes with post-limiter amplitude and shifts hue (violet/blue while a suspension is TENSE → warm amber as it RESOLVES); the whole experience is meant to work eyes-closed, the glow is there only for a glancing eye. **Input:** mic (`getUserMedia({audio})`); real-time monophonic pitch detection by **autocorrelation (Chris-Wilson approach)** — RMS gate + clarity gate + parabolic-interpolation refine, ~75–1000 Hz, **octave-collapsed** into a child-voice band (~G3–G4) to defend against octave errors; a short stability window means it answers a *deliberate* hum, not a passing slide. **The harmonic event (NOT pentatonic / NOT scale-snap):** the detected hum becomes a tonic and an unseen synthesized choir walks a genuine **suspension CHAIN** of three textbook common-practice figures that all resolve **DOWN by step** — **4–3** (P4 sighing to the M3), then **7–6** (m7 leaning to the M6), then **2–1** (M2 settling to the unison) — each tension held ~1.1 s, a ~0.3 s downward portamento "sigh," then ~0.9 s of rest, over a tonic drone an octave below. The child meets a tense note and hears it resolve: the denial of closure, then closure. **Synthesis (NO samples, NO AI voice):** formant-bandpassed sawtooth "ah" voices (three parallel bandpass resonators ~800/1150/2900 Hz). Safe master chain `gain (0.34) → DynamicsCompressor → destination`, capped per-voice gain 0.16, soft envelopes, no harsh transients. **Privacy:** no API route, no network — the mic stream is connected only to an analyser, never routed to output, never recorded or sent (stated on screen). **Idle / no-mic auto-demo:** mic denied/silent → a self-playing loop fires a synthesized "child" note that triggers the suspension-chain answer every several seconds with a `text-rose-300` notice, so a silent 06:30 glance still hears tension→resolution with zero hardware; full cleanup of MediaStream tracks / AudioContext / rAF / timers on unmount. References: the **4–3 / 7–6 / 2–1 suspension figures** of common-practice voice leading; **tonal closure and its denial as perceived emotional cues in children** (developmental music-cognition literature, RESEARCH §448 — children read closure/its-denial before they can label major/minor, making tension→release the most age-robust harmonic event here); **Bobby McFerrin's "Circlesong"** call-and-response model. Born from **RESEARCH §448** (which harmonic event a 4yo can actually perceive: *change* + *closure* before *mode*) → the dive's finding + the jury's off-glass directive jointly selected this from a kids **WIDE** fire of three orthogonal harmonic-event explorers: beat **`668-kids-two-suns`** (continuous major↔minor third-glide, tilt → three.js, cosmic-dramatic — strongest renderer-diversity, but the mode-flip premise is developmentally shaky for a 4yo and 669 was the only off-glass sibling) and **`670-kids-drone-cave`** (shifting tanpura drone under fixed bells, gamepad → WebGL2, mysterious — fresh moving-pedal mechanism, but WebGL2 is over-represented 4× and gamepad-fly overlaps 636); both banked as strong **IDEAS §448** seeds. **Ambition honest 2/5** (the kids norm): **#2** ≥3 subsystems (autocorrelation pitch-detect w/ gates+octave-collapse · suspension-chain voice-leading engine · formant "ah" synth + tonic drone · amplitude/tension-driven glow + demo fallback = 4) + **#3** named refs (the suspension figures · McFerrin · developmental tonal-closure literature). **#1 NOT claimed** — honest: the mic→harmonized-answer core has lab precedent (`280-kids-echo-canyon`); the fresh layer is the suspension *chain* pedagogy (tension→release walked across several figures), which is why this lost the §446 tie-break to 662 but wins now on the binding off-glass directive. **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-16)=[pentatonic/scale-snap "no-wrong-notes" TECH 6× · Canvas2D OUTPUT 4× · look-ahead-scheduler-generative-bed as the only idea 7× · warm/cozy kids VIBE 4× · glass-screen as the primary deliverable (13/15)] · picked=[**mic/voice INPUT** (love-aligned `158-kids-hum-paint`❤️) · **audio-first / OFF-GLASS OUTPUT** (the rarest+best-rated output in the lab; the kids side's first ever) · **autocorrelation pitch-detect → suspension-chain voice-leading TECH** (genuine dissonance→resolution, explicitly NOT pentatonic, NOT a scheduler-bed) · **hushed/sacred, tender-curious VIBE** (NOT warm-cozy, NOT silly)]` — clean on every banned tag, and the only sibling that breaks the glass-screen monoculture. **Build-verified** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build` exit 0, `✓ Compiled successfully in 37.0s`, `✓ Generating static pages (484/484)`, `.next/server/app/dream/669-kids-hum-answer.html` emitted — prerendered static ○; ### `671-glasswork` — `demoable` · adult · WIDE-winner (cycle 449, 2026-06-16)
[/dream/671-glasswork](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/671-glasswork) — **"Glasswork": a tender, intimate, 3am generative music-box whose harmony *breathes* through REAL four-part voice-leading — on every chord change each voice glides (audible portamento) to its NEAREST chord tone, so you both SEE the threads cross and HEAR the pad slide rather than jump.** The directest hit on JURY 2026-06-16 provocation #5 ("declare the missing middle solved and freeze groove/EDM for a week — the un-built adult register is now **tender / intimate** (the banked `660-glasswork`) — go there") — the explicit, named adult ask for this window, and the realization of the long-banked tender seed. **Audio (all Web Audio, no samples, no deps):** key is **D Dorian** (the natural-6 gives the wistful-not-sad colour, deliberately NOT C-major-pentatonic) with a rare Lydian-#11 tint; harmony is a **tension/resolution-weighted random walk** over a small diatonic palette (Dm7 · G · C · Am7 · Em · F · IVadd9 · a rare tint) with hand-tuned transition weights giving a homeward gravity, a new chord every ~6–10 s, never a fixed loop (`compose.ts`). The technique anchor: an **exhaustive 4-voice nearest-tone assignment** (`voiceleading.ts`) that minimizes total semitone motion with doubling/unison penalties so the chord stays open, then each pad voice **portamentos ~0.4–0.8 s** to its target — the glide is the point. A separate **never-repeating weighted melody** arches over each phrase (sine register-arch + woven rests, `compose.ts`). Synth (`synth.ts`): FM music-box bell (melody) · 4 portamento glass-pad voices · soft sub following the root · ConvolverNode reverb (synthetic generated impulse) · filtered feedback-delay shimmer · master ends in a **`DynamicsCompressor` brick-wall limiter** (−6 dB / ratio 12 / master 0.34) so it can never clip or blast. **Output: inline SVG** (the scarcest renderer — last SVG was `649`; off the jury-banned **Canvas2D**, off the hot three.js/WebGL2): a dark constellation of soft `<radialGradient>`+`<feGaussianBlur>` nodes (one per pad voice, y = pitch) that bloom on each onset, **faint threads tracing the voice-leading** (a fading `<line>` from each voice's old tone to its new one — you watch the harmony move), and brief brighter sparks for melody bells; React re-render throttled to ~24 fps with all per-frame state in refs. **Interaction is gentle and optional** — pointer height = brighter register + more shimmer, pointer-right = busier (shorter chords/faster melody); a tap "drops a stone" pulling harmony toward rest on the next change; ~1.5 s idle eases back to autonomous. **It plays itself** — Begin and the pad swells in, the melody enters, chords change on their own, so a silent 06:30 glance sees blooming nodes + crossing threads and hears the piece with zero interaction or hardware. **No API route, no guard, no npm deps, no network/mic/camera/GPU/secret** (pure client Web Audio + inline SVG — the lowest failure surface in the lab; AudioContext created inside the Begin gesture for iOS, full teardown on unmount). References: **Brian Eno** (*Music for Airports*, *Reflection* — generative ambient) · **Harold Budd** (*The Pearl*) · **Erik Satie** (*Gymnopédies* — intimate melancholy); technique anchor: classical four-part **voice-leading**. Born from **RESEARCH §449** (generative-ambient that obeys voice-leading rules — minimize each voice's motion, omit minor-9ths — is a live browser lineage [Alex Bainter / generative.fm], anchored in Eno's *Music for Airports*; tagged `[older, foundational]` honestly — the build is jury-directive + IDEAS-seed driven, path (c)). Winner of an adult **WIDE** fire (3 orthogonal explorers across under-built adult registers, each a different input × output × technique × vibe, none touching a banned tag): beat **`672-cinema-swell`** (a cinematic orchestral-swell instrument — hold chords → film-score string divisi blooms with crescendo swells + a tension arc, MIDI/keyboard → three.js, Zimmer/Richter/Jóhannsson; Karel care #4 journey-engine alt) and **`673-kepler-chimes`** (the music of the spheres — planets whose orbital periods snap to small-integer mean-motion resonance become an audible consonant polyrhythm that locks from phasing, tilt → raw WebGL2, Kepler/Matt-Russo-System-Sounds); both banked as strong **IDEAS §449** seeds. **Ambition honest 2/5** (the lab norm): **#2** ≥3 subsystems (harmonic random-walk · exhaustive nearest-tone voice-leading engine · weighted never-repeating melody + scheduler · 4-voice glass synth w/ reverb + feedback-delay shimmer · inline-SVG renderer = 5) + **#3** named refs (Eno/Budd/Satie + voice-leading). **#1 NOT claimed** — generative-ambient voice-leading is worked territory; ### `677-presence-field` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 451, 2026-06-17)
[/dream/677-presence-field](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/677-presence-field) — **"Presence Field": step back from the screen and your whole body, tracked as a luminous skeleton, conducts a SPATIAL ensemble — each limb is a sustained voice placed in 3D around you, so spreading and raising your arms sweeps the music through the room.** The directest hit on the lab's single biggest untouched first, named across THREE consecutive juries (JURY 2026-06-16 #2 + standing: "depth-camera / room-presence / projection installation — zero embodied-spatial builds still") — the first ADULT installation/room-presence piece, and Karel's care #3 (live-performance) + #5 (installation mode). **The core idea — spatialization IS the instrument:** one Web-Audio `AudioListener` at the origin, and **seven sustained voices (head, both wrists, both elbows, torso, hips) each routed through its OWN `PannerNode` with `panningModel="HRTF"`** placed at the live 3D position of its tracked joint (screen-x → left/right, height → register + y, implied depth → z). Moving the body audibly moves the voices around the listener — that sweep is the payload (the realization of RESEARCH §451's spatialization→presence finding and "Sounding Bodies" pose→spatial-sound). **Harmony (NOT pentatonic — banned this cycle):** a slow drifting D-Dorian chord cycle (Dm7→G7→Am7→Fmaj7→Dm7, ~9–13s, 2.2s glides), adult/meditative, not a no-wrong-notes pad and not a groove look-ahead scheduler; ear-safe master gain (≤0.32) → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination, dry + convolution-reverb wet send, ~0.7s fade-in; stillness eases to a soft enveloping drone (`settle()`). **Input:** webcam **full-body pose** via **MediaPipe Pose** (Tasks-Vision `PoseLandmarker`), loaded from the jsDelivr **CDN at runtime** via an indirect `new Function('return import(...)')` so the bundler never resolves it (no npm dep, build never depends on it). **Output: three.js** (the scarcest renderer — 0× in the last 10 ships; off the jury-banned Canvas2D, off the hotter WebGL2) — a dark foggy room with a faint grid floor, glowing additive joint spheres + skeleton bone-lines, and a hued glowing marker at each voice's live spatial position; slow auto-rotate for installation feel; animates BEFORE audio unlocks. **Privacy:** camera is on-device only, analysed in-browser, never stored or sent (stated on screen); no API route, no guard needed (no network/server/secret — the only network is the public MediaPipe model/wasm CDN). **Graceful degrade (the 06:30-glance path is MediaPipe-independent):** an **idle preview** runs a *synthetic* drifting body through the three.js room + spatial ensemble before Start is even pressed, and any failure (camera denied, MediaPipe/CDN/WASM load error, WebGL loss, no pose, or ~2.5s idle) shows a `text-rose-300` notice and runs that same self-playing virtual body sweeping the full ensemble — so a silent glance hears + sees the spatial room with zero hardware and zero CDN dependency. Full teardown on unmount (MediaStream tracks stopped, landmarker closed, three.js renderer/geometries/materials disposed, AudioContext closed, rAF cancelled, resize listener removed). References: **arXiv:2601.22082** (Jan 2026 — spatialization + situated audio raise the felt *sense of presence*) · **"Sounding Bodies," arXiv:2311.06285** (3D spatial sound from body pose) · **Myron Krueger, *Videoplace* (1974)** (the body as the interface, no wearables) · **Refik Anadol** room-scale presence. Born from **RESEARCH §451** (the embodied-spatial room is the lab's biggest untouched first; the research front says the payload is the *spatialization itself*, not the viz) and realizes the long-banked **`442-body-orchestra`** seed. Winner of an adult **DEEP** fire (ONE concept — body-presence → spatial-audio — via three body-sensing approaches): beat **`678-presence-flow`** (the BULLETPROOF no-dependency twin — webcam frame-differencing → the same HRTF ensemble, raw WebGL2; banked ⭐ as the safest spatial-presence resurrect) and **`679-presence-veil`** (the ENVELOPMENT take — selfie-segmentation silhouette MASS widens the per-voice azimuth fan from a frontal arc to a surround RING as you approach, raw WebGL2 veil; banked); both **IDEAS §451**. **Ambition honest 2/5**: **#2** ≥3 subsystems (MediaPipe-Pose body tracking · 7-voice HRTF spatial-panner ensemble + drifting D-Dorian harmony · three.js luminous-room renderer + synthetic-body auto-demo = 4) + **#3** named refs (arXiv:2601.22082 · "Sounding Bodies" · Krueger · Anadol). **#1 NOT claimed** — MediaPipe pose/hands/segmentation is used across the KIDS side (217/287/295/419/444/582/617); ### `702-kids-monster-band` — `demoable` · kids · WIDE-winner (cycle 460, 2026-06-17)
[/dream/702-kids-monster-band](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/702-kids-monster-band) — **"Monster Band": two little kids on two phones build ONE goofy 16-step monster groove neither could make alone.** The directest answer to JURY 2026-06-17 on **three** provocations at once: **#3 "ship a multi-user / two-player piece — still 0× across the entire window"** (the genuinely unbuilt register; *breaks the standing solo monoculture* — every one of the last 15 was one person alone), **#1 "groove, not a cadence"** (a beat built by tapping, emphatically NOT the harmonic-event/voice-leading template banned on the kids side), and **#5 "make a kid laugh"** (googly monsters that squash and BOING). Two browser tabs/phones open the same URL → join the same room over same-origin **`BroadcastChannel`** (no network, no server, **no api route, no guard, no secret**) → both phase-lock to **one shared 16-step ~96 BPM loop** via a broadcast beat-zero **epoch** (first player claims epoch 0; joiners adopt it; ties resolve last-write-wins toward the earliest). Each kid taps four giant ≥96px buttons — **🥁 BOOM** (low sine thump) · **📯 HONK** (triangle+FM down-glide) · **🫧 POP** (band-passed noise blip) · **🌀 BOING** (rubbery saw up-glide) — that drop sounds onto the nearest of the 16 steps and **loop forever**; the two kids' patterns overlay into one emergent groove. **Each monster squashes and bounces on EVERY hit — including the friend's hits** (instant `hit` messages + last-write-wins per-player 16-step pattern beads), so each kid *sees* the other playing in real time. **Input:** multi-user (same-origin BroadcastChannel) + big-button tap — the social co-play is the mechanic (off the jury-banned touch-as-primary reflex). **Output: three.js via @react-three/fiber** — bouncy googly 3D monsters with per-hit squash-and-stretch envelopes (off the banned WebGL2 + audio-first-SVG; three.js 1×→2× in the rolling-10, well under the 4× ban line). **Technique:** Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler (~25ms tick / ~120ms look-ahead) scheduling audio LOCALLY against the shared epoch (only the epoch + patterns cross the channel — audio is never streamed, which is what keeps the loops phase-locked); presence via hello/welcome/bye + a ~1.6s silence timeout; the two monsters detuned ±6% so they sound like siblings. **A real tapped GROOVE, emphatically NOT a harmonic event/cadence.** **Solo glance covered:** if no second player is present a friendly 👻 ghost-friend monster auto-plays a complementary pattern, and a ~2.5s idle auto-demo seeds a starter beat — so it sounds and bounces from the first second on one device; the ghost steps aside the instant a real friend joins and returns if they leave. Kids-safe by construction: ≥96px targets, <100ms response, master gain ~0.3 → lowpass → `DynamicsCompressor` (nothing harsh), iOS AudioContext unlock in the Start gesture, full teardown (close BroadcastChannel, cancel rAF, close AudioContext, clear timers). References: **Toca Band** (Toca Boca — the no-reading tap-a-character-to-add-a-part toy this is modelled on) · **Yamaha Tenori-on** (the lit 16-step grid sequencer) · **The Hub / League of Automatic Music Composers** (1970s–80s networked ensembles — *send control data, not audio*; "an ensemble nobody could play alone"). Born from **RESEARCH §460** (the multi-user register is the jury's 0× ask; The Hub's control-signal architecture ported to a kid-legible Toca-Band interface). Winner of a kids **WIDE** fire (3 divergent silly/groove explorers on different embodied inputs): beat **`703-kids-boing-zoo`** ⭐ (tilt → jelly-animal physics bonks → emergent slapstick rhythm; Canvas2D, zero deps/GPU/permission — the most bulletproof + funniest, banked ⭐ as the safest silly-kids resurrect) and **`704-kids-funny-face-party`** (front-camera motion → googly creature + a FREEZE-dance game; Canvas2D — the directest off-glass/embodied take with a fresh freeze-dance mechanic, banked); both **IDEAS §460**. **Ambition honest 2/5**: **#2** ≥3 subsystems (BroadcastChannel presence + last-write-wins beads sync · shared-epoch look-ahead scheduler · local Web Audio FM/noise monster synth · three.js/r3f bouncy-monster viz = 4) + **#3** named refs (Toca Band · Tenori-on · The Hub/League of Automatic Music Composers). **#1 NOT claimed** — BroadcastChannel multi-user already exists in the lab (319/334/341); this is a fresh *framing/recency* win (multi-user is 0× in the whole window) + breaks the solo monoculture, not a technique-first. **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-17)=[harmonic-event/voice-leading/tension-resolution TECH (esp. kids) · audio-first+minimal-SVG/glow OUTPUT · touch/on-glass-primary INPUT · WebGL2 OUTPUT · hushed/tender VIBE · standing single-user/solo] · picked=[**multi-user / BroadcastChannel INPUT** (two players are the input; secondary tap; *breaks the solo ban*) · **three.js/r3f OUTPUT** (off WebGL2 + audio-first-SVG) · **shared-clock 16-step tapped-groove TECH** (NOT a harmonic event) · **silly/friendly monster-band VIBE** (off hushed/tender — laugh-first)]` — clears EVERY ban and actively *breaks the standing solo monoculture*. **Build-verified** (full `npm run build` with all 3 candidates exit 0; then authoritative winner-only `npm run build` **EXIT 0, `Generating static pages (497/497)`** [+1 route = the winner], `/dream/702-kids-monster-band` present), **NOT browser/two-device-verified** (no second device/audio/GPU in sandbox) — the ghost-friend + idle auto-demo guarantee a live sounding glance on one device; unverified by hand: true two-device sync convergence under contention (epoch-adoption + presence-timeout logic is in place and degrades to the ghost), and whether the monster voices + squash read as "a band two kids built together" on a real phone.

### `704-spectral-seance` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 461, 2026-06-17)
[/dream/704-spectral-seance](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/704-spectral-seance) — **"Spectral Séance": a generative sound dreams an austere data-image — and then the image *becomes the next instrument you hear*, re-sonified column-by-column as a spectrogram while a cyan scan-line sweeps it in lock-step. You literally see AND hear the picture being played.** The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-17 #4** ("extend the two ceiling builds [689, 666] instead of starting a sixth tonal-tension toy") — the lab's first true **closed audio→image→AUDIO loop**, where ceiling-build `689-dream-chapters` only went one-way (audio→image). **The closed loop, four subsystems:** (1) a generative **inharmonic spectral bed** — 8 partials at NON-integer ratios (1, 2.07, 3.31, 4.62…) so it stays a *texture* and never collapses into a chord/cadence (the harmonic-event/voice-leading template the jury banned this cycle); (2) an **AnalyserNode spectral descriptor** (low/mid/high band split, centroid brightness, flatness/roughness, density) → a **controlled-vocabulary prompt** (bright+sparse → "high thin filaments of white light on black, austere data grid"; dark+rough → "dense low charcoal static"); (3) the dreamed image — **guarded `fal-ai/flux/schnell`** when a key exists, else a **deterministic descriptor-seeded procedural data-image** (domain-warped interference/line-field + grid); (4) **the return trip** — the image is downsampled to a 128×48 offscreen buffer and read as a **spectrogram/score**: each column = a moment, each row = a log-spaced frequency bin (~80Hz–6kHz, top = high pitch), and a bank of **48 oscillators** has its per-row gains driven directly by per-column pixel brightness as the scan-line sweeps (~75ms/column, ~9.6s per 128-column pass); the re-sonified spectrum then feeds the *next* descriptor, closing the loop. **Input:** autonomous/generative + AI-image (NO mic, NO touch-as-primary — it runs itself; a single "Begin" gesture unlocks audio for iOS, ~2.5s idle auto-start). **Output: raw WebGL2** — the dreamed image + sweeping cyan scan-line + Ikeda grid/vignette rendered as a textured quad in a fragment shader (Canvas2D used ONLY for the tiny offscreen pixel-sampler, never for output). **Technique:** image-as-spectrogram cross-modal re-sonification — a genuinely never-used mechanic in the lab (689/441 were one-way audio→image; this is the literal *return trip*). **Vibe:** Ryoji Ikeda austere data-spectacle (black ground, white/cyan, precise) — deliberately far from the jury-banned hushed/tender pole. **Bulletproof keyless glance:** any non-200 / network error / CORS-taint silently falls through to the procedural data-image, re-sonified through the *identical* column-by-column path — so with no `FAL_KEY` (how the public preview usually runs) it still dreams an image AND plays it back as sound; the status line shows "dreaming (procedural)" in `text-emerald-300/95` so it reads as fine-without-a-key. WebGL2 absence shows a graceful notice and still runs audio. Ear-safe: 48 osc summed with tiny per-osc gains → lowpass → `DynamicsCompressor` → master hard-capped at 0.34, smooth gain ramps (no zipper clicks); full teardown on unmount (stop all oscillators, close audioCtx, clear timers, cancel rAF). References: **Ryoji Ikeda** (data-spectacle) · **Iannis Xenakis *UPIC*** (1977, draw-the-sound) · **the *ANS synthesizer*** (1958, image-as-spectrogram) · the spectrogram↔waveform synthesis lineage. Winner of an adult **DEEP** fire (ONE concept — *the music dreams a picture and the dream changes the music* — via 2 approaches to **how the image returns to audio**): beat **`703-latent-oracle`** ⭐ (the SOFT-closure twin — the loop closes via *dominant color*→synth [hue→cutoff, brightness→shimmer, saturation→dissonance], WebGL2 ping-pong feedback smear, Anadol/Memo Akten *Learning to See*; the long-banked 687 seed, fully built — banked ⭐ **IDEAS §461** as the resurrect for a key-awake night, since its color-drift narrows keyless). **Ambition honest 4/5**: **#1** never-used technique (image-as-spectrogram literal re-sonification — the closed *return trip*; 689/441 were one-way) · **#2** ≥3 subsystems (inharmonic generative bed + FFT descriptor→prompt + guarded-flux/procedural image gen + 48-osc re-sonifier = 4) · **#3** named refs (Ikeda · Xenakis UPIC · ANS) · **#5** recent research (RESEARCH §461 dive + the §455-banked seed it consumes). **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-17)=[harmonic-event/voice-leading/tension-resolution TECH · audio-first+minimal-SVG/glow OUTPUT · touch/on-glass-primary INPUT · WebGL2 OUTPUT · hushed/tender VIBE · standing single-user/solo] · picked=[**autonomous/generative + AI-image INPUT** (it dreams itself; off the touch reflex) · **WebGL2 raster OUTPUT** · **image-as-spectrogram cross-modal re-sonification TECH** (emphatically NOT a harmonic event) · **Ikeda austere data-spectacle VIBE** (off hushed/tender)]`. *Note on the two flagged tensions:* (a) **WebGL2** — the jury banned it on its rolling-**15** (4×: 658/659/662/675), but the diversity-audit's hard gate is the rolling-**10**, where WebGL2 is **cold** (last use 675, 9 ships back; 0× in the last 10) — so reviving it is legitimately diverse by the binding mechanic; flagged honestly. (b) **solo** — this is single-user, but the standing solo monoculture was *just broken* by 694 (cycle 457) + 702 (cycle 460), and JURY #4 (extend the inherently-contemplative ceiling builds) explicitly trumps for an adult cycle. **Build-verified** (authoritative winner-only `npm run build` **EXIT 0**, `✓ Compiled successfully in 34.7s`, `✓ Generating static pages (499/499)`, `/dream/704-spectral-seance 6.9 kB / 113 kB First Load` prerendered **static ○** + its `/api` route), **NOT browser-verified by ear** (no audio/GPU in sandbox) — the ~2.5s auto-start + procedural fallback guarantee a live, sounding glance with zero key/hardware; unverified on a real device: whether the 48-osc spectrogram playback reads as "the picture is the instrument," whether the inharmonic bed stays pleasant over minutes, and the felt latency of scan-line↔audio lock.

### `710-presence-bloom` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 463, 2026-06-18)
[/dream/710-presence-bloom](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/710-presence-bloom) — **"Presence Bloom": the genuine cycle-2 of `677-presence-field`. Where 677 placed STATIC point-voices at your joints, here a deliberate wrist gesture (reach → dwell ~0.65s → outward flick) LEAVES BEHIND a persistent HRTF voice fixed in 3D that keeps singing — so over minutes you build a spatial chord-architecture around your own ears, rendered as a 60k-particle WebGPU storm where each voice is an attractor.** Two new capabilities over 677: **(1) accretion / long-form memory** — voices persist and accrete (cap ~24, oldest fades), each taking the next pitch in a slowly drifting **D-Dorian** modal field (Dm9→Gmaj9→Em11→Dadd9 region, homeward gravity on D/A), so the set is an evolving spatial chord and the field is genuinely *different at minute 5 than minute 1* (the 689/701-coral accreting-memory ceiling the jury asked the lab to extend); **(2) distance + room reverberation as a felt axis** — each voice's `PannerNode` (HRTF, inverse distance) has a reverb send into a shared `ConvolverNode` that GROWS with distance, so near voices are present+dry, far voices quiet+wet (the literal realization of RESEARCH §463's **arXiv:2505.18020** distance-cues+reverb finding). **The core idea — spatialization IS the instrument:** one Web-Audio `AudioListener` at the origin (your ears); harmony is the *material*, the *subject* is building luminous spatial architecture (emphatically NOT a harmonic-event/cadence — the jury's banned template). **Input:** webcam **full-body pose** via **MediaPipe Tasks-Vision `PoseLandmarker`** loaded from CDN at runtime via `import(/* webpackIgnore: true */ …)` (bundler never resolves it; no npm dep; build never depends on it). **Output: WebGPU compute** (`render.ts → makeRenderer`) — tens of thousands of GPU particles advected by a WGSL compute shader, each persistent voice an **attractor** particles gather/orbit/bloom around (nearer = brighter/larger), additive instanced point-sprite render; **with a first-class Canvas2D fallback** (~3600 particles, the SAME accreting-attractor behavior, additive trails + glow haloes) that is the EXPECTED path on most devices, so a WGSL failure *degrades* rather than breaks. **Vibe:** luminous architectural **AWE**, Anadol-scale — deliberately pushed away from 677's meditative-hush (the jury-banned tender/hushed pole, the explicit risk of a 677 cycle-2). **Privacy/safety:** camera analysed on-device only, never stored/sent; no API route, no guard needed (no server/secret; only network is the public MediaPipe CDN). Ear-safe: per-voice `GainNode` → HRTF `PannerNode` → (dry + distance-scaled reverb send) → master ≤0.32 (scaled down as voice count grows) → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination; soft attacks, ~0.7s fade-in, AudioContext created/resumed inside the Start gesture (iOS). **Graceful degrade (the 06:30-glance path is MediaPipe/GPU-independent):** visuals animate on mount (idle preview) before audio unlocks, and any failure (camera denied, MediaPipe/CDN load error, no pose, ~2.5s idle, or no WebGPU) runs a **synthetic ghost body** that drifts and places voices on its own — building the architecture hands-free — and falls to the Canvas2D particle field if WebGPU is absent, all with visible `text-rose-300` error notices; full teardown on unmount (cancel rAF, destroy GPU buffers, close AudioContext, stop camera tracks, remove listeners). References: **Refik Anadol** (*Latent City* / *Machine Hallucinations* — GPU particle data-architecture awe) · **arXiv:2505.18020** ("Effects of auditory distance cues and reverberation on spatial perception" — distance+reverb as the spatial signal, the cycle-2 deepening) · **arXiv:2407.13083** ("Modeling and Driving Human Body Soundfields through Acoustic Primitives" — body movement shapes spatial sound). Born from **RESEARCH §463** (the embodied-spatial cycle-2's real upgrade is persistence + distance/reverb, not more joints). Winner of an adult **DEEP** fire (ONE concept — *body leaves behind persistent accreting HRTF voices → a resonant architecture* — via 3 renderers): beat **`708-presence-cathedral`** (the most literal 677 cycle-2 — MediaPipe-Pose + three.js cathedral of emissive light-pillars; banked **IDEAS §463**, lost on renderer over-use [three.js → 4×] + CDN risk without a GPU-fallback safety net) and **`709-presence-tide`** ⭐ (the BULLETPROOF zero-dependency twin — webcam frame-diff [no ML/CDN/network] + Canvas2D top-down room-map; banked ⭐ **IDEAS §463** as the safest spatial-presence resurrect, realizing the long-banked 678-presence-flow lane). **Ambition honest 3–4/5**: **#2** ≥3 subsystems (MediaPipe-Pose + gesture detector · persistent-accreting HRTF spatial-voice engine w/ distance attenuation + distance-scaled reverb · drifting D-Dorian field w/ accretion + chord-drift · WebGPU WGSL particle storm + Canvas2D fallback = 4–5) · **#3** named refs (Anadol · arXiv:2505.18020 · arXiv:2407.13083) · **#4** genuine **cycle-2 of 677-presence-field** (the persistence + distance-reverb capability 677 lacked) · **#5** RESEARCH §463 same-day. **#1 NOT hard-claimed** — HRTF-spatialization-as-instrument + MediaPipe Pose both exist at 677; the fresh capability is *accretion + distance/reverb* (a cycle-2 deepening), not a lab-first technique. **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-17)=[harmonic-event/voice-leading TECH · audio-first+SVG/glow OUTPUT · touch/on-glass-primary INPUT · WebGL2 OUTPUT · hushed/tender VIBE · standing solo] · picked=[**full-body-pose / embodied-spatial INPUT** (off the touch reflex — played from across the room) · **WebGPU OUTPUT** (scarcest non-banned renderer, 1× in window; off banned WebGL2, off warming three.js [677/689/699=3×], off hot Canvas2D) · **persistent-accreting HRTF-spatialization + distance/reverb TECH** (NOT a harmonic event) · **luminous architectural AWE / Anadol VIBE** (NOT hushed/tender)]` — clears every banned tag; WebGPU is the renderer-diverse choice. **Build-verified** (all-3-present `npm run build` exit 0 / 503 pages; then authoritative winner-only `npm run build` **EXIT 0**, `✓ Generating static pages (501/501)`, `/dream/710-presence-bloom 9.41 kB / 116 kB First Load` prerendered **static ○**), **NOT browser-verified** (no GPU/camera/audio in sandbox) — idle preview + ghost-body auto-demo + Canvas2D fallback guarantee a live, sounding glance with zero hardware/CDN; ### `711-kids-beat-buddies` — `demoable` · kids · WIDE-winner (cycle 464, 2026-06-18)
[/dream/711-kids-beat-buddies](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/711-kids-beat-buddies) — **"Beat Buddies": the lab's FIRST two-player / multi-user kids piece. Two little kids sit on opposite sides of ONE tablet and build a silly band together — every pad they tap snaps onto ONE shared looping groove, so the result is always a beat, never noise.** The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-17 #3** ("ship a multi-user / two-player piece — still 0× across the entire window, the genuinely unbuilt register") at the same time as **#1** ("groove/rhythm, not a cadence") and **#5** ("MAKE A KID LAUGH") — and it was the only one of this cycle's three explorers to hit the multi-user gap. **Interaction:** the screen splits into two stacked player zones; the **top zone is rotated 180°** (`rotate-180`) so the kid across the table reads it right-way-up — Player A warm/orange (top), Player B cool/teal (bottom). Each kid has **four big silly-sound pads** (`clamp(64px,18vh,150px)`, emoji glyphs, no reading): drum, boing, honk, slide-whistle. **The core mechanic — shared-clock loop-stacking (Incredibox/Sprunki):** a single Web-Audio **look-ahead scheduler** (~25 ms `setInterval`, scheduling ~104 BPM 16th-notes ~120 ms ahead) runs ONE clock for BOTH players; a tap doesn't fire raw — it registers a *looping layer* with a fixed 16th-note pattern, quantized onto the next step, so adding pads builds a thickening shared groove and tapping again removes the layer. A soft synth kick + shaker always keep the pulse, so there's a beat to lock onto from the first tap. **The togetherness payload:** when BOTH players are active at once the two googly conductor blobs **high-five** with a confetti burst + spark line — pure co-play, no winning, no competition (the entrainment science of RESEARCH §464's **arXiv:2504.03958**: quantize both kids to one clock so locking-in is engineered, not demanded). **Input:** two-player same-device touch (each zone its own pad-state — emphatically NOT the jury-banned lone-finger-on-glass reflex; the second person IS the novelty). **Output: Canvas2D** — two squash-stretch googly conductor creatures that bop on every beat, grow brighter/bigger as layers stack, flash on each scheduled hit (splashes synced to `ctx.currentTime`), plus confetti. **Technique:** shared-clock quantized loop-stacking groove (a never-before-built mechanic in the lab — the lab's first *multi-user* anything on the kids side). **Vibe:** silly co-op band/dance-floor — groove + laughter, deliberately NOT a harmonic-event/tension-resolution machine (the jury's banned kids template). **Bulletproof glance (the most robust of the three explorers):** pure tap + synthesis, **no sensors, no camera, no permissions, no network, no CDN, no samples** — works instantly for any reviewer on any device, even solo (one person tapping both halves); a ~2.5 s-idle **auto-demo** gently toggles pads itself so a passing glance sees+hears the groove build and thin on its own. Ear-safe: all voices through `gain(0.28) → lowpass(7500Hz) → DynamicsCompressor → destination`; full teardown on unmount (cancel rAF, stop scheduler interval, close/disconnect AudioContext). If AudioContext can't start, a `text-rose-300` notice asks for one more tap. References: **Incredibox / Sprunki** (stackable looping beat layers locked to a shared clock — the dominant 2026-live kids beat-making form, RESEARCH §464) · **Toshio Iwai's Tenori-on** (shared lit grid-instrument played by touch). Born from **RESEARCH §464** (Incredibox-2026 mechanic + ensemble-entrainment science → a two-player shared-clock groove). Winner of a kids **WIDE** fire (3 divergent groove+laugh explorers on 3 inputs): beat **`712-kids-roll-a-beat`** (tilt-physics slapstick → bonks quantized onto a groove, velocity→comedic-pitch; banked **IDEAS §464**, lost on tilt-physics over-use [286/451/603/703]) and **`713-kids-dance-drum`** ⭐ (off-glass webcam-motion freeze-dance groove + spring-physics mirror creature; banked ⭐ **IDEAS §464** as the directest "get off the glass" / revives the abandoned dance register). **Ambition honest 4/5**: **#1** never-used technique (first multi-user / two-player piece in the lab; shared-clock loop-*stacking* quantizer driving two co-located players on a split+rotated screen) · **#2** ≥3 subsystems (shared look-ahead groove scheduler + 6 synth voices · split/rotated two-player tap UI w/ per-zone state · Canvas2D reactive creatures/splashes/confetti · idle auto-demo driver = 4) · **#3** named refs (Incredibox/Sprunki · Tenori-on) · **#4** multi-cycle (a reusable two-player co-op kids line — clean teardown + idle-demo; deepen with two-marble co-op, more pads, streak meter). **#5 NOT claimed** (a play piece about shared groove, not grounded in a specific algorithm-paper — though the design *choice* is motivated by §464's entrainment finding). **Diversity** `banned (JURY 2026-06-17)=[harmonic-event/voice-leading/tension-resolution TECH · audio-first+minimal-SVG/glow OUTPUT · touch/on-glass-primary INPUT · WebGL2 OUTPUT · hushed/tender VIBE · standing single-user/solo] · picked=[**two-player same-device INPUT** (the breaks-the-solo-monoculture move — the second person is the point; off the lone-finger reflex) · **Canvas2D OUTPUT** · **shared-clock quantized loop-stacking groove TECH** (emphatically NOT a harmonic event) · **silly co-op band VIBE** (NOT hushed/tender)]` — clears every banned tag, and is the rare build that *breaks the standing solo monoculture* (every one of the prior 15 was one person alone). Love-signal: backed by Karel's loves of `98-kids-drum-circle` (rhythm), `217-dance-avatar`, `234-kids-hand-creature`, `169-kids-marble-run`, `83-kids-tilt-rain`. **Build-verified** (two losers `rm -rf`'d, then authoritative winner-only `npm run build` **EXIT 0**, `✓ Compiled successfully in 46s`, `/dream/711-kids-beat-buddies 4.8 kB / 111 kB First Load` prerendered **static ○**), **NOT browser-verified by ear/touch** (no audio in sandbox) — pure-tap + auto-demo guarantee a live, sounding glance with zero hardware; unverified on a real device: whether two 4-year-olds *feel* the shared lock, the rotated-split ergonomics on a real tablet, and whether the quantize-on-tap latency reads as responsive to a kid.

[/dream/712-seismic-room](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/712-seismic-room) — **"Tremor": the world's earthquakes, live — the moment each one is detected by the global seismic network, it becomes a struck resonant tone and an expanding ripple on a Canvas2D world map; you sit inside the seismic present of the whole planet and hear it tick.** The lab's FIRST real-world EXTERNAL-live-data instrument (683 sonified market data; this is the planet itself) and the literal realization of JURY 2026-06-17 provocation #4 ("sonify a non-market live stream — seismic — for free"). **Input:** the free, no-auth **EMSC / SeismicPortal real-time WebSocket** (`wss://www.seismicportal.eu/standing_order/websocket`, GeoJSON FDSN events). **Always sounds even with no network:** a Gutenberg–Richter **Poisson synthetic-swarm** fallback (small quakes vastly outnumber large), so a glance is always live and moving; a badge flips emerald on live connect, amber-calm on fallback, and a toggle forces sim/live. **Sonification (all Web Audio, no samples, no deps):** magnitude→fundamental (140→38 Hz, bigger=lower) + loudness + decay; depth→timbre (shallow=bright triangle + a band-passed noise "crack"; deep=pure low sine, no crack); longitude→`StereoPanner`; a procedural `ConvolverNode` reverb + a low detuned room-tone drone; master ends in a `DynamicsCompressor` brick-wall limiter so a magnitude-7 can never blast. **Visual:** Canvas2D equirectangular world map (faint 30° graticule + dotted equator/meridian, no raster assets), each event an expanding ring + bright core colored by depth (shallow=amber, mid=violet, deep=blue) with a lingering glow for large quakes, plus a monospace event log. **Named refs:** Florian Dombois — *Auditory Seismology* · EMSC real-time feed · Ryoji Ikeda data aesthetics. Adult · WIDE-fire winner (cycle 465; banked 713-shadow-duet ⭐ first-WebMIDI + 714-physarum-choir — see IDEAS §465). Status: **demoable** (build-verified, not browser-verified — live-feed schema + by-ear seismic reading untested in sandbox; the synthetic swarm covers any no-network glance).

[/dream/713-kids-rubber-face](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/713-kids-rubber-face) — **"Rubber Face Sing-Along": a 4-year-old grabs a giant googly face and SCULPTS a silly voice with their fingers — no microphone, the voice is shaped entirely by how the face is squished.** The lab's first **gestural-deformation → formant ("vowel") synthesis** (grep-confirmed: every prior vowel/formant kids piece — `393`, `413` — drove the synth from a real microphone; this one is sculpted by touch). **Mapping:** pull the **nose** up/down → fundamental pitch slides like a slide-whistle (~120–500 Hz, loosely snapped to a friendly set so there's never a harsh note); stretch the **mouth** wide vs. tall → morph three parallel bandpass formants between vowels **ooo↔aaa↔eee**; squish the **cheeks** inward → a wah lowpass-cutoff wobble; pull the **ears/eyes** → vibrato depth + goofy warble; **release → the feature springs back (boing)** and the voice glides to a whisper. **Input:** single/multi-finger touch-deformation (NOT a mic, NOT a button-grid, NOT two-player — deliberately breaks the kids side's just-formed two-player-groove streak `702`/`711`). **Output:** Canvas2D rubbery googly face (spring-loaded handles, rosy cheeks, big tongue, eyes that track the nose). **Audio:** sawtooth glottal source + vibrato LFO → 3-formant bandpass bank → wah lowpass → the kids-safe chain `masterGain(0.3) → lowpass(7500) → DynamicsCompressor(−10/20:1) → destination`, always-on soft ambient pad, AudioContext unlocked in the Start gesture (iOS), `text-rose-300` retry-tap fallback, full teardown (rAF/osc/AudioContext). **Bulletproof glance:** a ~2.5s-idle **ghost-finger auto-demo** pulls the face around and sings on its own with zero permission/camera/CDN — yields instantly to a real touch. **Named refs:** Klatt formant synthesis / source-filter vocal model · Mr. Potato Head & stretchy-face toys · Sesame Street puppet mouths. Born from **RESEARCH §466** (density grep → deformation→synthesis is the lab's open laugh-mechanic). Kids 4+ · WIDE-fire winner (cycle 466; banked **`715-kids-stomp-zoo`** ⭐ off-glass webcam-stomp parade + **`714-kids-feed-monster`** drag-feed groove — see IDEAS §466). **Ambition 2/5** (#1 never-used technique [deformation→formant] + #3 named refs). Status: **demoable** (build-verified `npm run build` exit 0 / 504 pages; NOT browser-verified — the cartoon-vowel timbre + sub-50ms touch latency + multitouch need a real iPad; the idle auto-demo + friendly pitch-snap cover any silent/harsh glance).

[/dream/718-duet-paths](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/718-duet-paths) — **"Duet with the Paths": play a phrase (MIDI / keyboard / on-screen keys) and a machine improviser ANSWERS IN THE GAPS — trading fours with grains pulled from Karel's OWN recorded *Welcome Home* piano (concatenative/corpus-based, MACataRT/CataRT), not an echo.** `demoable` · Cycle 467. **For**: adults / Karel-the-pianist / live-performance-fit / jazz-responsive alternate journey-arc. The lab's first **call-and-response duet partner whose voice is Karel's actual recording**: on Begin it fetches his solo-piano buffer via the read-only `/api/audio/<id>`, slices it into a CataRT-style grain corpus (each grain tagged by autocorrelation pitch + RMS + zero-crossing brightness), and when your phrase closes (~750 ms silence after ≥2 notes) it derives an *answering* line (complementary register · inverted contour · density-matched · resolving in D Dorian) and realizes each note from the **closest-pitch grain of his recording**, pitch-nudged via `playbackRate` — so the reply is built from *his* piano sound. Turn-taking ducking (play over it → it yields), idle auto-demo (call-and-response loops on load with zero hardware), Canvas2D piano-roll "river" (your notes warm amber/rose, the shadow's grains cool cyan/violet, flowing past a now-line). **Offline synth fallback** (OfflineAudioContext piano corpus) keeps it fully alive keyless/offline with amber provenance; emerald "Karel's piano 🎹" when his buffer loads. Three inputs: Web MIDI (hot-plug, device badge), computer keyboard (`asdfghjkl` + `wetyuo` + `z/x` octave), on-screen ≥44px keys. Pure client Web Audio + Web MIDI + Canvas — no API route, no new deps. Realizes Karel's MORNING ask ("Shadow Duet … jazz call-and-response wired to your Paths piano") + the banked ⭐ seed's own "strongest next step." **Source:** RESEARCH §467 (MACataRT arXiv:2502.00023, Feb 2025 · Diemo Schwarz CataRT · IRCAM Somax2 / Pachet Continuator lineage).
