[/dream/719-kids-stomp-zoo](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/719-kids-stomp-zoo) — **"Stomp Zoo": a 4-year-old JUMPS and STAMPS in front of the camera and a whole parade of googly creatures launches into the air in a ripple, each stomp dropping a big comical tuba BONK.** `demoable` · Cycle 468 (kids, WIDE fire). **For**: kids 4+ / **off-glass whole-body** input / Canvas2D parade / silly marching-groove. The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-17 #2** ("the next off-glass swing should be embodied, not another glow-screen") *and* **#5** ("MAKE A KID LAUGH — the kids side has gone uniformly solemn") at once. **Input (off-glass):** front webcam → tiny 64×48 offscreen **frame-difference**, motion energy measured ONLY in the lower ~45% band (feet/legs) → sharp **rise** above an adaptive baseline w/ ~180 ms refractory = a STOMP onset (one stomp = one bonk). **Output (Canvas2D):** six saturated googly creatures do a squash-then-launch gravity arc, **staggered into a Mexican-wave ripple** across the parade (rewards repeated stomping — the deepening over the original seed), with dust puffs, screen-shake, warm bonk-flash; a ~20 s **freeze-dance** giggle beat (bed drops, creatures freeze with ❄, then kicks back in). **Audio:** a friendly tuba-honk BONK (filtered sawtooth + sine sub) walks a low marching **bassline** `[55,49,62,44,58]` Hz — rhythm/GROOVE, emphatically **not** a cadence/voice-leading (the jury-banned kids template) — over an always-on gentle oom-pah + shaker bed. **Bulletproof glance:** a **ghost auto-stomper** fires the parade on a groovy rhythm whenever the camera is unavailable/denied OR there's no stomp for ~2.5 s, so a silent 06:30 glance is alive; `text-rose-300` notice on camera-denied. Kid-safe `master(≤0.3) → lowpass(7000) → DynamicsCompressor(−10/20:1) → destination`; AudioContext + camera both unlocked in one Start gesture (iOS); full teardown stops the camera tracks. **On-device only — nothing recorded or sent; no API route, no guard, no new deps.** Winner of a kids **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three *embodied non-glass inputs*: SEE/SHAKE/BLOW); banked **`720-kids-shake-pop`** ⭐ (device-SHAKE → fizzy-bottle build-and-erupt; possibly a lab-first shake input) + **`721-kids-blow-balloon`** (mic-breath → balloon hum + raspberry) as **IDEAS §468**. **Named refs:** *BodyBeats* (whole-body musical interfaces for children via Laban's Theory of Effort) · VTech Toy Fair 2026 "your movement is the controller." **Ambition honest 2/5** (#2 ≥4 subsystems [frame-diff motion engine + stomp-onset detector + tuba-bonk synth + Canvas2D parade physics] + #5 recent research [RESEARCH §466 VTech 2026, consumed via the banked seed]). **Source:** RESEARCH §466→§468 chain. **Build-verified** (losers removed, authoritative winner-only `npm run build` EXIT 0, ✓ Compiled successfully, 506/506 static, `/dream/719-kids-stomp-zoo 4.19 kB / 110 kB First Load` prerendered **static ○**); **NOT browser-verified** (no camera/audio in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: whether the lower-band frame-diff reliably catches a real toddler's stomp without false-firing on hand-waving, the stomp→bonk latency on a real device, and whether the parade reads as laugh-out-loud; the ghost auto-stomper guarantees a sounding, moving glance with zero hardware).

### `720-paths-grainfield` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 469, 2026-06-18)
Fly *inside* Karel's real recorded Welcome Home piano: the whole performance is shattered into a **WebGPU compute particle field** (one GPU particle per ~90ms grain, laid out by sonic character — x = time-through-the-piece, y = brightness, + curl-noise drift), and dragging a cursor through the cloud **re-sounds the nearest grains concatenatively**, Hann-windowed and stereo-panned (CataRT-style descriptor-space navigation). His real recording re-granulated — never a fresh oscillator. Degrades first-class to a Canvas2D field; ghost auto-drift on idle; master chain `gain 0.28 → lowpass 6.8k → comp −10/20:1`. **Extends the ceiling builds `710-presence-bloom` (WebGPU compute) + `718-duet-paths` (his-piano grains).** INPUT: his real piano + pointer navigation · OUTPUT: WebGPU compute particles (Canvas2D fallback) · TECHNIQUE: corpus-based concatenative granular resynthesis · VIBE: cosmic/immersive-meditative. Named refs: Diemo Schwarz **CataRT**, *Audio Latent Space Cartography*. Design notes: `src/app/dream/720-paths-grainfield/README.md`

### `724-presence-drift` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 471, 2026-06-18)
**"Presence Drift": leave singing voices hanging in the air around your own ears — and each one is a slow READ-HEAD walking through Karel's REAL *Welcome Home* recording, so the spatial chord you build never holds still: it continuously re-voices itself over minutes, genuinely different at minute five than at minute one.** **For**: adult / installation · **webcam full-body pose** (MediaPipe Tasks-Vision, CDN; reach→dwell→flick gesture + body energy; synthetic **ghost-body** fallback) · **WebGPU compute particle storm** (tens of thousands of WGSL points; first-class **Canvas2D** fallback) · **HRTF-binaural** spatial concatenative grains around one `AudioListener` · cosmic/meditative, long-form/stateful. **This is the lab's first true cycle-2 of `710-presence-bloom`** (the jury's only new ceiling build), fused with the concatenative-grain piano of `718-duet-paths`/`720-paths-grainfield`. **The single change vs 710:** a placed voice is no longer a synth oscillator in a D-Dorian field — **each voice owns its own slow read-head** drifting through his real recording (~100ms Hann grains, 50% overlap), every head at a slightly different rate and wrap so the chord never re-aligns; voices accrete (cap ~24, oldest fades); overall body energy gently steers global drift speed (still = heads crawl, moving = advance faster); each voice is also a particle-storm attractor whose bloom warms violet→amber as its head drifts through the performance. The directest hit on **JURY 2026-06-18 #3** ("stop banking ceilings and walking away — push 710 to a cycle-2, reward DEPTH over breadth") **+ #5** ("use his real music — it's in only 1 of the last 15") **+ #1** (the scarce WebGPU stack, not banned Canvas2D). **Named refs:** Diemo Schwarz *CataRT* / corpus-based concatenative synthesis · HRTF/binaural `PannerNode` spatialization · Refik Anadol (GPU particle data-architecture). **Ambition honest 4/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [MediaPipe pose + WebGPU compute + HRTF spatial audio + concatenative real-recording grains] · #3 named refs · #4 cycle-2 multi-cycle commitment · #5 RESEARCH §471 same-day cite [*Synaptic Sanctum Neuroscape* 2026 — CataRT grains + per-source binaural HOA locked to head-tracking]). **Degrades first-class at every layer:** visuals animate on mount; ghost-body places + drifts voices hands-free if no camera/pose; Canvas2D field if no WebGPU; offline-rendered piano buffer fills the corpus if the recording can't be fetched (amber notice). Reads only the public `/api/audio/:id` GET → **no api route, no `guard`** (rules #6/#8 clean). **Build-verified** (losers removed, authoritative winner-only `npm run build` EXIT 0, ✓ Compiled successfully, **509/509** static, `/dream/724-presence-drift` static ○ 10.6 kB / 117 kB First Load). **NOT browser-verified** (no GPU/camera/audio in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: WGSL compute + MediaPipe pose on real hardware, whether the drifting read-heads read as *his performance re-voicing itself* on headphones, the reach→dwell→flick gesture latency, HRTF imaging; ghost-body + Canvas2D + offline-buffer fallbacks guarantee a sounding, moving glance). Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-approach fire (three body→grain models); banked **`722-presence-paths`** ⭐ (descriptor-space reach — hand height→brightness, openness→time) + **`723-presence-tide`** (whole-body conductor, no placement — stillness→distant/wet grains, vigour→near/dry) as **IDEAS §471**. Design notes: `src/app/dream/724-presence-drift/README.md`

### `729-piano-portal-jam` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 473, 2026-06-18)
**"Piano Portal Jam": open a PORTAL to Karel's real *Welcome Home* piano and send it to a friend's phone with one shareable link — then the two of you actually play it together, peer-to-peer, across the room or across the world.** **The lab's first GENUINE cross-device multi-user piece** — every prior "multiplayer" (319/334/341/694/702/711) was same-browser `BroadcastChannel` fakery; this is real **WebRTC `RTCDataChannel`** between two devices. The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-18 #4** ("make one multi-user piece *actually* cross-device — one real two-phones-across-the-room jam retires the asterisk; all three multiplayer builds are same-browser") **+ #5** (built on his real recording). **The elegant twist:** both peers already hold his recording sliced into the same grain corpus, so **no audio is streamed** — only tiny note-events `{p,x,y,t}` cross the channel, and each peer re-sounds the other's grain *locally* from the identical corpus (near-zero bandwidth, no codec latency — the inverse of the AES/JackTrip PCM-streaming approach). **Signaling is zero-server, no API route, no backend:** non-trickle ICE (await `icegatheringstatechange==='complete'`) → one complete SDP → gzip via native `CompressionStream` → base64url token inside a link `…#o=<token>`; the guest opens the link, auto-builds the answer, returns a short code the host pastes. INPUT: touch/drag note-trigger **+ a remote PEER over WebRTC** · OUTPUT: **three.js `Points`** two-constellation starfield (warm amber/rose = you, cool cyan/violet = them; Canvas2D fallback) · TECHNIQUE: **WebRTC P2P data channel + concatenative grains** of his real recording (event-only transport) · VIBE: adult, cosmic, "two constellations meeting". **Named refs:** **JackTrip WebRTC** + AES *"Web-Based Networked Music Performances via WebRTC"* (RTCDataChannel + Web Audio). **Ambition 4/5** (#1 first real cross-device WebRTC P2P — all prior multiplayer is BroadcastChannel · #2 ≥3 subsystems [WebRTC signaling + P2P data-channel sync + concatenative grain engine + three.js renderer] · #3 named refs · #5 his real piano). **Solo + ghost:** after ~2.5s idle a simulated remote player drifts a path through his recording in the remote color, so a single 06:30 phone is always a sounding, moving duet with zero setup; the portal link is the stretch that makes it REAL with a 2nd device. Master chain `gain 0.28 → lowpass 6.8k → comp −10/20:1`; iOS gesture-gated AudioContext; full teardown (peer connection + data channel + audio graph + three.js dispose). Reads only public `/api/audio/:id` GET → **no api route, no `guard`** (rules #6/#8 clean). **Compile + lint verified** (`✓ Compiled successfully in 95s`, ESLint clean on the folder), **static-generation BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE) — an infra quirk, NOT the code: pristine `main` fails identically** (proven this cycle); Vercel builds this same app normally. **NOT browser-verified** — and crucially the **cross-device link is correct-by-construction but NOT link-tested** (no 2nd device / live STUN in the sandbox); public STUN handles most NATs, symmetric NATs would need TURN (out of scope). Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-approach fire (one cross-device-jam concept, three signaling × renderer attacks); banked **`728-piano-relay-jam`** ⭐ (zero-server **copy-paste** SDP handshake + raw **WebGL2** field — scarcer renderer, purest zero-dep handshake) + **`730-piano-room-jam`** ⭐ (friendly **4-letter room code** via a guarded serverless SDP relay + **WebGPU** compute field — best UX & scarcest renderer, but needs Vercel KV/Upstash to survive cross-lambda; resurrect when a backing store is approved) as **IDEAS §473**. Design notes: `src/app/dream/729-piano-portal-jam/README.md`

### `731-kids-star-reach` — `demoable` · kids (4+) · DEEP-winner (cycle 474, 2026-06-19)
**"Star Reach": a 4-year-old lifts their BARE HANDS into the air — no screen to touch — and scoops handfuls of glowing stars out of a deep night sky, each one ringing a soft bell.** **For**: kids 4+ / **off-glass embodied** input / **raw-WebGL2** field / awe-wonder. Front camera → **MediaPipe HandLandmarker** (CDN, analysis-only, 2 hands, frames discarded immediately — never recorded/sent); openness from mean fingertip-spread ÷ hand-size (robust to how close the child stands), with hysteresis so each gesture rings once cleanly. **Close a fist → nearest stars gather to the palm + a soft just-tuned pentatonic bell cluster; open wide → they spill outward in a rising glissando arc; raise hands high → brighter/higher tones, low → warm/low.** No beat, no loop, no "wrong" note — pure cause-and-effect + luminous texture. **Output:** hand-written **WebGL2 (GLSL ES 3.00)** — *not three.js, not Canvas2D-primary* — a full-screen night-sky gradient + drifting nebula + ~2,600 `gl_PointSize` glow sprites with additive `SRC_ALPHA,ONE` blending, depth-faded and parallaxing; CPU-side gather/spill/spring-home physics so behaviour is identical across render paths. The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-18 #1** ("give a kid the scarce renderer too — ban the Canvas2D monoculture") + **#3** ("stop banking ceilings and walking away" — this *resurrects the twice-banked ⭐ `726-kids-star-scoop` seed* instead of spinning a new toy) + **#2** ("texture/cause-effect, not a groove; vary the register away from silly"). **Renderer choice (the curate axis):** raw WebGL2 is the **scarcest renderer in the rolling window AND the most iOS-bulletproof** for Karel's 06:30 phone glance — WebGPU is warming to its own monoculture (721/724/727) and three.js was just used last cycle (729); iOS has WebGL2 reliably and there's zero CDN renderer dep beyond the shared MediaPipe. **Kids-safe** `voices → masterGain(0.26) → lowpass(≤7200) → DynamicsCompressor(−10/20:1) → destination`; soft attacks, long decays, no loud transients; always-on open-fifth drone bed so the sky is never silent. **Degrades first-class:** camera denied / MediaPipe fails → two **ghost hands** keep scooping + singing (resume after ~3.5s of no hand), `text-rose-300` notice; WebGL2 unavailable → inline **Canvas2D** fallback with the identical gather/spill glow physics + bells, a badge showing the live path (`WebGL2 ◈` / `Canvas2D ◇`); alive within ~2s of START. iOS: AudioContext + `getUserMedia` both inside the first tap (≥64px Start button); full teardown stops camera tracks, deletes WebGL programs/buffers/VAOs + loses context, closes AudioContext, cancels rAF, disconnects ResizeObserver. **On-device only — nothing recorded or sent; no API route, no guard (rules #6/#8 clean); no new npm deps** (three is unused here; MediaPipe via runtime CDN script). **Named refs:** **MediaPipe Hands** · ***Journey*** (thatgamecompany — wordless awe, every gesture beautiful) · **Inigo Quilez** (additive point-glow / GLSL field lineage). **Ambition honest 2–3/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [MediaPipe hand-tracking + raw-WebGL2 GLSL point-glow field + spatial pentatonic bell-cluster engine] + #3 named refs; MediaPipe Hands already in lab `524` so technique-#1 doesn't count). **Source:** RESEARCH §470 → IDEAS §472 (`726-kids-star-scoop` ⭐) → RESEARCH §474 chain. Winner of a kids **DEEP** 3-renderer fire (three.js / WebGL2 / WebGPU); banked **`730-kids-star-scoop`** ⭐ (three.js sibling — warmest glow) + **`732-kids-star-cradle`** ⭐ (WebGPU compute, 12k particles — the bolder swing once WebGPU cools) as **IDEAS §474**. **Compile + lint verified** (TypeScript + ESLint pass, **zero issues in the 731 folder** — all warnings are pre-existing `src/lib/*` files), **static-generation BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE) — an infra quirk, NOT the code: pristine `main` fails identically** (proven this cycle); Vercel builds this same app normally and will deploy 731. **NOT browser-verified** (no camera/WebGL/audio in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: whether MediaPipe reliably reads a real toddler's fist/open across hand-sizes & lighting, the scoop→bell latency on a real iPad, and whether the spilled-star glissando reads as wonder; the ghost-hands + Canvas2D fallbacks guarantee a sounding, moving glance with zero hardware).

### `734-paths-tape-erosion` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 475, 2026-06-19)
[/dream/734-paths-tape-erosion](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/734-paths-tape-erosion) — **"Tape Erosion": Karel's real *Welcome Home* piano plays as a slow 7-minute arc that disintegrates and re-forms — the spectrum thins and smears, motifs vanish and ghost back, never an exact repeat — rendered as a decaying magnetic-tape spectrogram.** A **long-form, STATEFUL** piece (the lab's thin category): minute 6 is materially different from minute 1, not a loop. The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-18 #3** ("reward DEPTH — stop banking ceilings and walking away") by extending the loved **paths-granular thread** (`227-paths-granular`❤️) with its missing long-form dimension instead of a new toy, **+ #5** (use his real music — 1 of last 15) **+ #1** (ban Canvas2D — raw WebGL2, the scarce/iPad-bulletproof renderer). **Audio:** his recording is read via the public `/api/audio/:id` GET, sliced into 80–140ms Hann grains scrubbed by a slowly-advancing read-head (~0.4× over ~2–4 min); a **5-movement state machine** — *Intact → Eroding → Sparse → Ghost → Reforming* (~7 min, 12s smoothstep crossfades) — modulates rate-drift, LP cutoff (tape-head roll-off), dropout probability (tape damage), reverb wash, grain density and gain; a sub-bass C2 drone keeps it never-silent. **Visual:** raw **WebGL2** (not three.js, not Canvas2D-primary) — two ping-pong **R32F float FBOs** accumulate a spectral field; a feedback fragment shader applies Gaussian smear + exponential decay + horizontal advection + magnetic noise and deposits each new FFT column on the right edge; a display shader applies an **Ikeda-style colormap** (black→indigo→teal→warm-white) with scanline flicker + vignette. The erosion params are driven by the same movement state as the audio, so sound and image decay as one. INPUT: **audio-file (his real piano, NO camera)** · OUTPUT: **raw WebGL2 ping-pong FBO** (scarce, iPad-bulletproof; Canvas2D scrolling-spectrogram fallback) · TECHNIQUE: **spectral-feedback erosion + long-form stateful decay/reform** · VIBE: adult, elegiac, Ikeda-spectral. **Named refs:** **William Basinski *The Disintegration Loops*** (tape decaying as it plays — listening consumes the recording) · **Brian Eno *Music for Airports* / *Reflection*** (long-form non-repeating systems) · **Ryoji Ikeda** (spectral-feedback / data-as-light lineage). **Ambition 4/5** (#1 long-form >7-min STATEFUL register, new · #2 ≥3 subsystems [recording loader + granular erosion DSP + WebGL2 FBO feedback + 5-movement state machine] · #3 three named refs · #5 RESEARCH §475 long-form-generative finding, today). **Degrades first-class:** no audio fetch → offline fallback synth (~12s arpeggio) + `text-amber-300/95` notice; no WebGL2 / no `EXT_color_buffer_float` → Canvas2D scrolling spectrogram with comparable colormap; never blank-screen, alive from the first frame. Reads only public `/api/audio/:id` GET → **no api route, no `guard`** (rules #6/#8 clean); **no new npm deps**. Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-renderer fire (one disintegration concept; WebGPU / WebGL2 / three.js attacks); banked **`733-paths-disintegrate`** ⭐ (WebGPU compute, 40k particles — the bolder swing once WebGPU's review-device support is verified) + **`735-paths-revenant`** ⭐ (three.js 60k-`Points` volumetric Anadol-ghost — the warmest look) as **IDEAS §475**. **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (`✓ Compiled successfully`, zero errors in the 734 folder — fixed 3 TS-5.7 null-safety nits during validation), **static-generation BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE) — an infra quirk, NOT the code: pristine `main` (512 pages) fails identically** (proven this cycle); Vercel builds this same app normally and will deploy 734. **NOT browser-verified** (no audio/WebGL in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: whether the feedback field reads as *tape decay* and whether the 7-min arc holds; Canvas2D + fallback-synth guarantee a sounding, moving glance). ### `744-magnetic-walk` — `demoable` · adult · WIDE-winner (cycle 479, 2026-06-19)
[/dream/744-magnetic-walk](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/744-magnetic-walk) — **"Magnetic Walk": the invisible field around you, made audible — the phone's compass heading + tilt turn your orientation in the Earth's geomagnetic frame into a slowly-morphing just-intoned drone and a WebGL2 aurora that stays locked to magnetic north as you turn your body.** **For**: adults / installation / **mobile-native** / ambient-meditative / live-performance-fit. The lab's **first use of the device compass/magnetometer** — every prior orientation piece (the kids-tilt cluster, `308-orbit-choir`, `394-soundfield-room`) read only raw `beta`/`gamma` tilt; this reads true magnetic north (`webkitCompassHeading` on iOS, `(360-alpha)%360` elsewhere), so the *world* feels fixed while *you* turn. **Input:** one `deviceorientation` listener; on iOS, `DeviceOrientationEvent.requestPermission()` is called inside the Start tap (same gesture that unlocks audio). **Mapping:** heading walks a **12-station "compass of keys"** (just-intoned roots + chord colors), continuously crossfading between the two nearest stations so N/E/S/W give genuinely different drone colors; tilt (beta) → octave + lowpass; roll (gamma) → pan + shimmer detune; smoothed turn-rate → upper-voice level + brightness + visual energy. **Audio:** four detuned saw/sine voices + triangle shimmer → lowpass → a **runtime-synthesized convolution reverb** (decaying-noise impulse, no file), all glided with `setTargetAtTime` — a continuous slowly-morphing field, **no beat/loop, no samples, no granular/concatenative synthesis, no recorded piano** (the directest break of this cycle's banned 8× his-piano-grain monoculture). **Visual:** a **WebGL2** (GLSL ES 3.00) full-screen-triangle aurora rotated by `-heading` so it stays locked to magnetic north; hue follows heading, band structure follows tilt, brightness follows turn-rate, with a faint north spoke + ring on a dark tone-mapped field. INPUT: **device compass heading + tilt** (lab-first) · OUTPUT: **WebGL2 aurora** (Canvas2D fallback) · TECHNIQUE: **cross-modal geomagnetic sonification → generative just-intoned drone** · VIBE: ambient / psychogeographic / meditative. **Named refs:** **Christina Kubisch *Electrical Walks*** (induction headphones that make a city's EM fields audible as you walk — this is its geomagnetic pocket cousin) · **Pauline Oliveros *Deep Listening***. **Ambition honest 2/5** (#1 first compass/magnetometer input + #2 ≥3 subsystems [orientation sensor-fusion + generative drone synth w/ runtime convolution reverb + WebGL2 north-locked aurora shader]). **Source:** RESEARCH §479 (today — the vision-conditioned spatial-audio wave; the hook: bind a real-world spatial signal to sound in-browser from a *sensor*, zero model download). **Degrades first-class:** no sensor / permission denied / desktop / no live events within ~1.8s → **ghost mode** auto-drifts heading ~6°/s with gentle tilt so a silent 06:30 glance is sounding + moving with zero interaction (`text-rose-300` notice; seamless handoff the moment real data arrives); no WebGL2 → Canvas2D fallback with the same north-locked concentric-aurora idea; alive within ~2s of Start. **No external audio, no API route, no `guard`, no new npm deps** (rules #6/#8 clean; package.json/package-lock untouched). Winner of an adult **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (compass-sensor / neural-room / ISS-telemetry — three never-used techniques); banked **`745-room-listener`** ⭐ (the lab's FIRST in-browser neural net — TFJS + COCO-SSD turns each camera-detected object into a voice; ambition 3/5, triple-love-aligned) + **`746-orbit-bell`** (live ISS telemetry → cosmic globe drone + terminator-crossing bells) as **IDEAS §479**. **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (zero issues in the 744 folder — all ESLint output is pre-existing `src/lib/**`), **static-generation BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE) — an infra quirk, NOT the code: pristine `main` fails identically at the same path** (proven this cycle); Vercel builds this same app normally and will deploy 744. **NOT browser-verified** (no device/WebGL/audio in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: real iOS `webkitCompassHeading` + permission flow, GLSL aurora compile, drone timbre/click-freeness, and whether the ghost→live-sensor handoff feels seamless; the ghost auto-drift + Canvas2D fallback guarantee a sounding, moving glance with zero hardware).

### `748-duet-follower` — `demoable` · adult · WIDE-winner (cycle 481, 2026-06-19)
[/dream/748-duet-follower](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/748-duet-follower) — **"Duet Follower": Karel's real *Welcome Home* recording becomes an accompanist that LISTENS to you — you keep the pulse (spacebar / A–L keyboard row / tap the stage) and the system estimates your tempo from inter-onset intervals and drives the playbackRate of his actual performance to follow your groove toward the next musical moment. You conduct his recording's pace; it's a duet where his performance is the accompanist that adapts to you.** The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-19 #1** ("his music can be used WITHOUT shattering it into grains — **play it and score-follow it**; the concatenative grain-cloud is now 7/15, the new pentatonic") and **#2** ("rotate OFF GPU-shader fields entirely for a cycle — build one piece with NO shader, prove the idea carries the piece, not the renderer"). **The lab's first use of his recording as a *followed score/performance*** — across 740+ prototypes his piano was only ever *visualized* or *scattered into a CataRT grain cloud*; here it is a continuous, time-stretched performance that re-times itself to YOUR pulse. **Input:** keyboard / tap pulse (spacebar, A–L / Q–T rows, click/touch) — **no mic, no camera** (both over-represented 4× and jury-flagged). **Technique:** onset → tempo estimate (short median of recent inter-onset intervals, clamped 30–240 bpm) → his recording is analyzed once into a coarse ~50ms RMS envelope whose rising edges become musical **landmarks**; on each tap the engine sets `playbackRate = gap-to-next-landmark / beatPeriod` (smoothed 35/65, clamped 0.4–2.2×) so his performance *arrives at that moment one of your beats from now*. **Continuous whole-performance playback** (one looping `AudioBufferSource` whose rate is re-timed) — emphatically **NOT** a descriptor-space grain cloud. **Output:** pure **SVG/DOM** — a moving piano-roll ribbon (envelope mirrored about a fixed center playhead), amber landmark markers, a pulsing playhead; **no WebGL, no WebGPU, no shader, no Canvas2D** (the cycle's whole point: prove the idea without a renderer). VIBE: warm chamber-concert duet (radial amber wash) — explicitly **not** the near-dark luminous-glow contemplative vibe the jury banned at 9×. **Named refs:** **Matchmaker** (real-time piano score following, arXiv 2510.10087, Oct 2025) · **Christopher Raphael *Music Plus One*** (statistical automatic accompaniment) · **Roger Dannenberg / Barry Vercoe** (foundational synthetic-performer accompaniment) · **Arshia Cont *Antescofo*** (anticipatory score follower) — this is the deliberately *inverted* cousin: the human is the soloist-conductor, his recording is the follower. **Ambition honest 3–4/5** (#1 score-following / interactive-accompaniment is lab-first — his recording used as a followed performance, never done · #2 ≥3 subsystems [tap/keyboard onset input + tempo estimator + envelope/landmark analyzer + continuous follower engine + SVG ribbon] · #3 four named refs · #5 RESEARCH §481, today — soft/qualified bind to the Matchmaker / Structure-Aware-Accompaniment 2024–2026 lane, NOT a <14-day claim). **Source:** RESEARCH §481 → this WIDE fire. **Degrades first-class:** no recording fetch → offline-rendered piano phrase is followed instead (`text-amber-300/95` notice); alive within ~2s; full teardown (rAF cancel, engine dispose, AudioContext close). Reads only the public `/api/audio/:id` GET → **no api route, no `guard`** (rules #6/#8 clean); **no new npm deps**. Winner of an adult **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three orthogonal NON-grain, NON-shader uses of his real recording: score-follow / speech-arrange / sky-conduct); banked **`749-spoken-libretto`** (speech-ASR → real-recording PHRASE selection onto a typographic SVG staff; Reich *Different Trains* / Lucier) + **`750-sky-almanac`** ⭐ (locally-computed sun position + moon phase → long-form STATEFUL arrangement of his real-recording phrases on an SVG sun-arc dial; Cage *Atlas Eclipticalis* / Finer *Longplayer* — the daylight vibe + long-form-stateful both thin categories) as **IDEAS §481**. **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (`✓ Compiled successfully`, **zero issues in the 748 folder** — all ESLint warnings are pre-existing `src/lib/**`), **static-generation BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE) — proven environmental THIS cycle: pristine `main` with 748 moved aside compiles + fails at the identical `next-font-manifest.json` open** (not the code); Vercel builds this same app normally and will deploy 748. **NOT browser-verified** (no audio in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: whether the envelope-landmark following reads as *his performance following your pulse* on his real recording's dynamics, the tap→re-time latency, and whether `playbackRate` pitch-shift stays musical; the offline-fallback phrase has clean well-spaced onsets and guarantees a sounding, following glance). ### `754-conducted-table` — `demoable` · adult · DEEP-winner (cycle 483, 2026-06-19)
[/dream/754-conducted-table](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/754-conducted-table) — **"The Conducted Table": Karel's real *Welcome Home* piano becomes a long-form ENSEMBLE you direct from a top-down score table — mute and revive a semicircle of seats, shape tempo and dynamics, and let friends fill the empty chairs from their own phones.** A deliberate **cycle-2 of `729-piano-portal-jam`** (the lab's first cross-device WebRTC duet): it keeps 729's zero-server note-event networking but **replaces 729's grain engine** (the technique JURY 2026-06-19 banned at 7/15) with a **non-grain phrase-remix** of his recording — the directest read of JURY #3 ("protect the depth habit; return to a ceiling nobody extended — take 729 to 3+ players / a conducted room") fused with JURY #1 ("use his music a way that isn't a grain cloud"). **Input:** tap seats in/out + tempo/dynamics sliders + remote peers — **no mic, no camera** (both jury-flagged 4×). **His music as PHRASES, not grains:** `segmentPhrases()` finds musical phrases by onset/silence RMS detection (~20ms windows; phrase start = energy rises after a quiet gap; end = quiet >~250ms; kept 0.6–3s, brightness-sorted); each seat plays ONE whole phrase via `AudioBufferSourceNode` with a per-seat `playbackRate` register shift + short envelope — emphatically not 90ms descriptor-space grains. **Long-form, stateful (5+ min, not a loop):** a Chris-Wilson look-ahead scheduler keeps the pulse steady while a memory arc migrates the harmonic center (slow sines + drift, retuning the open-fifth drone), breathes density over ~90s cycles, and drifts each seat's phrase-bank center + subdivision — minute 5 ≠ minute 0; the conductor biases, never resets. **Output:** **Canvas2D** — a warm amber/gold top-down parchment table, 6 seats in a semicircle facing the conductor, traveling conductor→seat cue arcs + seat blooms, IN/OUT/LIVE visual states — *not* a GPU shader field (JURY #2: "build one piece with no shader; Canvas2D is scarce again at 3× — use it"). VIBE: bright warm concert hall — explicitly not the near-dark luminous-glow contemplative vibe banned at 9×. **Networking (extends 729 — star/conductor-hub):** zero server, no API route, no signaling deps; the conductor is the host hub, "Invite a player" gzips an offer SDP → base64url into a shareable `#o=` link, the guest auto-answers, the host pastes the answer code; 3+ players = one peer connection per seat; only `{seat, phrase, vel, t}` events travel (both peers hold the identical recording → near-zero bandwidth, render locally). Networking is purely additive — solo is the full experience. **Named refs:** **`729-piano-portal-jam`** (cycle-1) · **The Hub / League of Automatic Music Composers** (historic networked ensembles — small messages, not audio) · **JackTrip** · AES **"Web-Based Networked Music Performances via WebRTC"** · **"A Design Space for Live Music Agents"** (arXiv 2602.05064, Feb 4 2026 — the ghost seats are agents the conductor steers, not micromanages). **Ambition honest 3/5** (#1 first *conducted/multi-seat* extension of the cross-device ceiling + #2 ≥3 subsystems [phrase-corpus loader/segmenter + look-ahead conductor scheduler w/ memory arc + Canvas2D score-table renderer + star WebRTC topology] + #3 named refs; #5 soft — RESEARCH §483, today). **Source:** JURY 2026-06-19 #3 (depth) + #1 (non-grain his-music) → RESEARCH §483 → this DEEP fire. **Degrades first-class:** no recording fetch → ~16s offline detuned-arpeggio fallback (with rests so segmentation still finds phrases) + a high-contrast `text-rose-700` notice; WebRTC/CompressionStream unsupported → invite UI hidden, solo only; ghost ensemble (all 6 seats ON) is alive + sounding the moment you press Begin; full teardown stops all sources + drones, cancels rAF + the lookahead interval, closes all peer connections + the AudioContext. iOS: AudioContext created/resumed inside the Begin tap. Reads only the public `/api/audio/:id` GET → **no api route, no `guard`** (rules #6/#8 clean); **no new npm deps**. Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-renderer fire (one Conducted-Room concept; three.js / Canvas2D / SVG-DOM attacks); banked **`753-conducted-orbit`** ⭐ (three.js concert-in-the-round, baton-on-a-3D-stage gesture — the most physically expressive conducting model) + **`755-conducted-stage`** (SVG/DOM dashboard whose long-form **timeline ribbon** makes the 5.5-min arc legible at a glance — the best at *showing* the arc) as **IDEAS §483**. **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (`✓ Compiled successfully in 97s`, **zero issues in the 754 folder** — all ESLint warnings are pre-existing `src/lib/**`), **static-generation BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE at `next-font-manifest.json`) — proven environmental THIS cycle: pristine `main` with 754 moved aside compiles + fails identically** (not the code); Vercel builds this app normally and will deploy 754. **NOT browser-verified** (no audio in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: whether onset/silence segmentation yields *musical* phrases vs. ragged fragments on his real dynamics, whether the conducted arc holds attention over minutes, and the real cross-device handshake on two phones; the ghost ensemble + fallback buffer guarantee a sounding, moving glance solo).

### `773-kids-parade-caller` — `demoable` · kids (4+) · WIDE-winner (cycle 490, 2026-06-20)
[/dream/773-kids-parade-caller](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/773-kids-parade-caller) — **"Parade Caller": a 4-year-old SAYS words out loud and they march in as a parade of percussion — each word's SYLLABLE RHYTHM (not its pitch) becomes a looping drum/clap pattern, so "el-e-phant" is a 3-hit gallop, "cat" is one big BOOM, and words accrete into a parade band you build by talking.** The lab's **first use of speech as RHYTHM** — every prior ASR piece (`752-kids-word-band`, `570-spoken-spell`) maps a recognized word to *pitch* (letters/phonemes → pentatonic notes); this maps it to *percussion*, the konnakol premise (spoken syllables ARE the beat) made playable by a toddler. The deliberate answer to **JURY 2026-06-19 #4** ("the un-built kids register is the active/joyful MIDDLE — bright daylight, bold primary color, fast legible cause-and-effect, neither solemn-glow nor slapstick") and **#2** ("rotate OFF GPU-shader fields — Canvas2D is scarce again at 3×"). **Input:** speech / browser ASR (`webkitSpeechRecognition`/`SpeechRecognition`, continuous + interim) — **no mic-hum analysis, no camera** (both jury-flagged). **Technique:** `syllables.ts` estimates syllable count from spelling (vowel-groups, silent-`e`, `-le` ending, clamp 1–6) + a stress index → `makeWordLoop` places the syllables evenly on a 16-step bar, accents the downbeat + stressed syllable, adds a marching hi-hat; loops accrete on one shared Web-Audio clock (~112 BPM, cap 5, oldest drops). Voice + bright primary color by syllable count (1=red kick, 2=amber clap, 3=green tom, 4=blue cowbell, 5=purple woodblock, 6=pink shaker); pitch demoted to a single warm C2 bass-marimba on the downbeat — the soul is the BEAT, not a pentatonic melody-wash (the perennial kids crutch). All percussion synthesized live (no audio files, no npm deps). **Output:** **Canvas2D** — sunny daytime sky, a scrolling marching road, bouncing primary-colored character discs (one per active word) pulsing on their hits with the word in big readable type, a sweeping red playhead. VIBE: bright exuberant carnival parade — explicitly **not** the near-dark luminous-glow contemplative vibe banned at 9×, and not silly-googly slapstick. **Named refs:** **Konnakol** (South Indian Carnatic vocal percussion — spoken syllables *are* the rhythm; taught to children from ~age 3 at the SaPa academy, "Indian beatboxing") · **Steve Reich** speech-melody (*Different Trains*, *It's Gonna Rain* — recorded-speech rhythm drives the music). **Ambition honest 2/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [browser ASR + syllable-rhythm analysis + accreting percussion step-sequencer on a shared clock + Canvas2D parade render = 4] + #3 named reference [Konnakol / Reich]; ASR-as-rhythm is a soft #1 — the primitive exists in-lab but never used for rhythm; #5 NOT claimed — konnakol is foundational). **Source:** JURY 2026-06-19 #4 + the grep that ASR-in-lab is pitch-only → RESEARCH §490 (konnakol = spoken syllables ARE percussion) → this kids **WIDE** fire. **Degrades first-class:** no `SpeechRecognition` / mic denied → an always-present **picture-word menu** (8 big tap buttons) drives the same loop pipeline (`text-rose-300` notice, never a dead end); **auto-demo** cycles built-in words through the same pipeline after ~3s of silence so a silent glance both sees and HEARS the parade (real input cancels it; ~5s silence restarts). Pure client Web Audio + Web Speech + Canvas2D — **no api route, no `guard`** (rules #6/#8 clean), **no new npm deps**. Winner of a kids **WIDE** 3-explorer fire (three orthogonal bright/active/non-shader directions: speech-rhythm / physics-marble / step-sequencer); banked **`774-kids-marble-symphony`** ⭐ (SVG/DOM Wintergatan-style physics marble machine — the scarcest renderer + love-aligned to the loved `169-kids-marble-run`) + **`775-kids-stamp-band`** (Canvas2D Toshio-Iwai *SimTunes*/*Electroplankton* step-sequencer with looping compositional memory) as **IDEAS §490**. **Compile + lint + type-check verified clean** (build reaches `Collecting page data`, **zero issues in the 773 folder** — all ESLint warnings are pre-existing `src/lib/**`; `tsc --noEmit` clean project-wide), **static-generation BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE at `next-font-manifest.json`) — proven environmental THIS cycle: pristine `main` with 773 moved aside fails identically at the same open** (standing infra limit, not the code); Vercel builds this app normally and will deploy 773. **NOT browser-verified** (no audio in sandbox — unverified by eye/ear: whether a 4-year-old's pronunciation reliably recognizes, whether the syllable heuristic feels musical across everyday words, and the parade's small-screen crowding at 5 loops; the auto-demo + picture-menu guarantee a sounding, marching glance with zero mic).

[/dream/781-kids-paint-conductor](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/781-kids-paint-conductor) — **"Paint Your Music": a 4-year-old finger-paints freehand on a bright cream canvas and a glowing playhead sweeps left→right forever, turning the picture they drew into the song they hear.** `demoable` · Cycle 492 (kids, DEEP fire — winner of 3 UPIC explorers). **For**: kids (4+) / **touch-draw** input / **Canvas2D** / bright daylight playful. **The literal realization of Iannis Xenakis's UPIC (1977, CEMAMu — "with UPIC, music becomes a game for children: they draw, they hear") for a 4yo** — and the lab's first true drawing-as-continuous-score (existing paint pieces 100/104/158/160/152 are per-stroke loops, splat-triggers, or draw-from-voice; none has a single global time-axis playhead that reads ALL strokes' y as pitch). **Mapping:** **x = time** (when in the 8s loop a point sounds), **y = pitch** (top=high, bottom=low, snapped to C-major-pentatonic across C3–A5 so nothing can ever sound wrong), **stroke color = timbre** (five distinct friendly voices: sine bell, triangle flute, filtered-saw horn, FM music-box, soft pluck), **thickness = loudness**. A drawn curve becomes a melodic line; stacked strokes become chords. **Long-form stateful** (the thin kids-depth category JURY-valued): strokes accumulate and the composition grows richer over minutes — no reset-per-tap. Seeded with a gentle pre-drawn arc that plays from load, so a hands-off 06:30 glance is alive and sounding. ≥64px emoji color swatches, sparkle-burst clear, kids-safe chain (`gain 0.28 → lowpass 7000 → comp −10/20:1`), always-on soft pad, iOS-gesture-gated AudioContext, full teardown, graceful `text-rose-600` audio-unavailable notice on the light bg. **Off every JURY-2026-06-19 ban** (no grain-resynthesis · no GPU-shader-field · no mic-hum · no dark-glow) and hits #4 (bright/joyful/active middle) + #3 (long-form stateful). No mic/camera, no data, no API route (no guard needed). Banked siblings: `782-kids-sun-clock-song` ⭐ (radial cyclic UPIC), `783-kids-melody-rider` (a character rides the drawn line) — IDEAS §492.

[/dream/778-markov-mirror](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/778-markov-mirror) — **"Markov Mirror": teach a small keyboard your melodic style, then watch the model itself — a glowing transition graph — improvise back in your style.** `demoable` · Cycle 493 (adult, WIDE fire — winner of 3 orthogonal explorers). **For**: adult / **on-screen-keyboard + computer-keys** input / **SVG/DOM** output / luminous-instructional violet-emerald. **A minimal *visible* live music agent.** You play (tap keys or `a s d f g h j k l`); the app builds a **live variable-order Markov chain** of YOUR note transitions (order-1 pairs + order-2 triples, counts accumulate, phrase context resets on a >900ms pause). "Improvise" (Space) then **walks the chain forever in your style** (prefers order-2 evidence, weighted by your counts, humanized timing, soft bass root every 4 steps), voiced by a warm triangle+sine ADSR piano → algorithmic-reverb bus → `gain 0.28 → lowpass 6.8k → compressor`. **The graph is not decoration — it IS the model, rendered live in SVG:** notes on a ring, directed Bézier edges whose thickness/brightness scale with use (well-worn transitions go emerald), the struck node haloed, the traversed edge glowing as the melody walks its own learned web. Teach / Improvise / Forget. **Why this renderer:** SVG/DOM is the scarcest surface in the rolling window (JURY 2026-06-20 #1's explicitly-named starved surface — 1×) and the *right* one here: the model is a graph, so show it as a graph, no canvas/WebGL. **Directly implements the "visible-model" axis of *A Design Space for Live Music Agents* (arXiv 2602.05064, Feb 2026)** — the lab's many accompanist pieces (718/748/770) all hide their brain; this one shows it and lets you reshape it. **Named refs:** David Cope *Experiments in Musical Intelligence* (EMI/Emmy) · Hiller & Isaacson *Illiac Suite* (1957, first Markov-generated composition) · the Feb-2026 live-agents design-space paper. **Ambition 3–4/5** (#1 first shipped live variable-order-Markov visible-agent / symbolic style-modeling register · #2 five subsystems [tap+key input · live-learning variable-order Markov · walk scheduler · polyphonic synth · live SVG graph] · #3 three named refs · #5 RESEARCH §493 same-day). **Off every banned tag** (NOT Canvas2D, NOT his-recording, NOT a GPU shader). Zero deps, zero API route (no guard needed), iOS-gesture-gated AudioContext, full teardown. **Compile + ESLint + `tsc --noEmit` all clean** (zero issues in the 778 folder; `✓ Compiled successfully`), **static-gen BLOCKED by the container fd ceiling (EMFILE) — infra quirk, NOT the code: pristine `main` with 778 stashed fails identically** (proven this cycle); Vercel builds normally. **NOT browser-verified** (no audio in sandbox — unverified by ear: whether the improviser audibly reflects your habits and whether the live graph reads as "watching the melody walk its own web"; setTimeout scheduling may drift under load). Resurrects the §491 ⭐ resurrect-first seed. a glowing **root creature** follows it. **Harmony engine:** WARM ♥ (3/4/8 semitones) · BRIGHT ★ (7/12/19) · SPICY ✦ (10/2/6) flavor buttons stack creatures that sing *relative to the live pitch* and continuously retune to it; tapping a flavor cycles its intervals; the tower caps at 5 voices; "↓ let go" releases the top. **Consonance vs dissonance = MOOD not gate:** spicy stacks use sawtooth + a +7-cent beating partner + shimmer LFO and the creature visibly wobbles/sparkles; consonant stacks (triangle) glow steady. **Named refs:** the **overtone series / just-intonation interval stacking** (harmony built upward from a fundamental — here the child's live voice) · the **Toca Band** "tap a character, it sings in relation to the others" model, reimagined so the bottom of the band is the child's real-time pitch. **Ambition honest 2/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [NSDF/MPM pitch detector + live-retuning interval-stack harmony engine + Canvas2D creature renderer + ambient bed] · #3 named refs; [/dream/918-kids-starlight-friend](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/918-kids-starlight-friend) — **"Starlight Friend": two 4-year-olds, each on their own iPad, share ONE magical night sky — shake your device to fling a shooting star and it lights up + chimes in your FRIEND's sky too, so you build a constellation song together.** `demoable` · Cycle 542 (kids, WIDE fire — winner of 3 orthogonal explorers). **For**: kids (4+) / **device-shake + WebRTC multi-user** input / **three.js** GPU starfield / calm-joyful indigo→violet social. **The lab's FIRST multi-user / WebRTC piece** (729/754 were adult cross-device but this is the first *kids* one, and the directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-24 #2** — "multi-user/WebRTC shared listening room, STILL 0× after being named in every single jury"). The compositional logic is **latency-tolerant social co-play, NOT pitch theory** — there is no tempo clock; stars twinkle and chime *whenever* they arrive on each device, and the reward is "we made this together." One warm C-major pentatonic so nothing two children fling can ever clash. **Input:** device **shake** (`devicemotion`, accel magnitude >18 w/ 360ms refractory) flings a warm gold/rose shooting star into the child's half of the sky; a full-screen **tap-pad fallback** drives the identical fling→bloom→chime→send pipeline (touch is deliberately the fallback, not the instrument — dodges the JURY touch-as-primary ban). iOS `DeviceMotionEvent.requestPermission()` + AudioContext both gated inside the one Start tap. **Output:** **three.js** — a shader indigo→violet backdrop (slow breathing shimmer), a 900-point GPU twinkle field, additive shooting-star + persistent placed-star pools (`powerPreference:'low-power'`, capped pixel ratio). NOT Canvas2D/SVG. **Technique:** **serverless peer-to-peer co-play** — an `RTCPeerConnection` data channel (`ordered:false, maxRetransmits:0` — drops fine, co-play is loose) carries tiny `{x,y,hue,t,vx,vy}` star-events; **both peers synthesize the chime + render the star locally** (The Hub model — the event IS the whole message, near-zero bandwidth, no shared scheduler). **Handshake has NO signaling server:** host `createOffer()` → wait ICE → **gzip the SDP via `CompressionStream('gzip')` → base64url** into a `#join=` share-link; guest auto-answers and shows a gzipped answer code; host pastes it back. WebRTC/gzip unsupported → invite UI hidden, solo is the full experience. **Robustness for the 06:30 hands-free glance:** a **ghost friend** auto-joins solo within ~800ms, flinging its OWN cooler cyan/violet stars w/ a softer chime, so one unattended phone reads as **two-player co-play, alive + sounding within ~1s** — and it bows out the instant a real channel opens (networking is purely additive). [/dream/927-depth-room](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/927-depth-room) — **"Depth Room": your webcam becomes a depth camera, and distance is the instrument — a browser ML model reads how far every pixel is, so leaning in blooms a close granular foreground and pulling back thins to a low drone; music lives in proximity, space, and motion, never in pitch.** `demoable` · Cycle 545 (adult, WIDE fire — winner of 3 orthogonal explorers). **For**: adult / immersive contemplative / **camera (webcam)** input / **WebGL2 fragment-shader** output / a softly-lit room. **The lab's FIRST depth-camera piece** — the single concept JURY has named in *every* verdict ("depth-camera STILL 0×"), always deferred for "needs a Kinect/RealSense." This dissolves that excuse: **real-time monocular depth estimation in the browser** turns an ordinary laptop cam into a per-pixel distance field with no special hardware. The compositional logic is **distance/space, NOT pitch theory** (JURY 2026-06-24 #3). **Input/technique:** `getUserMedia` → frames drawn to a 256×192 offscreen canvas → **Depth Anything V2** (`onnx-community/depth-anything-v2-small`) run on **WebGPU via Transformers.js**, loaded **at runtime from a jsDelivr CDN** (`@huggingface/transformers@3.0.0`) so **zero npm deps are added**; inference throttled to ~6fps, wrapped in try/catch. The depth map is averaged to a **16×12 grid** → features: **near-zone energy** (how much of you is CLOSE), **histogram spread**, **centroid x/y** of the nearest region, **motion-in-depth** (frame-to-frame change). **Output (audio):** a bank of **HRTF-`PannerNode`-spatialized** granular/additive voices — NEAR energy blooms bright foreground pentatonic-shimmer + opens lowpass; FAR thins to a low **drone bed** (root A1 + fifth E2); centroid-x pans L↔R; spread opens the shimmer stack; motion adds grain density + tremolo. **Pitch is held deliberately dumb** — one fixed A-minor-pentatonic + drone, nothing can clash. Master gain ≤0.3 → lowpass → compressor. **Output (visual):** a fullscreen **WebGL2 fragment shader** (`scene.ts`) samples the depth grid as an `R32F` texture — near pixels glow warm amber/rose and bloom around your nearest region, far recede to cool indigo; quiet iso-depth contour bands + drifting volumetric haze react to near-zone energy; image mirrored so it reads like a room you stand in. NOT three.js/Canvas2D/SVG. **Ambition honest 4/5** (#1 NEVER-used technique [monocular depth estimation — grep-confirmed lab-first; depth-camera 0× every jury] · #2 ≥4 subsystems [camera capture + browser ML depth model + WebGL2 depth-shader + HRTF spatial granular synth] · #3 named ref [**Depth Anything V2**, Yang et al., **NeurIPS 2024**; Transformers.js-WebGPU `webgpu-realtime-depth-estimation` demo] · #5 in-README dated RESEARCH §545 citation — **11 straight cycles** 535–545). **Source chain (visible in STATE):** RESEARCH §545 (a webcam is now a depth camera — monocular depth runs in-browser on WebGPU *now*) → JURY's standing #2 (depth-camera 0×) + #3 (music from space not pitch) → this adult **WIDE** fire. **diversity:** `banned=[mic INPUT (5×/10), three.js OUTPUT (5×/10), Canvas2D, SVG (JURY 2026-06-24)]` · `picked=[camera INPUT (1 prior/10 — under cap), WebGL2-fragment-shader OUTPUT (the scarce GPU surface, not three.js), monocular-depth→spatial-granular TECHNIQUE (space, not pitch theory), immersive contemplative adult VIBE]` — clears every ban. **Degrades first-class (always sounds + shows):** no camera/denied → animated **synthetic procedural depth field** (slow breathing radial blob) drives the same audio+shader; no WebGPU / model-load fail → same synthetic field; no WebGL2 → minimal Canvas2D depth-grid view; a hands-off auto-start kicks a silent synthetic visual within **~0.45s**; audio only after the **"Enter the room"** tap (gesture-gated AudioContext). **Privacy:** camera processed entirely on-device, **live — never recorded or uploaded** (stated in UI in emerald). [/dream/952-maqam-calligraphy](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/952-maqam-calligraphy) — **"Maqam Calligraphy": a living Arabic _taqsim_ improvises itself in EXACT microtonal cents and writes itself as a luminous ink-and-gold calligraphic line — so you can SEE the quarter-tones sit between the piano's 12-TET cracks.** `demoable` · Cycle 555 (adult, DEEP fire — winner of 2 Canvas2D approaches). **For**: adult / contemplative / **autonomous + light touch-steer** input / **Canvas2D** output / warm ink-and-gold illuminated-manuscript ritual. **The lab's FIRST non-Western melodic-modal lane** — Arabic **maqam**, distinct from the lab's prior microtonal work (538/414/404 are JI/Bohlen-Pierce _tuning-lattices_; this is the maqam _modal/ornament/improvisation_ tradition). The directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-25 #2** (make music from real PITCH/melody again) from a non-vertical direction: a single ornamented MELODIC line, no chords, no voice-leading engine. **Engine (`maqam.ts` + `sayr.ts` + `audio.ts`):** every pitch is an exact cents offset from a D tonic (`freq = 293.66*2^(cents/1200)`), quarter-tones (~150c, ~350c) **first-class, never snapped to 12-TET**. Eight **ajnas** (Rast `0/200/350/500`, Bayati `0/150/300/500`, Hijaz `0/100/400/500`, Nahawand `0/200/300/500`, Kurd `0/100/300/500`, Saba `0/150/300/400`, Ajam `0/200/400/500`, Sikah trichord `0/150/350`) compose five **maqamat** (lower jins on the tonic + upper jins on the **ghammaz** pivot). A **sayr state machine** drives a ~5.5-min **long-form, stateful** journey (qarar-low -> ascent -> ghammaz -> modulation/peak -> descent -> qarar-home), modulating to a related maqam via an adjacency map at the peak — genuinely different at minute 5 than minute 1. A **free-meter** phrase generator (no fixed bar) targets characteristic/rest tones with stepwise approach, breaths between phrases, and ornaments: **portamento** slides through the microtonal space (`setTargetAtTime`), grace notes, trills, and "leaning" on the neutral half-flats. **Synth (NO granular — jury-banned):** a plucked **oud/qanun**-like voice (triangle+saw -> fast-decay lowpass pluck + sympathetic partial) over a sustained **tanbura** drone (tonic + fifth, slow beating); master `gain <=0.26 -> lowpass -> DynamicsCompressor -> destination`. **Visual (Canvas2D — the only non-banned renderer this window):** an illuminated-manuscript field where the melody draws an **ink-and-gold brushstroke** (y = exact cents, stroke weight = emphasis, portamento = curved sweeps, grace/trill = flourishes) against a dim dashed **12-TET ghost grid** + gold **active-jins guide-lines** labeled `qarar`/`ghammaz`/`<n>c` — the literal "quarter-tones between the cracks"; modulation washes a new tint, the tanbura glows at the tonic/fifth baselines. **UX:** pick a starting maqam -> "Begin taqsim" (gesture-gates AudioContext); plays hands-free; light steering nudges the next modulation or heads home; ~0.9s auto-demo runs a silent visual if no Begin; `text-rose-300` audio-fail notice; full teardown. **Ambition honest 4/5** (#1 never-used technique [first maqam / exact-cents non-Western modal + first sayr-driven long-form self-modulating taqsim; the **sayr** concept; **AMICOR 2026** (_Language Resources and Evaluation_); **1932 Cairo Congress of Arab Music**] - #5 in-README dated **RESEARCH §555** — 20 straight cycles 535–555). #4 NOT claimed (single-cycle ship; [/dream/960-cristal-friction](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/960-cristal-friction) — **"Cristal Friction": bow a row of glowing glass/metal rods with your cursor — the singing comes from a REAL elasto-plastic stick-slip friction physical model (Helmholtz motion), not a sampled or additive emulation.** `demoable` (build-checked + Node-DSP-tested; not GPU/ear-verified) · Cycle 559 (adult, WIDE fire — winner of 3 orthogonal NON-harmony explorers). **For**: adult / **pointer-rub** input (cursor velocity = bow speed, vertical press = bow force) / raw-**WebGL2** glowing-rods shader (Canvas2D fallback) / warm-glass candle-lit ritual. **The lab's first friction EXCITER model** — prior "bowed/glass" pieces (355-kids-glass-armonica, 202-membrane-drum, 468-kids-bottle-flute) emulated the *resonator* with additive/FM; here a per-sample **elasto-plastic / LuGre bristle friction law** (stiction near zero relative velocity → Stribeck drop into slip) runs in an **AudioWorkletProcessor**, feeding friction force back into a **Chamberlin modal resonator bank**'s contact velocity to *self-sustain* the bowed oscillation. Silent at rest; locks to the rod pitch under a steady bow; breaks into whistling **wolf-tones** when bowed fast/light (a feature). Six rods just-tuned to a pentatonic+octave drone on ~D3 so any combination is consonant — the **friction TIMBRE and the embodied bowing gesture are the idea, not a harmony engine** (deliberately breaking the 7-of-10 harmony monoculture the JURY 2026-06-25 monoculture-warning pointed at). Worklet loaded as a Blob URL (no public/ file); oscillator fallback if AudioWorklet absent. **Named refs:** McIntyre, Schumacher & Woodhouse, *On the oscillations of musical instruments* (1983); the elasto-plastic bowed-string friction model (2025–26 physical-modeling revival, Frontiers in Signal Processing 2025); the **Cristal Baschet** + Franklin's **glass armonica** (1761). **RESEARCH §559** chain (today's friction-synthesis dive → today's build). **Ambition 4/5** (#1 first friction stick-slip exciter · #2 ≥3 subsystems · #3 named refs · #5 §559). Honest note: the model self-oscillates to a roughly constant limit-cycle amplitude (as a real Helmholtz-regime string does), so the loudness/brightness *envelope* is a deliberate gestural shaping layer on top of the physics; build-checked + the worklet was Node-tested for stability/self-oscillation/boundedness, but the WebGL2 shader and final sound were not rendered/heard in-container.

[/dream/997-resonant-halls](https://getresonance.vercel.app/dream/997-resonant-halls) — **"Resonant Halls": walk in FIRST PERSON through a cathedral of five harmonic rooms — each room a key on the circle of fifths with its OWN acoustics — and stepping through a doorway is a key modulation you hear in the reverb itself.** `demoable` (build-checked + lint/type clean; not GPU/ear-verified) · Cycle 577 (adult, **DEEP** fire — winner of 2 approaches: this first-person 3D vs. `996-dream-rooms` the WebGPU-compute floor-plan twin). **For**: adult / immersive contemplative / **pointer-look + WASD walk** input (co-equal; pointer-drag looks, keys walk; plus a hands-free "Take the tour" auto-walk) / hand-rolled **raymarched WebGL2 3D** output / luminous cathedral with volumetric doorway light. **The DEEP extension of the lab's spatial thread** — 977-echo-room-gpu (the only 5/5; walk among HRTF recordings of past selves) → 992-dream-house (cycle 575; La Monte Young drone field, position blooms partials but acoustics fixed) → **this**: now the room itself encodes a *key* and **the acoustics themselves are a navigable field** — the directest answer to **JURY 2026-06-27 #2** ("extend 977 into a multi-cycle spatial instrument — make it a *room*: multiple harmonic zones you physically walk between") and **#3** ("force a real GPU-compute OR 3D path" — taken via the **3D path**, first-person raymarching, not a flat 2D plot). **Engine.** Five rooms keyed **C → G → D → A → E**, each a just perfect fifth (×3/2) above the last, octave-folded into the warm felt-in-the-body low band (~65–110 Hz; master lowpass 6 kHz, never shrill). Each room sustains a continuous **just-intoned chord** (1/1, 9/8, 5/4, 3/2, 2/1, 3/1) — a drone instrument, never triggered notes, no wrong notes. **Per-room acoustics (the headline):** each room owns a **procedurally-synthesized impulse response** → its own `ConvolverNode` — a dense exponential-decay noise tail (1.1 s bright chapel → 4.6 s dark apse), a sparse size-scaled early-reflection stamp panned across the field, and a one-pole darkening pass, all from a deterministic per-room LCG (stable, hand-verifiable). So a small chapel rings short/present, a tall nave rings long/distant. **Proximity → mix:** `computeRoomWeights(cameraZ)` = normalized Gaussian wells per room centre, ramping each room's wet/dry sends with `setTargetAtTime` (no clicks); overlapping wells cross-fade doorways. **Doorway = pivot-chord modulation (the audible reward):** each key's **3/2 fifth equals the next key's 1/1 root**, so during a crossing both rooms sound and that shared partial is a **held common tone** (classic pivot) while the departing key's other tones fade and the arriving key's bloom — the change lands continuous, not a jump-cut, and you hear it dissolve from one room's reverb into the next; `computeCrossing(cameraZ)` drives the "→ modulating C → G" HUD. **Render:** hand-rolled 3D, **NO three.js** — a single full-screen fragment shader **raymarches an SDF corridor of box-rooms** (positive-inside SDF boxes unioned with overlapping z half-extents so shared walls open into doorways; interior sphere-tracing finds walls; clerestory light + volumetric doorway glow + cathedral ribs + colored distance haze in each room's accent), with a **hand-built first-person camera** (the lookAt approach from 995-kids-moon-trampoline: position + yaw/pitch → forward → `right = normalize(cross(fwd,up))`, `up = cross(right,fwd)` → ray origin/dir uniforms). Accent **hue = fifthsIndex/12** so kindred keys are kindred colors — luminous cathedral, deliberately **NOT** the engraved-manuscript/ink-on-parchment vibe the jury banned. **Ambition honest 4/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [JI drone synth + per-room procedural convolution acoustics + raymarched SDF 3D render + hand-rolled first-person camera nav = 4] · #3 named refs [La Monte Young & Marian Zazeela *Dream House* (MELA); architectural-acoustics auralization / convolution-reverb-from-IR; the circle of fifths as literal floor-plan] · #4 multi-cycle commitment [extends the 977→992 spatial thread; cycle-1 ships the walkable-rooms + per-room-acoustics spine; deepen next: doorways that interact, an operator/Tauri view, more rooms] · #5 in-README dated **RESEARCH §577** citation). **#1 NOT claimed** — both raymarching (176/206-sdf-cave, 909, 915) and `ConvolverNode` (many priors) exist in the lab; the fresh axis is *per-room acoustics that change as you walk between keyed rooms*, not over-claimed as a clean novel technique. **Source chain (visible in STATE):** RESEARCH §577 (the 2026 frontier of *precomputed/reciprocal sound-propagation fields* — acoustics-as-a-navigable-field; arXiv:2602.06937 Reciprocal Latent Fields, 2510.20602 Resounding Acoustic Fields) → JURY 2026-06-27 #2/#3 → this adult **DEEP** fire. **diversity:** `banned=[computer-keyboard/MIDI-as-primary-adult-input, Canvas2D-AND-flat-fragment-shader-ONLY (force GPU-compute or 3D), the "explainable-inverse-of-an-opaque-neural-frontier" conceptual move, engraved-manuscript/ink-on-parchment adult vibe (JURY 2026-06-27)]` · `picked=[pointer-look+WASD-walk INPUT (pointer co-equal, not keyboard-only), raymarched 3D WebGL2 OUTPUT (the sanctioned 3D escape, not a flat 2D plot), per-room-convolution-acoustics + pivot-chord-spatial-modulation TECHNIQUE (pure spatial presence, NOT a music-theory explainer), luminous-cathedral VIBE]` — clears every ban. **No API route → no `guard`** (all client-side, zero AI/network/cost surface); **Hum a note and a flower blooms *in tune with you*.** A 4-year-old hums into the mic; we detect the sung **pitch** in real time and a glowing flower grows from a bud — petals sprout by golden-angle phyllotaxis while a tone is sustained, petal/glow color tracks pitch (warm red/orange low → violet/white high) — and a soft **3-voice "ah" choir answers**, snapping the child's hum to the nearest tone of a slowly-cycling **I–vi–IV–V** in C major (real functional harmony, *not* a pentatonic "no-wrong-notes" snap). **The lab's first voice-*pitch* input** — every prior mic piece used voice as *energy* (RMS/onset/breath: 1020, 922, FFT bands); this tracks the actual fundamental and folds it into harmony, directly answering JURY 2026-06-28 #3 ("break the pointer reflex — deepen a lonely fresh input"). Pitch math lives in a **pure, framework-free `pitch.ts`** (`detectPitchHz`: RMS silence gate → normalized autocorrelation over ~70–1200 Hz → first-strong-peak-after-dip to kill octave errors → clarity gate → parabolic sub-Hz interpolation), **verified by `pitch.test.ts`** (pure TS + `console.assert`, no framework import, no top-level auto-run): detects 196/220/440/880 Hz within ~3% and returns -1 on silence — **ran live this cycle: ALL PASSED**. **MIC SAFETY:** source → `AnalyserNode` only, never to `destination` (no feedback howl); nothing recorded/sent. Always-on soft ambient pad + master limiter + click-free portamento = safe kids sound; graceful no-mic auto-demo (slow synthetic hum still blooms + sings, `text-rose-300` notice). **Implements this cycle's research dive** (RESEARCH §590: 2026 commodity-ization of fully-client-side browser pitch detection for kids/education) — the dive→build chain is visible. **Ambition 3/5** (#1 never-used-here technique [real-time voice-pitch→harmony, grep-0× on kids lane] · #2 ≥3 subsystems [mic + autocorrelation pitch detection + functional-harmony choir engine + organic render] · #5 RESEARCH §590). Love-bias: pulled by Karel's love of `158-kids-hum-paint` (hum-based kids). **No API route → no guard** (all client-side, zero network/AI); zero new npm deps. Build: authoritative winner-only `npm run build` → compile + ESLint + type-check PASS (winner folder grep-clean: 0 tsc errors, 0 eslint errors/warnings; only pre-existing `src/lib/**` warnings); static-gen blocked only by the standing container `EMFILE` fd ceiling (infra, not code — identical every cycle; Vercel deploys normally). **NOT audio/mic-verified on a real device** (no mic in container — unverified: real-voice detection robustness on a child's timbre, latency feel; the passing `pitch.test.ts` covers the detector math on synthetic sines). Winner of a kids **WIDE** 3-explorer fire; banked **`1034-kids-rain-chimes`** ⭐ RESURRECT-FIRST (tilt → WebGPU-compute droplet rain whose band-crossing readback rings a real I–vi–IV–V; committed `sim.test.ts`) + **`1032-kids-shadow-choir`** (camera luminance-silhouette → centroid-Y picks chord, coverage stacks choir voices) as IDEAS S590. Two RGBA16F FBOs (8-bit fallback) ping-pong each frame: the previous frame is re-sampled with a slight zoom + rotation + fBm warp, multiplied by a gentle decay (0.80–0.978 — never a hard buffer-flash), nudged in hue (chromatic lag so trails drift in color as they fade), then fresh content composites over it — a slow breathing fBm surface, two slightly-detuned dot lattices (moiré), and faint animated visual-snow grain. Fold-count + cell coordinate drive a **jeweled cosine palette** with **thin-film iridescence**, per-channel **chromatic aberration**, **dark grout** along domain edges, a breathing fBm domain-warp ("melting surfaces") + a traveling-wave phase, filmic tone-map. **Honest approximation (documented in README + in-app notes):** a fixed inverting circle per sector with the correct orthogonality relation — reads convincingly as negatively-curved {7,3}, not the proven exact Schwarz-triangle group. **Journey:** a single non-looping ~5-min `progress` clock ramps recursion depth / geodesic fall-speed / warp / saturation / chroma / glow through onset → come-up → **breakthrough peak (~35–60%)** → plateau → soft-landing return (never abrupt). **Always audio-visual:** a self-sufficient generative **drone** (detuned osc stack + sub-bass + opening low-pass + limiter, master 0.15, click-free fades, full teardown) plays with **zero permissions** and self-FFTs to drive the visuals; an **optional analysis-only mic** (`attachMic` → `AnalyserNode` ONLY, **never** to `destination` — no howl) maps bass→fall-speed, mids→warp, highs→iridescence, loudness→saturation. ### [1050-mycelial-grow](/dream/1050-mycelial-grow) · adult / visionary · **analysis-only mic-breath** (RMS, non-pointer) + autonomous / Canvas2D **space-colonization growing network** · cycle 598 · DEEP-winner (2026-06-29) · demoable · `state: visionary · pole: intense-warm (organic)`
**The visionary lane's FIRST warm piece and FIRST visionary state — gold mycelium that actually GROWS out of the loam-dark, branching filaments colonizing the field forever (minute 5 ≠ minute 1), each fork ringing a soft tone.** Real **Space Colonization Algorithm** (Runions/Lane/Prusinkiewicz 2007; Jason Webb's JS port) in a pure framework-free `growth.ts`: a cloud of attractors pulls a network of growth nodes — each attractor influences only its nearest node within an *attraction radius*, each influenced node steps `segmentLength` along the averaged (jittered) direction to its attractors and spawns a child, attractors within the *kill radius* are consumed, and **branching emerges naturally** when a node is pulled in divergent directions (reported as a *fork* event). **Long-form / evolving (the point):** fresh attractor clouds **reseed in slow ~5.5 s waves** into new regions so the network keeps colonizing NEW territory; a per-frame field fade dims the oldest filaments and a `maxNodes` ring-buffer recycles the oldest non-root slots, so it accumulates and runs **indefinitely** — genuinely different at minute 5 than minute 1 (a category the lab is thin on). **Look:** dark loam (`#0a0705`), filaments drawn with additive (`"lighter"`) compositing — growing **tips glow brightest**, older/inner branches thicken with depth and dim toward rust/ochre/brown; **Strike a still pond of light and play the expanding ripples — warped through your own visual cortex's log-polar map into breathing tunnels, spirals and honeycombs, each ring ringing a consonant bell.** This fire's headline is actually the **`_shared/visionary/` infrastructure extraction** the JURY called ~7 fires overdue (#3): two new tested engines — **`_shared/visionary/logpolar.ts`** (the load-bearing form-constant / log-polar warp: `LOGPOLAR_GLSL` GLSL string + JS twins `screenToCortex`/`cortexToScreen`/`formConstant`/`honeycomb`/`FORM_PHI`, round-trip-exact, verified by `logpolar.test.ts`) and **`_shared/visionary/safeFlicker.ts`** (the photosensitive-safe flicker gate: OFF by default, hard-clamped ≤3 Hz, soft-sine floor never a hard strobe, instant `kill()`, honors `prefers-reduced-motion`) — so the lane finally **composes** the warp instead of re-deriving it a fourth time (it was re-derived in 1038/1042/1044). 1053 is the first consumer AND brings **WebGPU compute back as the resonating body** (JURY #4 — compute had collapsed to 2×, both dead Echo-Halls pieces). **The instrument:** a real 2D damped wave-equation `u_next=(2·u_curr−u_prev)+c²∇²u_curr` then ×damping, on a **WebGPU compute** path (WGSL: ping-ponged `prev`/`curr`/`next` storage buffers, a `splat` compute pass injecting gaussian impulses on each strike, a `render` compute pass warping screen pixels through the log-polar map + form constant → storage texture → blit) with a **mandatory Canvas2D fallback** (the identical model on a smaller CPU grid in `wave.ts`, using the JS twins — auto-selected when `navigator.gpu` is absent/fails, `text-amber-300/95` notice) so it's a fully playable instrument on any device. **Played, not watched:** the field rests dark (faint indigo glow + quiet sub-drone); **tap to strike one ripple, drag to draw a line of strikes**; Form selector (tunnels/spirals/honeycomb), Decay (ring sustain), Strike strength, Bells (2–7 listener probes on a golden-angle spiral), and an opt-in Shimmer (the safe-flicker path) + instant Kill. **Audio (Web Audio):** each probe samples local wave energy; a ripple cresting under it rings a short **inharmonic additive bell** in a just-intonation pentatonic set through a generated convolver reverb; a soft sub-octave drone underneath (idle ≈ near silence). A tiny CPU "mirror" wave drives the probes in both paths, avoiding a per-frame GPU readback stall. **Named refs:** Bressloff–Cowan–Golubitsky–Thomas–Wiener (2001) retina→V1 complex-log map (the engine in `logpolar.ts`); Heinrich Klüver's four form constants (the selectable Form modes). **Ambition 3/5** (#2 ≥3 subsystems [WebGPU-compute wave body + log-polar warp render + JI bell/drone audio + touch-strike instrument = 4] · #3 named references · #5 RESEARCH §601 [WebGPU compute production-ready across browsers incl. Safari 26; the compose-the-infra finding]; #1 NOT claimed — log-polar is lab-prior [1038/1042/1044], the fresh axis is *consolidation into shared tested infra* + the compose payoff + a played wave-strike relationship). **diversity:** `banned=[passive-mic-analysis-as-primary-input, full-screen-WebGL2-fragment-shader-you-stare-at OUTPUT, auto-playing-screensaver relationship] · picked=[touch-strike INPUT (played, active), WebGPU-compute wave-field OUTPUT (not a WebGL2 fragment shader you watch — brings compute back), wave-equation-as-resonating-body × log-polar-form-constant-warp TECHNIQUE, cosmic-ambient meditative VIBE played-not-watched]` — clears all three JURY bans and rebalances the pole to cosmic-ambient. **SAFETY (photosensitive-epilepsy):** non-strobing by default — slow luminance drift only; the only flicker path is the ≤3 Hz opt-in safe-flicker engine with instant kill. **No API route → no guard** (pure client; zero new npm deps; no AI/cost/network surface). Winner of an adult visionary **DEEP** 2-approach fire (one concept — "play a form-constant field into being" — via two substrates); banked **`1054-cortex-paint`** ⭐ RESURRECT (the de-selected sibling — paint plane-wave stripes directly in cortical space, WebGL2 stroke-driven field, optional Welcome Home file-carrier; built complete + tsc/eslint-clean, removed unbuilt) as IDEAS §601. ### [1200-gait-loom](/dream/1200-gait-loom) · adult / altered-states · **camera body-skeleton / gait — MediaPipe Pose, 33 landmarks (active, embodied, locomotion-based)** / Canvas2D radial gait-loom (rotating step-clock, footfall bursts, woven limb-threads, faint skeleton) · cycle 670 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-05) · demoable · `state: rhythmic-trance / movement-entrainment · pole: embodied-kinetic`
**Your GAIT is the sequencer's transport — step (or step-in-place) and your cadence locks a BPM; each footfall and limb-swing fires a granular percussion hit quantized to that gait clock, weaving a loom that accretes as you move and unravels to silence when you stop.** The lab's answer to the 2026-07-05 jury's un-cashed provocation #4 ("go structural — the body's actual geometry, joints, limbs, presence in a room, as the instrument; **gait→tempo is still 0×**"). MediaPipe **PoseLandmarker** (`pose_landmarker_lite`, VIDEO mode, CDN runtime dynamic-import — zero new npm deps, mirroring the proven 1185/677 pattern) yields 33 landmarks/frame; a per-foot **lift→plant state machine** (`gait.ts`, ankle-height normalized by torso length = scale-invariant) detects footfalls, and the inter-footfall interval is median+EMA-smoothed into a **BPM** (clamped ~60–160). Wrist **velocity peaks** fire limb-swings between beats; strong knee-lifts add mid accents. **VOICE = granular synthesis** (`grains.ts`, Curtis Roads *Microsound* 2001): at load it synthesizes two source buffers with **no external assets** (a filtered-noise burst + a decaying resonator ping); every hit granulates them — footfalls read the low resonator (rate≈0.5) as kick-like thuds, wrists spray bright noise grains (rate≈2–2.5) — Hann-windowed, pitched/panned per limb, hard grain cap, behind a compressor + short feedback delay. A 16-step ring spins at the gait BPM via **look-ahead scheduling** against `audioContext.currentTime`; incoming hits **quantize into the ring** and each cycle replays the deposited grains (the *loom weaves*); slot lives + master gain decay when you stop (the *unravel*). **Deliberately NOT a just-intonation choir/pad/drone** (the jury's banned voice, 6× in the window) and **NOT bright-daylight** — Canvas2D radial gait-clock in **chromatic chiaroscuro** (ember/amber footfalls + teal/emerald limb-threads on deep graphite), sweeping playhead locked to the BPM, woven quadratic threads between limb events, faint mirrored skeleton, centre readout of live BPM/cadence/lock. **Ambition 2/5** (honestly: #1 **NOT** claimed — PoseLandmarker is lab-common [677/582/710/803/811/869…], only 0× in the recent-15 window; #2 ≥3 subsystems [Pose inference + gait state-machine + granular sequencer + Canvas2D loom = 4]; #3 named refs [Curtis Roads *Microsound* 2001; Myron Krueger *Videoplace* 1974–75; the "Sonified Body" skeletal-movement→OSC practice]). **diversity:** `banned=[bright-daylight palette · Canvas2D-bright output · JI-choir/drone voice · passive/no-gesture input] · picked=[body-skeleton/gait INPUT (active, 0× in window) · Canvas2D radial loom on graphite chiaroscuro OUTPUT (not bright) · granular VOICE (not JI) · ember+teal chromatic VIBE]` — clears all four. The freshest angle vs the ~10 existing body pieces: **gait→tempo** (0× even *within* embodiment) + a **rhythmic-transport form** unlike 803-body-chimes (modal) / 811-body-ribbons (UPIC) / 869-spatial-grove (spatial walk). **Graceful fallback (always sound + visuals):** camera denied / model down / no WebGL → reason in `text-rose-300` + **limb pads** (L/R foot thuds, L/R wrist sprays) + a **tap-tempo** button + **spacebar** step, all driving the *same* gait clock + granular engine. **SAFETY:** rhythmic visual bursts but no full-field flash >3 Hz; luminance drift slow; no strobe. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure client, no prod API, zero network/cost surface). **Validation:** authoritative winner-only gate → `next lint --dir 1200-gait-loom` **✔ 0 warnings/0 errors** + `tsc --noEmit` project-wide **0 errors**; full `npm run build` static-gen blocked only by the standing container **`EMFILE`** fd ceiling (4096 hard cap; infra not code — Vercel deploys normally). **NOT camera/ear-verified** (headless container — the gait thresholds, grain balance, and tempo-lock feel want Karel's webcam + speakers; fallback guarantees it's never blank/silent). Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-voice structural-embodiment fire; banked **`1198-limbline`** ⭐ (per-limb **Karplus-Strong** plucked-string body — each bone a waveguide, joint velocity plucks, limb extension→pitch; glowing filaments with travelling pulses) + **`1199-resonant-room`** (body joints excite a 128×128 **FDTD wave-membrane** → inharmonic Bessel-mode plate bank; dropped at curate as closest to shipped 803-body-chimes) as IDEAS §670.
