### [1226-loom](/dream/1226-loom) · adult · **pointer-pluck + keyboard (active, gestural)** / three.js **3D deforming ring** (teal→magenta jewel, gold scan-cursor + pluck-flares) · cycle 679 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-06) · demoable · `state: playable-physical-instrument · pole: warm/tactile`
**Pluck a glowing ring and hear its shape — the vibrating surface IS the waveform you're listening to.** The lab's cleanest cash of **scanned synthesis** (Verplank, Mathews & Shaw, "Scanned Synthesis," ICMC 2000) and the literal implementation of this fire's research dive (§679 #1: the differentiable-string frontier where *the moving physical object and its sound are one state*). A closed ring of **N=128 masses** is simulated as a 1D **circular mass-spring string** (`ring.ts` — discrete-Laplacian neighbour springs + weak centering + damping, semi-implicit/symplectic Euler at the SLOW **haptic** rate, so the wave visibly sloshes around the loop over seconds, not at audio rate). The instantaneous array of 128 displacements **is a single-cycle wavetable**: an `AudioWorkletProcessor` (`worklet-src.ts`, Blob-URL `addModule` — the repo's 475-style idiom) holds that live table and gives each voice a phase accumulator scanning the loop at the note's pitch (interpolated lookup), and the main thread pushes the live shape every frame — so **the timbre morphs continuously as the ring wobbles**. A **pluck** (pointer press/drag on the ring, or `a s d f g h j k` / on-screen buttons in **D Dorian**) injects a gaussian bump of displacement+velocity and triggers a voice — one gesture changes both what you see and what you hear. Rendered in **three.js 3D** (`renderer.ts`): a glowing **teal→magenta** LineLoop + additive halo Points sharing one live geometry, a **gold scan-cursor** orbiting the read position, gold pluck-flares, gentle auto-rotation over a jewel CSS gradient. **Deliberately NOT** the jury-banned combos: not bright-daylight (deep jewel), not Canvas2D-bright (three.js 3D), not a JI choir/drone (a *scanned-wavetable* voice — grep-fresh vs the recently-shipped modal/Karplus–Strong[1220]/granular[1225]), not passive input (you pluck it), not a 2D full-screen field (a 3D object), not chromatic-chiaroscuro. **Never blank/silent:** breathing standing-wave on mount + idle **auto-pluck** after Begin, so it plays itself for the cold 06:30 glance. **Graceful fallback:** no WebGL → `text-rose-300` notice; no `AudioWorklet` → a silent-degrading **16-harmonic-DFT additive** oscillator-bank resynth of the live shape. **Ambition 3/5** (**#2** four subsystems: mass-spring sim + scanned-wavetable worklet [+ additive fallback] + three.js ring/cursor/flare renderer + pluck/keyboard input; **#3** named ref Verplank/Mathews/Shaw ICMC 2000 + Max Mathews; **#5** §679 dive #1 "object-is-waveform," dated today. #1 NOT claimed — scan-adjacent 474 exists; the fresh axis is a real 1D-mass-spring scanned voice, not a lab-first technique). **diversity:** `banned=[bright-daylight PALETTE · Canvas2D-bright OUTPUT · 2D-full-screen-field OUTPUT · JI-choir/drone VOICE · modal/Karplus–Strong/granular VOICE(recent) · passive INPUT · chromatic-chiaroscuro PALETTE] · picked=[active pointer-pluck+keyboard INPUT · three.js-3D deforming-ring OUTPUT · scanned-synthesis-wavetable VOICE · teal→magenta jewel PALETTE]` — clears all bans. **SAFETY:** no strobe — pluck flares fade smoothly, ring luminance drifts well under 3 Hz. Audio gesture-gated (Begin resumes the ctx); per-voice envelope (in-worklet) → master GainNode (ramp from 0) → **DynamicsCompressor** limiter; 12-voice cap + voice-steal; full teardown (cancel rAF, disconnect/close audio, dispose three geometries/materials/renderer, revoke Blob URLs). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure client; `three` is an existing project dep, zero new npm deps; no prod-API/cost/network surface). **Validation:** authoritative winner-only `npm run build` → **Compiled + full ESLint + type-check PASS** (only pre-existing `src/lib/**` warnings, **ZERO from the 1226 folder**), winner `.next/server/app/dream/1226-loom/page.js` **compiled ✓ (34 KB)**; static-gen blocked only by the standing container **`EMFILE`** 4096-fd ceiling (`next-font-manifest.json`; infra not code — Vercel deploys normally); belt-and-suspenders `npx eslint src/app/dream/1226-loom/` = **exit 0**, build-log grep for `Failed to compile`/`Type error`/`Module not found` = none. **NOT ear-verified** (headless, no speakers — the scan-morph timbre + pluck feel + worklet-vs-additive path want Karel's browser; breathing + idle auto-pluck guarantee it's never blank/silent). Winner of an adult **WIDE** 3-fresh-voice fire; banked **`1227-operators`** (Chowning/DX FM operator-galaxy you sculpt in 3D) + **`1228-reed`** (McIntyre–Schumacher–Woodhouse nonlinear self-oscillating wind waveguide, breathe to overblow) as IDEAS §679. **Your two hands are grain-heads moving through a cloud of sound — reach wide to scatter it, lift a hand to raise its pitch, and your body's place in the room pans it in true stereo space.** The lab's **first true stereo-spatialized granular cloud driven by body position** — the one genuinely un-built axis in the well-mined body-as-instrument lane (803/869/1068/1200 all precede it), and the direct cash of JURY 2026-07-05 provocation #4's specific "**depth-camera spatial audio** still 0×". MediaPipe **PoseLandmarker** (`pose_landmarker_lite`, VIDEO mode, jsDelivr CDN runtime dynamic-import via `webpackIgnore` — zero new npm deps, mirroring the proven 1185/677 pattern, GPU→CPU delegate retry) tracks the two **wrists** + **torso** (shoulders/hips) into a compact `PoseFrame`. Two granular grain-heads (`audio.ts`, Curtis Roads *Microsound* 2001): every grain is a short (~60–140 ms) Hann/triangular-windowed slice of an **in-engine synthesized FM wavetable** (no external asset), pitch-shifted click-free. **Mappings:** hand **height** → grain playback-rate (~0.47×–2.14×) + per-head lowpass cutoff (raise a hand → higher & brighter); **reach between the hands** → grain density / stereo spread (wide = dense wide scatter, together = focused low-density point-source); **torso horizontal centre** → whole-cloud panorama, **lean** → a slow global filter sweep. Each head is hard-panned to its side through an equal-power **StereoPanner** — **spatial audio is the distinguishing voice** (grep-first as a body-driven grain cloud; 1200-gait-loom used granular but as a rhythmic Canvas2D *sequencer*, no spatialization, no 3D field, no continuous scrub). Every grain that fires lights an **amber spark** in a three.js **point-cloud grain-field receding in depth** (teal near → violet far); the two hands are **bright amber attractors** moving through it. **Deliberately NOT** the jury-banned combos: not bright-daylight (deep nebular), not Canvas2D-bright (three.js 3D), not a JI choir/drone (granular), not passive input (the whole body is the instrument), not a flat 2D full-screen field (3D depth cloud). **Graceful fallback (always sound + visuals):** camera denied / model down / no WebGL → `text-rose-300` notice + **two draggable hand-pucks** (mouse/touch) driving the identical engine, with a gentle **auto-drift** so both hands wander and the cloud plays itself for the cold 06:30 glance — never a dead screen. **Ambition 2/5** (honestly: **#1 NOT claimed** — PoseLandmarker is lab-common [677/803/869/1068/1200…], only the *spatial-granular voice* is fresh, not the input; **#2 ≥3 subsystems** [Pose inference + hand/torso kinematics + granular engine + StereoPanner spatializer + three.js point-cloud renderer + fallback = six]; **#3 named refs** [BlazePose — Bazarevsky, Grishchenko et al., Google 2020; Curtis Roads *Microsound*, MIT Press 2001]). **diversity:** `banned=[bright-daylight PALETTE · Canvas2D-bright OUTPUT · JI-choir/drone VOICE · passive INPUT · 2D-full-screen-field OUTPUT · modal/Karplus–Strong VOICE(recent)] · picked=[active full-body camera-pose INPUT · three.js-3D point-cloud OUTPUT · granular+true-stereo-spatialization VOICE · teal→violet nebular + amber PALETTE]` — clears all bans. **SAFETY (photosensitive-epilepsy):** no strobe — grain sparks are local point brightenings with smooth per-frame decay (×0.9), hand-attractor glow is low-passed, no full-field flash; luminance change well under 3 Hz. ### [1392-phase-loom](/dream/1392-phase-loom) · adult / altered-states · **Web MIDI + on-screen keyboard (active, played)** / three.js **3D orbiting phase-rings** (violet→emerald→amber, conjunction filaments + slow core swell) · cycle 725 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-10) · demoable · `state: hypnotic-minimalist · pole: hypnotic`
**Hold notes and each becomes a loop at its OWN period — the loops drift Reich-style in and out of phase, weaving evolving polymetric music with NO drum grid.** The lab's cash of the 2026-07-09 jury's provocation **#2** — "don't let the look-ahead groove machine become the new bell; if you want TIME, find it somewhere other than a drum grid (polymetric phasing, a swung loop)." Every note you activate (MIDI note-on, one of 10 on-screen pads, or `A S D F G H J K L ;`) spawns a short **just-intonation pentatonic cell** (3–6 steps, ratios 1, 9/8, 5/4, 3/2, 5/3 over two octaves transposed to that root). **Each loop has its own period** — cell **length** varies (3–6 → immediate polymeter) and each pitch gets a tiny **±~2.7% tempo drift** — so no two loops ever share a grid; over ~10–60 s any pair slides from unison through the full cycle of offsets and back (Steve Reich *Piano Phase* / Terry Riley *In C*, cited honestly). A 25 ms look-ahead is used **purely for Web Audio timing accuracy** (each voice carries its own `nextTime`/`stepDur`, scheduled independently) — a clock, **not** a 120-BPM 4/4 step-sequencer, so it cleanly dodges the banned look-ahead-drum-groove. An underlying JI pad comes from the shared `_shared/visionary/droneBank.ts`. **Visual (three.js — the fresh substrate):** each active loop is a tilted orbital **ring** with a glowing mote circling once per loop period; rings at different periods orbit at different rates, so you literally SEE the phasing — when two motes reach the same angle (a conjunction = loops in phase) a **filament lights** between them and the central **core swells**, fading as they drift apart. The swell tracks the very slow beat frequency (luminance change far below 3 Hz — no strobe). **Input:** Web MIDI requested on Begin; a `● MIDI` (emerald) / `○ on-screen keys` (amber) badge shows the live path; the on-screen pads + keyboard drive the identical `toggleSlot` path when no device is present — both work. **Never blank/silent:** Begin seeds two contrasting loops so the phasing is instantly audible + visible; "Nudge a loop" re-phases; "Clear" stops all. **Ambition 3/5:** **#2** four subsystems (phasing-loop engine + JI voice pool + shared droneBank pad + three.js orbit-ring renderer + MIDI/keyboard input) · **#3** named refs Reich *Piano Phase* (1967)/*Music for 18* (1976), Riley *In C* (1964) · provocation-#2 cash. **#1 NOT claimed** — phasing/minimalism is well-established; the fresh axis is the *framing+substrate*: MIDI-played autonomous per-note loops finding TIME via phasing instead of the step-sequencer grid, on a three.js surface that makes the interference beat visible. **diversity:** `banned=[Canvas2D-primary · look-ahead-drum-groove · granular-freeze-of-real-recording · pointer-SOLE-input] · avoid=[SVG-primary · mic] · picked=[Web-MIDI+keyboard INPUT · three.js-3D-orbit-ring OUTPUT · polymetric-phasing TECHNIQUE · violet→emerald→amber hypnotic PALETTE]` — clears every 2026-07-09 ban, dodges at-line SVG + over-repped mic. **SAFETY:** no strobe — conjunction bloom is a slow sub-3-Hz core swell; `prefers-reduced-motion` drops auto-rotation + gentles the swell. ### [1530-hyperbolic-organ](/dream/1530-hyperbolic-organ) · adult / visionary · **keyboard-played (`WASD`/arrows translate + `Q/E` spin — NOT pointer, NOT mic)** / **pure SVG vector tiles (no canvas/WebGL/three.js)** · cycle 752 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-12) · demoable · `state: visionary state-hyperbolic / Klüver-lattice · pole: intense/kinetic (geometric, rests the void)`
**Play a negatively-curved universe — an Escher Circle-Limit {8,3} tiling in the Poincaré disk that you translate and spin with the keys, each hyperbolic move ringing one just-intonation interval and shifting the drone.** The lab's cleanest answer to the standing 2026-07-12 jury's provocation #1 (three.js is the new mouse-drag, 5/15; GPU-render-primary ~10/15 — *"next cycle's primary surface must NOT be a hand-authored GPU render"*): the tiling is real `<path>` elements created with `document.createElementNS`, updated **imperatively** every frame (never via React state) — **pure SVG vector tiles, the freshest off-GPU-render surface in the lab** (neither three.js, WebGL2, nor canvas). One central regular octagon (`cosh R = cot(π/p)·cot(π/q)` → `r = tanh(R/2)`) is grown breadth-first by a **Fuchsian reflection group** — each geodesic edge an arc of a circle orthogonal to the boundary, reflection across it a circle inversion — capped at `MAX_TILES=130` and pruned near the rim. The "camera" is a Möbius isometry `V ∈ SU(1,1)`; each frame composes `V` with a small translation+rotation from a decaying key-velocity and re-normalises onto SU(1,1), pushing every tile vertex through `V` and drawing each curved edge as a 5-sample geodesic polyline. **See = hear:** each movement key walks a **just-intonation pitch lattice** (running ratio ×= that key's interval — 3:2, 4:3, 5:4, 6:5, 9:8, 5:3 — folded into one octave), retuning a quiet drone bed and striking one inharmonic FM bell — so **moving through hyperbolic space IS moving through a lattice of pure ratios** (Tonnetz made literal). **Played, not watched:** keyboard is the only instrument (`W/A/S/D`/arrows translate, `Q/E` spin); before you act the disk drifts on a silent idle auto-pan, and Play unlocks the drone + keys (never blank/silent). **Named refs (README):** M.C. ### [1524-droste-descent](/dream/1524-droste-descent) · adult / visionary · **pointer-joystick + keyboard (drag/`WASD`/arrows dive-climb-twist + `Space` surge — NOT pointer-sole, NOT mic/camera)** / **pure DOM + CSS-3D nested frames (no canvas/WebGL/three.js)** · cycle 751 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-12) · demoable · `state: infinite-regress / Droste-tunnel · pole: ecstatic-plunge (kinetic, rests the void)`
**Hold infinite regress in your hands and steer it — plunge, climb, and twist through an endlessly self-nesting Droste tunnel where every level you fall through is felt as one octave of a falling Shepard tone.** The lab's first **discrete Droste / mise-en-abyme instrument** (`droste`/`mise-en-abyme` grep-**0×** across the full lab — distinct from the 12× continuous fractal-zoom shaders and 17× kaleidoscopes), built entirely from **13 real nested `<div>` frames under a single CSS `perspective`** (the jury's starving 1× off-GPU surface — the browser compositor, deliberately NOT a hand-authored GPU render, after three.js hit 5/15 and GPU-render-primary ~10/15). A continuous `travel` value places each frame at level `((k−travel) mod N)` in Z; frames that pass the camera wrap to the far plane and fade in, so a finite stack reads as an **endless** self-nesting tunnel (the treadmill trick); per-level `rotateZ` gestures the de Smit/Lenstra Droste spiral. **See = hear:** descent velocity (levels/sec) drives the shared `_shared/visionary/shepard.ts` Shepard–Risset engine's glide rate (octaves/sec), with two engines (`dir −1` fall / `+1` climb) crossfaded by velocity sign for bidirectional glide, so pitch falls exactly as fast as the eye descends; each integer level crossing rings a just-intonation bell marking the octave. **Played, not watched:** pointer joystick (vertical = dive/climb, horizontal = twist) + `W/S/A/D`/arrows + `Space` surge, with inertia; release → a slow idle auto-drift (kinetic at rest, never blank/silent). A JI `startDroneBank` bed opens with intensity; `createVoidReverb` supplies the cavern. **Named refs (README):** M.C. Escher *Print Gallery* (1956), the Droste effect (1904), de Smit & Lenstra *The Mathematical Structure of Escher's Print Gallery* (2003), Shepard (1964) / Risset endless glissando, Klüver's tunnel/funnel form-constant. **Ambition — honest 4/5:** **#1-soft** (discrete-Droste-recursion concept grep-0×; declared honestly — DOM/CSS-3D + Shepard are each individually used, the fresh axis is discrete mise-en-abyme recursion as a PLAYED instrument welded 1:1 to the Shepard octave) + **#2** ≥5 subsystems (recursive DOM/CSS-3D renderer + played descent/twist drive + dual Shepard engines + droneBank pad + JI bell voice) + **#3** named refs above + **#5-soft** (§751 Ganzflicker/form-constant dive — conceptual trigger, NOT <14-day, logged). **diversity:** `banned=[three.js-scene-graph(5×) · GPU-render-primary(~10/15) · log-polar-breathing-field(1506→1516) · pointer-drag-SOLE(4×)] · picked=[DOM/CSS-3D nested-frames OUTPUT (starving 1×) · pointer+keyboard+surge INPUT · discrete-Droste-recursion TECHNIQUE (0×) · Shepard-welded-1:1 AUDIO · ecstatic-plunge PALETTE · PLAYED]` — clears every live 2026-07-12 ban. **SAFETY:** no strobe — only smooth transform motion + slow hue drift; `prefers-reduced-motion` slows drift + caps descent rate. Audio gesture-gated ("Begin the descent" creates the ctx), master ramps 0→≤0.18 through a **DynamicsCompressor** limiter, capped/oldest-stolen bell polyphony, full teardown on unmount. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure client; no server/secret/network; zero new npm deps — DOM/CSS + Web Audio only). **Validation:** normalizer 0 rewrites; `eslint … --max-warnings 0` = **0**; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` → build OK, `page.js` (31.5 kB) + `"/dream/1524-droste-descent"` in `routes-manifest.json`; `tsc --noEmit` = 0 dream errors. **NOT eye/ear-verified for feel** (headless): frame-count legibility, twist-vs-spin threshold, and the Shepard descent mix want Karel's browser — README documents the knobs; the idle auto-drift + depth HUD guarantee it's never blank, and 13 deterministic DOM frames render identically anywhere (phone-safe). Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-approach "INFINITE REGRESS" fire; banked **⭐⭐ `1526-cell-recursion`** (dive INTO a honeycomb eye-cell, its inner copy of the whole lattice becomes your world — Sierpiński/Menger DOM carpet; the most distinctive interaction, resurrect after verifying the level-4 ~7k-cell tree in-browser) + **⭐ `1528-mirror-well`** (receding-selves mirror corridor) as IDEAS §751. ### [1536-codec-melt](/dream/1536-codec-melt) · adult / visionary · **keyboard-played (`A–K` piano row; hammer to melt — NOT pointer, NOT mic/camera)** / **Canvas2D + WebCodecs (`VideoEncoder`/`VideoDecoder`, VP8) — the lab's FIRST-EVER WebCodecs piece** · cycle 753 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-12) · demoable · `state: visionary-tracer / datamosh-melt · pole: intense/kinetic (a played melt that heals — rests the void)`
**Play the melt of a dying video codec.** A drifting Canvas2D field of violet blobs is fed frame-by-frame into a **real hardware `VideoEncoder`** (VP8) pinned at a deliberately *starved* 55 kbps, decoded straight back with `VideoDecoder`, and upscaled nearest-neighbour so the codec's own compression artifacts — blooming DCT macroblocks, colour-banded slabs — **are the render substrate itself.** Datamosh as an instrument. This is the **lab's first-ever use of the WebCodecs API** — the genuine grep-0× never-used technique (`VideoEncoder`/`VideoDecoder`/`EncodedVideoChunk` appear in **0** other files across the 1500-deep lab; the criterion five juries named as the wall to the first 5/5, honestly cleared at last). Every key is at once a **synth voice** and a **burst of visual motion** — a bright high-contrast comet flung across the source scene; because motion is exactly what a starved codec cannot encode, that comet detonates the macroblocks around it, and the picture heals as the note decays. **The key engineering insight** (documented in README): WebCodecs has no per-`encode` bitrate parameter and the only runtime bitrate change, `encoder.configure()`, forces a keyframe = an instant full-frame *heal* that fights the melt — so instead the encoder is **pinned at fixed 55 kbps** and melt depth drives injected **motion** (bigger/faster/brighter comets the low bitrate's P-frames can't track), achieving "starve toward the floor" without the keyframe-heal side effect; keyframes are requested only to heal when calm (melt < 0.08) or a 5 s safety cap. This is the **most render-robust of three codec-manipulation approaches** built in the DEEP fire (no reconfigure churn, standard WebCodecs usage, small 384×216 source so 16px macroblocks read as big chunky slabs). **See = hear weld:** attack/hammering → melt depth → comet size+speed+brightness (how hard the codec blooms) *and* synth filter cutoff + release + drone drive (louder/brighter voice); pitch → comet launch angle (golden-angle) + iridescent-violet hue (where the codec smears + what colour). **Audio:** gesture-gated `AudioContext`; detuned saw+tri voices → lowpass ADSR + shared `droneBank` just-intonation bed; master `GainNode` **0.18** → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination; polyphony ≤14 (oldest stolen), gains ramped (no clicks). **Never blank/silent:** idle ~2.5 s → seeded sequencer walks a slow phrase (melts + sings on its own at Karel's 06:30 glance); real keys take over instantly. **Fallback (WebCodecs absent / config unsupported / mid-stream throw):** hand-rolled Canvas2D **feedback datamosh** — the same tracer ping-pong (prev frame zoom+rotate+hue-nudge+decay) with raw source composited over — still plays, melts, sounds, under a `text-destructive` note. **Named refs (README):** Takeshi Murata *Monster Movie* (2005, canonical datamosh); Rosa Menkman *The Glitch Moment(um)*; Nino Filiu *SuperMosh* (real-time datamosh via WebCodecs — direct technical lineage); Sven König *aPpRoPiRaTe!*; visionary positive-afterimage "tracer" phenomenology. **Ambition — honest 3/5 (the lab's genuine crack at the #1 wall):** **#1** WebCodecs = **grep-0× never-used-in-the-lab technique** (verified across the full lab; MIDI is 36×, hand-tracking 20× — both falsely flagged 0× by prior juries; WebCodecs actually survives the grep) · **#2** ≥3 subsystems (played-input engine + Canvas2D source-scene renderer + WebCodecs encode/decode datamosh pipeline + Web Audio synth+drone = 4) · **#3** named refs above. **#5 NOT claimed** (§753 dive is a technique-novelty finding, not a <14-day paper — WebCodecs/SuperMosh predate the window; logged straight, consistent with §750/§751/§752). **diversity:** `banned=[three.js-scene-graph-primary(5×) · GPU-render-primary(~10/15) · cortical-traveling-wave/log-polar-breathing-field(1506→1516) · pointer/touch-drag-SOLE(4×)] · picked=[keyboard INPUT (not pointer-sole, not warm mic/camera) · Canvas2D + WebCodecs OUTPUT (a genuinely new 0× render substrate — NOT a hand-authored GPU render, NOT three.js/WebGL2/SVG) · codec-datamosh TECHNIQUE (grep-0×) · iridescent-violet visionary-tracer PALETTE · pole intense/kinetic (a played melt that heals — rests the void, not a watched breathing-field)]` — clears every live 2026-07-12 hard ban. **SAFETY:** no strobe — melt is a smoothly-eased scalar (τ≈0.85 s) modulating comet motion + trail persistence, never a per-frame full-screen luminance flip; all transitions ease well beyond 150 ms, nothing in the 3–30 Hz danger band; `prefersReducedMotion()` caps comet speed/melt, slows idle tempo, lengthens the heal. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D + WebCodecs; no server/network/secret; zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites; `eslint src/app/dream/1536-codec-melt --max-warnings 0` = **0**; `tsc --noEmit` = **0** errors in 1536; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0** (plain `npm run build` compiles+lints+typechecks clean but dies at "Collecting page data" on the standing ~700-route **EMFILE** fd-ceiling — infra, absent on Vercel). **NOT eye/ear-verified for feel** (headless container — no browser: WebCodecs `VideoEncoder`/`VideoDecoder` globals are absent under `chrome-headless-shell`, so only the software fallback path can run here; the real codec path, the felt melt-controllability, macroblock legibility, and loudness balance want Karel's Chrome — the idle demo + deterministic scene guarantee it's never blank/silent). Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-approach fire (one concept — *datamosh as a played visionary instrument* — via three codec mechanics); banked **⭐⭐ `1538-mosh-bloom`** (TOP ship-next — the authentic Murata keyframe-drop P-frame smear you hold, `Space` = "I-frame bloom" clarity-snap; de-selected only on its non-standard re-fed-delta amplifier reading "more as melt than block-drag mosh on some engines" per its own knock — verify true P-frame-drag in real Chromium first) + **⭐ `1540-ghost-delay`** (WebCodecs decode-delay ring buffer → additive codec-ghost tracer-trails, pitch→depth+audio-delay, intensity→bitrate-crush; Bill Viola time-delay lineage; de-selected on leaning into the drift/tracer register the jury asked to REST this cycle + per-intensity encoder-reconfigure churn 1536 avoids) → IDEAS §753. ### [1548-ink-bloom](/dream/1548-ink-bloom) · adult / visionary · **mic-breath-played (voice/breath RMS drives drops+boil; pointer-stir secondary — NOT keyboard, NOT camera, NOT pointer-sole)** / **CSS Houdini Paint Worklet (`paintWorklet`/`registerProperty`) — the lab's FIRST-EVER Houdini piece, Canvas2D fallback identical** · cycle 755 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-13) · demoable · `state: hypnagogic ink-drift / suminagashi · pole: cosmic-ambient ↔ intense`
**Breathe onto a black pool and watch drops of ink bloom into interlocking suminagashi rings you can hear — painted natively by the browser's compositor.** The lab's **first-ever use of the CSS Houdini Paint API** — the genuine grep-0× never-used render substrate (`paintWorklet`/`registerPaint`/`registerProperty` appear in **0** other files across the 1500-deep lab; the #1 "never-used technique" criterion, honestly cleared — and uniquely, it renders on the **CSS compositor, NOT a hand-authored GPU render**, so it cleanly dodges the standing three.js/WebGL2 GPU-render-primary ban). Ink is dropped onto a still pool and — as in real **suminagashi** (Japanese floating-ink marbling) — every new drop pushes all earlier rings radially outward by the exact non-overlap transform `C + (P−C)·√(1 + d²/|P−C|²)` (a point at distance `r` moves to `√(r²+d²)`), so the field settles into nested, interlocking concentric contours. **The key engineering insight** (documented in README): a Paint Worklet receives only scalar custom properties and has no per-pixel access (`PaintRenderingContext2D` is a vector-only Canvas2D subset — no `getImageData`), so the whole ink field is **reconstructed deterministically inside the worklet from eight scalars** (`--t/--energy/--drops/--boil/--hue/--px/--py/--stir`) via a per-index `mulberry32` — an elegant answer to Houdini's scalar-only bridge. The marbling is ONE pure `drawInk(ctx,w,h,state)` `.toString()`-embedded into a Blob-URL worklet (`CSS.paintWorklet.addModule`) AND called directly by a `<canvas>` fallback → literally-identical pixels; feature-detected, header labels which path is live ("CSS Houdini Paint" vs "Canvas 2D fallback"), so the novel path genuinely runs in Chromium while the piece renders everywhere (Firefox/Safari/headless). **See = hear weld (tightest of the three DEEP explorers):** each drop you *see* is the exact frame a bell/ink-drop plink fires — one discrete event; breath loudness → drop rate + a "boil" agitating contours into gold-flecked filigree + warmth (calm = slow cosmic drift, loud = boiling intensity). **Audio:** gesture-gated `AudioContext`; a sustaining 3-detuned-osc cosmic drone through a 0.06 Hz-LFO lowpass + drop-synced plinks; master **0.18** → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination; ≤14 voices; full teardown on Stop/unmount. **Never blank/silent:** if the mic is denied/absent a seeded self-demo envelope keeps ink blooming and droning. **Named refs (README):** suminagashi floating-ink marbling; CSS Houdini Paint API / George Francis (georgedoescode) generative paint-worklets; Memo Akten (breath/energy as continuous controller). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#1** Houdini Paint = **grep-0× never-used-in-the-lab technique** (verified across the full lab) · **#2** ≥3 subsystems (Paint Worklet render engine + `registerProperty` audio→typed-CSS-prop bridge + Web Audio mic analysis + suminagashi field generator = 4) · **#3** named refs above. **#4** abstained at ship (declared multi-cycle in README — cycle-2 folds in 1550's curl-noise/rake + 1552's thin-film hue + Karel's real Path piano as the drop schedule); **#5 NOT claimed** (§755 dive is a technique-novelty finding, not a <14-day paper; logged straight, fifth cycle running). **diversity:** `banned=[three.js-scene-graph-primary · GPU-render-primary(~10/15) · cortical-traveling-wave/log-polar-breathing-field · pointer/touch-drag-SOLE · Canvas2D-as-headline(4× warm)] · picked=[HOUDINI-PAINT-WORKLET OUTPUT (grep-0×, CSS-compositor NOT GPU — Canvas2D is only the fallback) · mic-breath+pointer-stir INPUT (embodied, not sole/not banned, not the broken 3× keyboard rut, not camera-just-did) · suminagashi ink-marbling TECHNIQUE · iridescent-ink→jeweled PALETTE · pole cosmic-ambient↔intense (fresh named tradition — NOT the warm liquid-light-blob look, NOT the rested breathing-field/void)]` — clears every live 2026-07-12 hard ban. **SAFETY:** no strobe — boil modulates contour *amplitude* not frequency, drone LFO 0.06 Hz, hue drifts on a ~30 s cycle (all luminance change ≤3 Hz); `prefers-reduced-motion` halves the virtual clock + lowers drop rate. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Houdini/Canvas2D; no server/network/secret; zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites; `eslint src/app/dream/1548-ink-bloom --max-warnings 0` = **0**; `tsc --noEmit` = 0 winner errors (stale `.next/types` for the removed siblings cleared via `rm -rf .next`); authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0**, `page.js` (33.8 kB) + `"/dream/1548-ink-bloom"` in `routes-manifest.json` (plain `npm run build` dies only at "Collecting page data" on the standing ~700-route **EMFILE** fd-ceiling — infra, absent on Vercel). **NOT eye/ear-verified for feel** (headless container — no browser/mic/speakers): the felt drop→plink tightness, ring legibility, and whether the Houdini compositor path is smooth full-bleed want Karel's Chrome; the idle self-demo + deterministic reconstruction guarantee it's never blank/silent and render identically anywhere. Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-approach "Houdini-Paint marbling" fire (one concept — *ink-in-water marbling on the CSS compositor* — via three vector marbling algorithms); banked **⭐⭐ `1550-comb-marble`** (TOP ship-next — ebru gel-git/taraklı comb + divergence-free curl-noise flow + pointer-rake; richest technique, de-selected only on a looser aggregate see=hear weld) + **⭐ `1552-veil-marble`** (thin-film/oil-on-water iridescent veils; de-selected on least marbling-authentic + leaning into the warm liquid-light-blob register) → IDEAS §755. ### [1596-lectio-verse](/dream/1596-lectio-verse) · adult / visionary-adjacent (scripture / lectio) · **audio-file (drop/pick a recording — primary; keyboard step/pause secondary; NOT mic, NOT voice)** / **typographic DOM via CSS Custom Highlight API (8 `read0…read7` buckets, zero per-glyph DOM; `<span data-read>` fallback + live badge) — NO Canvas2D, NO WebGL** · cycle 763 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-13) · demoable · `state: self-reading illuminated scripture / lectio divina · pole: contemplative`
**Drop in a piano recording and the scripture reads itself — one word illuminated per struck note.** The lab's answer to the fresh 2026-07-13 jury's **#3 (and most-emphatic) provocation** — *"stop banking the 5/5 and ship it."* The banked reading-light codex, finally shipped, with its cross-modal **score-follower** as the headline: a tall vertical column of seeded asemic pseudo-scripture painted near-invisible on a near-black page; a bright **reading light** (hot candlelight head → dim amber afterglow) illuminates **one word at a time**, and a just-intonation FM "reader" synth speaks each word as it lands. **The weld:** load a real recording (Load-audio button or drag-drop) → it plays through `MediaElementSource → AnalyserNode` and a **spectral-flux onset detector** (adaptive threshold mean+k·std over ~0.7 s + local-peak + refractory) fires on each note attack; **every onset advances the reading light one word** — a run of fast notes rushes a line, a held chord lets a word glow, the built-in synth ducks so the loaded piano leads. So the performance *literally reads the text aloud*, note by note — Karel drops his real Path piano in and the light follows his phrasing. **Never blank/silent:** with no file the seeded codex auto-reads on an internal pulse over a sustaining JI under-bed drone (gesture-gated). **Named refs (README):** CSS Custom Highlight API (MDN); spectral-flux onset detection (Bello et al. 2005); **Online Time Warping (Dixon 2005) + Matchmaker (arXiv:2510.10087)** — the real-time audio-to-score-alignment lineage this follower relates to (this cycle's widened-net research anchor); illuminated manuscript / *lectio divina*; asemic writing (Michaux). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (Custom-Highlight reading-light renderer + seeded morpheme generator + JI FM synth + audio-file onset score-follower = 4, integrated) + **#3** named refs above + **#4** explicit multi-cycle (cycle-2 of the 1588-glossolalia banked plan; cycle-3 = Karel's real Path recording + the sibling followers). **#1 NOT claimed** — Custom Highlight API was cashed in 1588 (§761); the novelty here is the **cross-modal audio-file score-follow weld**, not the API (honest — the jury blessed shipping it anyway). **#5 NOT claimed** — 12th straight dry even on the widened net (OLTW/Matchmaker are 2005/2025, not <14-day). **diversity:** `banned=[mic/voice-INPUT · Canvas2D-OUTPUT · voice→JI-tone→form-constant ENGINE · iridescent-violet+Klüver ART-PALETTE]` (per JURY 2026-07-13); `picked=[audio-file INPUT (fresh modality — the jury's own named path, dodges the voice ban) · typographic-DOM Custom-Highlight OUTPUT (dodges Canvas2D) · onset score-follower ENGINE (audio→onset→reading-position, NOT the banned voice→JI→form-constant spine) · illuminated-codex verse-column PALETTE (a text codex, NOT a Klüver mandala) · pole contemplative]` — clears every hard ban. **SAFETY:** no strobe — the reading light is a smoothly-eased per-word illumination, advance rate capped, luminance change ≤3 Hz; `prefers-reduced-motion` slows the pulse + caps advance. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Custom Highlight DOM; no server/network/secret; zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites; `eslint src/app/dream/1596-lectio-verse --max-warnings 0` = **0**; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0**, `page.js` (38.6 kB) + `"/dream/1596-lectio-verse"` in BOTH `routes-manifest.json` and `app-path-routes-manifest.json` (plain `npm run build` compiles+lints+typechecks clean but dies at "Collecting page data" on the standing ~700-route **EMFILE** fd-ceiling — infra, absent on Vercel); the seeded auto-read + under-bed drone guarantee it's never blank/silent. Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-builder fire (ONE concept — *the reading-light codex that score-follows real audio* — via three score-follow mechanisms); banked **⭐⭐ `1598-cantor-light`** (TOP ship-next / winner's cycle-3 — the OLTW **tempo-tracker**: a lightweight online-time-warp follower that tracks accelerando/ritardando with a live BPM readout, the most faithful to this cycle's Matchmaker/OLTW research anchor; de-selected only because discrete one-word-per-note is more legible + surprising + robust unattended than continuous tempo-tracking against a generative score) + **⭐ `1594-reading-light`** (the RMS-envelope follower — loudness→descent-speed, the robust baseline / a selectable "dynamics" follower mode; de-selected as the coarsest coupling — dynamics, not phrasing) → IDEAS §763. ### [1656-the-toll](/dream/1656-the-toll) · adult / **conceptual-critical — a piece you can only hear while you pay the toll of attention (NOT visionary, NOT a pretty-visualizer; comments on the attention economy)** · **sustained-attention HOLD (spacebar / press-and-hold the field) + deterministic ghost-hand auto-demo — NOT mic/voice, NOT touch/pointer-drag, NOT keyboard-steer, NOT camera** / **austere typographic DOM (one large state line + hairline violet meter + mono "what you let go" receipt on a dark field) — NO Canvas2D, NO three.js/WebGL, NO GPU render** · cycle 772 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: attention-as-cost long-form generative critique · pole: conceptual/critical (off-violet, off-GPU)`
**A long-form generative piece that only advances while you hold — release, and it dissolves; almost no one holds long enough to hear the end.** Winner of a WIDE 3-explorer fire (Karel's-real-piano · living-earth-data · conceptual-critical) and the first real entry in the 2026-07-13 jury's **emptiest named menu lane** — conceptual/critical, "a recording you can't hear without doing something costly." **The pick FLIPPED during curation:** a whole-lab prior-art grep showed the other two explorers were near-duplicates of already-shipped pieces — `1652-path-codex` (real-piano onset → illuminated SVG manuscript) rebuilds the shipped `1596-lectio-verse` reading-light score-follower, and `1654-terraphone` (live-USGS seismic organ) rebuilds `1193-tremor-core` + `233-earth-pulse` — the "same soul, new substrate" trap the jury warns against; `1656` was the only genuinely-distinct soul, so it shipped. **How it works:** holding a single sustained gesture (spacebar, or press-and-hold anywhere on the field) is "the toll" — a small, boring, real cost of continuous attention. An attention meter integrates held-time (off `AudioContext.currentTime` deltas, never wall clock) at 1s/s; **releasing erodes it at 0.6s/s** (you slide backward, you don't hard-reset) while a fast "veil" gain snaps the *sound* to silence — two timescales that make the cost legible. **The music (long-form, real memory):** six named movements (a single held tone → the motif enters → answered a 5th up → an inverted countermelody → the climb → **tonic home at ~250s**), one just-intonation motif returning transformed across them, voices cross-fading in via smoothstep weights → genuinely **different at minute-5 than second-5** (the thin "long-form generative with state+memory" categorical lane). Reaching 250s prints a resolution line **most visitors will never see because they let go**; every release prints a receipt-style "what you let go" line ("you held 47s — the third movement was 20s away"), accumulating like a till roll. **The visual IS the medium — austere typography:** one large hero line that *is* the current state (its opacity/tracking/weight ARE the attention meter made typographic — loose and faint when neglected, tight and present when paid for), a hairline violet meter, the mono receipt on a dark field. No canvas, no WebGL, no particles — restraint is the point. **Self-demonstrating unattended (the 06:30 fit):** after a 3s no-input grace a deterministic `GHOST_SCRIPT` (hold 18s / release 4s / hold 30s…) drives the toll so the piece audibly climbs, decays on each scripted release, and prints receipts with zero input; the instant a real gesture arrives the ghost yields **permanently** (badge: "you have the toll" vs "ghost is holding — press space to take over"). Master chain: every note → veil → master `GainNode` (0.14) → `DynamicsCompressor` → destination, all ramps (no clicks on hold/release); full teardown (RAF cancel + listeners removed + engine disposed + `ctx.close()`) on unmount; spacebar `preventDefault` so it never scrolls. **Deterministic:** seeded `mulberry32` for micro-detune only; **no** `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date` (verified). **Named refs:** John Cage *4′33″* · Pauline Oliveros *Deep Listening* · Jenny Odell *How to Do Nothing*; research-chained to this cycle's §772 dive (audio-to-score alignment arxiv 2605.20014 seeded the sibling brief; the conceptual lane came from the jury's #5). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (attention-hold state machine + long-form generative score with a returning/transformed motif + fast-veil/slow-erosion decay engine + typographic-DOM render = 4, coupled each frame) + **#3** named refs above + **#4** long-form stateful with real memory (motif transformed to a tonic homecoming; minute-5 ≠ second-5). **#1 NOT claimed** — conceptual/attention pieces have faint prior lab presence (1190-quietude); the fresh weld is attention-as-toll with erosion + an unreachable resolution. **#5 NOT claimed** — 14th straight <14-day dry. **diversity:** `banned=[mic/voice-INPUT · touch/pointer-INPUT(4×) · Canvas2D-render · three.js/WebGL GPU-render OUTPUT(7×) · voice→JI→form-constant ENGINE · cosmic-gravity ENGINE · iridescent-violet+Klüver PALETTE]`; `picked=[sustained-attention-HOLD INPUT (binary attention-cost, NOT touch/pointer-drag, NOT keyboard-steer) · typographic-DOM OUTPUT (off-GPU) · attention-state long-form ENGINE · ink-monochrome off-violet PALETTE · pole conceptual/critical]` — clears every hard ban AND breaks the recent 7× GPU-render run. **SAFETY:** no strobe — only gentle 500ms opacity/tracking transitions, nothing in the flicker band. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + DOM; no server/network/secret; zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites; `eslint src/app/dream/1656-the-toll --max-warnings 0` = **0**; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0**, `page.js` (28.4 kB) + `"/dream/1656-the-toll"` in BOTH `routes-manifest.json` and `app-path-routes-manifest.json` (plain `npm run build` compiles+lints+typechecks clean but dies at "Collecting page data" on the standing ~725-route **EMFILE** fd-ceiling — infra, 4096-fd container cap, absent on Vercel; same as cycles 756/762/767/768/771); no `1652`/`1654` leaked (grep=0). **NOT eye/ear-verified for feel** (headless container — no display/speakers): whether the motif transformation reads as a genuine arc, whether erode-on-release feels legible rather than punitive, and whether the austere anti-spectacle surface holds attention at a 06:30 glance want Karel's Chrome; the deterministic ghost hand guarantees it's never blank/silent. Winner of an adult **WIDE** 3-explorer fire; banked **⭐⭐ `1652-path-codex`** (Karel's real Path piano score-followed into a self-illuminating SVG medieval codex — a fresh render surface but overlaps the shipped 1596-lectio-verse reading-light; resurrect only from a distinct angle) + **⭐ `1654-terraphone`** (live-USGS awe-pole seismic organ, deterministic replay-sim headless — resolves the ledger-organ brand tension but overlaps the shipped 1193-tremor-core / 233-earth-pulse; the data-lane ship needs a feed the lab hasn't sonified) → IDEAS §772. ### [1670-species-loom](/dream/1670-species-loom) · adult / **music-theory engine — the species-LAWFUL cycle-2 of 1660-fugue-loom (fold the verified fux-machine rule engine in; "the rule is the star" — NOT a pretty-visualizer, NOT JI-drone bed, NOT gravity, NOT cosmic)** · **keyboard-PLAYED subject (home row = D-dorian, top row = accidentals) + deterministic ghost auto-demo — real agency, NOT zero-input/watch-only, NOT touch/pointer, NOT mic/voice** / **self-writing SVG two/three-stave manuscript with red struck-through veto noteheads — NO Canvas2D, NO WebGL/three.js, off-GPU** · cycle 775 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: verified species-counterpoint machine that shows its rules · pole: lawful/composerly/played`
**You play a subject, and a machine grows it into voices whose every note is chosen to obey real species-counterpoint rules — the illegal moves flashing red and vetoed on the score in front of you.** The **species-lawful cycle-2** of `1660-fugue-loom` (a convincing but not academically-lawful self-playing fugue), cashing the fresh 2026-07-14 jury's **#3 provocation verbatim** — *"fold the banked verified `fux-machine` rule engine in to make the voice-leading genuinely species-lawful; stop banking the cycle-2, ship the follow-through (criterion #4 is the weakest-honored floor criterion)"* — WHILE staying inside the jury's two louder notes: species counterpoint is rule-*governed dissonance treatment* (real second-species passing tones, the anti-wash → #1's "real dissonance"), and the subject is **PLAYED**, not zero-input (→ #2's "demand real agency, no watch-only relapse"). **How the rule engine works (`engine.ts`):** the played subject becomes a cantus firmus; a **backtracking legal-set constraint search** grows two voices note-by-note — at each bar it enumerates in-scale candidates, keeps only those passing every rule, scores survivors (favouring contrary + stepwise motion + fuller imperfect consonances), tries them in seeded order, and **backtracks** when a bar has no legal continuation. Rules: **consonance on downbeats** (perfect 1/5/8 + imperfect 3/6 only; 2nds, 4th-against-bass, tritone, 7ths rejected) · **no parallel or hidden perfects** (parallels between every voice pair; hidden/direct perfects policed on the outer pair — the standard 3-voice relaxation) · **melody** mostly stepwise, consonant leaps ≤ octave, no aug/dim leaps, no two big leaps in a row · **second species (2:1)** in the lower voice with weak-beat dissonance licensed *only* as a passing tone (tagged `pt`) · a fixed **clausula vera / authentic cadence** (leading-tone C#→D into the final D octave). **The see=hear weld — vetoes you can watch:** a rejected parallel/hidden-perfect candidate is drawn on the self-writing SVG manuscript as a **red, struck-through ghost notehead** (`∥5`, `∥8`, `→5`) exactly as the playhead reaches that bar; vertical intervals are labelled (`M6`, `P5`, `m3`, `pt`…) as each note sounds. **Independent verification (not decorative):** a *separate* `verify()` pass re-scans every vertical (downbeats + parallel/hidden checks + every second-species weak beat) and counts violations — the live badge `verticals checked: N · violations: 0` is that real second check, headless-verified 0 across a dozen subjects incl. accidental-laden ones at the fixed seed. **Play it:** home row `a s d f g h j k l` = D4→E5 D-dorian, top row adds the C# leading tone; play 4–10 notes → **Compose fugue** (or **Ghost subject**), Play/Stop/Clear; on load a deterministic **ghost** composes+performs the default after a ~3 s no-input grace (badge *ghost is composing* → *you have the subject*), yielding the instant a mapped key is pressed. **Deterministic:** every stochastic choice from a seeded **mulberry32** (constant seed) — no `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date` (verified); the visual manuscript clock is **decoupled from the audio clock** (rAF-driven) so it never freezes even if autoplay gates the sound. Three panned per-voice organ-ish synth lines → master gain ≤ 0.13 → `DynamicsCompressor`, smoothed ramps, full teardown on unmount. **Named refs (README):** J.J. Fux *Gradus ad Parnassum* (1725) · G. Mazzola et al. "Three-voice first-species counterpoint" arXiv 2606.01102 (2026) · FuxCP (constraint-programming counterpoint) · "Formulating First Species Counterpoint With Integer Programming"; research-chained to this cycle's §775 dive (Strasheela real-time constraint counterpoint + IP first-species → the legal-set-search-with-visible-veto fold). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#4** declared cycle-2 of 1660 (the jury's named weakest-honored criterion, cashed — cycle-3 = fold this verified engine into 1660's full fugal architecture, previewed by the banked 1674) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (verified voice-leading constraint search + independent verifier + played-subject/ghost state machine + polyphonic synth + self-writing SVG manuscript = 5) + **#3** named refs above. **#1 NOT claimed** — the counterpoint *engine* now exists in the lab as of 1660 (§773); the fresh weld is the *verified, rule-visible, played* fold, not a never-used technique. **#5 NOT claimed** — **18th straight** <14-day dry (Mazzola 2606.01102 is June 2026 ~6 wks — the tightest chain in cycles but not <14d; standing widen-or-retire note holds). **diversity:** `banned=[JI-consonant-drone BED(13×) · orbital-gravity ENGINE · zero-input/watch-only INPUT(4×) · cosmic palette · WebGL/three.js OUTPUT(on-watch 5×) · touch/pointer INPUT(on-watch 6×)]`; `picked=[keyboard-PLAYED subject INPUT (real agency — NOT watch-only, NOT touch/pointer, NOT mic, NOT cosmic) · SVG self-writing-manuscript OUTPUT (off-GPU, off the on-watch three.js creep) · verified-species-counterpoint ENGINE (rule-governed real DISSONANCE treatment — NOT the JI-drone BED, NOT gravity) · ink-on-parchment off-violet PALETTE · pole lawful/composerly/played]` — clears every hard ban AND cashes jury #3 while staying inside #1+#2. **SAFETY:** no strobe — the red veto flash is a small, local, slow notehead element; luminance change well under the flicker band; `prefers-reduced-motion` respected. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + SVG/DOM; no server/network/secret; zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites (already on-brand, violet the sole chrome accent; parchment/red live only inside the SVG art); `eslint src/app/dream/1670-species-loom --max-warnings 0` = **0**; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **Compiled (warnings only, all pre-existing in unrelated `src/lib/*`/older prototypes)**, `page.js` emitted + `"/dream/1670-species-loom"` in BOTH `routes-manifest.json` and `app-path-routes-manifest.json` (plain `npm run build` compiles+lints+typechecks clean but dies at "Collecting page data" on the standing ~730-route **EMFILE** fd-ceiling — infra, 4096-fd container cap, absent on Vercel; same as cycles 756/762/767–774); no `1672`/`1674` leaked (grep=0). **NOT ear/eye-verified for feel** (headless container — no display/speakers): whether the played-subject → lawful-voices development reads as musically satisfying (vs merely correct) by ear, and whether the red-veto + interval labels read legibly at a 06:30 glance, want Karel's Chrome; ### [1682-cadence-forge](/dream/1682-cadence-forge) · adult / **music-theory engine — a PLAYED equal-tempered functional-harmony instrument that modulates and BITES (cashes JURY 2026-07-14 #1's last literal example "an equal-tempered one that actually modulates and bites"; NOT a JI-drone bed, NOT gravity, NOT cosmic)** · **keyboard-PLAYED roman numerals (home row I ii iii IV V vi vii°; Shift = applied secondary dominants; L=vii°7; M/Space = pivot-chord modulation; N = deceptive cadence) + deterministic ghost auto-demo — real agency, NOT zero-input/watch-only, NOT touch/pointer, NOT mic** / **Canvas2D tension ribbon + live TIV component breakdown — NO three.js/WebGL, off-GPU** · cycle 777 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-14) · demoable · `state: functional-harmony tension engine that shows its math · pole: composerly/played, real ET tension (not JI wash)`
**Play scale-degree roman numerals and hear real functional harmony pull and resolve — while a numerically-grounded tonal-tension curve rises on the dominants and drops home on the tonic.** The lab's first **functional-harmony tension engine** and the DEEP-winner cash of the fresh 2026-07-14 jury's **#1 note** — "break the just-intonation consonance reflex; 13 of 15 pieces resolve to a pretty JI wash; force an **equal-tempered one that actually modulates and bites**" (the last uncashed of jury #1's four named examples; 774-bytemill cashed *noise/glitch*, 775-species-loom *real dissonance treatment*, 776-tabla-loom *percussion/beat-driven*). Finally ships the banked ⭐⭐`1678-tension-cell` (§776 TOP ship-next) concept. **How it works:** home row `A S D F G H J` = the seven diatonic triads (I ii iii IV V vi vii°) in the current key; each is realized by a real **4-voice SATB voice-leading search** (common tones held, upper voices minimized, chord coverage preferred — not stacked root triads); `Shift`+key fires an **applied/secondary dominant** (V7/x, real tritone), `K`=V7, `L`=vii°7 (fully-diminished), `M`/Space **modulates** via pivot chord to a related key (updating the on-screen key), `N` = **deceptive cadence** (V7→vi). **The tension math is real, not hand-waved:** every chord's tension is the published **TIV weighted scalar** (Navarro-Cáceres & Bernardes, *Entropy* 2020) — dissonance ×0.402 + hierarchical-tension ×0.246 + tonal-distance ×0.202 + voice-leading-motion ×0.193, /1.043 — drawn as a scrolling Canvas2D ribbon with ▲peak/▽dip labels PLUS a live per-component breakdown panel, so you see exactly which of the four terms is biting. Audio is pure Web Audio 12-TET (saw+sine per voice, ADSR) → master gain 0.12 → lowpass → `DynamicsCompressor`. **Deterministic ghost self-demo:** a frame-counter clock (no `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date`/wall-clock in executable code — verified) self-plays `I–vi–IV–V7/V–V7–I` then modulates and drops a deceptive cadence, decoupled from the audio clock so the ribbon animates even before/without audio; graceful `text-destructive` notice if AudioContext is missing. **Ambition — honest 3/5:** **#1** first functional-harmony tension engine (grep-0× for functional-harmony/roman-numeral/Lerdahl across the lab) + **#2** ≥3 subsystems (functional-harmony realizer + SATB voice-leader + TIV tension model + Canvas2D ribbon/breakdown render = 4) + **#3** named refs (Fred Lerdahl *Tonal Pitch Space* 2001 · the TIV tonal-tension model *Entropy* 2020 · Mapping Tonal Harmony Pro). **#5 NOT claimed** — 19th straight <14-day dry (freshest on-concept find = Mapping THP 5.1 at ~6 wks; TIV foundational-2020; foundational-technique exception invoked). **diversity:** `banned=[JI-consonant-drone BED(jury #1) · zero-input/watch-only(jury #2) · orbital-gravity · cosmic-space palette · (on-watch) three.js OUTPUT]`; `picked=[keyboard-PLAYED numerals INPUT (real agency, NOT watch-only, NOT touch/pointer, NOT mic, NOT cosmic) · equal-tempered FUNCTIONAL-HARMONY tension ENGINE (secondary dominants/tritones/modulation — the literal anti-JI, NOT a drone bed) · Canvas2D tension-ribbon OUTPUT (NOT three.js) · violet-tension PALETTE (NOT cosmic)]` — clears every hard ban AND cashes jury #1 inside #2. **SAFETY:** no strobe — the ribbon is a slow scrolling curve, luminance well under the flicker band. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D; Winner of an adult **DEEP** 3-approach fire (ONE concept — *played ET functional harmony that modulates and bites* — via play-the-numeral / sculpt-the-roughness / play-the-bassline); banked **⭐⭐ `1684-roughness-organ`** (the lab's first psychoacoustic sensory-dissonance engine — Plomp-Levelt/Sethares roughness computed on real partials, the universal-hump viz with a live dot per partial pair; highest surprise, but sculpts a chord's bite without modulating keys → TOP ship-next for the perceptual lane) + **⭐ `1686-figured-bass`** (a played real-time reharmonizer/continuo — you play a bass line, the machine harmonizes each beat with functional chords biased by a heat knob, modulating by fifths; cashes both halves but the machine makes the interesting choice → a "play a line" night) → IDEAS §777. ### [1726-drum-trance](/dream/1726-drum-trance) · adult / **shamanic theta auditory-driving — a drum-trance field where the STEADINESS of your ~4 Hz beat is the reward (direct build of the §784 research dive: Aparicio-Terrés *Sci.Rep.* 16:10204, 2026-03-26, "neural tracking at theta predicts drumming-induced ASC"); breaks JURY 2026-07-14 #1 (rhythm/grit, NOT a JI-drone bed) + #2 (real agency, NOT watch-only)** · **MULTI-TOUCH/pointer frame-drum pads (+ Space/F/J/K, + deterministic 4.2 Hz ghost drummer) — you PLAY the beat, real agency, NOT keyboard-melody, NOT zero-input/watch-only** / **Canvas2D Klüver form-constant field (imports `_shared/visionary/logpolar`) — NO WebGL/three.js, breaks the 4× raw-GPU streak (1700/1708/1714/1722)** · cycle 784 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-15) · demoable · `state: shamanic theta-entrainment trance · pole: intense`
**Tap the drums steadily near four beats a second and the visionary geometry locks in — hold a wobbly beat and it scatters back to grey; the visual IS a biofeedback readout of how well you're entraining.** The lab's first **closed theta-entrainment reward loop**, and the direct implementation of this cycle's fresh 2026 research: Aparicio-Terrés et al., *Scientific Reports* 16:10204 (2026-03-26) found that the strength of the brain's *phase-lock* (neural tracking) to a steady ~4 beats/sec (theta-band) drum pulse — not merely the presence of a 4 Hz beat — predicts the depth of the drumming-induced altered state. So the piece rewards **steadiness**, not noise. **5 subsystems:** (1) **multi-touch/pointer frame-drum pads** — 4 large tappable zones (center skin + rims), playable by tap/multi-touch/click, plus Space/F/J/K for laptop review — the user physically plays the rhythm (real agency, jury #2); (2) **modal membrane-drum synthesis** (`audio.ts`) — each hit = a noise burst through a bandpass into 2–3 **detuned inharmonic modal resonators** at Bessel-like ratios (1 : 1.59 : 2.14) with fixed per-partial cent detune — short, punchy, deliberately NOT a consonant sustained chord (breaks jury #1's JI-drone ban; distinct pitch/timbre per pad); (3) **theta-steadiness tracker** — measures inter-onset intervals, computes closeness to ~4 bps AND low-variance steadiness, maintains a smoothed entrainment scalar E∈[0,1] that RISES on steady locked beating and DECAYS on erratic/stopped hits; (4) **Klüver form-constant field** (`field.ts`, Canvas2D) — a full-screen tunnel→spiral→honeycomb form-constant field built on the shared `formConstant`/`honeycomb` log-polar helpers whose intensity/contrast/coherence scale with E (erratic = dim grey scattered tunnel; deep lock = brilliant honeycomb + peripheral white-out boundary-dissolution), pulsing on each hit; (5) **entrainment-reward loop** — a mono readout of tempo/lock%/form closes the loop, and rising E escalates the form-constant complexity — trance depth as an *earned* reward. **Deterministic + headless self-demo:** a 4.2 Hz **ghost drummer** auto-plays from mount (integer frame counter; excitation noise from a fixed-seed mulberry32; `ctx.currentTime` only for audio scheduling — no `Math.random`/`Date.now`/`new Date`/`performance.now` in the state/audio/animation path, verified), driving lock toward ~90% (bright honeycomb) so the piece is never blank/silent on the headless 06:30 box; it yields the moment the user taps and resumes after ~3.5 s of silence. **SAFETY:** no strobe — beat flashes are gentle local luminance pulses (the ~4 Hz beat is audio-only; the full screen never flashes at 4 Hz); `prefersReducedMotion()` honored. **Ambition — honest 2–3/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (touch-drum input + modal-percussion synth + theta-steadiness tracker + Canvas2D form-constant render + entrainment-reward loop = 5) + **#3** named refs (Aparicio-Terrés *Sci.Rep.* 2026 4-bps theta · Neher 1961 "auditory driving" · Maxfield 1990 rhythmic-drumming EEG · Harner *Way of the Shaman* · Klüver form constants) + research-cited to the §784 theta-tracking dive (path (a): today's research → tonight's build). **#1 NOT claimed** — percussion/drum synthesis + form-constants are owned; the fresh axis is the *combination* (the lab's first closed drum→theta-steadiness→form-constant reward loop). **#5 NOT claimed — 26th straight** <14-day dry (Nature paper 2026-03-26 ≈ 3.5 mo). **diversity:** `banned=[keyboard-PLAYED INPUT(4×) · zero-input/watch-only(jury#2) · JI-consonant-drone BED(jury#1) · orbital-gravity · cosmic-STARFIELD palette · (on-watch) raw-WebGL2/three.js OUTPUT(4×) + instrument-DSP + harmony-engine TECHNIQUE]`; **Drop any track — or let the built-in dissonant carrier play — and watch/hear it fracture: the audio bit-crushed to as few as 2 bits with sample-rate decimation (a grit slider dials both from shimmer to ruin) while a pure-Canvas2D feedback-displacement datamosh tears the image into mirror-tiled machine-elf hyper-detail.** The lab's **first-ever `bitcrush`** (amplitude quantization greps 0× across the 1700-deep lab) — and the conceptual anchor is fresh: bitcrush is the audible-artifact *ancestor* of the Residual-Vector-Quantization (codebook quantization) every 2024–26 AI music generator (Suno/Udio/Stable Audio/MusicGen/Riffusion) is built on (ArtifactNet, arXiv 2604.16254, 2026-04-20). ### [1740-breath-nebula](/dream/1740-breath-nebula) · adult / visionary · **mic-breath (low-band RMS envelope → breath-phase; mic → AnalyserNode only; deterministic ~0.1 Hz ghost breath when no mic) — NOT touch/pointer, NOT keyboard-played, NOT camera** / **WebGPU compute + render (a persistent ~150k–500k-particle storage buffer advected by a WGSL curl-noise compute shader, instanced additive render pass) — NO Canvas2D (jury-banned 7×), NO three.js/raw-WebGL2 — the near-0× substrate the jury demanded** · cycle 786 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-15) · demoable · `state: cosmic-ambient nebula-tide · pole: cosmic-ambient`
**Breathe toward the mic and a living cosmic nebula breathes with you — inhale blooms a cloud of hundreds of thousands of GPU points outward into warm-white light, exhale collapses it back into cold violet filaments.** The lab's answer to the fresh 2026-07-15 jury's three structural provocations at once: **#3 "break the Canvas2D monoculture — force a WebGPU-compute piece (still near-0×)"** (this is a genuine WGSL `compute` shader stepping a persistent GPU storage buffer, only ~2× across 1700+ prototypes), **#2 "return to the PRIMARY DIRECTION on the OTHER pole"** (cosmic-ambient, re-injected), and **#1 "leave the instrument/theory workshop"** (this is neither). **The technique:** each particle (`pos+age`, `vel+seed`) is advected every frame through a 3-D **curl-noise** flow field — the analytic curl of a value-noise vector potential, so the flow is near-divergence-free and makes filaments/sheets, not sinks — plus a **signed breath radial force** (outward on the rising in-breath, a cold inward collapse on the falling out-breath), a slow nebular swirl, damping, Euler integration, and seeded respawn on an emitter shell; a second pipeline reads the *same* buffer and expands each point into a camera-facing additive quad, coloured deep-indigo→violet→warm-white by local speed, camera auto-orbiting on a deterministic clock. **The breath:** smoothed mic low-band RMS drives the tide; with no mic a deterministic ~0.1 Hz sine keeps it breathing, alive and audible unattended. **The sound (deliberately NOT a static JI drone):** an inharmonic detuned-pair pad with per-partial detune LFOs (beating + shimmer), a filtered-noise wind rising on the in-breath, sparse Risset-ish bells on the out-breath → compressor → 0.15. **Named refs (README):** Robert Borghesi's *ASTRODITHER* (WebGPU + TSL audio-reactive, 2026-07-01 — the freshest anchor, a field "all signal until the music pushes it around"); the KAYAC WebGPU curl-noise 1M-particle compute demo; Refik Anadol's data-cloud aesthetic. Graceful degrade: no-WebGPU → readable notice + audio keeps running + a DOM radial-glow pulsing with breath; mic-denied → `text-destructive` note + ghost breath. Deterministic (integer frame counter + fixed-seed mulberry32 only; no `Math.random`/`Date`/`performance.now` in the update path), no strobe (slow luminance drift only, `prefers-reduced-motion` softens orbit + bloom). Two more altered-states pieces explored this fire (WIDE) and banked to IDEAS §786: **⭐⭐ 1742-drift-lattice** (three.js-shader hypnagogic phosphene lattice that deepens as your room goes quiet — fills the empty DREAM pole) + **⭐ 1744-void-bath** (audio-only HRTF-spatialized NDE drone-void, device-tilt).

### [1746-threshold-lattice](/dream/1746-threshold-lattice) · adult / visionary · **the DREAM/hypnagogic pole the 2026-07-15 jury named EMPTY — cashes the ⭐⭐-banked §786 seed, the direct build of the §787 research dive (MIT Media Lab *Dormio*/Targeted-Dream-Incubation + Windt "Intrusions of a drowsy mind", Frontiers 2015: the hypnagogic threshold is an addressable interface — this INVERTS it, making the ROOM the sensor)** · **mic AMBIENT ROOM-RMS, INVERSE mapping (reward stillness — the quieter/stiller your space, the deeper you sink; mic → AnalyserNode only; deterministic autonomous ghost descent when no mic) — NOT touch/pointer, NOT keyboard-played, NOT breath-pitch** / **three.js fragment `ShaderMaterial` (honeycomb Klüver form-constant lattice under an inverse log-polar retina→V1 warp, reuses `_shared/visionary/logpolar` `LOGPOLAR_GLSL`+`honeycomb`; peripheral fragmentary-image spirals; myoclonic-jerk spring-back shear) — NO Canvas2D (jury-banned 6–7×), NO raw-WebGL2 (§785 4× ban) — off both the banned substrates** · cycle 787 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-15) · demoable · `state: hypnagogic sleep-onset descent · pole: dream`
**Keep your room quiet and still and you sink, over ~12–15 s, through a honeycomb phosphene lattice toward the threshold of dream imagery — any sound throws you back up.** The lab's first real occupant of the DREAM/hypnagogic pole the fresh 2026-07-15 jury named empty (~0), and the direct cash of its provocation #2 ("cosmic-ambient and DREAM states are thin-to-empty — cash a banked altered-states piece"): this is the §786-banked ⭐⭐ `1742-drift-lattice` concept, resurrected off the banned Canvas2D onto a three.js `ShaderMaterial`, and it **solves the seed's known weakness** (the "quiet→deeper" link used to take ~15 s to read). **The interface is the room.** Ambient-mic RMS is mapped *inversely* and split into two channels: a **fast `uStill`** channel (sub-second) drives a center-sink glow + an always-visible live stillness meter so the cause→effect reads in <5 s, and a **slow `depth`** reward with an asymmetric envelope (~13 s rise when quiet, ~0.4 s fall on any sound) drives the lattice density, warp, tint and vignette — the actual "how deep am I" state. **The technique:** a honeycomb (Klüver's lattice form-constant) drawn in cortical space and sampled through the inverse log-polar (retina→V1) warp, so it streams inward as you sink; peripheral spirals hint at the fragmentary half-images of hypnagogia near the threshold; a golden-angle **myoclonic-jerk (sleep-start) state machine** fires a gentle damped spring-back shear + a soft thud at a depth-modulated cadence (deeper → a little more often). **The sound (calm dream pole, not the anti-JI grit mandate):** a seeded warm pad + dark noise wash that darkens/softens as depth rises, sparse frame-scheduled bells, low startle thuds → compressor → 0.12. A warm, breathing, audio-reactive visionary/visionary **mandala rendered with no canvas and no WebGL at all** — the whole visual is produced by the part of the browser that composites and paints boxes. Eight absolutely-positioned `<div>`s stack inside one breathing/parallax "stage": a warm `radial-gradient` base wash (the `conic-gradient`-unsupported degradation floor) → three `repeating-conic-gradient` petal fields whose repeat-period IS the petal count, counter-rotating on `--rot`/`--rot2`/`--rot3` at near-but-unequal speeds so they **beat out genuine moiré/kaleidoscope interference** → a `scaleX(-1)` mirror of field A for bilateral symmetry → a slow full-ramp `conic-gradient` iridescence under `mix-blend-mode: soft-light` nudged by `hue-rotate(--hue)` (held inside a warm ±35° arc so it never leaves the palette) → a central `radial-gradient` bloom whose radius+intensity ride `--bloom` (peak lightness pinned at 80%, never pure white = the flash-safety clamp) → an aperture vignette. **The engineering thesis** (documented in README): a SINGLE `requestAnimationFrame` loop never touches the DOM tree — it only calls `el.style.setProperty('--x', …)` on the root, and plain custom properties cascade to every layer and re-paint on the compositor for free (no `registerProperty` needed; the deepening idea is to register them as typed `<angle>`/`<number>` so the compositor interpolates on its own thread). **Audio → CSS weld:** a self-playing warm lydian pad (detuned triangle/saw partials under a slow lowpass LFO + the shared `_shared/visionary/convolutionVoid` reverb) with a generative A-pentatonic bell voice sounds from the first **Begin**; an `AnalyserNode` on the master bus reduces the FFT to six smoothed log-spaced perceptual bands written straight into `--band0..5`, and overall energy drives `--open` (petal intricacy + breathing scale + saturation), `--bloom`, and `--hue`/`--sat` — louder/brighter audio **opens** the lotus (finer petals, bigger bloom, deeper saturation), quiet lets it **close and dim**. Rotation is continuous and audio-independent so it is never a dead screen; drop your own track (`decodeAudioData` → looping source through the same analyser) to drive it instead. Self-runs fully untouched (synthetic idle bands before audio). **Ambition (2/5, honest):** #1 never-used render substrate (CSS compositor as PRIMARY render — grep-0×; the sharpest possible dodge off both the jury-banned Canvas2D and the over-served GPU-shader/WebGPU output pile) + #2 ≥3 subsystems (Web-Audio synth+reverb + FFT band-reducer + CSS-custom-property compositor engine). **Safety:** no strobe — rotation ~60 s/rev, breathing ~0.13 Hz, no luminance change near the photosensitive band, peak layer brightness clamped below white, `prefers-reduced-motion` slows every rotation to ~16% and damps the breathing depth. **2 more explored this cycle** (WIDE fan, banked in IDEAS.md): `1776-spore-gaze` (camera hand-DWELL blooms a visionary fractal — the literal build of the §793 gaze-fixation research, the highest-ambition 4/5 seed, ship-next) and `1780-dejong-swarm` (260k-point **de Jong strange attractor**, grep-0×, with visionary tracer-trails via WebGL2 transform-feedback + a float-texture feedback accumulator).

**A glass chord instrument you play with up to ten fingers that speaks real tonal harmony — press a cell to voice a diatonic function, hold several to conduct a progression, drag to glissando between chords, and it stays a silent, still, cold lattice until a real finger touches it.** The jury's 2026-07-17 verdict named three new invisible monocultures the theme-audit never catches — **one color** (violet-on-near-black ~12/15), **one scale** (everything de-risks to a pentatonic 6/15), and **one interaction model** (~11/15 play themselves with no human) — and asked, in three separate provocations, to change the color, the harmony, and make it need a human. This piece is the single most on-target answer to all three at once. **The tonal engine** (`harmony.ts`): a `Key = {tonicPc, mode}` drives a 4-column × 3-row matrix of 12 chords laid out by FUNCTION — Tonic / Predominant / Dominant / Applied columns — with the full diatonic set (I ii iii IV V V7 vi vii° ii7 in major; i ii° III iv V7 VI vii° iiø7 in minor, harmonic-minor V) **plus three real secondary dominants** (V/V, V/vi, V/IV) for chromatic bite, and a two-cell **modulation strip** that pivots the whole grid up a fifth (→ dominant) or to the relative minor/major — so the labels and pitches transpose live. **Voice-leading is the core:** each new chord is voiced by `voiceLead()`, which snaps each of 4 voices to the *nearest* chord tone of the target, so held→new transitions glide and common tones are held rather than leaping — and the audio simply `setTargetAtTime`-glides voice *i* from its old pitch to its new one (the portamento "bite"). A `<polyline>` "ribbon" over a C3/C4/C5 staff renders those 4 voices as a morphing line you can watch voice-lead. **Audio** (`audio.ts`, Web Audio, equal temperament — the point here is FUNCTION, not just intonation): each press spawns a 4-voice triangle+sine group through highpass→lowpass→compressor + a soft feedback delay; silent until a gesture resumes the context; every held voice releases on pointer-up. **Interaction** (Pointer Events with pointer-capture, `touch-action: none`): one finger or ten, drag across cells to glissando with voice-leading, press a mod cell to change key — and **with no pointer down there is total silence and a still, labeled graphite grid; there is deliberately no self-playing path.** **Palette:** cold graphite/charcoal ground, near-white ink, a single hairline, active cells invert to near-white — Ikeda's cold precise data-grid, one of the two color worlds (with 1810's monochrome) the jury explicitly named as unbuilt escapes from violet. **Ambition (honest 3/5):** #2 ≥3 subsystems (functional-harmony engine + voice-leading solver + multitouch pointer model + Web-Audio poly-voice glide synth + SVG-DOM render/animation) + #3 named reference (Ryoji Ikeda *data.matrix* for the cold grid; Toshio Iwai *Electroplankton*/*Tenori-on* for touch-as-instrument) + #5 same-day §813 research dive (MediaPipe/touch input maturity as the lever to break the self-playing monoculture). #1 NOT claimed — touch + SVG + functional harmony each exist somewhere in the lab; the win is the *combination* aimed precisely at the jury's three live bans, not a lab-first technique. **Safety:** no strobe, no flicker — the only motion is a gentle ribbon glide and 110ms cell fades. **2 more explored this cycle** (WIDE fan, banked in IDEAS §813): ⭐⭐ `1908-glasswind` (MediaPipe hands play a just-intonation harmonic-series air-column as Chladni sumi-ink standing waves on warm paper in a WebGL2 shader — the freshest *visual*, ship-next) and ⭐ `1912-limbs` (full-body MediaPipe pose → an inharmonic spectral cluster as a luminous three.js line-skeleton, high-chroma cyan/amber). **NOT eye/ear-verified in a browser this cycle** (headless — no display/touch/speakers): whether the voice-leading glides read as musical, whether the chord voicings are well-balanced, and whether ten-finger play stays coherent all want Karel's phone.
