### [1966-alpha-reset](/dream/1966-alpha-reset) · adult / visionary · **audio-file-drop + deterministic generative carrier (audio-as-carrier — NOT mic, NOT touch/pointer, NOT the recent tilt/camera/MIDI; explicitly NOT a memory piece)** / **three.js full-screen fragment `ShaderMaterial` over the shared log-polar / form-constant engine (`_shared/visionary/logpolar.ts` `LOGPOLAR_GLSL`) — three.js was 1× in the last 10 (coldest GPU family), NOT Canvas2D, NOT raw-WebGL2** · cycle 828 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-19) · demoable · `state: cross-modal auditory-reset of Klüver form-constants · pole: intense`
**Sound resets your visual cortex: each note in the music snaps a drifting, incoherent hallucinatory form-constant field into momentary crystalline coherence, then it dissolves back into visual snow.** WIDE-mode winner of a 3-explorer fire (cycle 828, 1 of 3 divergent altered-states directions). Returns the lab to its PRIMARY visionary direction (INTENSE pole) after a memory-instrument/data drift, and breaks the fresh **compositional-MEMORY monoculture** (5 of the last 10 ships — 1930/32/34/38/60 — were "your past gestures shape the present"; this is deliberately NOT one). **The mechanism (grep-0× as a weld):** a full-screen three.js `ShaderMaterial` renders four Klüver form constants — **tunnels, spokes, spirals + a honeycomb lattice** — in cortical `(log r, θ)` space via the shared **Bressloff–Cowan log-polar engine** (`LOGPOLAR_GLSL`). Each layer carries its own **phase offset** (`uOff` vec4) that, left alone, **drifts at a slightly different rate** → the layers fall out of registration, the average washes to flat gray, and the mandala smears into desaturated **visual snow** (incoherence). A **spectral-flux onset detector** (adaptive threshold = running mean + k·std over ~0.7 s, rising-edge peak, 120 ms refractory) fires on each note attack and **RESETS the phase offsets toward their common centroid** → the geometry momentarily LOCKS into a crisp iridescent mandala, then the incoherent drift pulls it apart again. Rhythmic/dense music keeps it coherent; sparse/quiet lets it dissolve. **Grounded in a REAL cross-modal finding** (evoked, not claimed medically): a brief sound phase-resets the ~10 Hz alpha rhythm of visual cortex (Romei et al. 2012) and the audiovisual binding window scales with individual alpha (Cecere et al. 2015). **INPUT:** drag-drop / file-picker any track (`decodeAudioData` → looping source → gain + Analyser fan-out) OR a built-in **deterministic seeded (`mulberry32`) pentatonic-arpeggio-over-drone carrier** scheduled off `ctx.currentTime`, whose attacks drive the onset detector so the coherence-snap is visible with **zero input, headless**. FFT bands → neural-gain map: bass→log-polar warp depth + zoom, mids→form-constant freq, highs→kaleidoscope fold count + honeycomb detail, loudness→saturation/iridescence (IQ cosine palette + chromatic aberration). **The four wired subsystems** (ambition #2, exceeded — 5): audio-file decode/loop + spectral-flux onset detector + phase-reset/coherence controller + log-polar three.js shader + generative carrier. **Ambition — honest 2/5:** **#2** ≥3 subsystems (5) + **#3** named refs (Bressloff–Cowan · Romei et al. 2012 "Sounds reset rhythms of visual cortex" · Cecere et al. 2015 Current Biology). **#1 NOT claimed** — log-polar geometry + FFT→shader both exist in the lab; the fresh move is the cross-modal *phase-reset weld*, grep-0× as a mechanism but built on existing primitives. **#5 NOT claimed** — the on-mechanism refs are foundational (2012/2015), not <14-day; honest, consistent with the saturation streak. **diversity:** `banned=[compositional-MEMORY technique (5×) · touch/pointer (historically 6×, keep drained — 0× last 10)]`; `picked=[audio-file/generative-carrier INPUT (audio-as-carrier) · three.js log-polar SHADER output (three.js coldest GPU family, 1×) · auditory-phase-reset-of-form-constants TECHNIQUE (grep-0× weld, NOT a memory piece) · neon-iridescent visionary state PALETTE · INTENSE visionary pole]` — clears the memory ban and re-centres the primary direction. **SAFETY (photosensitive):** the coherence-SNAP is a **spatial** pattern reorganization, NOT a brightness flash — onsets modulate only the phase offsets; the global `uGain` brightness envelope is **JS-slew-limited to ~0.25 s** so it cannot modulate in the 3–30 Hz band; visual snow is low-amplitude per-pixel grain (not synchronized full-screen flicker); `prefers-reduced-motion` reduces fold count, drift, and onset strength. **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + three.js; audio-file decode is local, no network/secret; three@0.182 already a dep — zero new npm deps). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites; `next lint --dir 1966-alpha-reset --max-warnings 0` = **0**; project-wide `tsc --noEmit` = **0**; authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0** (this cycle completed the full route legend — no EMFILE), `page.js` + `page_client-reference-manifest.js` emitted + `"/dream/1966-alpha-reset"` in BOTH `routes-manifest.json` and `app-path-routes-manifest.json`; losers 1968/1970 confirmed absent. **NOT eye/ear-verified for feel** (headless container — no display/speakers/audio-file; runtime GLSL compile can't be exercised without a GL context): whether the onset→coherence-snap reads as "the music crystallising the geometry," whether the drift-apart is legible vs merely noisy, and whether a dropped track drives it musically want Karel's Chrome; the shader was read line-by-line for GLSL-ES-1.00 legality and the deterministic carrier guarantees it's never blank/silent. ### [2218-missing-bass](/dream/2218-missing-bass) · visionary / **audio-only** · **the deep bass you feel is a PHANTOM — play only the 3rd–8th harmonics of an absent fundamental, high-pass away every trace of low energy, and your brain reconstructs the missing bass that is provably not in the sound** · **INPUT = keyboard (home-row scale of phantom roots) + pointer + harmonic-density / binaural-beat controls — PLAYED, multi-parameter (jury 2026-07-21 #1)** · **OUTPUT = Web Audio (upper-harmonic bank + cascaded 135 Hz high-pass + per-harmonic L/R binaural detune + soft-limiter) + Canvas2D FFT spectrum (jury #3 "hold audio-only" — off the whole GPU family)** · cycle 860 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-22) · demoable · `state: missing-fundamental / residue-pitch reconstruction + binaural entrainment · pole: cosmic-ambient (arrival, not dissolution — a bass that BUILDS from nothing)`
DEEP-mode winner of a 3-mechanism fire (all ears-only, headphones-required, PLAYED, zero-GPU) exploring *"an instrument whose notes are manufactured inside your own auditory system."* **Mechanism:** the **missing-fundamental / residue-pitch illusion** (Schouten 1940; Seebeck 1841; Helmholtz) — each held key renders sine oscillators ONLY at the 3rd–8th harmonics of an absent fundamental f0 (A-minor natural scale, 55–110 Hz), summed through a **cascaded 135 Hz high-pass** so there is provably ZERO acoustic energy at f0 (no oscillator is ever created there) — yet the brain reconstructs and "hears" the absent low pitch. A gentle **binaural beat** (per-harmonic L/R detune, 0–8 Hz) entrains; harmonic **density** (3rd–8th) tunes vividness; a **Reveal A/B** adds a real sine at f0 (bypassing the high-pass, drawn amber) so you can hear how close your reconstructed pitch was, then remove it and the phantom bass persists. **The see≈don't-hear weld:** the Canvas2D spectrum is drawn from the *real output FFT*, so violet harmonic bars appear only above the dashed cutoff while a ghost marker sits in the conspicuously EMPTY low band labeled "you hear a pitch here — there is no sound here" — you *see* the silence you nonetheless feel. Curated over `2216-priming-room` (conditioned hallucination, the bigger concept but single-tap + patience-heavy — banked to resurrect as its own DEEP cycle) and `2214-tartini` (cochlear combination tone, highest-wow but perceptually fragile — banked). Grows the jury's most under-served lane (audio-only/embodied) and rebalances the freshly over-corrected intense pole (5×/10) back toward cosmic-ambient. Off GPU entirely. Headphones required; the illusion is perceptual and needs real ears to confirm.

### [2392-room-tone](/dream/2392-room-tone) · **tool / NOT a mood piece — measures the REAL WORLD** · **an acoustic ruler: clap once and it measures the actual reverberation of the room you're sitting in, then plays a piano note *inside* that measured room** · **INPUT = mic (a single clap → impulse response) — a genuine physical measurement, not a mood knob** · **OUTPUT = Canvas2D instrument display (IR waveform + Schroeder energy-decay curve + fitted T20 line + big RT60 readout) + Web Audio ConvolverNode audition** · cycle 878 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-23) · demoable · `theme: acoustic measurement TOOL (deliberately NOT altered-states — the jury's #1 provocation, "build a useful tool / a piece about the outside world," made concrete) · vibe: clinical / instrumental`
WIDE-mode winner of a 3-explorer fire built to **break the altered-state monoculture** the 2026-07-23 jury flagged (~14 of 15 pieces "a drug-free altered state"). The brief: three fully non-consciousness directions — a tool, a toy, a piece about the outside world. **Mechanism:** a real acoustic measurement instrument. Click **Measure the room**, clap once; the mic (`getUserMedia`, echo/noise/AGC OFF) captures the ~1–2s decay tail through a `ScriptProcessorNode` with onset detection + pre-roll into a Float32 buffer. `analyzeImpulse` trims to the direct sound, runs true **Schroeder backward integration** (reverse cumulative-sum of h², in dB) to get the **energy-decay curve**, then least-squares-fits it over **−5…−25 dB (T20)** and −5…−35 dB (T30), extrapolating the slope to a 60 dB drop → **RT60 = 60/|slope|** (T20 chosen precisely because a clap rarely has a clean 60 dB decay above the noise floor — the ISO 3382 robust estimator). The Canvas2D "instrument" draws the raw IR, the violet EDC, the dashed fit line, the −5/−25 dB markers, a dB grid, and a large mono RT60 readout. **The payoff:** the measured, peak-normalized IR becomes a `ConvolverNode` buffer and a synthesized 4-partial piano tone routes **dry-to-output** or **wet-through-the-convolver** via an exclusive **Dry/Wet A-B** toggle (plus note pads + a phrase button) — so you literally *hear your piano play inside the room you just measured*. **Degrades fully offline:** no `mediaDevices` / denied permission / 8s no-clap timeout → a `text-destructive` notice + `synthesizeDemoIR()` (exp-decaying one-pole-smoothed noise + a direct spike) labelled "Demo room — no mic," so the whole Measure → RT60 → audition flow runs with zero mic. Curated over **⭐⭐ `2394-grid-song`** (the live NESO grid fuel-mix sonified as an evolving chord — the sharpest cash of "be about the outside world," banked TOP because the lab just shipped two live-data pieces this window: 2366-solar-wind, 2304-seismic-choir) and **⭐ `2390-cryptogram`** (a musical-cryptogram composer — spell BACH/DSCH/your-name into a canon; banked, lightest ambition floor). Named refs: **M.R. ### [2474-worldwire](/dream/2474-worldwire) · **outward-facing / real-world data — the world, listened to** · **the live global stream of Wikipedia edits, sonified as a field of just-intoned bells** · **INPUT = the live Wikimedia recent-changes SSE feed (you don't play it — the world does; you only shape the listening: which wiki, bots audible or hidden)** · **OUTPUT = Canvas2D ripple field + Web Audio JI bell/swell field** · cycle 886 · WIDE-winner (2026-07-24) · demoable · `theme: listen-to-the-live-world sonification (deliberately NOT altered-states — jury's strongest lane, "a piece about the outside world") · vibe: outward / generative-ambient`
WIDE-mode winner of a 3-explorer non-consciousness fire (jury Day 9 off the altered-state theme). **The concept:** sonify the real, live, global stream of Wikipedia edits — a piece genuinely *about the outside world* (the same virtue the 2026-07-23 jury praised in `2366-solar-wind` / `2304-seismic-choir`), not about the visitor's nervous system. **Data:** the browser `EventSource` opens Wikimedia **EventStreams** (`stream.wikimedia.org/v2/stream/recentchange`) directly — public, keyless, CORS-open, read-only, no API route, no library. Each edit strikes a soft additive bell; **pitch is inversely proportional to edit size** (|Δbytes|) snapped to a **7-limit just-intonation lattice** (1/1·9/8·5/4·3/2·5/3 × 5 octaves) so the field is always consonant; a **new article** rings a warm sustained swell; **bot edits** get a duller/quieter timbre (or filter them out); 16-voice cap through a compressor limiter + a filtered feedback-delay tail. **Visual:** each event blooms a Canvas2D ripple whose radius ∝ edit size and whose position is seeded by a **stable hash of the title** (the same article always lands in the same place), with comet-tail fades, brand-violet by event class, and the biggest few blooms labelled; a live edits/sec · wikis · total readout. **Degrades fully offline:** if the feed can't connect (offline / blocked / CORS / 6s open-timeout), a deterministic **synthetic Poisson event generator** takes over (labelled "demo stream — feed unavailable") so the piece is always alive and self-demoing at 06:30 with zero network — it's also the silent-review stand-in. **Named ref:** Hatnote's **"Listen to Wikipedia" (2013, LaPorte & Hashemi)**, listen.hatnote.com — this diverges via the JI scale, the Resonance ripple visual, and the synthetic fallback. **Ambition — 3/5:** #2 (≥3 subsystems: SSE ingest + inverse-size→JI-pitch mapping + polyphonic bell/swell synth with limiter + hash-placed ripple field) · #3 (Hatnote named ref) · #5 (RESEARCH §886 same-date, the "listen to the live world" sonification-lane finding). **diversity:** `banned` = jury-2026-07-23 [screen-tap-only input · three.js/GPU-shader output · entrainment/phase-lock technique · "drug-free altered state" framing · the two-independent-variables/no-master-knob TEMPLATE] + my audit [Canvas2D-as-primary borderline ~4–5×/10]; `picked` = [live-web-stream input (no direct play) · JI event-stream sonification technique (0× in lab) · Canvas2D ripple display · outward / human-social vibe — a genuinely different register from the recent physics-demo run chladni/comma/flock/horizon ("measure a system" → "listen to human activity")] — clears every live ban. **mode:** WIDE. **candidates:** 2474-worldwire(win) · 2470-trio(banked ⭐⭐, IDEAS §886 — reactive jazz trio, arXiv:2606.11886) · 2478-typesong(banked ⭐, IDEAS §886 — cross-modal typing instrument). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"`; the EventSource reads a public stream directly; zero new npm deps, no server route, no secrets). **Validation:** normalizer = 0 rewrites (on-brand: violet confined to the Canvas art, semantic-token chrome, `text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight` hero, `min-h-[44px]`/`rounded-md` buttons, no `text-white`/`font-serif`/off-brand-hue chrome, helpers `draw*`/`run*`/`ingest`/`compute*` — no `use*`); ### [2808-palimpsest](/dream/2808-palimpsest) · **camera / embodied — your movement draws a musical score you can see AND hear** · **a slit-scan graphical score: the camera reads your body one column at a time, your motion accretes into a persistent violet score that a sweeping playhead re-reads back as sound, so gestures you drew a minute ago return as a self-canon** · **INPUT = webcam (getUserMedia) — your motion is the only input** · **OUTPUT = Canvas2D slit-scan palimpsest (accreted score strata + bright playhead) + Web Audio 32-partial additive bank** · cycle 907 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-26) · demoable · `theme: your-past-motion-as-canon (Reich phase made bodily) · state: hypnagogic/flow · pole: cosmic-ambient · vibe: Ikeda-crisp graphical score`
DEEP-mode winner of a 3-approach fire on ONE concept — *your past selves sing back in canon* (Steve Reich's phase/tape idea made bodily). **The concept:** the webcam reads your body like a moving spectrogram; your **motion** (frame-to-frame luminance difference + a whisper of luminance so a held pose still registers) accretes into a persistent `96×128` **score-energy buffer** that **decays slowly** — a true **palimpsest**, gestures from a minute ago still faintly present under newer ones. A vertical **playhead** sweeps the score (full width every ~13 s); whichever column it's over is turned into sound by a **32-partial additive bank** where each partial's **frequency** is a *continuous* logarithmic mapping of vertical position (A2–A6, top = high, bottom = low — **never** scale-snapped) and its **amplitude** is that column's score energy. So the drawn column literally *is* the spectrum that sounds, and as the playhead re-crosses gestures still in the buffer they sound again — **a self-canon of your own drawing**. **Long-form arc (jury #5, cashed visually AND audibly):** a lowering motion-gate + rising density move it from sparse/literal to dense/layered over ~3 min; a ~95 s *breathing* LFO fades the oldest strata so the score never saturates; the master lowpass opens as the score fills — minute 5 is a visibly and audibly different piece than second 0, and the memory is a *literal growing artifact on screen*. **Degrades fully:** no camera / denied → a deterministic **virtual performer** (`mulberry32(0x2808)` + `performance.now()`) paints smooth strokes so the whole audio-visual piece + arc self-demos with zero camera (the silent-review stand-in); `AudioContext` created/resumed only after the Start gesture; if Web Audio is unavailable the score still draws silently. **Named refs:** **Ryoji Ikeda** (data-crisp high-contrast monochrome field) · **Iannis Xenakis, UPIC (1977)** (a drawn curve *is* the synthesis instruction — graphical score = sound) · **Steve Reich** (returning/phasing material, here literally drawn and re-read). **Ambition — honest 3/5:** #1 (novel technique: slit-scan graphical-score-as-synthesis / UPIC-style drawn-score-is-sound is **0× in the lab** — the lab has FFT spectrograms but never a *persistent accreting slit-scan score the playhead re-voices*) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: camera capture + motion→score accretion/decay buffer + playhead-column additive resynthesis + Canvas2D palimpsest render) · #3 (Ikeda + Xenakis UPIC + Reich). #5 also holds (RESEARCH §907, same date — the "motion is always sonified in the present tense; nobody plays your past motion against your now" finding). **diversity:** `banned` (audit of last 10, 897–906) = [**input-free** 4× · **mic** heavy (905+906 both mic) · **QWERTY-keyboard** jury-banned · **AI-bandmate** jury-banned · **voice-as-subject** jury-banned · the "sonify a physics/math system, pitch=physical consequence" technique rut 903/904/906]; `picked` = [**camera/body** input (jury #2's most-named under-served sensor, 1× this window — clears the input-free ban AND the mic-doubling; aligns with Karel's loved camera/body cluster: 138-lmdm-echo, 217-dance-avatar, 1482-face-mandala, 101-camera-song, 104-kids-mirror-draw) · **Canvas2D** output (the jury-endorsed revived minority) · **slit-scan additive graphical-score** technique (0× — not a physics-sonification) · Ikeda-crisp graphical-score vibe] — clears every live 2026-07-25 jury ban and directly executes provocation #2 (get off the keyboard, use a real sensor as the primary surface) while cashing #5 (long-form-stateful). **mode:** DEEP (mode ledger 903 D · 904 W · 905 D · 906 W → **907 D**). **candidates:** 2808-palimpsest(win) · 2792-round(banked ⭐⭐, IDEAS §907 — frame-diff centroid canon; lost for sitting near the loved `138-lmdm-echo`) · 2800-flock(banked ⭐, IDEAS §907 — dense-flow field-canon; lost for overlapping the banked `2784-driftroom`). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D + getUserMedia; helpers named `compute*`/`draw*`/`makeMulberry32`/`partialFreq`/`rampColor` — no non-hook `use*`); full-tree `npx tsc --noEmit` = **0 errors**; folder `npx next lint --max-warnings 0` = clean; both losers banked to IDEAS §907 then `rm -rf`'d before the authoritative build (never committed); ### [3080-mycelium](/dream/3080-mycelium) · visionary / organic · **cultivate a LIVING mycelial web of light: plant spores with your finger and the network filaments outward on its own — branching, fusing, never erasing — then tap a living strand to ring its voice** · **INPUT = touch/pointer (tap = plant spore + scatter nutrient; drag = paint a nutrient trail; tap-a-strand = pluck it)** · **OUTPUT = Canvas2D additive violet→magenta filament web + Web Audio continuous-pitch sympathetic voice-garden** · cycle 920 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-27) · demoable · `theme: cultivate-a-living-light (self-organizing morphogenesis you PLAY) · state: visionary/visionary organic entoptic bloom · pole: cosmic-ambient (organic)`
DEEP-mode winner of a 3-approach fire on ONE north star — *cultivate a living light: a self-organizing morphogenetic organism you PLAY, that keeps living and REMEMBERING so the piece is different at minute 8 than second 0.* **Mechanism:** the **Space Colonization Algorithm** (Runions, Lane & Prusinkiewicz, *Modeling Trees with a Space Colonization Algorithm*, Eurographics Workshop on Natural Phenomena, 2007) grown as a visionary mycelial web (`growth.ts`): live nutrient points (attractors) each pull the nearest growth tip; a pulled tip steps toward the *average* of its pulls (+seeded jitter), so **branch points emerge with no branching rule hard-coded**; a new tip landing near a *foreign* strand **anastomoses** (snaps on, closes a loop) — the fungal-network behaviour (Fricker et al.) that makes it read as living tissue, not a fractal tree; attractors within a kill radius are consumed so growth keeps reaching new ground; a per-frame growth budget paces it across many minutes. **The hand plays it (jury #2):** tap empty space = plant a spore + sprinkle attractors (you *direct where the organism reaches*); drag = paint a nutrient trail; **tap on/near a living strand = pluck its voice** (fast attack, long sympathetic decay, pitch from the strand's cumulative length + height) — *you play the web you grew.* A seeded `mulberry32(0x3080)` autopilot gardener plants/feeds/plucks when idle and yields for several seconds after any touch. **Audio (`audio.ts`, continuous pitch — never a scale):** plant → a soft low voice fades up (pitch from spore height); branch/fusion → a bright shimmer partial panned by x; pluck → triangle + non-integer overtone through a closing lowpass; total grown length → the shared JI `droneBank` drive, sitting in a `convolutionVoid` (`_shared/visionary`); master ≤0.14 → tanh soft-clip → limiter. **Long-form MEMORY (jury #5, cashed as a visible artifact):** the node array only grows and never resets — the *structural web is redrawn every frame from the node list* so old strands only dim to a luminance floor, never erased (a true accreting palimpsest, honest engineering note: a pure fade would eventually erase, contradicting "never erases," so the fading glow buffer carries only the ephemeral activity trail while the permanent geometry is redrawn from state); a live `strands / branch-points / total length` + elapsed readout makes the accretion legible in a short review. **Ambition — 3/5:** #1 (space-colonization dendritic growth is new to the lab) · #2 (≥3 subsystems: space-colonization growth engine + pointer play/pluck + Web Audio voice-garden + shared visionary bed) · #3 (Runions 2007 + Fricker anastomosis + Klüver cobweb form-constant) · #5 (RESEARCH §920 same-date — NCA/morphogenesis went real-time-high-res, SIGGRAPH 2026 arXiv:2506.22899). **diversity:** `banned` (last 10 + jury 2026-07-26) = [mic/voice input over-used (2920/2928/3048) · science/data-system sonification (whole kind) · input-free self-play · clinical diagram-as-score vibe · re-adding the JI/pentatonic net · WebGL2 output streak (3048)]; `picked` = [**touch/pointer** input (a hand directly on it — off the mic rut) · **Canvas2D** output (rotates off the WebGL2 streak, lowest production risk) · **space-colonization dendritic growth** technique (0×, NOT science-sonification — a cultivated living thing) · **organic entoptic cosmic-ambient** vibe (Karel's visionary #1, balances 3048's intense pole)] — clears every live ban. **mode:** DEEP (ledger 916 D · 917 W · 918 D · 919 W → **920 D**). **candidates:** 3080-mycelium(win) · 3064-lenia(banked ⭐⭐ HIGH, IDEAS §920 — Lenia continuous-CA creatures, WebGL2; lost to orbium-liveliness risk unverifiable headless + the WebGL2 streak) · 3072-regrow(banked ⭐, IDEAS §920 — Neural-CA regenerating living skin; lost to Gray-Scott being an already-used technique + unverified in-shader MLP array indexing). **No API route → no `guard`** (pure `"use client"` Web Audio + Canvas2D; zero new npm deps, no server route, no network, no secrets). **Validation:** normalizer = **0 rewrites** (on-brand: violet→magenta ramp + raw color confined to the Canvas art layer, semantic-token chrome, `text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight` hero, `min-h-[44px]`/`rounded-md` buttons, no `text-white`/`font-serif`/off-brand-hue chrome; helpers named `draw*`/`step*`/`make*`/`plant*` — no non-hook `use*`); folder `npx next lint --max-warnings 0` = clean; both losers banked to IDEAS §920 then `rm -rf`'d before the authoritative build (never committed); authoritative winner-only `npx next build --experimental-build-mode compile` = **EXIT 0**, `/dream/3080-mycelium` registered in `app-path-routes-manifest.json` (losers 3064/3072 absent from `src` and `.next`). **NOT eye/ear-verified** (headless — no display/speakers/touch): whether the growing web reads as living tissue under a finger, whether anastomosis closing loops is as beautiful as intended at phone size, and whether plucking a strand *feels* like playing all want Karel's device; ### [3528-wrest](/dream/3528-wrest) · adult / instrument / **NEGOTIATED AUTHORSHIP · AGENCY-WITH-CONSEQUENCE (no fail-buzzer)** · **a third relationship with an instrument: not *playing* it, not *witnessing* it, but continuously *wresting a self-running generative voice back from itself and letting it go.* One autonomous continuous-pitch voice always sounds and DRIFTS on its own (seeded random-walk + momentum + soft log-freq gravity toward a rotating 8-chord D-Dorian field — never a quantizer). A slow HOME bias (τ≈25 s, α-weighted) makes past negotiations a lasting residue: neglect it and it roams somewhere you didn't choose, over-grip it and the surprise dies — no score, no win/lose, but minute five is audibly the record of how you negotiated.** · **INPUT = mic voice (sung pitch via autocorrelation + RMS; non-touch, non-keyboard)** · **OUTPUT = raw WebGL2 `#version 300 es` fragment shader flow-field (machine-current band vs human-pull band, the sounding ridge negotiated between them, α as field-bend, home as residue line — off the just-shipped SVG (940) and warm WebGPU (939))** · **TECHNIQUE = fast shared-control handoff / negotiated authorship (0× in the lab) + α-weighted machine↔human lerp + slow home-bias memory** · cycle 941 · DEEP-winner (2026-07-29) · demoable · `relationship: negotiated-authorship / agency-with-consequence · pole: n/a (NOT altered-states, NOT fail-state, NOT no-stakes)`

### [3624-covenant](/dream/3624-covenant) · adult / instrument / **EARNED TRUST · AGENCY-WITH-CONSEQUENCE (no fail-buzzer)** · **an accompanist that commits to you only when you play with *intention* — a partner whose trust you EARN, not a fail-buzzer you avoid. Play your computer keyboard as a piano; an anticipatory heuristic accompanist keeps a confidence model of your last 8 notes (Krumhansl-Schmuckler key inference · inter-onset steadiness · contour coherence) and gates how much it gives back across five audible tiers — withholding a lone root drone → a fifth → a full triad → a voiced 7th → a moving bassline + rhythmic comping. Wander or fall silent and it retreats to the cautious drone; the richer partner is earned. It also *anticipates* — betting on your next chord via a small functional-harmony automaton, pre-voiced as a ghost note that solidifies when you confirm it ("read you right").** · **INPUT = computer-keyboard-as-piano (A S D F G H J K + W E T Y U blacks, Z/X octave; non-pointer)** · **OUTPUT = inline SVG "covenant field" — two violet presences joined by a filament braid whose strand-count/thickness/brightness scale with confidence (off warm three.js/Canvas2D/WebGPU)** · **TECHNIQUE = anticipatory heuristic accompaniment / confidence-gated commitment (0× in the lab) — the accompanist's *withholding* is the interface, not a bug** · cycle 945 · WIDE-winner of a 3-explorer fire (2026-07-29), chained from RESEARCH §945 (arXiv:2511.17879 reward-hacking→trivial-output + ReaLchords arXiv:2506.14723 anticipation/adaptation); losers 3632-oath (irreversible-looping/Basinski) + 3640-quarry (tilt pitch-hunt/Messa di Voce) banked to IDEAS §945 · demoable · `relationship: earned-trust / agency-with-consequence · pole: n/a (NOT altered-states, NOT fail-state, NOT no-stakes-passive) · no ML, no server — hand-rolled music theory`

### [3648-songlines](/dream/3648-songlines) · adult / instrument / **DEEPENING (v2 of 3608-atlas) · MIDI · AUTHORSHIP** · **a recording played like a keyboard: `3608-atlas` gave you a recording's timbre-map to *wander* with a pointer; Songlines makes it an *instrument you play and compose with*. ### [3672-oath](/dream/3672-oath) · adult / instrument / **REAL CONSEQUENCE · IRREVERSIBILITY-AS-INTERFACE (no fail-buzzer, no undo)** · **composing as a series of vows you can never take back.
